people/baseline-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisch, in warmem Seitenlicht: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Ruderboot am Kiesstrand, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt sie fest. Dahinter Meer, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/baseline-1.alt_en: Photorealistic, warm light: a grey-haired woman presses a new plank onto an upturned rowing boat on pebbles; a young man in a knitted cap nails it. Behind: jetty, two gulls.

problems: Minor: the hammer is aimed at the seam just above the new plank, and the man's free hand steadies the hull instead of visibly holding a nail; it still reads as nailing.
Minor: the young man crouches behind the woman's shoulder rather than clearly beside her, so his lanky build is partly hidden.
people/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisch unter grauem Himmel: Eine alte Frau mit Schürze drückt eine helle Planke an den Rumpf eines umgedrehten Ruderboots, ein junger Mann mit Mütze hämmert. Daneben Werkzeugkiste, Seil, Nageldose.
people/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic, overcast: an old woman in an apron presses a pale plank onto an upturned rowing boat; a young man in a beanie hammers. Toolbox, rope, nail tin beside.

problems: Drifts toward a 19th-century wood engraving or scratchboard illustration: dense, very fine hatching and naturalistically modelled faces and hands instead of the chunky, simplified knife-cut forms of a 16th-century black-line woodcut.
No wood-grain streaks in the solid blacks and hardly any worn-block breaks; the ink is even rather than hand-burnished.
Only the background hills and the ruled border have the bold, crude woodcut cutting the style asks for.
Minor: the new plank is barely set apart from the old planking.
people/woodcut-1.note_de: Zu fein und naturalistisch schraffiert: Das Bild wirkt eher wie ein späterer Holzstich als wie ein kräftiger Holzschnitt des 16. Jahrhunderts.
people/woodcut-1.note_en: Too finely hatched and naturalistic: it reads more like a later wood engraving than a bold 16th-century woodcut.
people/woodcut-1.alt_de: Fein schraffierter Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf warmem Papier: Eine alte Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt, dahinter Steg und Möwen.
people/woodcut-1.alt_en: Finely hatched black woodcut on warm paper: an old woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank, a young man in a knitted cap nails it. Jetty, two gulls.

problems: Gaze goes clearly off to the side rather than 'just past the viewer' (minor)
Nose crookedness barely perceptible (minor)
portrait/baseline-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisches Porträt im Abendlicht: Ein bärtiger Fährmechaniker mit Strickmütze und ausgefranster Jacke hält einen angeschlagenen Emaillebecher, Pflaster am Daumen, hinter ihm eine unscharfe Fähre.
portrait/baseline-1.alt_en: Photorealistic portrait at dusk: a bearded ferry mechanic in a knitted cap and frayed jacket holds a chipped enamel mug, a plaster on his thumb, a blurred ferry behind.

motif_missing: plaster is on the left index finger (through the mug handle), not on a thumb
problems: Plaster on index finger instead of thumb; thumb rests bare on top of the handle
Nose crookedness barely perceptible (minor)
portrait/baseline-2-1.note_de: Das Pflaster sitzt am Zeigefinger statt am Daumen.
portrait/baseline-2-1.note_en: The plaster is on the index finger, not the thumb.
portrait/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisches Porträt auf einem Fährdeck bei Sonnenuntergang: Ein Mann mit grauem Bart, Strickmütze und verschmutzter Arbeitsjacke hält einen rostfleckigen Emaillebecher, ein Finger trägt ein Pflaster.
portrait/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic portrait on a ferry deck at sunset: a man with a grey beard, knitted cap and grimy work jacket holds a rust-spotted enamel mug, one finger plastered.

motif_missing: scar is through his right eyebrow (viewer's left, near side), not his left
problems: Very fine, dense hatching reads as 19th-century wood engraving or scratchboard rather than a chunky, simplified 16th-century black-line woodcut
Face is modelled with near-photographic tonal hatching, which the style block says to avoid
No wood-grain streaks in the solid blacks and little sign of block wear
Scar on the wrong eyebrow
portrait/woodcut-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie feiner Holzstich als wie grober Holzschnitt, und die Narbe sitzt an der falschen Braue.
portrait/woodcut-1.note_en: Reads more like fine wood engraving than a bold woodcut, and the scar is on the wrong eyebrow.
portrait/woodcut-1.alt_de: Holzschnitt mit dichter Schraffur in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Ein bärtiger Mechaniker mit Strickmütze und Narbe über der Braue hält einen angeschlagenen Becher, dahinter Reling, Poller und Wasser.
portrait/woodcut-1.alt_en: Woodcut with dense black hatching on yellowish paper: a bearded mechanic in a knitted cap, a scar above his brow, holds a chipped mug; behind him railing, bollard and water.

motif_missing: plaster is on the right index finger, not on a thumb
scar is at his right eyebrow (viewer's left), not his left
problems: Face and hands are photographically detailed under a texture overlay; looks like a watercolour filter on a photo rather than real wet-in-wet painting
Splash-and-drip vignette edge is the generic AI 'watercolour splash' look; blooms and granulation are mostly confined to the periphery
Fingers of his left hand are lumpy and sausage-like, with two fingers curling oddly below the mug base (minor)
Plaster on index finger instead of thumb
Scar on the wrong eyebrow
portrait/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.note_de: Gesicht und Hände wirken wie ein Foto unter Aquarellfilter, und das Pflaster sitzt am Zeigefinger statt am Daumen.
portrait/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.note_en: Face and hands look like a photo under a watercolour filter, and the plaster is on a finger, not the thumb.
portrait/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_de: Aquarell mit verlaufenden Rändern und Farbtropfen auf weißem Papier: Ein bärtiger Mann mit Strickmütze und blauer Arbeitsjacke hält einen Emaillebecher, im Hintergrund ein Schiffsdeck im Abendlicht.
portrait/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_en: Watercolour bleeding and dripping into white paper: a bearded man in a knitted cap and blue work jacket holds an enamel mug, a ship's deck at dusk behind.

problems: Arrows only link 1→2, 3→4 and 5→6; the row changes 2→3 and 4→5 rely on the numbering alone (still unambiguous)
Cloth arches around the back of the bowl rather than lying over the dough (minor)
infographic/baseline-1.alt_de: Warm aquarellierte Infografik im Standardstil des Modells: sechs abgerundete Bildkarten mit roten Ziffern – Hand sät Körner, Weizen und Sichel, Mühlstein mit Mehlsack, knetende Hände, Teig unter Tuch, Brot im Ofen.
infographic/baseline-1.alt_en: Default-look painted infographic: six rounded cards with red numbers – hand sowing seeds, wheat and sickle, millstone and flour sack, kneading hands, covered dough, bread in oven.

infographic/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Aquarellartige Infografik im Standardstil des Modells: sechs Bildkarten mit braunen Ziffern, verbunden durch geschwungene Pfeile – Aussaat, Weizen mit Sichel, Mühlstein, Kneten, Teig in blau gestreifter Schüssel, Brot im Ofen.
infographic/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Watercolour-like infographic in the model's default style: six picture cards with brown numbers linked by curved arrows – sowing, wheat and sickle, millstone, kneading, dough in striped bowl, bread in oven.

problems: Fine stippling on dough and bread leans toward wood engraving / pen-and-ink rather than chunky 16th-century black-line woodcut
Arrows are crisp, vector-like shapes laid across the gutters; only 1→2, 3→4, 5→6 have arrows (order still clear from numbering)
infographic/woodcut-1.note_de: Auf dem Mehlsack steht praktisch ohne Leerzeichen „500g“ statt „500 g“.
infographic/woodcut-1.note_en: The flour sack reads '500g' with almost no space instead of '500 g'.
infographic/woodcut-1.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Titeltafel und sechs gerahmte Felder mit Schriftbändern – säende Hand, Weizen und Sichel, Mühlstein mit Mehlsack, knetende Hände, Teig unter Tuch, Brot im Backofen.
infographic/woodcut-1.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper: framed title panel and six panels with scroll banners – sowing hand, wheat and sickle, millstone and flour sack, kneading hands, covered dough, bread in oven.
text_errors: expected '500 g', found '500g': the gap between '500' and 'g' is about 5-6 px against 1-2 px between the digits, so it is a hairline at most and reads as no space at normal size

problems: Paint handling looks like a uniform mottled digital-watercolour texture rather than true wet-in-wet bleeding; few real blooms or backruns, focal areas evenly over-worked
Layout keeps the tidy 2x3 grid of the default look instead of a scattered sketchbook page; the baselines are already watercolour-like, so the style barely changes the information architecture
Added Tuscan-style hill landscape with cypresses and farmhouse in the header (generic, not a real landmark)
infographic/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.note_de: Die Malweise wirkt eher wie glattes Digital-Aquarell als Nass-in-Nass, und das Raster bleibt nah am Standardlook.
infographic/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.note_en: The paint looks more like tidy digital watercolour than wet-in-wet, and the grid stays close to the default look.
infographic/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_de: Rahmenloses Aquarell mit auslaufenden Rändern: Pinseltitel über Hügellandschaft, darunter sechs Szenen – Aussaat, Weizen mit Sichel, Mühle mit Mehlsack, Kneten, Teig unter Tuch, Brot im Ofen –, verbunden durch Sepia-Pfeile.
infographic/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_en: Frameless watercolour with bleeding edges: brush-lettered title above hills, then six scenes – sowing, wheat and sickle, mill with flour sack, kneading, covered dough, bread in oven – linked by sepia arrows.

motif_missing: village has roughly eight to nine houses plus a chapel and extra farmhouses on the left slope instead of five or six small houses
problems: oversized village contradicts the 'five or six small houses' count
tree trunk is upright or leans slightly away from the river; only the canopy reaches toward it
textbook AI default look: golden-hour backlight, HDR saturation, Dolomite-like snow peaks, wildflower foreground
landscape/baseline-1.note_de: Das Dorf ist mit rund neun Häusern deutlich größer als vorgegeben.
landscape/baseline-1.note_en: The village is much larger than specified, with about nine houses.
landscape/baseline-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisch im goldenen Abendlicht: Holzbank unter einem alten Baum, darunter ein Fluss mit steinerner Bogenbrücke und Steindorf mit Kapelle, links Weinterrassen, hinten schroffe Schneegipfel.
landscape/baseline-1.alt_en: Photorealistic golden evening light: a wooden bench under an old tree, a river with a stone arch bridge and stone village with chapel, vine terraces left, snowy jagged peaks behind.

problems: typical AI default look: warm backlight, saturated HDR colour, turquoise water, Dolomite-like peaks, wildflower foreground
landscape/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisch im warmen Gegenlicht: Holzbank unter knorrigem Baum, darunter ein türkiser Fluss mit Steinbogenbrücke, rechts ein Steindorf mit Kapelle, links Weinterrassen, hinten zackige Berge im Dunst.
landscape/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic in warm backlight: a wooden bench under a gnarled tree above a turquoise river with a stone arch bridge, stone village and chapel right, vine terraces left, hazy jagged peaks.

problems: linework is fine and detailed, closer to a 19th-century wood engraving or pen illustration than chunky 16th-century black-line woodcut
deep atmospheric recession with lighter, thinner lines on the distant mountains instead of a shallow stage-like space
almost no solid blacks with wood-grain streaks, no visible laid-paper texture
landscape/woodcut-1.note_de: Zu feine Linien und zu viel Raumtiefe – das wirkt eher wie ein späterer Holzstich als wie ein grober Holzschnitt des 16. Jahrhunderts.
landscape/woodcut-1.note_en: Lines too fine and space too deep: it reads more like a later wood engraving than a chunky 16th-century woodcut.
landscape/woodcut-1.alt_de: Schwarzer Holzschnitt mit Rahmenlinie auf cremefarbenem Papier: Bank unter knorrigem Baum, Fluss mit Steinbogenbrücke und Wanderer, Dorf mit Kapelle, links Terrassen, rechts Nadelwald, hinten zackige Berge.
landscape/woodcut-1.alt_en: Black-line woodcut with ruled border on cream paper: a bench under a gnarled tree, river with stone arch bridge and walker, village with chapel, terraces left, pine forest right, jagged mountains.

problems: Typical model-default product render: warm side light, wooden tabletop, blurred houseplant, olive retro radio. A good baseline.
Left handle bracket seems to rest on the top surface while the right one pivots on the side face. This is a minor inconsistency in how the handle is mounted and is not a defect worth failing.
Square 1254x1254 matches the requested 1024x1024. No logo, brand mark or watermark.
product/baseline-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisches Produktbild: olivgrünes Kofferradio mit gelochtem Metallgitter, großem Senderknopf, Skalenfenster und zwei Knöpfen, ausgezogene Antenne, auf Holztisch im warmen Licht, dahinter unscharf eine Pflanze.
product/baseline-1.alt_en: Photorealistic product shot: an olive-green portable radio with a perforated metal grille, large tuning dial, tick-mark window and two knobs, antenna raised, on a wooden table in warm light.

problems: Typical model-default product render that is almost identical to baseline-1 (same palette, table, plant and lighting). That sameness is what the baseline should show.
The tuning dial has an extra tick ring around it. This is acceptable because the frequency window itself shows only tick marks.
Square format is correct. No logo or watermark.
product/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisches Produktbild: Kofferradio mit dunkelgrünem Gehäuse und champagnerfarbener Front, gelochtem Gitter, Senderknopf mit Skalenring, zwei Knöpfen und schräger Antenne, auf Holztisch im Abendlicht.
product/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic product shot: dark green radio with champagne front, perforated grille, ringed tuning dial, two knobs and angled antenna, on a wooden table in warm evening light.

problems: Convincing black relief print on warm off-white paper. It has a ruled border, a shallow stage, wood-plank hatching and a hatched contact shadow.

The hatching is finer and more regular than chunky 16th-century black-line woodcut, and the dial's concentric lines lean toward wood engraving or scratchboard. There are few solid blacks with wood-grain streaks, and no visible laid-paper lines.

All controls are present and match the brief: a grille on the left half, one large dial, a tick-only window and two knobs. The handle and the partly extended, angled antenna are present. Square format is correct. No logo.
product/woodcut-1.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier mit Linienrahmen: Ein Kofferradio mit gelochtem Gitter, großem Drehknopf, Skala und zwei Knöpfen steht auf schraffiertem Holztisch, die Antenne schräg ausgezogen.
product/woodcut-1.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper inside a ruled border: a portable radio with dotted grille, large dial, tick-mark window and two knobs on a hatched wooden table, antenna angled up.

problems: The radio is rendered tightly and almost photographically: crisp, regular grille holes, a metallic dial with highlights and fine rust detail. A uniform pebbly digital watercolour texture lies over everything, which is the filter-like 'clean digital watercolour' look the style block says to avoid.
Real wet-in-wet behaviour (blooms, backruns, granulation, drips, dissolving vignette) appears mainly at the edges and in the backdrop, not in the focal object.

All motif controls are present: grille on the left half, large dial, tick-only window, two knobs, handle and angled antenna. The Mediterranean backdrop with cypresses and a sailboat is the style's choice of staging. It is generic and shows no real landmark.
Square format is correct. No logo or signature.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.note_de: Das Radio wirkt wie ein Foto unter einem Aquarellfilter, nur die Ränder sind wirklich nass in nass gemalt.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.note_en: The radio looks like a photo under a watercolour filter; only the edges are truly painted wet-in-wet.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_de: Aquarell, das an den Rändern ins weiße Papier ausläuft: ein rostiges, verblichenes Kofferradio auf einer Steinmauer, dahinter Zypressen, Meer und ein Segelboot, unten laufen Farbtropfen herab.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_en: Watercolour fading into white paper at the edges: a rusty, weathered portable radio on a stone wall, with cypresses, sea and a sailboat behind and paint drips below.

problems: Typical default AI poster look: teal/orange sunset, giant sun disc, silhouette trumpeter, red-roofed keeper's house beside a white lighthouse
Trumpeter is a semi-transparent silhouette that fades into the clouds (deliberate merge, allowed); only the valve hand is readable, but no anatomy error
Portrait 1024x1536 correct; no logo, signature or real landmark
poster/baseline-1.alt_de: Plakat im typischen KI-Look in Orange und Nachtblau: Die Silhouette eines Trompeters mit Hut verschmilzt mit dem Himmel, dahinter eine riesige Sonne über einer Felsinsel mit Leuchtturm.
poster/baseline-1.alt_en: Poster in the typical AI look, orange and navy: a hatted trumpeter's silhouette fades into the sky before a huge sun above a rocky island with a lighthouse.

problems: Typical default AI retro-travel-poster look: grainy digital painting, navy/orange palette, huge textured sun disc, lighthouse with red-roofed house
Trumpeter's coat continues downward into a dark cliff standing in the sea (deliberate merge, slightly confusing but allowed by the motif)
Hands and trumpet anatomically plausible; portrait format correct; no logo, signature or real landmark
poster/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Digital gemaltes Retroplakat in Orange und Dunkelblau: Ein Trompeter mit Hut, dessen Mantel in eine Klippe übergeht, rechts eine riesige Sonne über einer Felsinsel mit Leuchtturm.
poster/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Digitally painted retro poster in orange and navy: a trumpeter in a hat whose coat turns into a sea cliff, beside a huge sun above a lighthouse island.

problems: Convincing relief print: knife-cut black lines, parallel hatching, worn uneven ink on warm off-white paper, ruled black border, text in scroll banners
Lettering is 19th-century slab-serif wood type rather than 16th-century roman capitals or blackletter; no visible wood-grain streaks in the solid blacks
Lighthouse landmass runs into the right border, so it reads more as a headland than a clearly bounded small island (cropping is allowed)
Valve hand slightly mushy at close range but reads correctly; portrait format correct; no signature or logo
poster/woodcut-1.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Ein Trompeter mit Hut sitzt auf Felsen am Meer, gegenüber eine Insel mit Leuchtturm unter strahlender Sonne; Schrift in Spruchbändern.
poster/woodcut-1.alt_en: Black woodcut on warm off-white paper: a trumpeter in a hat sits on seaside rocks facing a lighthouse island under a rayed sun; lettering in carved scroll banners.

problems: Recognisable wet-in-wet watercolour: bleeding sky washes, blooms, splatters and drips, granulating blues and earth tones, vignette dissolving into bare paper at left and bottom
Headline painted as even multicoloured display capitals rather than sepia handwriting on an uneven baseline; no sketchbook notes or hand-drawn arrows
Figure and lighthouse are rendered fairly tightly, partly wet-on-dry, slightly towards a polished AI-watercolour look; composition and sunset palette close to the baseline
Hands holding the trumpet are mushy on close inspection (far hand a shapeless fist) but read plausibly at normal size; portrait format correct; no signature or logo
poster/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_de: Nass-in-Nass-Aquarell mit Farbläufen und Spritzern: Ein Trompeter mit Hut sitzt auf einem Felsen, gegenüber eine Leuchtturminsel vor tief stehender Sonne; die Ränder verlaufen ins Papierweiß.
poster/watercolor-wet-in-wet-1.alt_en: Wet-in-wet watercolour with bleeds and drips: a trumpeter in a hat sits on a rock facing a lighthouse island and low sun; the edges dissolve into bare paper.

motif_missing: Figures are not tiny: each is roughly a third to half of the cup's height, so the scale contrast that carries the idea is weak
problems: Textbook default AI look: photoreal, golden-hour backlight, shallow depth of field, cinematic hilltop panorama
Glue carrier walks toward the cup from several metres away instead of standing at the base
The oversized needle is stuck in the porcelain like a rod; the ladder figure only handles the thread
Rim figure sits in the upper third (top right); the headline space on the left stays free
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no logos, watermarks or anatomy errors found in close crops
editorial/baseline-1.note_de: Die Figuren sind nicht winzig, der Größenkontrast zur Tasse fällt schwach aus.
editorial/baseline-1.note_en: The figures are not tiny, so the scale contrast with the cup is weak.
editorial/baseline-1.alt_de: Fotorealistischer KI-Standardlook im Abendlicht: Drei Menschen reparieren eine riesige, gesprungene Porzellantasse mit blauem Blumendekor – einer näht auf der Leiter, einer lässt einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau trägt eine Klebstofftube.
editorial/baseline-1.alt_en: Photorealistic default AI look, golden evening light: three people mend a giant cracked blue-and-white teacup – stitching from a ladder, lowering a bucket, carrying a glue tube.

motif_missing: Figures are not tiny: each is roughly a third of the cup's height, so the scale contrast is weak
The ladder figure's 'oversized needle' reads as a small flat blade or knife, not a clear needle
problems: Textbook default AI look: photoreal daylight, fluffy clouds, crisp hyperdetail, soft background blur
Rim figure sits top centre, right inside the upper-third headline space, and the clouds make that area busy
Stitching shows as rope laces across the crack, which works
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no logos, watermarks or anatomy errors found in close crops
editorial/baseline-2-1.note_de: Die Figuren sind nicht winzig, und die Nadel wirkt eher wie ein Messer.
editorial/baseline-2-1.note_en: The figures are not tiny, and the needle looks more like a knife.
editorial/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistischer KI-Standardlook, Tageslicht mit Wolken: Drei Menschen flicken eine riesige, gesprungene Tasse mit blauen Blumen – einer näht auf der Leiter, einer lässt einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau schleppt eine Klebstofftube.
editorial/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic default AI look, bright daylight with clouds: three people mend a giant cracked blue-flowered teacup – stitching from a ladder, lowering a bucket from the rim, hauling a glue tube.

problems: Building reads as fairly wide rather than narrow (minor)
Lane slope is not clearly shown; the woman walks toward the viewer, so 'up the slope' is only implied (minor, acceptable)
street/baseline-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisch, goldenes Licht: Eckbäckerei mit grün gestreifter Markise und Brezelschild, Hund an der Bank, oben eine Frau mit Teppich im Fenster, rechts eine Frau, die ihr Rad mit Brot schiebt.
street/baseline-1.alt_en: Photorealistic, golden light: yellow corner bakery with green-striped awning and pretzel sign, dog by the bench, a woman shaking out a rug upstairs, another pushing a bicycle with bread.

problems: Building reads as fairly wide rather than narrow (minor)
Bicycle geometry slightly ambiguous at full resolution (bread basket sits over the near wheel with rear reflector), plausible as a rear basket and not noticeable at normal size
street/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisch, sonnig: Eckbäckerei mit rot-weiß gestreifter Markise und Brezelschild, Hund an der Bank, oben schüttelt eine Frau einen Teppich aus, eine andere schiebt ihr Rad mit Brot die Gasse hinauf.
street/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic, sunny: corner bakery with red-and-white striped awning and pretzel sign, dog by the bench, a woman shaking a rug upstairs, another pushing a bicycle with bread up the lane.

food/baseline-1.alt_de: Warmes, fotorealistisches Food-Foto: Auf einem rustikalen Holztisch liegen ein angeschnittenes Krustenbrot mit Brotmesser und eine Schale Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale. Dazu Butter, Basilikum, Rispentomaten und ein Leinentuch. Eine Hand reißt Brot ab.
food/baseline-1.alt_en: Warm photorealistic food shot: a cut crusty loaf with bread knife and a bowl of tomato soup with a cream swirl on a rustic wooden table, butter, basil, vine tomatoes, linen napkin, a hand tearing bread.

food/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Fotorealistisches Food-Foto in warmem Seitenlicht: Krustenbrot mit zwei Scheiben und Brotmesser auf dem Brett, daneben Tomatensuppe mit Sahne und Löffel, Butter, Basilikum, Rispentomaten und Leinentuch. Eine Hand reißt Brot ab.
food/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Photorealistic food shot in warm side light: crusty loaf with two slices and bread knife on a board, tomato soup with cream and spoon, butter, basil, vine tomatoes, linen napkin, a hand tearing bread.

problems: Fish anatomy glitch: the upper mandible runs diagonally across the fish's body, so the fish looks speared rather than gripped between the mandibles
Fish has a superfluous translucent fin sticking out in front of its snout, plus a cluster of spiky dorsal fins
Neck is held in an S-curve with the head angled down rather than clearly stretched forward (minor)
Ripple rings centre on the splash under the fish rather than spreading from the legs; legs only have small rings (acceptable)
Typical default look: hyper-crisp golden-hour wildlife photo, shallow depth of field, saturated greens, frozen droplets
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no watermark, signature or logo found
animal/baseline-1.note_de: Der Fisch wirkt vom Schnabel durchbohrt und hat überzählige Flossen.
animal/baseline-1.note_en: The fish looks speared through by the beak and has extra fins.
animal/baseline-1.alt_de: Gestochen scharfes Naturfoto in warmem Licht: Ein Graureiher steht im flachen Fluss und packt einen zappelnden Fisch, Tropfen spritzen, links Schilf mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter.
animal/baseline-1.alt_en: Crisp, warm-lit photorealistic wildlife shot: a grey heron standing in a shallow river seizes a wriggling fish amid flying droplets; reeds with a dragonfly and lily pads on the left.

problems: Neck folded in a tight S-curve with the fish already lifted above the water, more 'just caught' than 'stretched forward at the strike' (minor drift, acceptable)
Fish has a somewhat busy row of yellow fins but reads as a plausible fish held crosswise in the beak
Composition nearly identical to baseline-1 (same heron pose, reeds and dragonfly upper left, lily pads lower left), which illustrates the default sameness
Typical default look: smooth photorealism, summer light, bokeh background, saturated greens, frozen droplets
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); legs anatomically plausible; no watermark, signature or logo found
animal/baseline-2-1.alt_de: Glattes, fotorealistisches Naturbild im Sommerlicht: Ein Graureiher hebt einen Fisch aus dem Wasser, Tropfen fallen in Wasserringe, links Schilf, Seerosenblätter und eine Libelle auf der Halmspitze.
animal/baseline-2-1.alt_en: Smooth photorealistic nature image in summer light: a grey heron lifts a fish from the water, droplets falling into ripple rings; reeds, lily pads and a dragonfly on the left.

problems: Gaze goes slightly past the viewer rather than clearly back over the shoulder; head is turned three-quarters toward camera, so the glance reads but weakly

people/painted-wooden-toy-1.note_de: Die Figuren wirken geschnitzt und naturalistisch statt gedrechselt, das Meer fast fotografisch.
people/painted-wooden-toy-1.note_en: The figures look carved and naturalistic rather than lathe-turned, and the sea looks almost photographic.
people/painted-wooden-toy-1.alt_de: Bemalte Holzfiguren mit roten Bäckchen auf einem Brett: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze hämmert einen Nagel ein, dahinter Steg und Möwen.
people/painted-wooden-toy-1.alt_en: Red-cheeked painted wooden figures on a board: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat, a young man in a knitted cap hammers a nail; jetty and gulls behind.

problems: Background jetty and sea noticeably out of focus - modern shallow depth of field instead of stopped-down deep focus
Overall tonality reads as a uniform sepia photo filter with vignette rather than a dye-bathed nitrate print; blacks are mid-brown
Faces rendered with modern photographic clarity; few scratches, little uneven dye density
Woman's kneeling pose hidden behind the hull; her hair tousled, medium length rather than clearly short
people/tinted-and-toned-silent-film-1.note_de: Der Hintergrund ist unscharf wie in moderner Fotografie, die Färbung wirkt eher wie ein Sepiafilter.
people/tinted-and-toned-silent-film-1.note_en: The background is blurred like modern photography, and the colouring looks more like a sepia filter.
people/tinted-and-toned-silent-film-1.alt_de: Bernsteinfarben getöntes Stummfilmbild mit abgerundeten Ecken: Ein junger Mann mit Mütze hält Nagel und Hammer, eine alte Frau drückt eine Planke aufs umgedrehte Boot, dahinter Steg mit Möwen.
people/tinted-and-toned-silent-film-1.alt_en: Amber-tinted silent-film frame with rounded corners: a young man in a cap holds nail and hammer, an old woman presses a plank onto the upturned boat; jetty with gulls behind.

problems: Only two figures, no stacked smaller figures; less crowded than typical muralist composition
Faces and sea modelled somewhat naturalistically; contours not very firm
Woman's kneeling pose hidden behind the hull
people/mexican-muralism-1.alt_de: Wandfresko in Erdtönen mit feinen Rissen: Eine kräftige alte Frau drückt eine Planke auf das umgedrehte rote Boot, ein junger Mann nagelt sie fest, dahinter Brandung und Steg.
people/mexican-muralism-1.alt_en: Wall fresco in earth tones with fine cracks: a sturdy old woman presses a plank onto the upturned red boat while a young man nails it; surf and jetty behind.

problems: Figures are not solid black cut card: faces, hair, clothing folds and boat wood grain are drawn and shaded inside the dark shapes (explicitly avoided)
Young man's face shown in three-quarter view with modelled features, not strict profile
Backlit glittering amber sea reads like a sunset-photo silhouette / graphic illustration rather than layered paper backgrounds
No single black ground line frieze; pebble field rendered in depth
Ruin-like buildings on the distant island (generic, not identifiable)
people/silhouette-animation-1.note_de: Die Figuren sind schattiert und haben gezeichnete Gesichter statt massiver schwarzer Scherenschnitte.
people/silhouette-animation-1.note_en: The figures are shaded with drawn faces instead of solid black paper cut-outs.
people/silhouette-animation-1.alt_de: Dunkle Silhouetten vor bernsteinfarbenem Meer, von Pflanzenranken gerahmt: Eine alte Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze hämmert, links ein Steg mit zwei Möwen.
people/silhouette-animation-1.alt_en: Dark silhouettes against an amber sea, framed by plant tendrils: an old woman kneels at an upturned boat, a young man in a cap hammers; jetty with gulls.

motif_missing: young man looks about 35 (stubble, lined face), not about 20
problems: Wrong age for the young man - the motif explicitly tests age
Smooth modern digital monochrome with rich midtones instead of hard, grainy 1920s gelatin-silver contrast
Partly a tilted-frame effect; jetty background slightly soft
Woman's hair tousled, not clearly short
people/new-vision-1.note_de: Der junge Mann wirkt eher wie Mitte dreißig als wie zwanzig.
people/new-vision-1.note_en: The young man looks closer to 35 than to 20.
people/new-vision-1.alt_de: Schwarzweißfoto, steil von oben und schräg angeschnitten: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein Mann mit Strickmütze hämmert; Steg, Möwen, glitzerndes Wasser.
people/new-vision-1.alt_en: Black-and-white photo shot steeply from above on a diagonal: a grey-haired woman kneels pressing a plank to an upturned boat, a man in a knitted cap hammers; jetty and gulls.

motif_missing: young man nails an old dark hull plank near the keel, not the new plank the woman is pressing
problems: Reads as a hyper-sharp modern HDR photo/render with gritty over-detailed textures, not a 1940s dye-transfer film frame
No built studio set or painted backdrop sky: real-looking exterior with natural clouds and cliffs
No dense jewel colours or single saturated accent; palette is muted browns, greys and blue
Side light with textured shadows instead of flat high-key frontal carbon-arc lighting
Format 1536x1024 landscape correct; hands and anatomy fine; no logos or landmarks
people/three-strip-technicolor-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein überscharfes modernes HDR-Foto statt wie ein Technicolor-Studiobild der 1940er: keine Kulisse, keine Juwelenfarben.
people/three-strip-technicolor-1.note_en: Looks like a hyper-sharp modern HDR photo, not a 1940s Technicolor studio frame: no painted set, no jewel colours.
people/three-strip-technicolor-1.alt_de: Überscharfes Farbbild im HDR-Look: Eine alte Frau drückt eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze hämmert; dahinter Steg, Möwen und Meer.
people/three-strip-technicolor-1.alt_en: Hyper-sharp colour photo with gritty textures: an old woman presses a new plank onto an upturned boat, a young man in a knit cap hammers; jetty, gulls and sea behind.

problems: Faces are drawn with lines for eyes, brows and wrinkles instead of being a few cut pieces
Spatial depth: boat, pebbles and coastline recede in perspective instead of flat colour fields
Built from many small mosaic-like pieces in a modern editorial-collage manner rather than big Matisse-style silhouettes on two or three butted colour rectangles
No scattered leaf/star/seaweed rhythm shapes; central hero composition
Gouache brush streaks and scissor contours are convincing; hands fine; generic Mediterranean village, no real landmark
people/cut-paper-collage-1.note_de: Gezeichnete Gesichter und Raumtiefe lassen das Bild eher wie eine moderne Collage-Illustration wirken als wie ein Scherenschnitt von 1950.
people/cut-paper-collage-1.note_en: Drawn facial features and spatial depth make it read as a modern collage illustration rather than a 1950 gouache cut-out.
people/cut-paper-collage-1.alt_de: Collage aus gouachebemalten Papierstücken: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine gelbe Planke auf ein rotes, umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann nagelt sie fest; Kiesel, Steg, Möwen, Dorf am Hang.
people/cut-paper-collage-1.alt_en: Cut-paper collage of gouache-painted pieces: a grey-haired woman presses a yellow plank onto a red upturned boat, a young man nails it; pebbles, jetty, gulls, hillside village.

motif_missing: woman presses the plank with only one visible hand instead of both
problems: Drawn with adult skill: correct proportions, foreshortened crouching and kneeling poses, five-fingered hands, facial wrinkles, boots - the faux-naive adult look the style block forbids
Overlap and depth everywhere (woman behind boat, pebbles receding, boat in three-quarter view) instead of things standing side by side on a ground line
No green ground line; the whole lower half is a pebble field
Crayon medium itself is convincing (streaky wax strokes, paper white, sky strip, rayed corner sun)
Format correct; no logos
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-1.note_de: Mit erwachsenem Können gezeichnet – korrekte Anatomie, Perspektive, Überschneidungen –, daher nicht wie das Bild eines Sechsjährigen.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-1.note_en: Drawn with adult skill (correct anatomy, perspective, overlaps), so it does not look like a six-year-old's drawing.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-1.alt_de: Wachsmalkreide auf weißem Papier mit Sonne in der Ecke: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet und hält eine Planke ans braune Boot, ein junger Mann hämmert; Werkzeugkiste, Seil, Nageldose, Steg, Möwen.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-1.alt_en: Wax-crayon drawing on white paper with corner sun: a grey-haired woman kneels and lays a plank on a brown boat, a young man hammers; toolbox, rope, nail tin, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: young man is not at the boat: he crouches apart and nails a loose board lying on the pebbles, not the plank the woman presses
three gulls instead of two
problems: Central interaction broken: the two do not work on the same plank
Hatched wrinkles, wood-grain and peeling-paint detail and textured stones go beyond pure ligne claire flat fills
Figures are semi-realistic rather than simplified dot-eyed cartoon figures
Added sailboat and cliff-top house (harmless)
Format correct; woman's hands fine; no logos or real landmark
people/ligne-claire-1.note_de: Der junge Mann nagelt ein loses Brett auf den Kieseln statt der Planke am Boot; zudem drei statt zwei Möwen.
people/ligne-claire-1.note_en: The young man nails a loose board on the pebbles instead of the plank on the boat, and there are three gulls instead of two.
people/ligne-claire-1.alt_de: Comicbild mit schwarzen Konturen und flachen Farben: Ein junger Mann nagelt ein loses Brett, eine alte Frau drückt eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot; Steg, Möwen, Meer.
people/ligne-claire-1.alt_en: Comic panel, black outlines, flat colours: a young man nails a loose board while an old woman presses a plank onto an upturned boat; jetty, gulls, sea.

motif_missing: young man hammers a nail held in mid-air above his own hand, far from the plank the woman presses
problems: Central action wrong: the nail touches no wood
Figures are fairly naturalistic, not angular geometry with oval heads and dot eyes
Grain looks like an applied texture overlay; little bare cream paper, the frame is densely filled
Palette (mustard, teal, tomato red, olive on cream) and broken brush line fit the style
Woman's hair is wild and medium length rather than short; her figure reads somewhat androgynous
Format correct; no logos
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.note_de: Der junge Mann schlägt den Nagel in die Luft über seiner Hand statt in die Planke.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.note_en: The young man hammers a nail in mid-air above his hand instead of into the plank.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.alt_de: Illustration im Stil der Fünfziger in Senfgelb, Türkis und Tomatenrot mit Kreidestruktur: Ein junger Mann mit roter Mütze hämmert, eine grauhaarige Frau drückt ein Brett an ein umgedrehtes Boot.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.alt_en: Fifties-style illustration in mustard, teal and tomato red with crayon grain: a young man in a red cap hammers, a grey-haired woman presses a board onto an upturned boat.

motif_missing: young man aims his nail at the pebbles beside the boat, not into the plank the woman holds
problems: Central action wrong: nail tip points into the stones about a hand's width from the plank
Faces are somewhat clean and digitally crisp under the added grain; shadows not fully blocked
Blurred foreground object at bottom left contradicts deep focus (but fits the cut-by-frame-edge habit)
Grain, hard contrast, tilted horizon and mid-action framing are convincing
Distant building on the horizon is generic, not an identifiable landmark; format correct; no logos
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_de: Der junge Mann setzt den Nagel auf die Kiesel statt auf die Planke, die die Frau hält.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_en: The young man aims his nail at the pebbles instead of the plank the woman is holding.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_de: Grobkörniges, kontrastreiches Schwarzweißfoto: Eine alte Frau hält eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze hockt mit Hammer und Nagel daneben; Steg, Möwen, aufgewühltes Meer.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_en: Grainy, high-contrast black-and-white photo: an old woman holds a new plank against an upturned boat, a young man in a knit cap crouches with hammer and nail; jetty, gulls, sea.

problems: Too finished for a live courtroom sketch: sky, sea, jetty and pebbles are fully worked, little bare paper apart from the left margin
Dense, painterly impasto-like pastel build-up drifts toward a generic painted illustration rather than fast searching contours with few accents
Woman leans over the hull from behind; her kneeling pose is not visible (minor)
people/courtroom-sketch-1.note_de: Zu ausgearbeitet: eher ein fertiges Pastellbild als eine schnelle Gerichtsskizze mit viel freiem Papier.
people/courtroom-sketch-1.note_en: Too finished: it reads as a worked-up pastel painting rather than a quick courtroom sketch with bare paper.
people/courtroom-sketch-1.alt_de: Pastellskizze mit schnellen Strichen auf grauem Papier: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie fest; dahinter Steg und Möwen.
people/courtroom-sketch-1.alt_en: Pastel sketch on grey paper: a grey-haired woman presses a new plank onto an upturned boat, a young man in a knitted cap nails it; jetty and gulls behind.

problems: Rendered as a hatched, textured comic illustration with naturalistic colours, not flat offset fills in muted beige/grey/pale blue
No card sheen, rounded-card edge or seat-pocket creases
Panels 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 repeat nearly the same scene, so the step-by-step procedure barely progresses
Wrong/right panel leaves the lower half of its cell empty
Woman mostly shown pressing the plank with one visible hand
people/airline-safety-card-1.note_de: Schraffierte Comiczeichnung statt flacher Sicherheitskarten-Grafik; die Felder wiederholen fast dieselbe Szene.
people/airline-safety-card-1.note_en: Hatched comic drawing rather than flat safety-card graphics; most panels repeat nearly the same scene.
people/airline-safety-card-1.alt_de: Sicherheitskarte mit sechs Feldern: Eine alte Frau und ein junger Mann reparieren Schritt für Schritt ein Boot am Kiesstrand; runde Detailbilder, rote Pfeile, falsch und richtig eingeschlagener Nagel.
people/airline-safety-card-1.alt_en: Six-panel safety card: an old woman and a young man repair a boat on a pebble beach; circular close-ups, red arrows, a nail driven wrong and right.

motif_missing: Woman has a hair bun, not short grey hair, and reads as a slim young woman rather than about 70
Woman reaches toward the hull with one open hand instead of pressing the new plank with both hands
problems: Woman drawn as a naturalistic draped silhouette, not the Warli figure of two triangles joined at the tips
Toolbox, nail tin, boat and jetty drawn in perspective with 3D volume, which Warli avoids
Gulls drawn naturalistically; no repetition of setting elements in rows or spirals
Strokes are even and stencil-like rather than wavering bamboo-stick paste; reads as a Warli-inspired modern illustration
people/warli-painting-1.note_de: Kaum Warli: Dinge in Perspektive, die Frau als naturalistische junge Figur mit Dutt statt aus Dreiecken.
people/warli-painting-1.note_en: Barely Warli: objects are drawn in perspective, and the woman is a naturalistic young figure with a bun instead of triangles.
people/warli-painting-1.alt_de: Weiße Pastenlinien auf rotbraunem Grund: Zwei gesichtslose Figuren, eine Frau im Kleid und ein Mann mit Bommelmütze, reparieren ein umgedrehtes Boot; daneben Werkzeugkiste, Nageldose, Seil, dahinter Wellen und Steg.
people/warli-painting-1.alt_en: White paste on red-brown ground: two faceless figures, a woman in a dress and a man in a bobble hat, repair an upturned boat; toolbox, nail tin, rope, jetty.

motif_missing: Young man looks about 27-30 (stubble, lines), not about 20
problems: Framing is tighter and tidier than the 'step too far back' amateur composition; subjects fill the frame
Quite sharp for a fixed-focus compact camera
White print border is thin and uneven on the left edge
people/vernacular-family-snapshot-1.note_de: Der junge Mann wirkt eher wie Ende zwanzig als wie zwanzig.
people/vernacular-family-snapshot-1.note_en: The young man looks closer to thirty than twenty.
people/vernacular-family-snapshot-1.alt_de: Verblasster Farbabzug aus dem Familienalbum: Eine grauhaarige alte Frau und ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nageln eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Ruderboot am Kiesstrand, hinten Steg mit Möwen.
people/vernacular-family-snapshot-1.alt_en: Faded family-album colour print: a grey-haired woman and a young man in a knitted cap nail a new plank to an upturned rowing boat; jetty and gulls behind.

problems: Only the figures are clay; sea, cliffs, gulls, jetty and boat look photoreal
Background is softly out of focus (shallow depth of field) instead of everything in focus
No painted backdrop or visible tabletop set edges
Figures have detailed realistic hands and sculpted faces rather than chunky mitten hands and bead eyes of 1970s-90s TV clay
people/clay-animation-1.note_de: Nur die Figuren sind aus Knete; Meer, Möwen und Steg wirken fotografisch und unscharf statt wie ein gebautes Set.
people/clay-animation-1.note_en: Only the figures are clay; sea, gulls and jetty look photographic and blurred instead of a built set.
people/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetfiguren vor fotorealistischem Meer: Ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze schlägt einen Nagel ein, eine grauhaarige Frau drückt die neue Planke aufs umgedrehte Boot; daneben Werkzeugkiste, Seil, Nageldose, hinten Möwen.
people/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay figures against a photoreal sea: a young man in a knitted cap hammers a nail, a grey-haired woman presses a plank onto the upturned boat; toolbox, rope, gulls.

problems: Dense fine hatching on wood, clothing and faces reads as gekiga/modern seinen, which the style block excludes
Large top panel is at eye level, not a steep low or high angle; no figure breaks a panel border
Overall sepia-grey tint rather than clean black with screentone
Hammer grip in the top panel is awkward and hard to read
people/shonen-manga-1.note_de: Dichte Gekiga-Schraffur statt klarer Shōnen-Linien der 80er.
people/shonen-manga-1.note_en: Dense gekiga-style hatching rather than the clean lines of 1980s shōnen.
people/shonen-manga-1.alt_de: Schwarzweiße Mangaseite mit fünf schrägen Panels: Eine alte Frau hält eine Planke ans umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie an; Nahaufnahmen von Gesichtern, Händen und Hammer.
people/shonen-manga-1.alt_en: Densely hatched black-and-white manga page in five slanted panels: an old woman holds a plank to an upturned boat as a young man nails it; close-ups of faces and hands.

problems: Painting manner is European impasto/impressionist with naturalistic, shared perspective; no flat colour grounds, no looming oversized stiff figures, no clashing scales as in Ghanaian video-club posters
Only surface cues of the style (stitched seam line, nail holes, frayed sacking edges) are present; the picture itself reads as a weathered oil painting
Format 1536x1024 landscape correct; hands fine; no logo, signature or likeness
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.note_de: Wirkt wie ein impressionistisches Ölbild auf Sackleinen, nicht wie ein ghanaisches Filmplakat: keine flachen Farbgründe, keine übergroßen, steifen Figuren.
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.note_en: Reads as an impressionist oil painting on sacking rather than a Ghanaian movie poster: no flat colour grounds, no looming, stiff figures.
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.alt_de: Pastose Ölmalerei auf vernähtem Sackleinen mit Nagellöchern: Eine alte Frau drückt eine Planke auf ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze hämmert, dahinter Steg, Brandung, zwei Möwen.
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.alt_en: Impasto oil paint on stitched sacking with nail holes: an old woman presses a plank onto an upturned boat while a young man hammers; jetty and gulls behind.

problems: Filter look the style block warns against: a sharp, detailed photo mapped to an ironbow palette; wood grain, plank seams and individual pebbles far too crisp for a 320x240 microbolometer
Thermal logic off: hair glows hotter than the face, the sun-lit boat hull is as hot as skin, rope reads warm
No centre crosshair; no sensor stripes or blocky edges; colour scale at right is present
Toolbox, rope and nail tin sit to the right of the young man rather than between the two
Landscape format correct; no logos
people/thermal-imaging-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein scharfes Foto mit Wärmebild-Farbfilter: Holzmaserung und Steine zu detailliert, Haare heißer als Haut, kein Messkreuz.
people/thermal-imaging-1.note_en: Looks like a sharp photo with a thermal colour filter: wood grain and pebbles too detailed, hair hotter than skin, no crosshair.
people/thermal-imaging-1.alt_de: Wärmebild in Violett, Orange und Gelbweiß mit Farbskala am rechten Rand: Eine alte Frau drückt eine Planke ans umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann nagelt, auf dem Steg zwei Möwen.
people/thermal-imaging-1.alt_en: Thermal image in violet, orange and yellow-white, colour scale at right: an old woman presses a plank onto an upturned boat, a young man nails it; gulls on the jetty.

motif_missing: young man of about 20, lanky (he looks roughly 35-40, with deep facial lines and a solid build)
two gulls (three are shown: two on the jetty, one on the beach)
problems: Age contrast is the point of the motif and of its test ('age and skin'); the 'young man' reads as middle-aged at full resolution
Style otherwise convincing: soft low-res picture, blown sky, muted colours, tape noise band and dropout along the bottom; framing somewhat posed and centred
Landscape format correct; hands fine; no logos
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-1.note_de: Der junge Mann wirkt eher wie Ende dreißig als wie 20; außerdem sind es drei Möwen statt zwei.
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-1.note_en: The young man looks closer to forty than twenty, and there are three gulls instead of two.
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-1.alt_de: Unscharfes, blasses Camcorderbild mit Bildstörung am unteren Rand: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine Planke auf ein umgedrehtes Holzboot, ein Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie fest, dahinter Steg und Möwen.
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-1.alt_en: Soft, washed-out camcorder frame with tape noise along the bottom: a grey-haired woman presses a plank onto an upturned wooden boat, a man in a beanie nails it; jetty, gulls.

problems: Reads as modern detailed pixel-art illustration, not a 16-bit console screen: large palette with painterly colour variation, no repeating tiles, no parallax bands, cinematic scene rather than side or top-down game view
Pixel grid not fully uniform; some soft, unevenly sized blocks
Extra rowing boat moored at the jetty (duplicated main object in background)
Landscape format correct; hands fine; no logos
people/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Eher modernes, detailreiches Pixel-Gemälde als 16-Bit-Konsolenbild: zu viele Farben, keine Kacheln; am Steg liegt ein zusätzliches Boot.
people/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Looks more like modern detailed pixel painting than a 16-bit console screen: too many colours, no tiles; an extra boat is moored at the jetty.
people/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Detailreiche Pixelgrafik mit sichtbarem Raster: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Holzboot und drückt eine Planke an, ein junger Mann nagelt; dahinter Meer, Steg mit zwei Möwen.
people/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Detailed pixel art on a visible grid: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank, a young man nails it; sea, jetty, two gulls.

problems: Not 1990s clip art: full continuous background (sea, jetty, pebble beach edge to edge) instead of cut-out clips on plain white
Detailed comic/ligne-claire rendering with wood-grain texture, shaded pebbles and realistic faces instead of big-headed, dot-eyed stock figures with flat fills and banded gradients
No grey ground-shadow ellipses, no mismatched clip scales
Landscape format correct; hands fine; no logos
people/1990s-clip-art-1.note_de: Kein 90er-Clipart, sondern eine detaillierte Comiczeichnung mit vollem Hintergrund statt freigestellter Figuren auf Weiß.
people/1990s-clip-art-1.note_en: Not 1990s clip art but a detailed comic illustration with a full background instead of cut-out figures on white.
people/1990s-clip-art-1.alt_de: Comiczeichnung mit schwarzen Konturen und vollem Hintergrund: Eine grauhaarige Frau in Rot kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein junger Mann nagelt; Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/1990s-clip-art-1.alt_en: Comic-style drawing with black outlines and a full background: a grey-haired woman in red kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank, a young man nails it; jetty, two gulls.

problems: Minor: full-bleed composition without the paper margins the style asks for; underlying drawing is detailed rather than bold flat shapes; misregistration only faint
Ink set (fluorescent pink, blue, yellow), overprints, grain and halftone are convincing
Landscape format correct; hands fine; no logos
people/risograph-1.alt_de: Risodruck in Pink, Blau und Gelb mit körnigem Raster auf cremefarbenem Papier: Eine alte Frau hält eine Planke ans umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann nagelt sie fest; Steg mit Möwen.
people/risograph-1.alt_en: Risograph in pink, blue and yellow with grainy halftone on cream paper: an old woman holds a plank against an upturned boat, a young man nails it; jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: crooked nose not discernible in the profile head
problems: Background registers, block border, zigzag water panels, palette and flaking plaster are convincingly Egyptian, but the main figure is a modern naturalistic portrait: three-quarter torso, centred hero framing, drawn wrinkles and quasi-modelling instead of composite view
Man's left hand (viewer right) has the plastered thumb lying across the front of the mug parallel to the fingers, a slightly awkward grip
Scar sits on the only visible eyebrow (his right, given the profile); side cannot match the motif in this view
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logos, hieroglyphs or deities
portrait/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_de: Der Mann selbst ist naturalistisch und mittig gemalt statt in ägyptischer Kompositansicht.
portrait/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_en: The man himself is painted naturalistically and centred rather than in Egyptian composite view.

problems: Far too much fine detail (finely hatched mountains, houses, grass) and deep pictorial perspective; reads as a modern linocut/illustration rather than a coarse early-16th-century broadsheet woodcut with sparse hatching and stage-like flat space

Tiny white scratch mark in the bottom-right border, looks like a faint pseudo-signature (barely visible)
landscape/woodcut-2.note_de: Für einen groben Holzschnitt des 16. Jahrhunderts zu fein und zu räumlich ausgearbeitet.
landscape/woodcut-2.note_en: Too finely detailed and too deep in space for a coarse 16th-century woodcut.
landscape/woodcut-2.alt_de: Schwarzer Holzschnitt mit sichtbarer Holzmaserung: Bank unter einem alten Baum, ein Fluss mit Bogenbrücke, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Terrassenhänge, Nadelwald und zackige Berge.
landscape/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut with visible wood grain: a bench under an old tree, a river with an arched bridge, village with church tower, terraced slopes, pine forest and jagged mountains.

problems: Mountains, rocks, bark and bench are tonally shaded and densely textured; reads as modern illustration / shin-hanga-like rather than flat Edo nishiki-e colour fields with thin keyblock lines
Mist bands, bokashi sky and foreground tree cut by the frame are correct, but the overall look drifts toward a generic 'Japanese print' filter
Extra houses on the left terraced slope (minor); bird flock sits over the mountains rather than above the river (minor)
landscape/ukiyo-e-woodblock-print-1.note_de: Schattierte Berge und Felsen und viel Detail wirken eher wie moderne Illustration als wie ein flacher Edo-Holzschnitt.
landscape/ukiyo-e-woodblock-print-1.note_en: Shaded mountains and rocks and dense detail read more like modern illustration than a flat Edo woodblock print.
landscape/ukiyo-e-woodblock-print-1.alt_de: Farbholzschnitt im Ukiyo-e-Stil in Preußischblau und Ocker: Nebelbänder im Flusstal, Bogenbrücke mit Wanderer, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassenfelder, alter Baum mit Bank, dahinter blaue Berge.
landscape/ukiyo-e-woodblock-print-1.alt_en: Ukiyo-e-style colour woodblock print in Prussian blue and ochre: mist bands in river valley, arched bridge with walker, village with chapel, terraced fields, old tree with bench, blue mountains.

problems: Unprinted margin is narrow rather than wide (minor)
Detail is somewhat crisper and more illustrative than a soft glass-negative cyanotype (minor)
landscape/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefransten Pinselrändern: Unter einem alten Baum steht eine Bank am Fluss, dahinter Bogenbrücke mit Figur, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Terrassen, Wald und Berge.
landscape/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: a bench under an old riverside tree, beyond it an arched bridge with a figure, village with church tower, terraces, forest and mountains.

motif_missing: three tiny figures stand on the bridge instead of at most one
problems: Three small figures on the bridge, motif allows at most one

Detailed, fully rendered scene (houses, rocks, river reflections) under a blotchy watercolour texture; little true wet-in-wet bleeding, blooms or granulation; reads as the generic AI watercolour filter the style block warns against
Vignette edges and drips are present and correct
Extra farmhouses on the left terraced slope (minor)
landscape/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Auf der Brücke stehen drei Figuren statt höchstens einer, und das Bild ist detaillierter als lockere Nass-in-Nass-Malerei.
landscape/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Three figures stand on the bridge instead of at most one, and the painting is more detailed than loose wet-in-wet work.
landscape/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell mit verlaufenden Rändern auf weißem Papier: Bank unter einem knorrigen Baum, Fluss mit Steinbogenbrücke, Bergdorf mit Glockenturm, Terrassenhänge, Vogelschwarm vor schroffen Gipfeln in warmem Licht.
landscape/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour fading into white paper at the edges: a bench under a gnarled tree, river with a stone arch bridge, village with bell tower, terraced slopes, birds before jagged peaks.

problems: Grain is fine and midtones richly detailed (HDR-like mountains and village); lacks the coarse grit, blown highlights and blocked shadows of two-stop pushed Tri-X
Level horizon and classic, composed landscape framing instead of tilted handheld reportage
Extra houses/ruins on the left terraced slope (minor)
landscape/push-processed-black-and-white.note_de: Wirkt eher wie sauberes, detailreiches Digital-Schwarzweiß als wie grobkörniger, gepushter Tri-X-Film.
landscape/push-processed-black-and-white.note_en: Looks more like clean, detailed digital monochrome than coarse-grained push-processed Tri-X film.
landscape/push-processed-black-and-white.alt_de: Kontrastreiches, körniges Schwarzweißfoto: Holzbank unter einem dunklen Baum, ein Wildfluss mit Steinbrücke, auf der eine Person steht, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Nebel vor schroffen Gipfeln.
landscape/push-processed-black-and-white.alt_en: High-contrast grainy black-and-white photo: a wooden bench under a dark tree, rushing river with stone bridge and one person on it, village with church tower, mist before jagged peaks.

problems: Drifts heavily into the generic AI 'miniature diorama' look: hyper-detailed, dense tiny trees, rocks and houses instead of chunky simplified clay forms
Foreground is clearly out of focus (tilt-shift/miniature blur), contradicting 'everything in focus' and the explicit 'avoid tilt-shift'
Mountain ridge and rock faces are near-photoreal; river reads as real or resin water, not clay
No fingerprints, tool scores, lint or marbled unmixed clay visible at full resolution; bench and stones look like real materials
No visible set edges, card/fabric seams or painted-backdrop look; not a locked-off figure-height 1970s-90s TV frame

Motif itself complete: river, single-arch bridge with one figure, about five houses plus chapel, terraces left, forest right, leaning old tree with bench, jagged ridge, four birds; correct 1536x1024 landscape; no logos or real landmarks
landscape/clay-animation-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein fotorealistisches Miniatur-Diorama mit unscharfem Vordergrund, nicht wie ein Knetanimationsfilm.
landscape/clay-animation-1.note_en: Looks like a photoreal miniature diorama with a blurred foreground rather than a clay-animation film.
landscape/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Detailreiches Miniatur-Diorama mit Knetbäumen und unscharfem Vordergrund: Alter Baum mit Holzbank am Fluss, Steinbogenbrücke mit kleiner Figur, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassenhang, Waldhang, schroffe Berge, Vögel.
landscape/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Detailed miniature diorama with clay-ball trees, blurred foreground: old tree and bench by a river, stone bridge with tiny figure, village with chapel, terraces, forest, jagged peaks, birds.

problems: Ink handling is convincing: pink, medium blue and yellow with plausible overprints (purple, orange), speckled grain, coarse halftone, off-white paper border

Underlying image is a detailed, tonal painterly landscape with a conventional centred composition rather than bold flat shapes, tight cropping and an asymmetric zine-like layout, a slight drift toward the default look
Misregistration between layers is barely visible; paper margins are thin rather than generous

Motif complete: winding river, single-arch stone bridge with one figure, about six houses plus a chapel with bell tower, terraces on the left slope, dense forest on the right, old tree with bench, jagged ridge, five birds; correct 1536x1024 landscape; no logos or real landmarks
landscape/risograph-1.note_de: Eher ein detailreiches Gemälde mit Riso-Körnung als kräftige, flache Farbflächen.
landscape/risograph-1.note_en: Reads more like a detailed painting with riso grain than bold flat colour shapes.
landscape/risograph-1.alt_de: Risographie in Pink, Blau und Gelb mit grobem Raster: Alter Baum mit Bank über dem Fluss, Steinbrücke mit kleiner Figur, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassen, Nadelwald, verschneite Gipfel, Vögel.
landscape/risograph-1.alt_en: Risograph in pink, blue and yellow with coarse grain: old tree and bench above a river, stone bridge with a figure, village with chapel, terraces, pine forest, snowy peaks, birds.

problems: Radio sits large and centred as a hero object, which the style block says to avoid
Shows slight 3D depth (right side panel visible, shaded knurled knob rims) instead of a strictly flat side view
Crisp geometric lines and a perfectly regular dot grid read as a modern flat vector graphic with a plaster texture laid over it
Palette, red-brown outlines, flaking plaster, ground line and coloured block border are correct
Square format matches 1024x1024; no logo, signature or hieroglyphs
product/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine moderne Flachgrafik mit Putzstruktur; das Radio steht mittig als Heldenmotiv und zeigt leichte Tiefe.
product/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_en: Reads more like a modern flat graphic with a plaster texture; the radio sits centred as a hero object and shows slight depth.
product/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: ein flaches, ockerfarbenes Kofferradio mit blauem Lochgitter, schwarzer Senderscheibe, Skala und zwei Knöpfen, schräger Antenne, eingefasst von bunten Blockbordüren.
product/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster: a flat ochre radio with blue dotted grille, black dial, scale and two knobs, antenna raised, between coloured block borders.

problems: Somewhat more fine parallel hatching and three-quarter modelling than a 16th-century broadsheet woodcut, closer to a modern linocut
All motif elements present: left grille, large dial above tick-mark window, two knobs, handle, angled telescopic antenna
Square format correct; no logo or signature
product/woodcut-2.alt_de: Schwarzer Holzschnitt auf warmem Papier mit kräftigem Rahmen: ein Kofferradio auf gemasertem Tisch, mit Lochgitter, großer Senderscheibe, Skala, zwei Knöpfen, ausgezogener Antenne und Schnittspuren im Hintergrund.
product/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on warm paper inside a heavy border: a portable radio on a grained table, dotted grille, large dial, scale and two knobs, antenna raised, gouge streaks behind.

problems: Inside the convincing brushed margin the image is a crisp, finely detailed photo with open shadows and smooth tonal gradients, close to the blue-filtered digital photo the style block warns against
Lacks the soft detail and blocked shadows of a real cyanotype
All motif elements present; antenna passes plausibly behind the handle
Square format correct; no logo or signature
product/cyanotype-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein blau eingefärbtes, gestochen scharfes Foto als wie ein weicher Cyanotypie-Abzug.
product/cyanotype-1.note_en: Looks more like a crisp blue-tinted photo than a soft cyanotype print.
product/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefransten Pinselrändern auf cremefarbenem Papier: ein metallenes Kofferradio auf einem Tisch, mit Lochgitter, großer Senderscheibe, Skala, zwei Knöpfen und ausgezogener Antenne.
product/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Cyanotype in Prussian blue with ragged brushed edges on cream paper: a metal portable radio on a table, perforated grille, large dial, scale, two knobs and a raised antenna.

problems: Radio is rendered in near-photographic detail (knurled knobs, brushed-metal dial, fine scale ticks) under an overall watercolour texture filter, which the style block says to avoid
Painting runs almost edge to edge instead of dissolving into bare paper as a vignette
Background landscape and table show genuine wet washes and blooms
Small extra tick marks around the knobs; otherwise all motif elements present
Square format correct; villa on hillside is generic, no landmark, logo or signature
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Das Radio ist fast fotografisch detailliert unter einer Aquarellstruktur gemalt, und das Bild füllt nahezu das ganze Blatt.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: The radio is rendered in near-photographic detail under a watercolour texture, and the painting fills almost the whole sheet.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Nass-in-Nass-Aquarell: ein abgenutztes olivgrünes Radio mit rostigem Lochgitter, großer Senderscheibe, Skala, zwei Knöpfen und Antenne auf verwittertem Holztisch vor einer dunstigen Mittelmeerbucht.
product/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour with soft washes: a worn olive-green radio with rusty grille, large dial, scale, two knobs and raised antenna on a weathered table above a hazy Mediterranean bay.

problems: Background is thrown out of focus (bokeh), against the style's legible studio-set background and explicit no-bokeh rule
Glossy, digitally sharp reflections and warm soft lighting read as a modern AI product shot rather than a hard carbon-arc lit 1940s dye-transfer frame
Close product framing instead of a medium-long shot of a studio set
Jewel colours (ruby radio, emerald vase, red carnations) and painted-looking backdrop through the window do fit
All motif elements present; dial ring and window show tick marks only, no brand text on the knob
Square format correct; coastal town view is generic, no identifiable landmark
product/three-strip-technicolor-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein glänzendes modernes Produktfoto mit unscharfem Hintergrund als wie ein Technicolor-Filmbild der 1940er.
product/three-strip-technicolor-1.note_en: Looks more like a glossy modern product shot with a blurred background than a 1940s Technicolor frame.
product/three-strip-technicolor-1.alt_de: Satte Filmfarben: ein rubinrotes Radio mit goldenem Lochgitter, cremefarbener Senderscheibe, Skala und zwei Messingknöpfen auf poliertem Tisch, daneben rote Nelken, durchs Fenster eine Küstenlandschaft.
product/three-strip-technicolor-1.alt_en: Saturated film colours: a ruby-red radio with gold grille, cream dial, scale and two brass knobs on a polished table, red carnations beside it, a coastal view through the window.

problems: Grain is fine and the radio is rendered cleanly, closer to clean digital monochrome than coarse two-stop pushed Tri-X
Shallow depth of field blurs both foreground and harbour background, against the required deep focus
Contrast is moderate; shadows and highlights are not blocked or blown
Tilted horizon and gritty wet quay setting do fit
All motif elements present; frequency window shows tick marks only
Square format correct; blurred skyline is generic, not an identifiable landmark
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.note_de: Zu sauber und feinkörnig für gepushten Tri-X, und der Hintergrund ist unscharf statt durchgehend scharf.
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.note_en: Too clean and fine-grained for pushed Tri-X, and the background is blurred instead of in deep focus.
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.alt_de: Körniges Schwarzweißfoto mit schiefem Horizont: ein Metallradio mit Lochgitter, großer Senderscheibe, Skala, zwei Knöpfen und Antenne auf einem nassen Kaiblock, dahinter unscharf Kräne und Skyline.
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.alt_en: Grainy black-and-white photo with tilted horizon: a metal radio with grille, large dial, scale, two knobs and raised antenna on a wet quay block, blurred cranes and skyline behind.

problems: Drifts toward a polished miniature or product shot rather than a chunky 1970s-90s clay-animation frame: precise, evenly drilled grille holes and finely knurled knobs instead of simplified clay forms
Telescopic antenna and handle brackets read as real chrome metal, not clay
Shallow depth of field: the plant pot and the backdrop painting are visibly soft, but the style asks for everything in focus
Warmish light, no visible set edges, hardly any fingerprints or lint; the surface reads more like painted plaster than marbled plasticine

Motif complete: boxy body with rounded corners, grille on the left half, large dial above a tick-mark window, two small knobs, fold-down handle, partly extended angled antenna, radio alone and whole; square 1024x1024 format correct; no logo or watermark
product/clay-animation-2.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein fein ausgearbeitetes Miniaturmodell mit unscharfem Hintergrund als wie grobe Knetanimation; Antenne und Griffbügel sind aus Metall.
product/clay-animation-2.note_en: Looks more like a finely detailed miniature with a blurred background than chunky clay animation; the antenna and handle brackets are metal.
product/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetanimation: Ein grünes Kofferradio aus Knete mit cremefarbenem Lochgitter, schwarzem Senderknopf über der Skala, zwei kleinen Knöpfen und schräger Metallantenne steht vor blauer Wand mit Landschaftsbild.
product/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay animation: a green plasticine portable radio with cream perforated grille, black tuning dial above the scale, two small knobs and angled metal antenna, set against a painted blue wall.

problems: Ink treatment is convincing: three spot inks (pink, blue, yellow) with overprint oranges, speckled solids, visible misregistration and uncoated off-white paper

Composition is a centred three-quarter product view with volumetric shading rather than tightly cropped flat shapes in an asymmetric zine layout, so it reads slightly like a photo run through a riso filter
A tiny illegible pseudo-inscription on the lower edge of the handle (about x 470-560, y 270); hardly visible, not a readable logo

Motif complete: boxy body with rounded corners, grille on the left half, large dial above a tick-mark window, two small knobs, fold-down handle, partly extended angled antenna, radio alone and whole; square format correct
product/risograph-1.alt_de: Risographie in Pink, Blau und Gelb auf cremefarbenem Papier: Ein gelbes Kofferradio mit Lochgitter, blauem Senderknopf, Skalenfenster, zwei kleinen Knöpfen und schräger Antenne, die Farbschichten körnig und leicht versetzt.
product/risograph-1.alt_en: Risograph print in pink, blue and yellow on cream paper: a yellow portable radio with speaker grille, blue tuning dial, scale, two small knobs and angled antenna; grainy, offset inks.

problems: Lettering is a modern-looking serif in two colours (red, blue) rather than plain one-colour brush capitals
Lighthouse and houses are drawn in a modern European manner, with some modelling on the rocks
Trumpeter stands directly on the blue water panel; shoulders closer to profile than true composite view
poster/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf rissigem Putz: Ein rotbrauner Mann im Profil mit Lendenschurz bläst Trompete, rechts gelbe Sonne und Leuchtturminsel über blauem Zickzackwasser, farbiger Blockrahmen.
poster/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on cracked plaster: a red-brown man in profile, wearing a kilt, plays trumpet; a yellow sun and lighthouse island above blue zigzag water; coloured block border.

problems: Face carries more tonal modelling and detail than a few confident cuts
Reads more like a 20th-century linocut poster than an early 16th-century broadsheet
poster/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf warmem Papier: Ein Trompeter mit Hut im Profil, dahinter heller Mond und Leuchtturminsel; derbe geschnittene Schrift, Schriftband und schwerer Rahmen.
poster/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on warm paper: a trumpeter in a hat seen in profile, behind him a pale moon and a lighthouse island; chunky carved lettering, scroll banner, heavy border.

problems: Image area looks like a blue-tinted painting/illustration rather than a contact print from a glass negative
Smooth digital gradients in sky and moon glow, which the style block says to avoid
Brushed sensitiser edges and drips are convincing, but the inner scene is dramatic, painterly moonlight rather than a still, plainly framed photo
poster/cyanotype-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein blau eingefärbtes Gemälde mit digitalen Verläufen als wie ein Abzug von einem Glasnegativ.
poster/cyanotype-1.note_en: Looks more like a blue-tinted painting with digital gradients than a print from a glass negative.
poster/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Preußischblaue Cyanotypie mit pinselrauen Rändern: Ein Trompeter mit Hut als Silhouette, dahinter Vollmond, Leuchtturm auf einer Insel und glitzerndes Meer; weiße Schrift.
poster/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: a silhouetted trumpeter in a hat, behind him a full moon, a lighthouse on an island and glittering sea; white lettering.

problems: Leans toward the stock AI watercolour poster: orange sunset against blue, an even blotchy texture spread over everything
Lighthouse, house and island are neatly detailed rather than suggested by a few broad strokes
Lettering in blue and rust brush caps instead of sepia ink
Trumpet hands are an indistinct blob (acceptable for the style, but not readable as two hands)
poster/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Wirkt wie der typische KI-Aquarell-Look mit Sonnenuntergang, gleichmäßiger Fleckentextur und sauber ausgemaltem Leuchtturm.
poster/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Leans toward the typical AI watercolour look: sunset glow, an even blotchy texture and a neatly detailed lighthouse.
poster/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Nass-in-nass-Aquarell, das zum Rand ins blanke Papier ausläuft: Ein Trompeter mit Hut in Blautönen, orange Sonne über dem Meer, Insel mit Leuchtturm; Pinselschrift darunter.
poster/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Wet-in-wet watercolour fading into bare paper: a trumpeter in a hat painted in blues, an orange sun over the sea and a lighthouse island; brush lettering below.

problems: Out-of-focus foreground object with bokeh highlights, rather than the deep focus the style block asks for
Horizon only barely tilted
poster/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_de: Grobkörniges, kontrastreiches Schwarzweißfoto: Ein Mann mit wirrem Haar bläst die Trompete schräg nach oben, dahinter tiefe Sonne, Leuchtturminsel und glitzerndes Meer; unten ein weißes Schriftband.
poster/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_en: Grainy, high-contrast black-and-white photo: a curly-haired man blows a trumpet skyward, behind him a low sun, a lighthouse island and glittering sea; white text band below.

problems: Background island is softly out of focus (shallow depth of field) although the style requires everything in focus
Warm, golden lighting instead of neutral white studio lamps
No visible set edges; reads as a clay relief poster or close-up product shot rather than a locked-off film frame
Hands have detailed separate fingers rather than mitten hands
poster/clay-animation-2.note_de: Warmes Licht, unscharfer Hintergrund und fehlende Set-Kanten wirken nicht wie ein Einzelbild aus einem Knetanimationsfilm.
poster/clay-animation-2.note_en: Warm light, a blurred background and no visible set edges make it read less like a frame from a clay-animation film.
poster/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetanimations-Szene: Ein Trompeter mit Hut und Knollennase spielt vor einer großen gelben Sonne, dahinter eine Leuchtturminsel; Schrift aus gerollter Knete, Datum auf einer Knettafel.
poster/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay-animation scene: a hatted trumpeter with a bulbous nose plays before a big yellow sun, a lighthouse island behind; rolled clay lettering and a clay date plaque.

problems: Layout is a conventional centred poster stack (headline / image / date) rather than the asymmetric zine-like layout the style block asks for
Trumpeter is rendered with fairly photographic tonal detail through grain rather than bold flat shapes; reads slightly like a riso filter over an illustration
Lighthouse with attached red-roofed keeper's house on a rocky islet is a generic New England type; no clear real-landmark identification, but noted
Note: sips --cropOffset 0 0 ignores the offset and centres the crop; also crops/riso1_*.png names collided with existing files from other reviewers (overwritten riso1_hands/face/lh/head.png)
poster/risograph-1.alt_de: Risographie in Pink, Blau und Gelb auf gebrochenem Weiß: Ein Trompeter mit Hut spielt vor einer großen gelben Sonne, darunter eine Felseninsel mit Leuchtturm, körnig und leicht versetzt gedruckt.
poster/risograph-1.alt_en: Risograph print in pink, blue and yellow on off-white paper: a trumpeter in a hat plays before a large yellow sun above a rocky island with a lighthouse, grainy and slightly misregistered.

problems: The cup is drawn in slight perspective (the open rim shows as an ellipse) with some soft ochre shading, which drifts from strict Egyptian side view
Figures are only partly composite view; the man on the rim has a fairly naturalistic three-quarter torso
Minor: the rim figure holds a second rope besides the bucket rope, and a second needle sits at the end of the stitch line
Landscape 1536x1024 as requested; no logo, signature, deities or hieroglyphs
editorial/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf rissigem Putz: Ein Mann auf einer Leiter vernäht den Riss einer riesigen Lotos-Tasse, einer lässt vom Rand einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau trägt eine Klebstofftube.
