editorial/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on cracked plaster: on a ladder a man stitches a giant lotus cup, another lowers a bucket from its rim, a woman shoulders a glue tube.

problems: Some fine parallel hatching and fairly detailed faces lean toward a 19th-century chapbook or wood-engraving look rather than a coarse 16th-century broadsheet cut; few large solid blacks and no visible wood grain
The glue tube is open and hollow at the back, so it reads a little like a pipe or bottle
Generic village church spire in the background, not a real landmark; landscape format correct
editorial/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Riesige geblümte Tasse voller Risse, ein Mann auf der Leiter näht sie, einer sitzt mit Eimer am Rand, eine Frau schleppt eine Leimtube.
editorial/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper: on a ladder a man sews a giant cracked teacup, another sits on its rim with a bucket, a woman hauls a glue tube.

problems: Crisp photographic detail, smooth gradient sky and full midtone range look like a blue-filtered digital photo with a brushed-edge overlay, which the style block says to avoid; cyanotype should have soft detail and blocked shadows
The unprinted margin is narrow, not wide
A large chunk of the cup's front wall is missing, so the bucket hangs in a hole; this is spatially a bit confusing but still reads as lowering it into the cup
editorial/cyanotype-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein blau eingefärbtes Digitalbild mit Pinselrand als wie ein echter Lichtdruck.
editorial/cyanotype-1.note_en: Looks more like a blue-tinted digital image with a brushed border than a true sun print.
editorial/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit gepinselten Rändern: Eine riesige zerbrochene Porzellantasse auf einer Wiese, ein Mann vernäht sie von der Leiter, einer lässt einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau trägt Leim.
editorial/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with brushed edges: a giant broken porcelain cup in a meadow; a man on a ladder stitches it, one lowers a bucket, a woman carries glue.

problems: Painted nearly edge to edge (the full landscape and foreground reach the bottom edge) instead of a vignette that fades into bare paper
Figures, cup cracks and shards are rendered in fine, controlled detail with pen-like lines, which drifts toward the generic AI watercolour illustration rather than loose wet-in-wet washes
Cracks are filled with gold-brown lines that look like kintsugi; the motif does not ask for this, but it does not conflict with it
editorial/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Zu detailliert und bis an den Rand gemalt, statt locker nass in nass ins Papierweiß auszulaufen.
editorial/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Too detailed and painted edge to edge instead of loose washes fading into bare paper.
editorial/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell mit fließenden Lavuren: Eine riesige blau bemalte Tasse voller Risse, ein Mann näht sie von der Leiter, einer sitzt mit Eimer am Rand, eine Frau schleppt eine Klebetube.
editorial/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour with soft washes: a giant cracked blue-patterned cup; a man on a ladder sews it, one sits on the rim with a bucket, a woman hauls glue.

problems: Figures are finely modelled miniatures with realistic proportions, knitted-texture sweaters and articulated fingers instead of chunky ball heads, sausage limbs and mitten hands
Background trees and hills are soft-focus with shallow depth of field, which contradicts 'everything in focus'; no set edges or card or fabric seams are visible
The cup reads as real glazed ceramic rather than clay
The woman hugs the glue tube against her chest and shoulder rather than carrying it on her shoulder (minor)
editorial/clay-animation-1.note_de: Fein modellierte Miniaturfiguren mit echten Fingern und unscharfem Hintergrund statt grober Trickfilm-Knete.
editorial/clay-animation-1.note_en: Finely modelled miniatures with real fingers and a blurred background rather than chunky animation clay.
editorial/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetfiguren in einer Trickfilm-Kulisse: Ein Mann auf einer Holzleiter vernäht eine riesige gesprungene Tasse, ein zweiter lässt vom Rand einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau schleppt eine Klebetube.
editorial/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay figures on a tabletop set: a man on a wooden ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup, another lowers a bucket from the rim, a woman hauls a glue tube.

problems: Composition is a modern European street in full linear perspective with a receding lane and open sky; the style block explicitly forbids perspective, and there are no stacked registers or ground lines
Egyptian character carried only by the profile figures in white linen, the colour palette, flaking plaster and the block border
All figures share one red-brown skin tone, so the women are not pale ochre as the convention requires
Bicycle: only the front wheel is visible; the rear wheel is hidden behind the dress and reads as missing (minor)
An extra man sits on the bench (harmless addition)
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_de: Die Straße ist in moderner Perspektive gemalt; ägyptisch wirken nur die Figuren und der Putz.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_en: The street is drawn in modern perspective; only the figures and plaster look Egyptian.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz mit buntem Blockrand: Profilfiguren in weißem Leinen, oben wird ein Teppich ausgeschüttelt, unten Bäckerei mit Brezelschild, Hund an der Bank, Frau schiebt Fahrrad.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian-style wall painting on flaking plaster with block border: profile figures in white linen shake a rug, sit by the bakery with a dog and push a bicycle uphill.

problems: Finer and more detailed than an early 16th-century broadsheet woodcut (small roof tiles, flower boxes, modelled faces); reads more like a modern linocut
Deep perspective instead of a flat, stage-like space (minor)
street/woodcut-2.note_de: Im Schaufenster stehen schwache, unleserliche Reihen aus Pseudo-Buchstaben, die nicht verlangt waren.
street/woodcut-2.note_en: Faint rows of illegible pseudo-letters show behind the shop window, though no such text was asked for.
street/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier mit Rahmenlinie: Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Brezelschild und gestreifter Markise, oben schüttelt eine Frau einen Teppich, Hund an der Bank, Frau schiebt Fahrrad bergauf.
street/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on off-white paper: corner bakery with striped awning and pretzel sign, a rug shaken from a window, a dog by the bench, a woman pushing a bicycle uphill.
text_errors: House number '12' is correct (carved roman numerals beside the door).

Expected no other text, but found faint pseudo-lettering in the bakery window: two rows of letter-like glyphs in each pane behind the glass, one above the top shelf and one above the middle shelf (around x 115-330, y 975-995 and y 1045-1060). They are illegible but are clearly set in rows like signage, reading roughly 'B S S Ǝ E K' and '6 S (C) T E F'. They are faint and hard to notice at normal size, but they are invented letter-like text.
extra: faint illegible pseudo-letter rows behind the shop-window glass (two rows per pane, e.g. 'B S S Ǝ E K' / '6 S (C) T E F'-like glyphs)

problems: Corner building and lane are drawn in European vanishing-point perspective, which the style block says to avoid; it reads as a European storybook illustration with a gold sky
Faces softly shaded; the water is blue, not tarnished silver
The dog sits by the door, but a flower pot separates it from the bench (minor)
The woman with the bicycle seems to be heading across or down the lane toward the bakery rather than clearly up the slope (minor)
Positive: number 12 is in white on a blue tile as specified; gold sky, ruled gold frame and dense patterns are present
street/persian-miniature-1.note_de: Haus und Gasse folgen europäischer Zentralperspektive; persisch wirken vor allem Goldhimmel, Rahmen und Muster. Am Dachgesims läuft ein goldenes Band aus Pseudo-Schrift, obwohl nur die Hausnummer erlaubt war.
street/persian-miniature-1.note_en: House and lane follow European perspective; the Persian look rests mainly on the gold sky, frame and patterns. A band of gold pseudo-script runs along the roof eave, though only the house number was allowed.
street/persian-miniature-1.alt_de: Miniatur im persischen Stil mit Goldhimmel und Goldrahmen: rosa Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Teppich aus dem Fenster, Hausnummer 12 auf blauer Fliese, Hund an der Tür, Frau mit Fahrrad.
street/persian-miniature-1.alt_en: Persian-style miniature, gold sky and gold frame: pink corner bakery, rug shaken from a window, number 12 on a blue tile, dog by the door, woman with bicycle.
text_errors: House number '12' is correct (white numerals on a blue tile beside the door).

Expected no other text, but the dark-blue band along the roof eave (front and angled side face, around y 160-260) carries a row of sparse gold cursive strokes that read as pseudo-Arabic/Persian script, unlike the floral arabesque friezes lower on the facade. The style block explicitly forbids pseudo-script. The strokes are small and faint at normal size.
extra: gold pseudo-calligraphic inscription band along the roof eave

problems: Inside the brushed border the image is quite crisp and photographic with smooth tonal gradients, edging slightly toward a blue-toned digital photo (minor)
street/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefranstem Pinselrand: sonniges Eckhaus mit Bäckerei und Brezelschild, Teppich im Fenster, Wäscheleine, Hund an der Bank, Frau schiebt Fahrrad die Gasse hinauf.
street/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: sunlit corner bakery with pretzel sign, rug at a window, washing line, dog by the bench, woman pushing a bicycle uphill.

problems: Typical generic AI watercolour: detailed, nearly photographic rendering (bread loaves, lamps, faces, interior shelves) under a watercolour texture, which the style block explicitly says to avoid
Few genuine wet-in-wet effects (blooms, backruns) in the focal area; only the vignette edges and drips show loose washes
street/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Statt lockerer Nass-in-Nass-Lavuren fein ausgearbeitete, fast fotografische Details unter Aquarelltextur.
street/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Finely rendered, near-photographic detail under a watercolour texture instead of loose wet-in-wet washes.
street/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell, das zum Rand hin in weißes Papier ausläuft: ockerfarbenes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Markise und Brezelschild, oben ein Teppich im Fenster, Hund an der Bank, Frau schiebt Fahrrad bergauf.
street/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour vignette fading into white paper: ochre corner bakery with awning and pretzel sign, a rug at an upper window, dog by the bench, woman pushing a bicycle uphill.

problems: No drawn panel frame; some tonal texture on stone walls, cobbles and clouds instead of purely flat fills (minor)
Faces are semi-realistic rather than simplified dot-eyed cartoon faces (minor)
The rug is held over the sill rather than visibly shaken (minor)
street/ligne-claire-1.alt_de: Comicbild in Ligne claire mit dünnen Konturen und flachen Farben: gelbes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei und Brezelschild, Teppich im Fenster, Wäscheleine, Mann und Hund an der Bank, Frau schiebt Fahrrad.
street/ligne-claire-1.alt_en: Ligne claire comic panel with thin outlines and flat colours: yellow corner bakery, pretzel sign, rug at a window, washing line, man and dog at the bench, woman with bicycle.

motif_missing: The woman with the bicycle faces left and walks downhill toward the corner. She is not pushing the bike up the slope, and the lane climbs away into the background instead of sloping down to the right.
problems: Reads as a slick modern miniature diorama, not a 1970s-90s TV clay-animation frame: the foreground cobbles have shallow depth-of-field blur (the style asks for everything in focus), and background trees and tower are softened.
The shop window has a warm, glowing, cosy interior, close to the generic AI look; lighting is soft rather than neutral studio lamps with small hard shadows.

The architecture (stone walls, wrought-iron bracket, lantern, shutters) is highly detailed and realistic instead of chunky card-and-fabric set pieces. There are no glue seams, no visible set edges, and hardly any fingerprints or tool marks.
The camera is high and wide rather than locked off at figure height.

Extra figure: an old man in a flat cap sits on the bench eating a roll. He was not requested but does no harm. The figure design leans toward a generic Aardman look, but it is not a copy of a known character.

Format is correct (portrait 1024x1536). No logos, signatures or real landmarks. The bell tower is generic. '12' sits beside the door. The pretzel sign has no lettering. The rug in the window, the clothesline between the buildings, the flower boxes, the awning and the dog by the bench are all present. Hands look fine.
street/clay-animation-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein glattes Miniatur-Diorama mit unscharfem Vordergrund als wie ein Knetfilm der 70er bis 90er, und die Radfahrerin schiebt ihr Rad bergab statt bergauf.
street/clay-animation-1.note_en: Looks more like a polished miniature diorama with a blurred foreground than a 1970s-90s TV clay film, and the woman pushes her bike downhill, not uphill.
street/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetanimation: gelbes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, gestreifter Markise und Brezelschild; Mann und Hund an der Bank, oben schüttelt eine Frau einen Teppich aus, rechts schiebt eine Frau ihr Rad mit Brotkorb.
street/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay animation: yellow corner bakery with striped awning and pretzel sign; man and dog by the bench, a woman shaking a rug above, another pushing a bread-laden bike.

motif_missing: bread knife: shown as a plain smooth-bladed knife, not a serrated bread knife
problems: Core Egyptian grammar missing: table, cutting board and bowls are drawn in modern three-quarter perspective with ellipses, not as flat side-view objects
No ruled ground lines or stacked registers; centred still-life framing, which the style block says to avoid
Bread crust is modelled with stippled tonal shading instead of flat unshaded fills
Egyptian character comes only from the flaking plaster surface, the palette and the coloured block border, so it reads as a texture overlay on a modern illustration
Red-brown hand colouring and red-brown outlines are correct, as is the square 1024x1024 format
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_de: Ein perspektivisches Stillleben auf Putzstruktur statt flacher ägyptischer Seitenansichten auf Standlinien.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_en: A perspective still life on a plaster texture, not flat Egyptian side views on register lines.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Wandmalerei auf rissigem Putz mit bunter Blockbordüre: Brotlaib mit Scheiben auf Brett, Messer, Schale Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale, Butter, Rispentomaten, Basilikum, Serviette; eine rotbraune Hand zupft Brot.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Wall painting on cracked plaster, coloured block border: loaf and slices on a board, knife, tomato soup with cream swirl, butter, vine tomatoes, basil, napkin; a red-brown hand holds bread.

motif_missing: bread knife: shown as a riveted kitchen knife, not a serrated bread knife
problems: Dense fine hatching and engraving-like detail on bread, tomatoes and basil, which reads closer to wood engraving or scratchboard than a coarse 16th-century woodcut
Grey and sepia tonal fills in the soup, tomatoes and basil, where the style asks for pure black on off-white
Heavy ruled border, bold outlines and wood-grain table fit the style
Extra chair in the background (harmless)
All other motif elements are present: crumbs, cream swirl, spoon, drip on the rim, butter with a cut, vine tomatoes, basil, folded napkin, and a hand from the upper right
food/woodcut-2.note_de: Feine Schraffuren und Grautöne wirken eher wie Holzstich als wie grober Holzschnitt.
food/woodcut-2.note_en: Fine hatching and grey tones look more like wood engraving than a coarse woodcut.
food/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier mit kräftigem Rahmen: Brotlaib mit Scheiben und Messer auf dem Brett, Suppenschüssel mit Sahnespirale, Butter, Tomaten, Basilikum, Tuch; oben rechts zupft eine Hand Brot.
food/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper with a heavy border: loaf with slices and knife on a board, soup bowl with cream swirl, butter, tomatoes, basil, cloth; a hand crumbles bread.

problems: Interior detail is crisp and the styling resembles modern moody food photography from a raised angle, a mild drift toward a blue-toned photo
Hand-brushed ragged edges, drips, unprinted margin, blocked shadows and Prussian blue only are all convincing
All motif elements are present, including a serrated bread knife, a drip on the bowl and a hand tearing a piece off a slice; hand anatomy is fine
food/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefransten Pinselrändern und Tropfspuren: Brotlaib mit Scheiben und Brotmesser, Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale, Butter, Basilikum, Rispentomaten, Leinentuch; eine Hand reißt ein Stück Brot ab.
food/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges and drips: loaf with slices and bread knife, tomato soup with cream swirl, butter, basil, vine tomatoes, linen cloth; a hand tears off bread.

problems: Bread crumb, crust, butter and tomatoes are rendered in fairly fine, almost photographic detail with crisp edges, close to the typical AI 'photo under watercolour texture' look
Wet-in-wet qualities such as blooms, backruns and a vignette dissolving into bare paper appear mainly in the background and at the edges, not in the focal area

All motif elements are present: serrated knife, crumbs, cream swirl, spoon, drip on the rim, butter, vine tomatoes, basil, folded striped napkin, and a hand from the upper right; hand anatomy is acceptable
food/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Brot und Butter sind zu detailreich gemalt, eher ein Foto unter Aquarellstruktur als lockere Nasslasur.
food/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Bread and butter are rendered in near-photographic detail rather than loose wet washes.
food/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell, dessen Ränder in fleckige Blau- und Ockerlasuren auf weißem Papier auslaufen: Brot mit Scheiben, Brotmesser, Tomatensuppe mit Sahne, Butter, Rispentomaten, Basilikum, gestreiftes Tuch; eine Hand hält abgerissenes Brot.
food/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour dissolving into blotchy blue and ochre washes at the edges: bread with slices, knife, tomato soup with cream, butter, vine tomatoes, basil, striped cloth; a hand holds torn bread.

problems: The bread loaf, slices, serrated knife and wooden table look photographically real rather than modelled in clay; only the hand, bowls, butter and partly the tomatoes read as plasticine
Warm, slightly golden lighting and a softened background, against the neutral studio lamps and all-in-focus look the style asks for
No visible set edges; the camera looks slightly down instead of locked off at figure height
Clay hand with tool marks, the painted window backdrop and the chunky bowls are convincing
All motif elements are present, including the drip on the rim, cream swirl, spoon, vine tomatoes, basil, folded napkin and a hand from the upper right
food/clay-animation-1.note_de: Brot, Messer und Tisch wirken fotografisch echt statt aus Knete geformt.
food/clay-animation-1.note_en: Bread, knife and table look photographically real rather than modelled in clay.
food/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetanimation am Holztisch vor gemaltem Fenster: Eine Knethand hält ein Stück Brot über die Tomatensuppe; daneben ein fast fotografisch wirkender Brotlaib mit Scheiben, Messer, Butter, Rispentomaten, Basilikum, Leinentuch.
food/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay-animation set at a wooden table, painted window behind: a clay hand holds bread over tomato soup; nearly photographic loaf with slices, knife, butter, vine tomatoes, basil, linen cloth.

problems: Fully painted naturalistic riverside landscape with far-bank horizon and water reflections; the style block forbids horizon and landscape
Heron, reeds and dragonfly are rendered in fine ink-like brushwork, not finger-swabbed ochre contours or blown pigment
Rock surface carries a regular woven/canvas-like overlay texture, so it reads like a filter on a painting
No hand stencils, red dot rows or overlapping older lines; figures do not follow wall bulges
All motif elements present (fish in beak, droplets, ripple rings at legs and strike, reeds, floating leaves, dragonfly on reed tip, far bank); no anatomy errors, format 1536x1024 correct
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-1.note_de: Zu naturalistisch für Höhlenmalerei: eine ausgemalte Uferlandschaft mit Horizont und Spiegelungen statt Tierfiguren auf der Felswand.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-1.note_en: Too naturalistic for cave art: a fully painted riverside landscape with horizon and reflections instead of animal figures on the rock.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-1.alt_de: Detailreiche Ocker- und Kohlemalerei auf rissigem Kalkstein: Ein Graureiher watet im Wasser und packt einen Fisch, links Schilf mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter, hinten ein Uferstreifen mit Büschen.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-1.alt_en: Detailed ochre and charcoal painting on cracked limestone: a wading grey heron snaps up a fish; reeds, a dragonfly and lily pads on the left, bushes on the far bank.

problems: Minor: ripple rings and lily pads seen from above are not Egyptian conventions (the ripples are required by the motif)
Minor: fine feather lines and slight tonal modelling on the neck go beyond flat unshaded fills
All motif elements present; heron in side view crest to feet, legs anatomically plausible, blue water with black zigzags, block border, no hieroglyphs or deities, format correct
animal/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Putz mit bunter Blockborte: Ein Graureiher steht im blauen Wasser mit schwarzen Zickzacklinien und fängt einen Fisch, links Papyrus mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter.
animal/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting with a coloured block border: a grey heron in blue zigzag water catches a fish; papyrus, a dragonfly and lily pads at left.

problems: Wing is cut in many fine feather strokes, against 'no fine detail' and 'sparse hatching'
Deep landscape with horizon, far tree line and reflections instead of a flat, stage-like space
Border is a thin line, not a heavy ruled border; few large solid black areas
Overall reads as a generic modern lino/woodcut rather than an early 16th-century broadsheet cut
Dragonfly is drawn rather fly-like with a big head (minor)
All motif elements present; heron faces left, fish in beak with droplets, ripples at legs and strike; format correct
animal/woodcut-2.note_de: Eher ein moderner Holzschnitt mit feinen Federschnitten und tiefer Landschaft als der grobe Flugblattstil des 16. Jahrhunderts.
animal/woodcut-2.note_en: Reads as a modern woodcut with fine feather cuts and a deep landscape rather than the coarse 16th-century broadsheet manner.
animal/woodcut-2.alt_de: Schwarzer Holzschnitt auf gelblichem Papier: Ein Graureiher watet im Wasser und schnappt einen zappelnden Fisch, Wasserringe um die Beine, links Schilf mit Libelle und große Blätter.
animal/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper: a wading grey heron snaps up a wriggling fish, ripple rings round its legs, reeds with a dragonfly and broad leaves at left.

problems: Sharp, frozen wildlife action shot with background softness reads as a blue-tinted modern telephoto photo, which the style block says to avoid
Detail is crisp rather than soft with blocked shadows; a 19th-century glass negative could not freeze the strike and droplets
Brushed sensitiser edges and drips are convincing, but the unprinted margin is narrow rather than wide
All motif elements present; legs and fish anatomically fine; format correct
animal/cyanotype-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein blau eingefärbtes, gestochen scharfes Naturfoto als wie eine echte Cyanotypie.
animal/cyanotype-1.note_en: Looks more like a sharp, blue-tinted wildlife photo than a true cyanotype.
animal/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit gepinselten Rändern auf weißem Papier: Ein Graureiher watet im Wasser und fängt einen Fisch, Tropfen spritzen, links Schilf mit Libelle.
animal/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with brushed edges on white paper: a wading grey heron catches a fish amid splashing droplets, reeds with a dragonfly at left, ripples spreading.

problems: Heron is rendered in fine feather detail with a crisp eye highlight, close to 'photographic detail under a watercolour texture'
Few true wet-in-wet effects: hardly any blooms, backruns or granulation; strokes look controlled and digital
Vignette edges dissolving into paper are good, but the middle is worked almost edge to edge
All motif elements present; fish in beak, splash, ripples from the strike, dragonfly on reed; format correct
animal/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Der Reiher ist sehr fein ausgearbeitet; vom losen Nass-in-Nass-Malen mit Ausblühungen ist wenig zu sehen.
animal/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: The heron is finely detailed; little of the loose wet-in-wet handling with blooms shows.
animal/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell, das zu den Rändern ins weiße Papier ausläuft: Ein Graureiher watet zwischen Seerosenblättern und packt einen Fisch, Wasserringe und Spritzer, links Schilf mit Libelle.
animal/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour fading into white paper at the edges: a grey heron wading among lily pads seizes a fish amid ripples and splashes, reeds with a dragonfly at left.

problems: Water is photorealistic with real reflections, glossy droplets and splash, not a tabletop set material
Heron is a near-naturalistic sculpture with smooth feather plates, not chunky TV claymation forms (ball head, sausage limbs, bead eyes); no fingerprints, tool marks or marbling visible
Background is softened by shallow depth of field (bokeh) and no set edges are visible, against the locked-off, all-in-focus studio look
All motif elements present; anatomy fine; format correct
animal/clay-animation-1.note_de: Kein Knetanimations-Look: ein fast naturgetreuer Modellreiher in fotorealistischem Wasser statt grober Knetfiguren in einer Tischkulisse.
animal/clay-animation-1.note_en: Not a clay-animation look: a near-realistic model heron in photoreal water instead of chunky clay figures on a tabletop set.
animal/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetmodell-Szene mit Kulissenhintergrund: Ein modellierter Graureiher steht in glänzendem, echt wirkendem Wasser und fängt einen Fisch, links Schilf mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter aus Knete.
animal/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay model scene with a painted backdrop: a sculpted grey heron stands in glossy, real-looking water catching a fish; clay reeds with a dragonfly and lily pads at left.

motif_missing: badger does not glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer (looks at the door)
problems: Figure drawn as a modern cartoon in 3/4 view with fur hatching, not a flat composite-view figure
Door jamb and doorstep steps rendered as 3D blocks in perspective, which the style explicitly avoids
Egyptian character carried mostly by the block border, flaking plaster, palms and zigzag water panel
Badger reads rather lanky and long-legged instead of stout and short-legged
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Der Dachs blickt zur Tür statt über die Schulter zum Betrachter, und Tür und Stufen sind räumlich statt flach gemalt.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: The badger looks at the door instead of back at the viewer, and the door and steps are drawn in perspective rather than flat.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz mit buntem Blockrand: Ein Dachs mit Schirmmütze, Steppweste, Schal und Umhängetasche klopft an eine Holztür, Paket in der Pfote, dahinter Palmen und Wasser.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster, coloured block border: a badger in cap, quilted vest, scarf and satchel knocks on a wooden door holding a parcel; palms and water behind.

motif_missing: badger does not glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer (head turned toward the door)
problems: Dense fine hatching and fur detail read as wood engraving or scratchboard, not a coarse 16th-century plank woodcut with sparse cuts
Deep perspective space (lantern, cottage, fence, steps) instead of a flat stage-like space
Border is a thin ruled line rather than a heavy one
character/woodcut-2.note_de: Feine Schraffuren und viele Details wirken eher wie Holzstich als wie grober Holzschnitt, und der Dachs blickt nicht über die Schulter zurück.
character/woodcut-2.note_en: Fine hatching and dense detail look more like wood engraving than a coarse woodcut, and the badger does not glance back over its shoulder.
character/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf cremefarbenem Papier: Ein Dachs mit Schirmmütze, Karoschal, Steppweste und Umhängetasche voller Briefe klopft an eine Brettertür, in der Pfote ein verschnürtes Paket, daneben eine Laterne.
character/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper: a badger in cap, checked scarf, quilted vest and letter-stuffed satchel knocks on a plank door, tied parcel in paw; lantern and fence beside.

motif_missing: badger does not glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer (looks toward the door)
problems: Ragged brushed edges and paper margin are convincing, but the image inside is a sharply detailed painted illustration tinted blue, close to a blue-filtered digital image
No soft glass-negative detail or blocked shadows; fine fur, ivy and stone textures stay crisp
character/cyanotype-1.note_de: Das Bild wirkt wie eine fein ausgearbeitete, blau eingefärbte Illustration statt wie ein weicher Sonnendruck, und der Blick zurück zum Betrachter fehlt.
character/cyanotype-1.note_en: The picture looks like a finely detailed illustration tinted blue rather than a soft sun print, and the glance back at the viewer is missing.
character/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefransten Pinselrändern: Ein Dachs mit Mütze, Strickschal, Steppweste und Umhängetasche voller Briefe klopft an eine efeuumrankte Holztür, in der anderen Pfote ein Paket.
character/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: a badger in cap, knitted scarf, quilted vest and letter-filled satchel knocks on an ivy-framed wooden door, a parcel in its other paw.

motif_missing: badger does not clearly glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer (half-turned face directed at the door)
problems: Fur, cap and satchel rendered in fine near-photographic detail under a watercolour texture instead of loose suggested washes
Door and plants painted to the right and top edges, so the vignette only dissolves on the left and bottom
Parcel rests on the forearm while the paw points away below it rather than gripping it
character/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Fell und Details sind fast fotografisch ausgearbeitet statt in losen Lasuren angedeutet, und der Dachs blickt nicht über die Schulter zurück.
character/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Fur and details are rendered almost photographically instead of suggested in loose washes, and the badger does not glance back over its shoulder.
character/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell in warmen Erdtönen, zum Rand hin auslaufend: Ein Dachs mit Schirmmütze, rotem Schal und Steppweste klopft an eine Holztür, trägt Paket und Posttasche, dahinter eine Dorfgasse.
character/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour in warm earth tones, fading at the edges: a badger in cap, red scarf and quilted vest knocks on a wooden door with parcel and satchel; village lane behind.

motif_missing: badger does not glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer (muzzle points at the door)
problems: Warm sunny lighting, realistic blue sky and blurred background drift toward the glossy modern AI stop-motion look the style avoids
No visible set edges or painted backdrop; reads as a detailed CG diorama, not a locked-off 1970s-1990s TV tabletop set
White fur tufts on tail and chest are fluffy fibres, not modelling clay
Forms more detailed than chunky ball-head and sausage-limb simplification
character/clay-animation-1.note_de: Warmes Sonnenlicht, unscharfer Hintergrund und flauschiges Fell rücken das Bild in Richtung glatter Computeroptik statt klassischem Knetfilm, und der Blick zurück fehlt.
character/clay-animation-1.note_en: Warm sunlight, a blurred background and fluffy fur push the image toward a slick computer look rather than classic clay animation, and the glance back is missing.
character/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetanimation im Miniatur-Set: Ein Dachs aus Knete mit blauer Mütze, rotem Strickschal, grüner Weste und Ledertasche klopft an eine grüne Tür, ein verschnürtes Paket im Arm.
character/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay-animation still on a miniature set: a modelling-clay badger in blue cap, red knitted scarf, green vest and leather satchel knocks on a green door, string-tied parcel in arm.

motif_missing: River dead-ends in the southern forest instead of flowing into the bay
problems: River peters out inland past the bridge and never reaches the bay (geographic logic)
Hill is 3D-shaded and town buildings are in oblique perspective, against the flat, unshaded Egyptian convention
Reads more as a fresco-textured fantasy map than a Theban tomb painting; the block border, zigzag water, flaking plaster and boxed lettering are right, but there are no register ground lines
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_de: Der Fluss versickert im Wald, statt in die Bucht zu münden.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_en: The river peters out in the forest instead of reaching the bay.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Karte im Stil ägyptischer Grabmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Hafenstadt Varn, Windmühle auf dem Hügel Eskel, Leuchtturm Moa, Zickzackwellen, Fisch und bunter Blockrand.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian tomb-painting map on flaking plaster: crescent island Lornholm with harbour town Varn, windmill on Eskel hill, Moa lighthouse, zigzag waves, a toothed fish and a chequered border.

motif_missing: River ends in the southern forest instead of flowing into the bay
Road links lighthouse and town but not the windmill
problems: River dead-ends among the trees in the south and never reaches the bay
No road branch to the windmill on Eskel
River filled with a grey-blue tone, which the style block rules out
Much finer detail and field hatching than a coarse early-16th-century plank woodcut (tiny trees, fine cliff hatching)
map/woodcut-2.note_de: Der Fluss endet im Wald statt in der Bucht, und kein Weg führt zur Windmühle.
map/woodcut-2.note_en: The river ends in the forest instead of the bay, and no road reaches the windmill.
map/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Insel Lornholm mit Steilküsten, dichtem Wald, Windmühle auf dem Hügel Eskel, Hafenstadt Varn mit Steg und drei Booten, Leuchtturm Moa, Seeschlange.
map/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on warm paper: Lornholm island with cliffs, dense forest, a windmill on Eskel hill, harbour town Varn with pier and three boats, Moa lighthouse and a sea serpent.

problems: Island is a detailed aerial perspective illustration toned blue, not a flat cut-paper or tissue photogram, so it drifts toward a blue-filtered digital drawing
Unprinted margin is narrow rather than wide; the brushed, dripping edges and paper texture are convincing
map/cyanotype-1.note_de: Die Insel ist eine detaillierte, blau eingefärbte Perspektivzeichnung statt eines flachen Fotogramms.
map/cyanotype-1.note_en: The island is a detailed perspective drawing tinted blue rather than a flat photogram.
map/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit gepinselten, tropfenden Rändern: sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Wald, Windmühle auf dem Hügel Eskel, Hafen Varn mit drei Booten, Leuchtturm Moa, ein Wal, weiße Schrift.
map/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with brushed, dripping edges: crescent island Lornholm with forest, a windmill on Eskel hill, harbour town Varn with three boats, Moa lighthouse, a whale, white lettering.

problems: Tight, fine rendering of every tree, rock and house; reads as the generic AI watercolour fantasy map, not loose wet-in-wet washes
Island is worked in detail almost edge to edge, with little suggestion by broad strokes (the sea and vignette edges are looser)
River rises on the western slope near the coast, not clearly on the windmill hill
map/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Statt lockerer Nass-in-Nass-Lasuren ist die Insel kleinteilig und detailliert ausgemalt.
map/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Instead of loose wet-in-wet washes, the island is painted in tight, fine detail.
map/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell, das zum Rand hin ins weiße Papier ausläuft: Insel Lornholm mit Wald, Windmühle auf Eskel, Hafenstadt Varn mit Steg und drei Booten, Leuchtturm Moa, Wal, Sepiaschrift.
map/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour fading into bare paper at the edges: Lornholm island with forest, windmill on Eskel hill, harbour town Varn with pier and three boats, Moa lighthouse, whale, sepia labels.

motif_missing: River flows into the open sea on the south-east coast, not into the bay
problems: River runs south to the open sea instead of into the harbour bay, and a disconnected patch of water sits on the hill's east side
Island is only weakly crescent-shaped; the harbour is a walled basin with stone moles rather than a pier in an inner bay
Place-name tags use printed lettering instead of rolled clay letters (the title is correct)
Clay surface is fairly clean and smooth, with few fingerprints or tool marks
map/clay-animation-1.note_de: Der Fluss mündet im Südosten ins offene Meer statt in die Hafenbucht.
map/clay-animation-1.note_en: The river flows into the open sea in the south-east instead of the harbour bay.
map/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetrelief auf einem Brett: Insel Lornholm aus Plastilin mit Wald aus Knetkugeln, Windmühle auf Eskel, ummauertem Hafen Varn mit drei Booten, Leuchtturm Moa, Wal und Buchstaben aus Knetwürsten.
map/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay relief on a board: plasticine island Lornholm with a forest of clay balls, windmill on Eskel hill, walled harbour Varn with three boats, Moa lighthouse, a whale, clay-snake lettering.

problems: Icons are vector-clean modern flat icons with an even outline weight, sitting under a flaking-plaster texture; apart from the palette, the ruled compartments and the block border they show little Egyptian drawing habit
Magnifier lens has a glossy white glass highlight, a 3D cue the style avoids
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_de: Wirkt wie moderne Flat-Icons mit Putztextur, und die Lupe hat sogar einen glänzenden Glasreflex.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_en: Reads as modern flat icons under a plaster texture, and the magnifier even has a glossy glass highlight.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Kalkputz: Neun flache Icons in rotbraun umrandeten Feldern – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Pin, Zahnrad, Herz – in Ocker, Blau und Grün, mit farbigem Blockrahmen.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster: nine flat icons in ruled compartments – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, pin, gear, heart – in ochre, blue and green, with a block border.

problems: Minor: the house has grass tufts and the pin a ground shadow, so the level of detail varies slightly
Curved highlight cuts on the heart, bell and lenses lean slightly toward tonal modelling; the contours are somewhat smoother than a 16th-century cut
icons/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Neun Icons in einem dick gerahmten Raster – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Pin, Zahnrad, Herz –, grobe Schnittlinien und Holzmaserung in den Feldern.
icons/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on off-white paper: nine icons in a heavily ruled grid – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, pin, gear, heart – with coarse gouge marks and wood grain.

problems: Icon shapes are crisp standard glyph outlines, and the mottling inside them looks slightly filter-like, but the brushed edge, the drips and the bare margin are convincing
icons/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie mit ausgefranstem Pinselrand: Neun weiße Scherenschnitt-Silhouetten auf Preußischblau – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Pin, Zahnrad, Herz –, umgeben von unbedrucktem Papier.
icons/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: nine soft white paper-cut silhouettes on Prussian blue – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, pin, gear, heart – inside a bare paper margin.

problems: Objects are neatly rendered with defined edges and dark contours (envelope, magnifier rim, calendar rings) instead of loose wet-in-wet washes; generic watercolour clip-art look
Only the background splashes show blooms and bleeding; the icons themselves are worked up in detail (door planks, curled calendar page, lens reflections)
Uneven level of detail: the house has bushes and the pin a green ground wash, the others do not
icons/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Eher sauber ausgearbeitete Aquarell-Cliparts mit Konturen als lockeres Nass-in-Nass.
icons/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Closer to neatly rendered watercolour clip art with outlines than loose wet-in-wet painting.
icons/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell auf rauem Papier: Neun farbige Icons – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Pin, Zahnrad, Herz –, jedes umgeben von zerlaufenden blauen und ockerfarbenen Farbwolken, ohne Rahmen.
icons/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour on textured paper: nine coloured icons – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, pin, gear, heart – each set in bleeding blue and ochre washes, unframed.

problems: Top-down flat lay on a card board rather than a locked-off film camera at figure height; no set edges visible (acceptable as clay relief on a board for an icon set)
Clay is fairly clean: tool scores and cracks are visible, but there is little marbling or fingerprinting and no lint
icons/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetrelief auf blauem Karton: Neun Icons aus matter Knetmasse – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Pin, Zahnrad, Herz – in Rot, Gelb, Grau und Creme, mit Werkzeugspuren.
icons/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay relief on blue card: nine matte modelling-clay icons – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, pin, gear, heart – in red, yellow, grey and cream, with tool marks.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: figure counts are 8 / 25 / 20 / 3 for 12 / 30 / 24 / 6, so each figure stands for a different amount (1.5k, 1.2k, 1.2k, 2k)
problems: Pictogram counts are inconsistent. By count, July is 8.3x September (should be 5x) and 3.1x June (should be 2.5x). The style block itself demands 'rows of identical objects, counted exactly'.
Row counts (2, 5, 4, 1) are proportional, but row widths differ (4, 5, 5, 3 figures), so visual mass and area are not.
Lettering is a set Roman serif in blue, not brush-painted. This is minor.

Otherwise the style is strong: composite figures, red-brown men and ochre women, ground lines, blue zigzag water, a coloured block border, flaking plaster and no hieroglyphs. Landscape format is correct.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_de: Die Figurenzahl stimmt nicht: Juni zeigt 8, September nur 3 und Juli 25 Figuren. Damit geht das Verhältnis 12:30:24:6 verloren. Die Texte stimmen und die Stapelhöhen passen, aber die Figurenzahlen (8, 25, 20, 3) entsprechen nicht dem Verhältnis 12:30:24:6, sodass der September zu klein wirkt.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.note_en: The figure counts are off: June shows 8, September 3 and July 25 figures, which breaks the 12:30:24:6 ratio. The text is correct and the stack heights fit, but the figure counts (8, 25, 20, 3) do not match the 12:30:24:6 ratio, so September looks too small.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Putz mit Farbblock-Rahmen: Reihen rotbrauner Männer und ockerfarbener Frauen stehen gestapelt in vier Booten über blauem Zickzackwasser, darunter Monate und Zahlen in Feldern.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-1.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on cracked plaster: rows of red-brown men and ochre women stacked in four boats over blue zigzag water, with months and numbers in ruled boxes below.
text_errors: figure counts expected in ratio 12:30:24:6, found 8 / 25 / 20 / 3 figures (JUN about 20% low and SEP about 40% low relative to JUL; JUL is 8.3x SEP instead of 5x). The stacks have 2:5:4:1 rows, so their heights are proportional; only the counts are off.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the stacks hold 4 / 12 / 10 / 4 figures, so June (12) and September (6) show the same count
problems: June and September stacks both hold 4 figures, although June should be double September.
Stack heights (about 240, 660, 505 and 165 px) make September about 0.25 of July (should be 0.2) and July about 2.75x June (should be 2.5).
The bottom rows of the August and September stacks are cut off at the waist behind the label plinths, leaving truncated figures.

Style is convincing as a bold woodcut or linocut with grain flecks, a scroll banner and a heavy border. The ship and crowd are cut somewhat finer and more modern than an early-16th-century broadsheet.
chart/woodcut-2.note_de: Die Figurenstapel sind nicht proportional: Juni und September zeigen gleich viele Figuren (je 4), obwohl Juni doppelt so viele Passagiere hat. Die Texte stimmen, aber die Septembersäule ist zu hoch: Sie zeigt fast so viele Figuren wie der Juni, obwohl es nur halb so viele sein sollten.
chart/woodcut-2.note_en: The figure stacks are not proportional: June and September both show four figures although June has twice the passengers. The text is correct, but September's column is too tall: it shows almost as many figures as June, though it should be half.
chart/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf Büttenpapier: Passagiere gehen an Bord einer Fähre, daneben stehen Stapel kleiner Reisender auf einem Steg vor Meer und Inselkirche, Titel im Schriftband.
chart/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on off-white paper: passengers board a ferry; beside it, stacks of small travellers stand on a pier before sea and an island church, title on a scroll.
text_errors: SEP column expected at about 1/5 of JUL's height, found about 1/4 (around 27% too tall). SEP shows 2 full and 2 half figures, almost as many as JUN's 4, although it should be half of June. Figure counts are about 4 / 12 / 10 / 4.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the silhouette counts are 6 / 24 / 18 / 6, a 1:4:3:1 ratio instead of 2:5:4:1, so June equals September
problems: June and September both show 6 figures. July is 4x September (should be 5x) and 4x June (should be 2.5x).
September's silhouettes are drawn smaller than the others, so pictogram size is inconsistent.
The ferry and sea reflections lean slightly toward a blue-toned photograph. The ragged brushed edges, drips, white serif lettering and photogram-like silhouettes are convincing.
chart/cyanotype-1.note_de: Die Figurenzahlen stimmen nicht: Juni und September zeigen je 6, Juli 24 und August 18 Figuren statt im Verhältnis 12:30:24:6. Die Texte stimmen, aber der Juni ist zu klein dargestellt: sechs Figuren, so viele wie im September, während der Juli 24 hat.
chart/cyanotype-1.note_en: The figure counts are wrong: June and September show 6 each, July 24 and August 18, instead of the 12:30:24:6 ratio. The text is correct, but June is shown too small: six figures, as many as September, while July has 24.
chart/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefranstem Pinselrand: Eine Fähre steuert auf eine Insel mit Leuchtturm zu, davor stehen weiße Personensilhouetten in vier Gruppen, beschriftet mit Monat und Zahl.
chart/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: a ferry heads for an island with a lighthouse, and white figure silhouettes stand in four groups labelled with month and number.
text_errors: figure quantities expected in ratio 12:30:24:6, found 6 / 24 / 18 / 6 figures (JUN has the same count as SEP, and JUL is 4x JUN instead of 2.5x). The JUN block is about 28% of JUL's height instead of 40%.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the crowd columns measure about 192 / 620 / 450 / 100 px, which exaggerates July (3.2x June instead of 2.5x, 6.2x September instead of 5x)
problems: Column heights are not proportional. July is about 29% too tall relative to June, and August is 2.3x June instead of 2x.
Person counts are inconsistent too: about 6 in September and about 13 in June, but far more than 30 in July.

The style is a generic, fairly controlled illustrative watercolour. Figures are rendered in detail (backpacks, hats) with some dark linework, and true wet-in-wet blooms and backruns are few. The vignette edges and sepia brush lettering fit the style.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Die Säulen sind nicht proportional: Die Juli-Menge ist gut dreimal so hoch wie die im Juni statt zweieinhalbmal. Die Texte stimmen, aber die Juni-Menge ist im Vergleich zum Juli etwa ein Fünftel zu niedrig.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: The columns are not proportional: July's crowd is over three times June's height instead of two and a half. The text is correct, but the June crowd is about a fifth too short compared with July.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell in verlaufenden Blau- und Ockertönen: Auf einem Hafensteg türmen sich vier unterschiedlich hohe Säulen aus Menschen, links eine Fähre, rechts eine Felseninsel mit Häusern, Titel in Pinselschrift.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour in bleeding blues and ochres: four uneven columns of people stand on a harbour pier, a ferry at left, a rocky island with houses at right, brush-lettered title.
text_errors: JUN crowd expected at about 40% of JUL's height, found about 31% (about 190 px vs 620 px, roughly 20% too short). AUG (~72%) and SEP (~17%) are close to the limit but still acceptable.

problems: The counts are correct: 12, 30, 24 and 6 pictograms, one per thousand.
June is set in rows of 4 while the other months use rows of 6, so the block heights cannot be compared directly.
June's lower two rows of pictograms are squashed, with legs about 15% shorter, and September's figures are slightly shorter. This breaks the rule of identical pictograms of equal size.

The style is generic: modern restroom-sign person icons rather than Arntz-type figures, one colour per month, and a huge heavy display title instead of small matter-of-fact lettering. Flat colours, no outlines and the cream paper fit the style.
chart/isotype-1.note_de: Juni steht in Viererreihen statt Sechserreihen und seine Figuren sind gestaucht. So lassen sich die Blöcke schlechter vergleichen.
chart/isotype-1.note_en: June is set in rows of four instead of six and its figures are squashed, which makes the blocks harder to compare.
chart/isotype-1.alt_de: Isotype-Grafik auf Cremepapier: Flache Personen-Piktogramme in Ziegelrot, Schieferblau, Ocker und Schwarz stehen in Reihen über je einem Fährsymbol, darunter Monat und Zahl.
chart/isotype-1.alt_en: Isotype chart on cream paper: flat person pictograms in brick red, slate blue, ochre and black, stacked in rows above a ferry symbol, month and number beneath.

problems: The bars are proportional within about 6%: 188, 458, 361 and 97 px.
The background ferry, sea and island sit in creamy shallow-depth-of-field blur. The style block asks for everything in focus and says to avoid bokeh.
The pier bollards, ropes and wooden planks look photoreal rather than modelled from clay or card. There are no visible set edges, and the board is centred in hero framing.
The clay relief bars show fingerprints and tool marks, and the letters are rolled from clay snakes. These parts fit the style.
chart/clay-animation-1.note_de: Der Hintergrund verschwimmt in fotografischer Unschärfe, Poller und Taue wirken echt statt geknetet.
chart/clay-animation-1.note_en: The background melts into photographic blur, and the bollards and ropes look real rather than modelled in clay.
chart/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Knetrelief auf einer Tafel: vier Balken aus roter, blauer, gelber und grüner Knete mit gerollten Zahlen und Monatsnamen, dahinter ein Steg mit Pollern, eine Fähre und eine Insel.
chart/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Clay relief board: four bars of red, blue, yellow and green modelling clay with rolled-clay numbers and months; behind it a pier, a ferry and an island.

motif_missing: JUN bar contains only 8 passenger figures although its value is 12 (JUL and SEP use one figure = 1)
AUG bar contains only 20 passenger figures although its value is 24
Bar heights only roughly proportional: JUL/SEP ≈ 5.7 instead of 5, AUG/JUN ≈ 1.9 instead of 2; bar widths also differ
problems: Pictogram encoding is inconsistent: JUL shows 30 figures (5x6) and SEP 6 figures (one figure = 1), but JUN shows 8 (4x2) and AUG 20 (5x4), so the counted quantities contradict the printed numbers 12 and 24
Heavy decorative harbour scene (sun, sea, cliff with lighthouse, ferry, gulls, bollards) competes with the data, though the chart stays readable

Riso look is strong (pink/blue/yellow spot inks, speckled grain, pink misregistration on the title, off-white paper), but the layout is a full-bleed poster rather than a zine spread with generous margins and hand-drawn arrows
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no logos, signatures or watermarks; lighthouse and cliff are generic
chart/risograph-1.note_de: Die Figurenzahl stimmt nicht: Im Juni stehen 8 statt 12, im August 20 statt 24 Figuren. Die Figuren passen nicht zu den Zahlen: Juni zeigt 8 Figuren für 12 und August 20 für 24, während Juli (30) und September (6) je eine Figur pro Tausend zählen.
chart/risograph-1.note_en: The figure counts are wrong: June shows 8 instead of 12 figures, August 20 instead of 24. The pictograms don't match the numbers: June shows 8 figures for 12 and August 20 for 24, while July (30) and September (6) use one figure per thousand.
chart/risograph-1.alt_de: Risographie in Pink, Blau und Gelb mit körnigem Druck und versetzten Farben: Rosa Balken voller blauer Passagierfiguren für Juni bis September vor Meer, Klippe mit Leuchtturm und Fähre.
chart/risograph-1.alt_en: Risograph print in pink, blue and yellow with grainy, misregistered ink: pink bars filled with blue passenger figures for June to September, set against sea, a lighthouse cliff and a ferry.
text_errors: expected 12 pictograms for JUN (JUL and SEP use one figure per thousand: 30 and 6), found 8 (4x2 grid)
expected 24 pictograms for AUG, found 20 (5x4 grid)

SEP block is slightly short: measured block heights JUN 255, JUL 629, AUG 485, SEP 107 px; SEP should be about 126 px relative to JUL (about 15% short, at the tolerance limit). JUN and AUG block heights are within 5%.

motif_missing: two-burner stove (hob shows three burners plus one under the kettle, i.e. four)
problems: Table top, chairs, sink and stove box drawn in perspective / three-quarter view instead of flat Egyptian side view (perspective is explicitly avoided)
No ground-line registers; composition reads as a modern flat folk illustration dressed in an Egyptian palette, block border and flaking-plaster texture
Stove has four burners and two knobs instead of a two-burner stove
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_de: Tisch, Stühle und Herd sind perspektivisch statt flach im ägyptischen Seitenprofil gezeichnet, und der Herd hat mehr als zwei Platten.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_en: Table, chairs and stove are drawn in perspective rather than flat Egyptian side view, and the stove has more than two burners.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_de: Wandmalerei im altägyptischen Stil auf abblätterndem Putz mit bunter Blockbordüre: Küche mit Kräutern am Fenster, Tellerregal, Radio, Puzzle und blauer Teekanne auf dem Tisch, Kessel auf dem Herd.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_en: Egyptian-style wall painting on flaking plaster, block-coloured border: kitchen with herbs on the sill, plate shelves, radio, jigsaw and blue teapot on the table, kettle on the stove.

problems: Far too much fine detail and dense parallel hatching for a bold early-16th-century woodcut; reads closer to a modern linocut or wood engraving
Deep diagonal room perspective with many overlapping planes instead of a flat, stage-like space
Border is a thin line rather than a heavy ruled border
Loose jigsaw pieces are drawn as little flower shapes
interior/woodcut-2.note_de: Zu fein und räumlich zu tief für einen groben Holzschnitt des 16. Jahrhunderts, eher ein moderner Linolschnitt.
interior/woodcut-2.note_en: Too fine and too deep in space for a bold 16th-century woodcut; it reads more like a modern linocut.
interior/woodcut-2.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: enge Küche mit Kräutertöpfen am Fenster, Regal mit Tellern, Gläsern und Radio, Kessel auf dem Herd, Puzzle und Teekanne auf dem Holztisch.
interior/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on off-white paper: cramped kitchen with herb pots on the sill, shelves of plates, jars and radio, kettle on the stove, jigsaw and teapot on the table.

motif_missing: wall calendar (a hanging botanical print is shown in its place)
two-burner stove (four-knob gas range shown)
problems: Wall calendar replaced by a botanical print
Stove has four knobs/burners instead of two
Bread bag and jar of wooden spoons appear twice (left counter and right counter / sill and counter)
Unprinted margin is narrow and the ragged edge looks partly like a digital brush frame; image detail is sharper than a typical cyanotype
interior/cyanotype-1.note_de: Der Wandkalender fehlt, an seiner Stelle hängt ein Pflanzenbild.
interior/cyanotype-1.note_en: The wall calendar is missing; a botanical print hangs in its place.
interior/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefransten Pinselrändern: Küche mit Sprossenfenster über der Spüle, Kräutertöpfen, Regal mit Nudelgläsern und Radio, Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Tisch.
interior/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: a kitchen with a window over the sink, herb pots, shelves of pasta jars and radio, jigsaw, teapot and cup on the table.

motif_missing: wall calendar
two-burner stove (four-burner range with four knobs shown)
problems: Tightly rendered, near-photographic detail under a mottled watercolour texture instead of loose wet-in-wet washes; generic AI-watercolour look (explicitly avoided)
Wall calendar missing
Stove has four burners/knobs instead of two
Jar of wooden spoons duplicated on the counter
interior/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Eher detailreiche Aquarell-Illustration als lockeres Nass-in-Nass, und der Wandkalender fehlt.
interior/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: More a detailed watercolour illustration than loose wet-in-wet, and the wall calendar is missing.
interior/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell, das an den Rändern ins weiße Papier ausläuft: Küche mit Kräutern am Fenster, Regal mit Nudelgläsern und Radio, Kupferkessel auf dem Herd, Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Tisch.
interior/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour fading into white paper: kitchen with herbs on the sill, shelves of pasta jars and a radio, copper kettle on the stove, jigsaw, teapot and cup on the table.

motif_missing: two-burner stove (four-knob range shown)
problems: Reads as a photographed rustic kitchen or dollhouse: real wood grain, real-looking basil and rosemary, tiles and chairs, not chunky oil-based modelling clay
Warm golden sunlight and soft bokeh through the window, both explicitly avoided; no neutral studio lamps
Only teapot, mug and newspaper look modelled; no fingerprints, tool scores, card/fabric set or visible set edges
Stove has four knobs/burners instead of two
interior/clay-animation-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein fotografiertes Puppenhaus mit echtem Holz und Pflanzen, kaum wie Knetanimation.
interior/clay-animation-1.note_en: Looks like a photographed dollhouse with real wood and plants rather than clay animation.
interior/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Fotorealistische Miniaturküche in warmem Sonnenlicht, nur Teekanne und Tasse wirken geknetet: Kräuter am Fenster, Regale mit Gläsern und Radio, Puzzle auf dem Holztisch, Mantel an der Tür.
interior/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Photorealistic miniature kitchen in warm sunlight, only teapot and mug look clay-modelled: herbs on the sill, shelves of jars and a radio, jigsaw on the table, coat by the door.

motif_missing: fourth leaf (only three leaves: one curled, one bitten, one plain)
problems: Only three leaves instead of four

Rendering is a naturalistic European botanical plate (fine veins, detailed stamens, modelled/shaded fruit) placed on aged plaster; Egyptian cues limited to block border, flaking whitewash, red-brown outlines and palette
No ground lines/registers; 3D shading on the whole fruit, which the style block says to avoid
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logos, signatures or watermarks
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Es sind nur drei statt vier Blätter, und die Malweise wirkt eher wie eine europäische Botanik-Tafel als wie ägyptische Wandmalerei.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Only three of the four leaves are shown, and the rendering looks more like a European botanical plate than Egyptian wall painting.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Wandmalerei im ägyptischen Stil auf rissigem Kalkputz mit bunter Blockbordüre: Quittenzweig mit Blüte, Knospe, drei Blättern und gelber Frucht, darunter halbierte Quitte, Samen und Blütenblatt.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian-style wall painting on cracked plaster with a coloured block border: quince branch with blossom, bud, three leaves and yellow fruit; below, a halved quince, a seed and a petal.

problems: Fine, dense parallel hatching used for tonal modelling of the fruit and leaves reads as wood engraving/scratchboard rather than a coarse knife-cut woodcut
Few large solid black areas, no wood-grain streaks or white flecks in solids
Heavy ruled border and off-white paper are on-style
All motif elements present: four leaves (curled, bitten), five-petalled blossom, bud, lumpy fruit, halved fruit with core and seeds, single seed, detached petal; format correct; no marks
botanical/woodcut-2.note_de: Die feine Schraffur erinnert eher an einen Holzstich als an einen groben Holzschnitt.
botanical/woodcut-2.note_en: The fine hatching looks more like wood engraving than a coarse woodcut.
botanical/woodcut-2.alt_de: Schwarzer Holzschnitt auf cremefarbenem Papier mit kräftigem Rahmen: Quittenzweig mit fünfblättriger Blüte, Knospe, vier Blättern und Frucht, unten die halbierte Quitte, ein Samen und ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/woodcut-2.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper inside a heavy border: quince branch with five-petalled blossom, bud, four leaves and fruit; below, the halved quince, a seed and a loose petal.

motif_missing: fourth leaf (only three leaves: one curled, one bitten, one plain)
problems: Only three leaves instead of four
Plant is a tonally shaded, three-dimensional drawing in blue rather than a flat soft-edged photogram silhouette; drifts toward a blue-toned illustration
Brushed sensitiser edges, drips and unprinted margin are convincing
Format correct; no logos, signatures or watermarks
botanical/cyanotype-1.note_de: Ein Blatt fehlt, und die Pflanze ist plastisch schattiert statt als flaches Fotogramm belichtet.
botanical/cyanotype-1.note_en: One leaf is missing, and the plant is drawn with shading rather than printed as a flat photogram.
botanical/cyanotype-1.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit gepinselten Rändern auf hellem Papier: Quittenzweig mit Blüte, Knospe, drei Blättern und Frucht, dazu halbierte Quitte, Samen und Blütenblatt in Weiß.
botanical/cyanotype-1.alt_en: Cyanotype in Prussian blue with brushed edges on pale paper: quince branch with blossom, bud, three leaves and fruit, plus a halved quince, a seed and a petal in white.

motif_missing: leaf count off: three full leaves plus two small leaflets instead of four leaves
problems: Painting is detailed and crisp-edged with chunky filter-like patches and white flecks, not loose wet-in-wet washes; few blooms or backruns, forms rendered rather than suggested
Leaf count ambiguous (three large leaves plus two small leaflets at the fork)
Blossom has five petals; bud, bitten and curled leaves, lumpy fruit, halved fruit with seeds, seed and petal present; vignette on bare paper is on-style
Format correct; no logos, signatures or watermarks
botanical/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_de: Statt lockerer Nass-in-Nass-Lasuren ist das Aquarell detailliert und scharfkantig gemalt.
botanical/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.note_en: Rather than loose wet-in-wet washes, the watercolour is detailed and crisp-edged.
botanical/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_de: Aquarell auf rauem Papier in Rosa, Gelb und Grün: Quittenzweig mit Blüte, Knospe, angefressenem und eingerolltem Blatt, gelbe Frucht, darunter halbierte Quitte, Samen und Blütenblatt.
botanical/watercolor-wet-in-wet-2.alt_en: Watercolour on textured paper in pink, yellow and green: quince branch with blossom, bud, a bitten and a curled leaf, yellow fruit; below, a halved quince, seed and petal.

problems: Reads as a realistic sculpted clay still life photographed on a seamless grey studio backdrop, not a frame from a clay-animation film
No tabletop set, card/fabric, painted backdrop or visible set edges; forms are naturalistic rather than chunky and simplified; few fingerprints or tool scores
Branch floats unsupported while fruit and cut pieces cast shadows on the ground
All motif elements present: four leaves (curled, bitten), five-petalled blossom, bud, lumpy fruit, halved fruit with core and seeds, single seed, detached petal; format correct; no marks
botanical/clay-animation-1.note_de: Wirkt wie eine realistische Tonskulptur im Fotostudio, nicht wie ein Bild aus einem Knetanimationsfilm.
botanical/clay-animation-1.note_en: It looks like a realistic clay sculpture in a photo studio rather than a frame from a clay-animation film.
botanical/clay-animation-1.alt_de: Aus Knetmasse modellierter Quittenzweig vor grauem Hintergrund: Blüte, Knospe, vier Blätter und gelbe Frucht, davor halbierte Quitte mit Kernen, ein Samen und ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/clay-animation-1.alt_en: Quince branch modelled in clay against a grey backdrop: blossom, bud, four leaves and a yellow fruit; in front, a halved quince with seeds, a single seed and a petal.

motif_missing: older woman barely readable as a woman (face and build read as an old man)
no distinct new plank; she presses against the existing hull
problems: naturalistic illustration with horizon, seascape, distant hills and perspective, explicitly against the style (no ground line, horizon or landscape)
figures fully modelled and shaded like a modern illustration, not crude outlines
rock texture applied like a filter over the drawing; no hand stencils, dot rows, blown-pigment edges or overlapping older lines
composition is a centred narrative scene rather than figures placed on wall bulges at uneven sizes
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.note_de: Eine naturalistische Illustration mit Horizont und Landschaft, nur auf eine Felsstruktur gelegt – keine echte Höhlenmalerei.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.note_en: A naturalistic illustration with horizon and landscape laid over a rock texture, not genuine cave painting.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.alt_de: Felsmalerei in Ocker und Kohle auf rissigem Kalkstein: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet und drückt gegen ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze hämmert; dahinter Meer, Steg, Möwen.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.alt_en: Ochre and charcoal on cracked limestone: a grey-haired woman kneels against an upturned boat while a capped young man hammers a nail; sea, jetty and gulls behind.

problems: dense cross-hatching and engraved shading instead of relief lines and dilute washes; reads like a tinted engraving
sea horizon, jetty and boat drawn in perspective, against the no-landscape/no-perspective rule
pebble beach fills the ground instead of a single ground line
tongue frieze and meander band are correct, but the figure drawing is pastiche
people/greek-red-figure-vase-painting-2.note_de: Schraffuren, Perspektive und Meereslandschaft lassen es eher wie einen eingefärbten Kupferstich wirken als wie rotfigurige Vasenmalerei.
people/greek-red-figure-vase-painting-2.note_en: Cross-hatching, perspective and a seascape make it read more like a tinted engraving than red-figure vase painting.
people/greek-red-figure-vase-painting-2.alt_de: Orangefarbene Figuren auf schwarzem Glanzton zwischen Zungenfries und Mäanderband: Ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, eine alte Frau drückt sie fest.
people/greek-red-figure-vase-painting-2.alt_en: Orange figures on black gloss between tongue frieze and meander: a young man in a knitted cap nails a plank to an upturned boat, an old woman pressing it down.

motif_missing: woman presses the hull, not a new plank (the planks lie on the ground)
problems: sunset-photo backlit silhouettes with glittering sea and rim light, exactly what the style says to avoid
figures, boat, toolbox and rope have interior shading and texture instead of solid scissor-cut black
deep perspective with distant headland, town, lighthouse and sailboat instead of a shallow side-on frieze stage
figures not in strict profile; no single black ground line
people/silhouette-animation-2.note_de: Gegenlicht-Silhouetten vor glitzerndem Meer mit Tiefe und Binnenzeichnung statt flacher Scherenschnittfiguren im Profil.
people/silhouette-animation-2.note_en: Backlit sunset silhouettes with depth and interior detail instead of flat scissor-cut figures in profile.
people/silhouette-animation-2.alt_de: Bernsteinfarbenes Gegenlichtbild: Dunkle Silhouetten einer alten Frau und eines jungen Mannes mit Hammer am umgedrehten Boot, dahinter glitzerndes Meer, Steg mit zwei Möwen, Leuchtturm und Segelboot.
people/silhouette-animation-2.alt_en: Amber backlit scene: dark silhouettes of an old woman and a hammering young man at an upturned boat; behind, glittering sea, a jetty with two gulls, a lighthouse and sailboat.

problems: print looks digitally smooth: almost no grain, smooth sky, full modern tonal range with many midtones
overall reads closer to contemporary dramatic monochrome than a 1920s gelatin silver print, though the steep angle, diagonals and hard shadows fit
people/new-vision-2.note_de: Starke Aufsicht und harte Schatten, doch die Aufnahme wirkt digital glatt, mit kaum Korn und zu vielen Mitteltönen.
people/new-vision-2.note_en: Strong overhead angle and hard shadows, but the print looks digitally smooth, with little grain and too many midtones.
people/new-vision-2.alt_de: Schwarzweißfoto steil von oben, schräg angeschnitten: Eine alte Frau drückt eine helle neue Planke auf den Bootsrumpf, ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie fest; harte Sonne, Steg, Möwen.
people/new-vision-2.alt_en: Steep overhead black-and-white photo on a diagonal: an old woman presses a pale new plank onto the hull, a young man in a beanie nails it; hard sun, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: woman's grey hair is pinned up, not short
kneeling posture not visible
problems: looks like a modern HDR digital photo on a real coast, i.e. the generic AI photo look
no built studio set or painted backdrop sky; real clouds and real seascape
no dye-transfer jewel colours against muted set colours; crisp digital micro-detail and texture
extra lighthouse and cliff-top houses in the background
people/three-strip-technicolor-2.note_de: Wirkt wie ein modernes HDR-Foto an einer echten Küste, nicht wie ein Technicolor-Studiobild mit gemalter Kulisse.
people/three-strip-technicolor-2.note_en: Looks like a modern HDR photo on a real coast, not a Technicolor studio frame with a painted backdrop.
people/three-strip-technicolor-2.alt_de: Scharfes, farbsattes Foto an felsiger Küste: Ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, eine grauhaarige Frau drückt sie fest; dahinter Steg, Möwen, Leuchtturm.
people/three-strip-technicolor-2.alt_en: Crisp, saturated photo, rocky coast: a young man in a knitted cap nails a new plank to an upturned boat as a grey-haired woman holds it; jetty, gulls, lighthouse.

problems: drawn with adult skill: correct anatomy, expressive faces, realistic hands, gulls and toolbox
overlap, foreshortening and perspective on the boat and figures, no child schemas (circle heads, stick limbs, rake fingers)
sea rendered as a full perspective band rather than objects standing side by side on a ground line
only the crayon texture, corner sun and sky strip match the style: faux-naive adult illustration
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-2.note_de: Die Wachskreide stimmt, doch richtige Anatomie, Überschneidungen und Perspektive wirken erwachsen, nicht wie von einem sechsjährigen Kind.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-2.note_en: The crayon texture fits, but correct anatomy, overlaps and perspective look adult-drawn, not like a six-year-old's work.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-2.alt_de: Wachsmalkreide auf weißem Papier, Sonne in der Ecke: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein junger Mann mit blauer Mütze hämmert; Steg, Möwen.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-2.alt_en: Wax crayon on white paper, sun in the corner: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank, a young man in a blue cap hammers; jetty, gulls.

problems: The young man nails the left end of the new plank where it sticks out into the air over the woman's lap, with no hull behind it, so the nail has nothing to go into

Drifts from pure ligne claire: hatched wrinkles and folds on faces and clothes, a weathered-paint texture on the hull, shaded pebbles; the figures are semi-realistic rather than simplified and dot-eyed

Hands, the cap, the rolled sleeves, the toolbox, the rope, the nail tin, the jetty end and the two gulls are all correct; the lighthouse and houses are generic; no signature or logo; 1536x1024 landscape is correct
people/ligne-claire-2.note_de: Der junge Mann nagelt das Ende der Planke fest, das frei in die Luft ragt.
people/ligne-claire-2.note_en: The young man nails the end of the plank that juts out into thin air.
people/ligne-claire-2.alt_de: Ligne-claire-Comicpanel mit klaren Konturen und flachen Farben: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes rotes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt, dahinter Steg und Möwen.
people/ligne-claire-2.alt_en: Ligne claire comic panel in flat colours: a grey-haired woman presses a plank onto an upturned boat while a young man in a beanie nails it; jetty and gulls behind.

motif_missing: The young man crouches on the far side of the hull, well away from the woman, not beside her
problems: Not mid-century modern commercial art: faces and hands are realistic and modelled, with none of the angular geometry, oval heads, dot eyes or thin limbs
No loose, broken black brush line and no off-register flat colour shapes; instead an all-over speckled grain like a worn-paper or risograph overlay, which the style block rules out
The palette (mustard, teal, tomato red, olive, cream) and the bare cream sky are the only features that match; it reads as a textured modern editorial illustration
All motif objects are present (toolbox, rope, nail tin, jetty, two gulls); hands are fine; no signature or logo; landscape format is correct
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.note_de: Statt flacher, geometrischer Werbegrafik der 50er-Jahre eine realistisch gemalte Illustration mit Körnungsfilter.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.note_en: Instead of flat, geometric 1950s ad art, this is a realistic painted illustration with a grain filter.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.alt_de: Körnige, gedruckt wirkende Illustration in Senf, Petrol und Tomatenrot auf Creme: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, gegenüber hämmert ein junger Mann.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.alt_en: Grainy, print-like illustration in mustard, teal and tomato red on cream: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing on a plank while a young man hammers opposite.

motif_missing: The young man drives his nail into the hull edge, not into the plank the woman is holding
The woman's kneeling pose is hidden behind the hull
problems: The woman holds a narrow strip of wood across the hull like a batten, not a plank laid along the hull
Too clean for Tri-X pushed two stops: fine, even grain, full tonal range with no blocked shadows or blown highlights, a level horizon and no motion blur; closer to digital monochrome with added grain
Hands and the claw hammer are anatomically fine; two gulls on the jetty posts; toolbox, rope and nail tin are present; no logo or watermark; landscape format is correct
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_de: Der junge Mann schlägt den Nagel neben die Planke, die die Frau festhält, statt in sie hinein.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_en: The young man drives his nail beside, not into, the plank the woman is holding.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_de: Körniges Schwarzweißfoto im Reportagestil: Eine alte Frau mit zerzaustem grauem Haar drückt eine Leiste an ein umgedrehtes Holzboot, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze hockt daneben und hämmert; Steg mit Möwen.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_en: Grainy black-and-white reportage photo: a grey-haired old woman presses a strip of wood onto an upturned boat while a young man in a beanie crouches, hammering; gulls on jetty posts.

motif_missing: The woman wears her hair in a curly bun instead of short grey hair
No nail is visible in the young man's hand; he raises the hammer at the end of the hull
problems: The two figures are large and detailed (hair bun, patterned knit cap, rolled-sleeve bands), not small faceless figures spread across a wide field
The man's body is a jacket shape rather than two triangles joined at the tips
The boat, its ribs and the toolbox are drawn in perspective, and the wave bands make a kind of horizon
The lines are clean and even and the plaster texture is uniform, more like a stencil print than wavering rice-paste strokes
Toolbox, rope, nail tin, jetty and two gulls are present; no deity or ritual square; landscape format is correct
people/warli-painting-2.note_de: Die Frau trägt einen Dutt statt kurzer Haare, und die großen, detailreichen Figuren weichen von der Warli-Formensprache ab.
people/warli-painting-2.note_en: The woman wears a bun instead of short hair, and the large, detailed figures stray from Warli's triangle-figure canon.
