people/warli-painting-2.alt_de: Weiße Linienmalerei auf rotbraunem Lehmputz im Warli-Stil: Eine Frau aus Dreiecken kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein Mann mit Mütze hämmert, ringsum Kiesel, Wellen, Möwen.
people/warli-painting-2.alt_en: White line painting on red-brown mud plaster in Warli style: a triangle-bodied woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank, a capped man hammers; pebbles, waves, jetty and gulls.

motif_missing: The young man holds his nail in mid-air in front of the woman's apron, far from the plank, so he is not nailing the plank
problems: Filter-like: realistic, modern illustrative figures and naturalistic surf under a cracked-fresco texture, with none of the Quattrocento frieze staging, ruled single-point perspective or profile heads
Hazy, atmospheric distant hills instead of planes that stay crisp to the horizon
The boat is cut off by the left edge; a generic Italian hill town with a tower sits in the background (not an identifiable landmark)
Hands are fine; toolbox, rope, nail tin, jetty and two standing gulls are present; no halos or gold; landscape format is correct
people/early-renaissance-1.note_de: Der junge Mann hält seinen Nagel vor der Frau in die Luft statt an die Planke.
people/early-renaissance-1.note_en: The young man holds his nail in mid-air in front of the woman instead of against the plank.
people/early-renaissance-1.alt_de: Freskoartiges Bild mit Rissen im Putz und matten Erdfarben: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine helle Planke an, daneben hämmert ein junger Mann; Steg, Möwen, Bergstädtchen.
people/early-renaissance-1.alt_en: Fresco-like painting with cracked plaster and matte earth tones: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a pale plank while a young man hammers; jetty, gulls, hill town.

motif_missing: The woman's kneeling pose is not visible; her lower body is hidden behind the hull
problems: Reads as a skilled impasto, Impressionist-style oil painting with a distressed-cloth overlay, not a Ghanaian video-club poster

Proportions and modelling are naturalistic; there are no looming oversized figures with stiff anatomy, no clashing scales and no flat hot red, yellow or green grounds; the sky and sea are painted with conventional depth
Only the surface matches: sewn seams, frayed corners and nail holes
The boat is lying at an angle, so it is not clearly upturned; hands are fine; toolbox, rope, nail tin, jetty and two gulls are present; no title, signature or logo; landscape format is correct
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.note_de: Wirkt wie ein impressionistisches Ölgemälde mit Stoffeffekt, nicht wie ein ghanaisches Kinoplakat mit übergroßen Figuren und flachen Knallfarben.
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.note_en: Looks like an impressionist oil painting with a cloth effect, not a Ghanaian movie poster with looming figures and flat hot colours.
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.alt_de: Pastos gemaltes Bild auf zusammengenähtem Sackstoff mit ausgefransten Ecken: Eine ältere Frau drückt eine Planke ans Boot, ein junger Mann mit bunter Mütze nagelt; Brandung, Steg, Möwen.
people/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.alt_en: Thickly brushed painting on sewn sacking with frayed corners: an older woman presses a plank onto a boat as a young man in a striped cap hammers; jetty, gulls.

problems: Picture is crisp and finely detailed (knit texture, skin pores, individual pebbles) like a 35mm film still; no soft low-resolution video, no sideways colour bleed or smeared edges
Warm cinematic grade and carefully composed, near-centred two-shot from crouching height, the opposite of the casual handheld standing-height camcorder framing
Only VHS cue is the noise/dropout band along the bottom edge, which reads as a pasted-on filter

Motif complete: kneeling old woman pressing new plank with both hands, young man in bobble hat hammering, open toolbox, rope, tin of nails, jetty end, two gulls; an extra hammer lies on the stones (harmless)
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-2.note_de: Das Bild wirkt wie ein scharfes Kinostandbild, nicht wie weiches, verschmiertes Camcorder-Video.
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-2.note_en: The picture looks like a crisp film still rather than soft, smeared camcorder video.
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-2.alt_de: Scharfes, filmhaftes Farbbild mit Störstreifen am unteren Rand: Eine alte Frau drückt eine neue Planke ans umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann mit Bommelmütze nagelt sie fest.
people/vhs-camcorder-footage-2.alt_en: Crisp film-like frame, noise band at the bottom: an old woman presses a new plank onto an upturned boat while a young man in a bobble hat nails it.

problems: Reads as a modern detailed comic/manga-style illustration, not early-1990s clip art: fine hatching, painterly wood grain, individually shaded pebbles

infographic/constructive-universalism-1.note_de: Statt ungleicher Felder mit flachen Zeichen zeigt das Bild ein fast gleichmäßiges Raster mit Pfeilen und räumlichen Bildern.
infographic/constructive-universalism-1.note_en: Instead of unequal cells with flat signs, it shows a near-regular grid with arrows and pictures in perspective.
infographic/constructive-universalism-1.alt_de: Ölbild auf Karton in Ocker, Ziegelrot und Grau: Ein schwarz gemaltes Gitter fasst sechs Felder mit Hand und Saat, Ähren und Sichel, Mühlstein, Kneten, Teigschüssel und Brot im Ofen.
infographic/constructive-universalism-1.alt_en: Oil on cardboard in ochre, brick red and grey: a hand-painted black grid holds six signs, from sowing hand and sickle to millstone, kneading, dough bowl and baked loaf.

problems: Lower two tiers are six equal-width panels forming a uniform grid instead of panels of unequal width
Caption lettering is mixed-case italic, not even hand-inked capitals
Fine engraving-like cross-hatching rather than bold swelling brush contours and solid black shadows
Added red arrows between panels (not text, acceptable)
Opening wide panel, yellow caption boxes, slanted outlined title with drop shadow and yellowed newsprint are convincing; generic village church is not a real landmark
infographic/four-color-newsprint-comic-1.note_de: Die sechs Felder bilden ein gleichmäßiges Raster statt ungleich breiter Comicfelder.
infographic/four-color-newsprint-comic-1.note_en: The six panels form an even grid instead of comic panels of unequal width.
infographic/four-color-newsprint-comic-1.alt_de: Comicseite der 1950er auf vergilbtem Zeitungspapier: Unter einem breiten Eingangsbild mit Weizenfeld und schrägem Titel zeigen sechs Felder mit gelben Kästen Säen, Ernten, Mahlen, Kneten, Gehen und Backen.
infographic/four-color-newsprint-comic-1.alt_en: 1950s comic page on yellowed newsprint: below a wide wheat-field panel with slanted title, six inked panels with yellow caption boxes show sowing, harvesting, milling, kneading, rising and baking.

problems: Six items of nearly equal size in a regular two-column zigzag: no abrupt scale jumps, little bare paper
Numerals sit beside the pictures instead of overlapping them
Pictures are detailed and modelled (shaded loaf, textured millstone, realistic hands) rather than simple geometric shapes; off-register effect barely visible
Palette, crayon grain, free-floating colour shapes, dashed arrow and hand-drawn title match the style
infographic/mid-century-modern-infograph.note_de: Die Bilder sind gleich groß und detailreich gemalt; es fehlen die Größensprünge und die freie Fläche des Stils. Bei „230°C“ fehlt das Leerzeichen vor dem Gradzeichen; der übrige Text ist korrekt.
infographic/mid-century-modern-infograph.note_en: The pictures are equal-sized and finely rendered; the style's scale jumps and bare paper are missing. '230°C' is missing the space before the degree sign; all other text is correct.
infographic/mid-century-modern-infograph.alt_de: 1950er-Erklärgrafik auf warmem Papier: Bunte Ziffern und kreidige Farbflächen in Senf, Petrol und Tomatenrot; eine gestrichelte Pfeillinie führt im Zickzack von der Aussaat bis zum Brot im Ofen.
infographic/mid-century-modern-infograph.alt_en: 1950s explanatory chart on warm paper: bold numerals and crayon-textured shapes in mustard, teal and tomato red; a dashed arrow zigzags from sowing seed to bread in the oven.
text_errors: expected '230 °C', found '230°C' (no space before the degree sign; measured gap 0→° is 5 px against 3 px between the digits, while the space in '500 g' measures 8 px)

problems: Pictures are near-photorealistic digital renders, not flat poster-colour paintings on a hand-painted card
Layout is a 2x3 grid of rounded tiles (explicitly avoided) rather than one card with a dotted line winding downwards
The film look is reduced to a pink-magenta colour cast and grain laid over a default AI infographic
Labels in mixed case, not plain capitals
Circled numerals, dotted arrows and white-on-dark title card are present
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.note_de: Statt einer handgemalten Tafel zeigt das Bild fast fotorealistische Bilder in einem Kachelraster unter einem Rosafilter.
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.note_en: Instead of a hand-painted card, it shows near-photoreal pictures in a tile grid under a pink tint.
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.alt_de: Rosastichig verblasstes Filmbild: Unter einer dunklen Titeltafel zeigen sechs fast fotografische Felder mit Nummernkreisen und gepunkteten Pfeilen Aussaat, Sichel, Mühlstein, Kneten, Teigschüssel und Brot im Ofen.
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.alt_en: Faded, pink-tinted film frame: under a dark title card, six near-photographic panels with circled numerals and dotted arrows show sowing, sickle, millstone, kneading, dough bowl and bread in an oven.

motif_missing: connecting arrows wrong: dashed arrows run Harvest->Knead and Knead->Bake, so no arrow leads into Mill or Rise (the numbers still give the order)
problems: the stitched arrows contradict the numbering (2->4, 3->4, 4->6, 5->6)
crowded layout with little bare felt; bread, dough and flames carry some shading and puffiness
infographic/felt-applique-1.note_de: Die genähten Pfeile führen vom Ernten direkt zum Kneten und vom Kneten zum Backen und überspringen so Mahlen und Gehen.
infographic/felt-applique-1.note_en: The stitched arrows run from Harvest straight to Knead and from Knead to Bake, skipping Mill and Rise.
infographic/felt-applique-1.alt_de: Filz-Wandbehang an Holzstange, mit groben Stichen aufgenäht: Unter dem Titel ‚From Grain to Bread‘ sechs nummerierte Schritte von der säenden Hand bis zum Brot im Steinofen.
infographic/felt-applique-1.alt_en: Felt wall hanging on a wooden rod with visible stitching: six numbered steps titled 'From Grain to Bread', from a sowing hand to a loaf in a stone oven.

motif_missing: arrow band does not connect Knead to Rise: it comes out from behind the Mill and runs to Bake, so Knead has no exit and Rise no entry
problems: extra colours beyond black plus one spot colour: skin tone, gold wheat, brown wood, sickle handle and bread
fully drawn scenes (field, brick oven) instead of schematic cross-sections and side views
no misregistration gaps; reads more like a coloured vintage engraving than a two-colour offset print
infographic/1970s-textbook-diagram-1.note_de: Neben Orange tauchen Braun-, Gold- und Hauttöne auf, und das Pfeilband verbindet Kneten nicht mit Gehen. Alle Beschriftungen stimmen; nur ein winziges, unleserliches Gekritzel in der Holzmaserung des Tisches (Schritt 4) wirkt wie eine Signatur.
infographic/1970s-textbook-diagram-1.note_en: Brown, gold and skin tones break the two-colour rule, and the arrow band does not connect Knead to Rise. All labels are correct; only a tiny, illegible squiggle in the table's wood grain (step 4) looks like a signature.
infographic/1970s-textbook-diagram-1.alt_de: Schulbuchgrafik im 70er-Stil: Tuschezeichnungen mit Punktschattierung und ein orangerotes Pfeilband schlängeln sich durch sechs nummerierte Schritte, von säender Hand und Sichel bis zum Steinofen.
infographic/1970s-textbook-diagram-1.alt_en: 1970s-style textbook diagram: stippled black ink drawings and an orange-red arrow band snaking through six numbered steps, from sowing hand and sickle to millstone, kneading, rising dough and stone oven.
text_errors: extra: Possible pseudo-signature (uncertain): a tiny looped scribble, about 30x4 px, at the right end of the table's wood grain in step 4 (around x 955-985, y 1050). Fainter script-like flecks sit in the same grain line further left (around x 775-800, y 1052). No letters can be read, and they could simply be hatching texture. All nine required strings are present and exact ('500 g' and '230 °C' have proper spaces).

problems: pictures are fine dot-matrix bitmaps rather than typed from characters, with no shared character-cell grid (closer to a graphics terminal than text mode)
no bottom status line or block cursor
boxed 2x3 grid like many other renderings
infographic/crt-terminal-readout-1.alt_de: Grün leuchtender Röhrenmonitor: Titel in invertierter Kopfzeile, darunter sechs aus Leuchtpunkten gerasterte Bildfelder von der säenden Hand bis zum Brot im Ofen bei 230 °C, verbunden durch getippte Pfeile.
infographic/crt-terminal-readout-1.alt_en: Green phosphor CRT screen: title in a reverse-video bar, below it six dot-matrix panels from a sowing hand to bread in an oven at 230 °C, joined by typed arrows.

problems: painterly, softly shaded, near-realistic figures instead of flat colour with one highlight and a dark outline
labels set in a clean mixed-case typeface, not uneven brushed capitals
boxes almost equal in size; the grid is too tidy
gradient glow inside the oven
arrows between the boxes, though the style reads as a numbered menu
infographic/west-african-barbershop-sign.note_de: Die Bilder sind weich schattiert und fast realistisch gemalt statt flächig mit Kontur, die Beschriftung wirkt gesetzt statt gepinselt. Auf dem Mehlsack ist der Abstand in „500 g“ so schmal, dass es fast wie „500g“ aussieht.
infographic/west-african-barbershop-sign.note_en: The pictures are softly shaded, near-realistic painting instead of flat outlined colour, and the labels look typeset rather than brushed. On the flour sack the space in '500 g' is so narrow that it almost reads as '500g'.
infographic/west-african-barbershop-sign.alt_de: Handgemaltes Schild auf verwittertem Holz mit Nagellöchern: roter Titel auf gelbem Band, darunter sechs blaue Felder mit gelben Beschriftungsleisten, von der säenden Hand bis zum Brot im Steinofen.
infographic/west-african-barbershop-sign.alt_en: Hand-painted sign on weathered board with nail holes: red title on a yellow band, six blue panels with yellow label strips, from sowing hand to bread in stone oven.
text_errors: expected '500 g', found '500g': the space before 'g' is only about a third of a normal space (8 px gap against 3 px between digits; the space in '230 °C' on the same sign is 16 px), so it reads as '500g'

problems: even 2x3 tile grid, which the style says to avoid
stippled shading on the millstone, soil, dough, bread and table, though the style allows no shading
arrows between the boxes, which the style forbids
no dashed exploded guidelines, magnified circular insets or parts inventory
reads as colouring-book line art more than flat-pack instructions
infographic/wordless-assembly-instructio.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine Malbuch-Zeichnung: gleich große Kästen, Punktschattierung und Pfeile zwischen den Feldern statt Explosionslinien und Lupenausschnitten.
infographic/wordless-assembly-instructio.note_en: Reads more like colouring-book line art: equal boxes, stippled shading and arrows between panels instead of exploded guidelines and magnified insets.
infographic/wordless-assembly-instructio.alt_de: Schwarze Strichzeichnung auf Weiß wie eine Aufbauanleitung: sechs Kästen mit fetten Ziffern, Menschen nur als Hände, vom Säen über die Handmühle bis zum Brot im Elektroofen.
infographic/wordless-assembly-instructio.alt_en: Black line drawing on white like assembly instructions: six boxes with bold numerals, people shown only as hands, from sowing through a hand mill to bread in an electric oven.

problems: label text uses finer pixels than the artwork (mixed pixel sizes) and has no dark drop shadow
oven fire glow is fairly smooth, leaning towards hi-bit
infographic/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: 16-Bit-Pixelgrafik: goldener Titel in dunkelblauem Fenster über einer Spielwelt aus Wald und Wegen, darauf sechs gerahmte Bildfenster mit Pfeilen, vom Säen bis zum Brot im glühenden Steinofen.
infographic/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit pixel art: gold title in a dark blue window over a forest game map, six framed windows joined by arrows, from sowing to bread in a glowing oven.

motif_missing: Step 3: the flour stream lands on the floor beside the '500 g' sack rather than pouring into it
problems: The panels are lush, coherent pixel paintings filling each row, which is the 'tidy pixel art' the style block excludes, rather than crude dithered 256-colour clip-art GIFs with jagged edges and white halos
The wordless footer of 88x31 pictogram buttons is missing; the page simply ends after step 6
None of the typical clip-art GIFs (spinning globe, flames, construction sign)
Lettering is one tidy default serif for all labels with no clashing comic fonts, and the table column is wide rather than narrow
Correct genre markers: tiled starfield with a repeating nebula, bevelled 3D rainbow headline, grey bevelled table borders, rainbow divider bars, yellow GIF down-arrows, blue underlined link labels
Format is portrait 1024x1536 as requested. No logos, watermarks or anatomy errors; the kneading and sowing hands are clean
infographic/web-1-0-geocities-homepage-1.note_de: Die Bildfelder sind sauber ausgearbeitete Pixelmalerei statt grober GIF-Clipart, und die Button-Fußzeile fehlt.
infographic/web-1-0-geocities-homepage-1.note_en: The panels are polished pixel paintings rather than crude GIF clip art, and the button footer is missing.
infographic/web-1-0-geocities-homepage-1.alt_de: 90er-Homepage auf gekacheltem Sternenhimmel: Unter einer Regenbogen-3D-Überschrift sechs Tabellenzeilen mit Pixelbildern von der Aussaat bis zum Brot im Ofen, blau unterstrichene Links, Regenbogenbalken mit gelben Pfeilen.
infographic/web-1-0-geocities-homepage-1.alt_en: 1990s homepage on a tiled starfield: rainbow 3D headline, six table rows of pixel pictures from sowing to baking, blue underlined links, rainbow divider bars with yellow arrows.

problems: Drawn white arrows are printed on the board between steps 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6, which the style block forbids ('no drawn arrows')

The viewpoint is inconsistent rather than straight down: the millstone, flour sack and bowl are seen in three-quarter view, and the oven is shown head-on with a lit interior, which is impossible from directly above
Reads as a 2x3 grid of six staged tableaux rather than knolling, which means rows of many small objects squared to the frame and grouped by kind; the oven is full-size rather than a small stand-in
The flour stream joins millstone and sack, and the cloth only drapes the bowl's rim, leaving the dough dome uncovered (minor)
Correct: matte green board, soft side light, typed title strip and paper number tags lying flat, people only as hands
Format is portrait 1024x1536 as requested. No logos or brand marks; the hands are anatomically clean
infographic/flat-lay-knolling-1.note_de: Aufgedruckte Pfeile und Objekte, die schräg oder frontal statt von oben gezeigt sind (etwa der Ofen), brechen die strenge Knolling-Draufsicht.
infographic/flat-lay-knolling-1.note_en: Printed arrows and objects shown at an angle or head-on rather than from above, like the oven, break knolling's strict top-down view.
infographic/flat-lay-knolling-1.alt_de: Flat-Lay-Foto auf mattgrünem Karton, beschriftet mit Papierschildchen: eine Hand streut Körner auf Erdfurchen, Ähren und Sichel, Mühlstein mit Mehlsack, knetende Hände, Teigschüssel unter Tuch, Brot im Ofen.
infographic/flat-lay-knolling-1.alt_en: Flat-lay photo on green board with paper tags: a hand scattering grain on furrowed soil, wheat and sickle, millstone and flour sack, kneading hands, covered dough bowl, loaf in oven.

problems: The composition is a Western perspective landscape: the river recedes to a horizon and the mountains sit in the far distance, with no ground lines or stacked registers. The style block explicitly says to avoid perspective.
The bench is drawn in three-quarter perspective and the tree trunk has some modelling, where the style calls for flat side-view objects.

Only the surface reads as Egyptian: flaking whitewashed plaster, ochre and Egyptian-blue palette, red-brown outlines, zigzag water and the coloured block border. It works like a filter laid over a generic Mediterranean landscape with cypresses.
The chapel is a pedimented, temple-like shrine. This is acceptable as a modest chapel but not specific to the style.
No signature, logo or real landmark. Format is correct at 1536x1024 landscape.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Das Tal ist mit Tiefenwirkung gemalt statt flach in Registern; ägyptisch wirken nur Putz, Farben und Rahmen.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: The valley is painted in receding perspective rather than flat registers; only the plaster, palette and border read as Egyptian.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz in Ocker, Ägyptischblau und Grün, mit Farbblockrand: Fluss mit Zickzackwellen, Steinbrücke mit Figur, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassenhang, Wald, alter Baum mit Bank.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Wall painting on flaking plaster in ochre and Egyptian blue, block border: zigzag-rippled river, stone bridge with figure, village with chapel, terraces, forest, old tree with bench.

problems: The composition is not near-symmetrical around a central axis. A large repoussoir tree dominates the left side, which is closer to Dahl or Richter than to Friedrich.
The sky covers about 40% of the picture, a little less than the half the style asks for.

The Dolomite-like peaks and the very fine overall detail edge slightly toward a matte-painting look. The palette (pearl grey, pale violet, rose horizon band, umber foreground) and the valley mist are convincing.
Present: single-arch bridge with one tiny figure, about five houses with a chapel, terraces on the left, conifer forest on the right, six birds. No signature.
landscape/german-romanticism-1.alt_de: Ölgemälde in zarten Lasuren in der Dämmerung: Nebel im Tal, rosa Streifen am Horizont, links alter Baum mit Bank, Dorf mit Kapelle, Steinbrücke mit Figur, ferne Felsgipfel.
landscape/german-romanticism-1.alt_en: Oil painting in thin glazes at twilight: valley mist, a rose band on the horizon, old tree and bench at left, village with chapel, stone bridge, distant peaks.

motif_missing: A second figure-like shape stands on the bridge parapet, but the motif allows at most one tiny figure.
problems: The view inside the mask looks fully coloured and painterly, close to a photochrom or oil sketch. It does not look like a grey or sepia glass photograph with a few thin, overrunning hand tints.
There is no white thumb spot, no paper label and no visible tape edge. Only the black mask, the dust and the scratches carry the style.
The mask opening is a rounded rectangle, which is acceptable.
The bench is a wooden plank on stone supports, which is acceptable.
No logo, signature or maker's name. Format is correct.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-1.note_de: Das Bild wirkt durchgehend farbig gemalt statt wie ein sparsam getöntes Glasfoto, und auf der Brücke stehen zwei Figuren.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-1.note_en: The view looks fully painted in colour rather than a sparsely tinted glass photograph, and two figures stand on the bridge.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-1.alt_de: Kolorierte Laterna-magica-Glasplatte hinter schwarzer Maske mit abgerundetem Fenster, zerkratzt und staubig: Gebirgstal mit Fluss, Steinbrücke, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Terrassen, Wald, alter Baum mit Bank.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-1.alt_en: Coloured magic-lantern glass slide behind a black mask with rounded window, scratched and dusty: mountain river valley, stone bridge, village with bell tower, terraces, forest, old tree and bench.

problems: Arbitrary colour works well: red trunk, violet and orange ground, purple mountains as saturated as the foreground.
There is no bare canvas between strokes and no loose blue contour lines.
The brushwork is dense, short dabs rather than broad flat patches, and the framed valley view leans slightly toward a conventional vista.
Two extra houses stand on the left slope, apart from the village. This is minor; the village by the bridge has about five houses and a chapel.
Present: single-arch bridge with one figure, white birds, a bench under a tree that leans toward the river. No signature.
landscape/fauvism-1.alt_de: Fauvistisches Ölbild in breiten Flecken reiner Farbe: roter Baumstamm, Bank auf orange-violettem Hang, Fluss mit Bogenbrücke und Figur, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Terrassen, violette Berge.
landscape/fauvism-1.alt_en: Fauvist oil in broad patches of pure colour: red tree trunk, bench on an orange-violet slope, river with arched bridge and figure, village with bell tower, terraces, violet mountains.

problems: This is a generic digital retro travel-poster illustration in golden-hour light with a grain overlay, which the style block explicitly says to avoid.
There are no stepped geometric planes, no ruler-and-compass construction, no smooth airbrushed gradients with hard masked edges and no large empty gradient field.
No single element is made monumental from a steep low or dead-frontal angle. The composition is a conventional framed vista with naturalistic, painterly foliage and rocks.
The palette is warm ochre and teal rather than the flat four-to-six-ink set of black, deep blue, vermilion, grey and ochre.
All motif elements are present: tree leaning toward the river with a bench, single-arch bridge with one figure, village with chapel, terraces, forest, ridge, five birds. No logo or signature.
landscape/art-deco-poster-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein digitales Retro-Reiseplakat im Abendlicht; Geometrie, Airbrush-Verläufe und ein monumentales Motiv des Art déco fehlen.
landscape/art-deco-poster-1.note_en: Reads as a digital retro travel poster in golden light; the geometry, airbrush gradients and monumental focus of Art Deco are missing.
landscape/art-deco-poster-1.alt_de: Körnige Retro-Plakatillustration in warmem Abendlicht: alter Baum und Bank am goldenen Hang, Fluss mit Bogenbrücke, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Weinterrassen, dunkler Nadelwald, blasse Gipfel.
landscape/art-deco-poster-1.alt_en: Grainy retro poster illustration in warm evening light: old tree and bench on a golden slope, river with arched bridge, village with bell tower, terraces, dark pine forest, pale peaks.

problems: This is a picture-postcard travel view framed by a tree, which the style block explicitly rules out. It does not show an unremarkable place in a deadpan, frontal view.

The image has a modern digital stock-photo look: crisp clarity, lush saturated greens and a slight HDR feel. There is no 1970s colour-negative or dye-transfer character, no fine grain and no incidental everyday clutter.
Only the midday light, short shadows, pale sky and deep focus match the style, and these also belong to the default photoreal look.

All motif elements are present: single-arch bridge with one tiny figure, five or six houses and a chapel, terraces on the left, forest on the right, jagged ridge, four birds, a bench under a leaning tree. The bridge is generic, not a real landmark. No watermark.
landscape/new-color-photography-1.note_de: Eine glatte Postkartenansicht im Look heutiger Reisefotos statt einer nüchternen Großformataufnahme der 1970er.
landscape/new-color-photography-1.note_en: A slick postcard view in the look of today's travel photos, not a deadpan 1970s large-format print.
landscape/new-color-photography-1.alt_de: Scharfes Farbfoto in Mittagssonne unter blassblauem Himmel: alter Baum mit Holzbank im Vordergrund, klarer Fluss mit Steinbogenbrücke, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Terrassen, bewaldeter Hang, Felsgipfel.
landscape/new-color-photography-1.alt_en: Crisp colour photograph in midday sun under a pale blue sky: old tree with wooden bench, river with stone arch bridge, village with bell tower, terraces, wooded slope, peaks.

problems: Extremely dense line work everywhere (thousands of strokes, brick patterns, leaf clusters, hatched forests, rippled water); the style asks for sparse wireframes of few straight segments with wide empty black
Organic curved clover-like foliage instead of curves broken into polygons
Hidden lines are removed like an ink drawing; no see-through wireframes with back edges visible
Birds rendered as filled solid shapes (filled surfaces should be avoided)
Overall reads as an inverted pen-and-ink drawing or edge-detection filter on a standard AI landscape, not a vector-scan arcade screen

Motif complete: river, single-arch bridge with one tiny figure, 5-6 houses plus chapel, terraces left, forest right, leaning tree with bench, mountain ridge, 6 birds; format 1536x1024 landscape correct; no logos or signatures
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-1.note_de: Viel zu dicht und detailreich: wirkt wie eine invertierte Federzeichnung statt wie wenige leuchtende Vektorlinien.
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-1.note_en: Far too dense and detailed: it reads as an inverted pen drawing rather than a few glowing vector lines.
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-1.alt_de: Dichte hellgrüne Leuchtlinien auf Schwarz: Ein Fluss windet sich unter einer Steinbogenbrücke hindurch, daneben ein Dorf mit Kirchturm, links ein großer Baum mit Bank, dahinter Berggipfel und Vögel.
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-1.alt_en: Dense pale-green glowing lines on black: a river winds under a stone arch bridge past a steepled village; at left a large tree with a bench, peaks and birds behind.

problems: Strong foreground blur/bokeh on the bottom rocks and flowers, contradicting 'everything in focus' and the avoid list (creamy bokeh)
Photorealistic water and a near-realistic painted mountain massif; warm sunny light drifts toward golden-hour look
No visible set edges, fingerprints, tool scores, lint or marbled unmixed clay; surfaces are smooth, reading as a CG miniature/model-railway diorama rather than a 1970s-90s clay film frame
Tree, bench and houses do have a plausible modelled-clay quality
Village count borderline: four clearly visible houses plus one mostly hidden behind, plus chapel
Format 1536x1024 landscape correct; one small figure on bridge, six birds; no logos or signatures
landscape/clay-animation-2.note_de: Unscharfer Vordergrund und fotorealistisches Wasser lassen es eher wie ein glattes Miniaturdiorama als wie Knetanimation wirken.
landscape/clay-animation-2.note_en: Blurred foreground and photoreal water make it look like a smooth miniature diorama rather than clay animation.
landscape/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Miniaturlandschaft aus Knete im Sonnenlicht: Unter einem knorrigen Baum steht eine Holzbank, ein Fluss zieht unter einer Steinbrücke vorbei, rechts Dorf und Kapelle, dahinter schroffe Gipfel.
landscape/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay miniature landscape in sunlight: a wooden bench under a gnarled tree, a river flowing beneath a stone bridge, a village with chapel at right, jagged peaks behind.

problems: Mixed pixel sizes: coarse irregular blocks in foliage, grass and sky (mosaic artefacts around the birds) next to fine detail in houses and bridge; no single coarse grid
Effective resolution far above ~256 px on the short side
Painterly gradients and atmospheric haze in mountains and sky instead of flat 3-5 step ramps; few dark outlines
Composition is a central scenic vista (river down the middle), not a side-view or top-down tile-based game screen with parallax bands
Overall a 'hi-bit' pixel-filter look over a typical AI landscape

Motif complete: river, single-arch bridge with one small figure, 5-6 houses plus chapel, terraces left, forest right, tree with bench, mountain ridge, birds; format 1536x1024 landscape correct; no logos or signatures
landscape/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Uneinheitliche Pixelgrößen und malerische Verläufe – eher Pixelfilter als echter 16-Bit-Spielbildschirm.
landscape/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Mixed pixel sizes and painterly gradients make it look like a pixel filter rather than a real 16-bit game screen.
landscape/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Bunte Pixelgrafik im Stil alter Konsolenspiele: Ein blauer Fluss fließt unter einer Steinbrücke durchs grüne Tal, rechts Steinhäuser mit Kapelle, links Terrassenfelder und ein Baum mit Bank.
landscape/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Colourful console-style pixel art: a blue river flows under a stone bridge; stone houses and a chapel at right, terraces and a tree with a bench at left.

motif_missing: Telescopic antenna is not attached to the radio body: it ends on top of the carry handle's crossbar and does not continue down to the housing, which shows through the gap below the handle
problems: Antenna seems to be mounted on the carry handle instead of the housing. Zoom crop of the handle and antenna junction (around x 820-1020, y 340-520) shows the rod ending on the handle bar, with sea and sky visible below it
Mixed pixel sizes: the radio, especially the dial, knobs and outlines, uses a finer grid with near-smooth shading than the coarse dithered sky and background tiles. The style block says to avoid this
Composition is a centred three-quarter hero shot of the product on a wall, not a game screen of repeating tiles or parallax bands. It drifts toward a generic 'pixel-art illustration' look

Positives: checkerboard dithering in the sky, dark outlines, limited flat ramps on the stone wall and foliage. Speaker grille on the left half, one large dial above a tick-mark window, two small knobs below it and a fold-down handle are all present. Contact shadow on the wall is present
Format is correct (1254x1254 square for 1024x1024). No logo, watermark or signature. The background lake village with a tower is generic and not an identifiable landmark
product/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Die Antenne sitzt auf dem Tragegriff statt am Gehäuse, und die Pixelgrößen sind uneinheitlich.
product/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: The antenna sprouts from the carry handle instead of the body, and pixel sizes are mixed.
product/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik im 16-Bit-Stil: Ein graubraunes Kofferradio mit Antenne, Lautsprechergitter, großem Drehknopf, Skala und zwei Knöpfen steht auf einer Steinmauer am See, dahinter Berge.
product/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit pixel art: a grey-brown portable radio with antenna, speaker grille, large dial, tuning scale and two knobs stands on a stone wall by a lake with mountains behind.

problems: Headline is a heavy condensed grotesque (Impact-like) rather than a hand-drawn geometric monoline capital; not set in a solid band
Trumpet valve section and lower gripping hand are slightly muddled where fingers merge with the valve casing (minor, stylised)
poster/art-deco-poster-1.alt_de: Art-déco-Plakat in Blau, Schwarz und Ocker mit feinem Spritzkorn: Ein Trompeter im dunklen Anzug ragt riesig ins Bild, rechts eine Leuchtturminsel vor gelber Scheibe, unten roter Schriftzug LORNHOLM.
poster/art-deco-poster-1.alt_en: Art Deco poster in blue, black and ochre with fine airbrush grain: a towering trumpeter in a dark suit, a lighthouse island before a yellow disc, red LORNHOLM lettering below.

problems: Image is built from a fine grid of square dots (LED/dot-matrix look), not from typed characters in identical character cells (no slashes, hashes or shade blocks)
No reverse-video header bar, no bottom status line, no block cursor
Text appears in several sizes (headline, subline, date) instead of one bitmap font size plus block-character headline
Trumpeter's hand is an unreadable blob; torso dissolves into scattered dots
poster/crt-terminal-readout-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine grüne Punktgrafik als wie ein Terminal: Zeichenraster, Statuszeile und Cursor fehlen.
poster/crt-terminal-readout-1.note_en: Reads more as a green dot drawing than a terminal screen: no character grid, status line or cursor.
poster/crt-terminal-readout-1.alt_de: Grüner Röhrenbildschirm mit Zeilenraster: Aus leuchtenden Bildpunkten gesetzt ein Trompeter mit Hut, Sonne, Leuchtturminsel und gespiegeltes Wasser; oben der Blockschriftzug LORNHOLM, unten das Datum.
poster/crt-terminal-readout-1.alt_en: Green CRT screen with scanlines: a trumpeter in a hat, a sun, a lighthouse island and reflecting water drawn in glowing dots; blocky LORNHOLM headline above, date below.

problems: Anatomy and perspective are fairly naturalistic and consistent (island recedes correctly) rather than stiff with clashing scales; sea brushwork leans impressionistic
Sack seam reads only as a horizontal fold/crease
poster/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.note_de: Im Datum steht ein kurzer Bindestrich statt eines Halbgeviertstrichs (18-20 statt 18–20).
poster/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.note_en: The date uses a short hyphen instead of an en dash (18-20 instead of 18–20).
poster/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.alt_de: Handgemaltes Kinoplakat auf geknittertem Sackleinen in Rot, Gelb und Blau: Ein Trompeter füllt die linke Bildhälfte, rechts Leuchtturminsel vor Sonne und Wellen, Schrift mit Schlagschatten.
poster/ghanaian-hand-painted-movie-poste.alt_en: Hand-painted movie poster on creased sacking in red, yellow and blue: a huge trumpeter fills the left side, a lighthouse island, sun and waves at right, shadowed capitals.
text_errors: expected '18–20 JUL 2027' (en dash), found '18-20 JUL 2027' (short hyphen: dash 43 px wide vs digits 67-74 px, ratio ~0.6, typical of a hyphen, not an en dash)
extra: faint illegible sack-print marks showing through the paint (shirt at left, date banner); the style asks for this texture, nothing is readable, so it is not counted as text

problems: Drifts to modern hi-bit indie pixel art: soft painterly gradients in sky and water, scenic centred composition instead of side or top-down game view
Subline and date are a smooth slab-serif at a finer pixel scale, not 8x8 monospaced bitmap letters (mixed pixel sizes)
Lighthouse sits on a rocky landmass running off the right edge with a mainland village in front, so it reads more as a headland than a small island
Trumpeter's two legs are awkwardly stacked, second foot only loosely connected (minor)
poster/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Wirkt wie moderne Hi-Bit-Pixelkunst mit weichen Verläufen; Untertitel und Datum sind keine Bitmap-Schrift.
poster/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Looks like modern hi-bit pixel art with soft gradients; subline and date are not bitmap lettering.
poster/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik im Stil eines 16-Bit-Spiels: Ein Trompeter mit Hut sitzt auf einer Steinmauer am Meer, Sonnenuntergang, Leuchtturm auf Felsen, Dorfdächer; farbgestreifter Titel LORNHOLM in Blockbuchstaben.
poster/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit-style pixel art: a trumpeter in a hat sits on a stone wall by the sea at sunset, a lighthouse on rocks, village roofs; colour-banded blocky LORNHOLM title.

problems: Teacup modelled with volume and perspective, more depth than a flat 1390s miniature
Broad flowered meadow instead of a narrow ground strip; gold ground plain, without diaper or tooling, looks more flat-printed than raised and burnished
Glue tube carries the cup's blue floral decor and has a flared open end, so it reads partly like a porcelain horn
editorial/gothic-illuminated-manuscript-.alt_de: Gotische Buchmalerei auf Goldgrund mit Rankenbordüre: Auf einer Leiter vernäht ein Mann den Sprung einer riesigen Porzellantasse, oben lässt einer einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau schleppt eine Leimtube.
editorial/gothic-illuminated-manuscript-.alt_en: Gothic miniature on gold leaf, vine border: a man on a ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup, another lowers a bucket from its rim, a woman carries a glue tube.

problems: No cutaway at all: the cup is shown whole from outside, with no section, interior chambers, pipes or machinery
Full landscape with blue sky, clouds, horizon and village instead of a pale empty ground
Reads as a generic vintage-filtered painting (yellowed grain, faint halftone) rather than a 1920s-50s popular-science cutaway
Glue-carrying woman styled after the Rosie the Riveter poster (red polka-dot bandana, rolled sleeves, overalls)
Shards drawn as thick stone-like slabs rather than thin porcelain
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.note_de: Keine Schnittansicht: Statt eines aufgeschnittenen Inneren zeigt das Bild eine vergilbte Landschaftsszene mit Himmel.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.note_en: No cutaway: instead of a sectioned interior it shows a yellowed landscape scene with sky.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.alt_de: Vergilbte Rasterdruck-Illustration in Retrofarben: Unter blauem Himmel vernäht ein Arbeiter auf einer Leiter eine riesige gesprungene Tasse, oben lässt einer einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau schleppt eine Leimtube.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.alt_en: Yellowed halftone illustration: under a blue sky a worker on a ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup, another lowers a bucket from the rim, a woman hauls a glue tube.

problems: Mixed and irregular pixel sizes with soft, blurred block edges; grid is finer than about 256 px on the short side
Smooth shading on the cup and painterly panorama (lake, mountains, hill town) give a modern hi-bit look rather than a tile-based 16-bit game screen
Needle is only modestly oversized
editorial/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Die Pixel sind ungleich groß und weich, eher moderne Hi-Bit-Grafik als ein echter 16-Bit-Bildschirm.
editorial/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Pixels vary in size and are soft-edged, closer to modern hi-bit art than a true 16-bit screen.
editorial/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik wie aus einem 16-Bit-Spiel: Vor See und Bergdorf vernäht einer auf der Leiter eine riesige gesprungene Tasse, ein zweiter lässt einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau trägt eine Leimtube.
editorial/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit-style pixel art by a lake and hill town: one figure on a ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup, another lowers a bucket, a woman carries a glue tube.

problems: Cutting is finer and more detailed (cobbles, bricks, bread in the window, flower boxes) than the coarse early-16th-century broadsheet look the style asks for; it reads closer to a modern linocut or woodcut illustration, but it is still clearly a woodcut: black on off-white, heavy ruled border, solid blacks, no grey tones.
Generic onion-dome bell tower, no real landmark. No logo, signature or watermark. 1024x1536 portrait, as requested.
street/woodcut-3.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf Cremepapier mit breitem Rahmen: Eckhaus mit Bäckerei und Brezelschild, Hund vor der Bank, oben wird ein Teppich ausgeschüttelt, eine Frau schiebt ihr Rad bergauf.
street/woodcut-3.alt_en: Black woodcut on cream paper, heavy border: corner bakery with pretzel sign, dog by the bench, a rug shaken from a window, a woman pushing her bike uphill.

motif_missing: The woman pushes her bicycle out of the lane towards the left foreground (downhill), not up the slope
problems: Strong drift towards European storybook gouache: faces and bread are modelled with shading, and the figures wear European Renaissance dress (beret, hose). The lane recedes to a vanishing point, and distant things are smaller rather than set higher up. The large corner house is framed as a centred hero element. The water is painted blue rather than silver tarnished black.
What fits the style: flat gold sky, ruled gold frame on a plain cream margin, dense patterned wall ornament, '12' in white on a blue tile.
Extra figures (baker, man carrying bread, man with basket, cat) are acceptable. No real landmark, logo or signature. Portrait format is correct.
street/persian-miniature-2.note_de: Wirkt eher wie europäische Bilderbuchmalerei mit Goldhimmel: Die Gesichter sind schattiert und die Gasse hat Fluchtpunkt-Tiefe.
street/persian-miniature-2.note_en: Looks more like a European storybook painting with a gold sky: the faces are shaded and the lane has vanishing-point depth.
street/persian-miniature-2.alt_de: Miniaturmalerei mit Goldhimmel und Goldrahmen: rosa bemaltes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei und Brezelschild, Hund am Bänkchen, Teppich im Fenster, Wäscheleine, eine Frau schiebt ihr Rad mit Brotkorb.
street/persian-miniature-2.alt_en: Gold-framed miniature with gold sky: pink patterned corner house with bakery and pretzel sign, dog by a bench, rug at a window, washing line, woman pushing a bread-laden bicycle.

problems: Reads as modern hi-bit indie pixel illustration rather than an early-90s 16-bit game screen. It uses an angled three-quarter street perspective instead of a side or top-down tile view, with no repeating tiles or parallax bands. It also has a large number of colours, warm glowing shop lamps with soft halos, and illustrative shading.
The pixel grid is roughly the right size (about 4 px per pixel, about 256 on the short side) and the sky shows some dithering.

All motif elements are present: bakery, striped awning, pretzel sign, bench with dog, rug at the window, clothesline, woman pushing the bike uphill, generic bell tower, '12' by the door. No logo or landmark. Portrait format is correct.
street/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Eher moderne Hi-Bit-Pixelgrafik in Schrägansicht mit leuchtenden Lampen als ein 16-Bit-Spielbildschirm.
street/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Closer to modern hi-bit pixel illustration, in angled perspective with glowing lamps, than a 16-bit game screen.
street/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik im Stil eines Konsolenspiels: Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, gestreifter Markise und Brezelschild, Hund neben der Bank, Teppich im Fenster, Wäscheleine, eine Frau schiebt ihr Rad die Gasse hinauf.
street/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Console-style pixel art: corner house with bakery, striped awning and pretzel sign, dog beside the bench, rug at a window, washing line, woman pushing her bike up the lane.

motif_missing: The hand only holds a crumbling piece of bread over the soup; it does not tear a piece off a bread slice
problems: Table, cutting board and bowls are drawn in three-quarter perspective with elliptical rims, and the loaf is modelled with shading, which breaks Egyptian side-view and flat-fill conventions
No ruled ground lines or stacked registers; it reads as a modern folk illustration on fake flaking plaster
Strong style cues are present: flaking whitewash, coloured block border, red-brown skin, Egyptian blue and ochre palette, red outlines
Knife is a modern black-handled chef's knife rather than a bread knife (minor)
Square format is correct. Hand anatomy is acceptable. No logo, signature or hieroglyphs
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_de: Tisch und Schüsseln sind räumlich statt flach im Profil gemalt, und die Hand hält das Brot nur.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_en: Table and bowls are drawn in perspective instead of flat profile, and the hand only holds the bread.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Kalkputz mit bunter Blockborte: Auf einem roten Tisch liegen Brotlaib, Messer, Tomatensuppe, Butter, Basilikum und Kirschtomaten; eine rotbraune Hand hält ein Stück Brot.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster with a coloured block border: bread, knife, tomato soup, butter, basil and cherry tomatoes on a red table; a red-brown hand holds bread.

motif_missing: The hand dips a piece of bread into the soup; it does not tear a piece off a bread slice
problems: The finish is hyperreal and photographic rather than thin oil glazes. Visible brushwork is minimal
Warm sunbeam streaks across the wall come close to the golden glow and window bloom the style block says to avoid
Added period costume on the arm (linen cuff, brown jacket sleeve)
Dutch cues are present: window light from the left, pale cracked plaster wall, doorway to a further room with a jug and chair

All table elements are present: loaf with slices, crumbs, knife, board, soup with cream swirl, spoon and rim drip, butter with knife marks, basil, vine tomatoes, linen cloth. Square format is correct. No logo or signature
food/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.note_de: Die Hand tunkt Brot in die Suppe, statt es abzureißen, und das Bild wirkt eher fotografisch als gemalt.
food/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.note_en: The hand dips bread into the soup instead of tearing it, and the finish looks more photographic than painted.
food/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.alt_de: Ölgemälde im Stil holländischer Interieurs: Fensterlicht von links fällt auf einen alten Holztisch mit Brotlaib, Messer, Butter, Kirschtomaten und Tomatensuppe; eine Hand tunkt Brot hinein.
food/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.alt_en: Oil painting in the manner of Dutch interiors: window light from the left falls on an old wooden table with bread, knife, butter, cherry tomatoes and tomato soup; a hand dips bread.

motif_missing: The hand dips a piece of bread into the soup; it does not tear a piece off a bread slice
problems: This is a sharp photo under an ironbow colour map, which the style block explicitly says to avoid. Individual arm hairs, bread pores, basil veins and wood grain are far beyond a 320x240 microbolometer
Brightness follows visible light rather than temperature: the cold butter glows near-white, hotter than the steaming soup, and room-temperature tomatoes glow orange
Cast-shadow and texture logic come from a photograph
The framing is a posed food still life, not a tight measurement shot
Crosshair and colour scale are present. Square format is correct. No logo
food/thermal-imaging-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein eingefärbtes, gestochen scharfes Foto: Die kalte Butter leuchtet heißer als die heiße Suppe.
food/thermal-imaging-1.note_en: It looks like a sharp photo under a colour filter: the cold butter glows hotter than the hot soup.
food/thermal-imaging-1.alt_de: Falschfarbenbild in Violett, Orange und Gelb mit Fadenkreuz und Farbskala: Brotlaib, Tomatensuppe, Butter, Kirschtomaten und eine Hand, die Brot in die Suppe tunkt, wirken wie ein eingefärbtes Foto.
food/thermal-imaging-1.alt_en: False-colour image in violet, orange and yellow with crosshair and scale bar: bread, tomato soup, butter, cherry tomatoes and a hand dipping bread, looking like a tinted photo.

motif_missing: The hand holds a torn piece of bread over the soup; it does not tear it off a bread slice
problems: Looks like a downscaled painted illustration: soft gradients, semi-anti-aliased edges and far more colours than a 16-bit palette with short ramps
The composition is a high-angle food still life, not a game screen with tiles or sprites
The hand's inner fingers dissolve into a muddy dark-brown blob, a small anatomy glitch

All table elements are present: loaf with slices, crumbs, knife on board, soup with cream swirl, spoon and rim drip, butter with a cut, basil, vine tomatoes, checked cloth. Square format is correct. No logo
food/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Wirkt wie ein verpixeltes Gemälde mit weichen Verläufen statt wie ein Spielbildschirm, und die Hand hält das Brot nur.
food/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: It looks like a pixelated painting with soft gradients rather than a game screen, and the hand only holds the bread.
food/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik in groben Blöcken: Von schräg oben liegen Brotlaib mit Scheiben, Messer, Butter, Kirschtomaten, Basilikum und Geschirrtuch auf dem Holztisch; eine Hand hält Brot über die Tomatensuppe.
food/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Pixel art in coarse blocks, seen from above: bread with slices, knife, butter, cherry tomatoes, basil and a tea towel on a wooden table; a hand holds bread over tomato soup.

problems: Composition contradicts the style block: a full landscape scene with horizon line, tree-lined far bank, water surface and mirrored leg reflections. Paleolithic art has no ground line, horizon or landscape.
Drawing idiom is closer to East Asian ink-wash or naturalistic brush painting (feathery brush strokes, lily pads, reed clumps) than to finger-swabbed or blown contour animals
A uniform woven or crosshatch texture overlay covers the whole image, which looks like a digital filter rather than a limestone surface
No hand stencils, dot rows, engraved lines or overlapping older figures; the heron is a single framed scene, not a figure placed on a rock bulge

Rock surface, cracks, flaked areas and the ochre/charcoal palette are convincing; all motif elements are present (both legs, ripples, fish, droplets as red dots, dragonfly on reed tip, floating leaves left, far bank)
Format 1536x1024 landscape is correct; no logo, signature or watermark
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.note_de: Wirkt wie Tuschmalerei auf Fels: Eine Landschaft mit Horizont und Spiegelungen passt nicht zur Höhlenmalerei.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.note_en: Reads as ink painting on rock: a full landscape with horizon and reflections does not belong to cave art.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.alt_de: Ocker- und Kohlemalerei auf rissiger Kalksteinwand: Ein Graureiher packt im Flachwasser einen Fisch, links Schilf mit Libelle, dahinter ein Uferstreifen mit Bäumen.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-2.alt_en: Ochre and charcoal painting on cracked limestone: a grey heron seizes a fish in shallow water, reeds with a dragonfly on the left, a tree-lined bank behind.

problems: Water, splashes and droplets are photoreal liquid rather than modelled clay, glass or cellophane, so half the frame reads as a real photo or diorama
Heron is finely sculpted with individual layered feathers and a realistic eye, with no chunky simplified forms, bead eyes or visible fingerprints, tool scores or lint; it drifts toward smooth CG clay
Shallow depth of field blurs the bank behind the head, and no set edges or card/fabric seams are visible
Clay qualities are present in the reeds, lily pads, rocks, dragonfly and the painted textured sky backdrop

All motif elements are present: side-view heron with both legs, ripples at feet, fish in beak, droplets, reeds and broad leaves left, dragonfly on reed tip, far bank vegetation. No anatomy errors found.
Format 1536x1024 landscape is correct; no logo, signature or watermark
animal/clay-animation-2.note_de: Das Wasser ist fotorealistisch statt aus Knete, der Reiher zu fein modelliert für einen Knetfilm.
animal/clay-animation-2.note_en: The water is photoreal rather than modelled, and the heron is too finely sculpted for a clay film.
animal/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetfiguren-Szene: Ein grauer Reiher aus Plastilin schnappt im Wasser nach einem Fisch, Tropfen spritzen, links Schilf mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter, hinten gemalter Himmel über Bäumen.
animal/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay-animation scene: a grey plasticine heron snaps a fish from the water as droplets fly, reeds with a dragonfly and lily pads left, painted sky behind trees.

problems: Reads as modern hi-bit landscape illustration rather than a 16-bit console game screen: no repeating tiles or game-like parallax bands, and the heron is a large centred-left showpiece rather than a compact sprite

Grid is about 170 cells on the short side, so somewhat finer and more detailed than the target of about 256 cells. The palette is broad, with painterly multi-tone gradients in the water and foliage instead of short 3-5 step ramps.
Dark outlines are inconsistent; the heron neck and body rely on soft tonal shading
Checkerboard dithering appears only in the clouds; the pixel grid is reasonably uniform, with no scanlines, bezels or score counters

All motif elements are present: side-view heron with both legs in ripples, fish in beak, spray droplets, reeds and lily pads on the left, dragonfly perched on a cattail tip, wooded far bank. No anatomy errors found.
Format 1536x1024 landscape is correct; no logo, signature or watermark
animal/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Eher moderne, malerische Pixelgrafik als ein Spielbildschirm der 16-Bit-Ära.
animal/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Looks more like modern painterly pixel art than a 16-bit-era game screen.
animal/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik aus groben Bildpunkten: Ein Graureiher fängt im blauen See einen Fisch, Wasserringe um die Beine, links Schilf mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter, dahinter bewaldetes Ufer.
animal/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Pixel art in coarse blocks: a grey heron catches a fish in a blue lake, ripples round its legs, reeds with a dragonfly and lily pads left, wooded bank behind.

motif_missing: glance back over the shoulder is weak: head is in three-quarter view toward the door rather than looking back over the shoulder
problems: Style drifts toward modern hi-bit pixel illustration: very large palette, soft painterly shading and gradients inside the pixel grid, warm hi-bit lantern glow, which the style block says to avoid
Composition is a centred hero shot of a single character, not a side or top-down tile game screen or a framed dialogue portrait
Pixel blocks have slightly soft, smeared edges instead of crisp, non-anti-aliased squares
Checkerboard dithering in the sky and dark outlines are present, so the medium is recognisable
Format correct: portrait 1024x1536

Motif otherwise complete: stout badger, striped face, round ears, bushy tail, peaked cap, quilted vest with pockets, red knitted scarf, crossbody satchel with letters, knocking paw, string-tied parcel, doorstep, wooden door, full body
No logos, watermarks or signature; the hilltop castle is generic, not a real landmark
No anatomy errors found
character/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine moderne, detailreiche Pixel-Illustration als wie ein Bildschirm aus einem 16-Bit-Spiel.
character/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Looks more like a modern, highly detailed pixel illustration than a screen from a 16-bit game.
character/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik mit Raster-Dithering im Himmel: Ein Dachs mit Schirmmütze, Steppweste, rotem Schal und Umhängetasche klopft mit Paket an eine Holztür, hinten Dorf, Brücke und Burg.
character/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Pixel art with dithered sky: a badger in a peaked cap, quilted vest, red scarf and satchel knocks on a wooden door holding a parcel, village, bridge and castle behind.

motif_missing: winding road does not link the windmill (passes ~100 px east of it with no branch)
river does not clearly run into the bay: it passes under the bridge and disappears into the forest edge beside the beach
problems: Drift toward generic fantasy-map illustration: island painted with oblique depth, modelled cliffs and a 3D forest of individual trunks, against the style's 'no depth' flat sea-chart convention
Title cartouche is Renaissance-style strapwork rather than a Gothic frame or banner
Place names are black on scroll banners, not red as the style block asks; gold is fairly convincing (textured, slightly cracked), and the vine border with drolleries (bird, hares) fits
Format correct (1254x1254 square); no logos, signatures or real landmarks
map/gothic-illuminated-manuscript-1.note_de: Die Straße erreicht die Windmühle nicht, und die räumlich gemalte Insel wirkt eher wie eine Fantasykarte als wie gotische Buchmalerei.
map/gothic-illuminated-manuscript-1.note_en: The road never reaches the windmill, and the island's painted depth looks more like a fantasy map than Gothic illumination.
map/gothic-illuminated-manuscript-1.alt_de: Buchmalerei in Blattgold und Ultramarin: die sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Leuchtturm, Windmühle auf dem Hügel, ummauerter Hafenstadt, drei Segelbooten, Seeungeheuer und goldener Windrose im Rankenrahmen.
map/gothic-illuminated-manuscript-1.alt_en: Gothic illumination in gold and ultramarine: crescent-shaped Lornholm with lighthouse, hilltop windmill, walled harbour town, three boats, sea monster and gilded compass rose in a floral border.

motif_missing: river does not run into the bay: it flows from the hill under a bridge away from the bay and dead-ends in the middle of the southern forest
winding road does not reach the harbour town Varn (it links lighthouse, windmill and the bridge only; Varn sits across the bay unconnected)
problems: Geographic logic error: the river ends abruptly inside the forest
Pixel grid mostly consistent with flat ramps, bordered label windows and colour-banded title logo; slight AI softness and anti-aliasing on pixel edges
Format correct (1254x1254 square); no logos, signatures or real landmarks
map/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Der Fluss endet mitten im Wald statt in der Bucht, und keine Straße führt zur Hafenstadt.
map/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: The river ends in the forest instead of the bay, and no road reaches the harbour town.
map/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik im Stil eines 16-Bit-Konsolenspiels: die sichelförmige Insel Lornholm als Oberweltkarte mit Hafenstadt und drei Booten, Windmühle, Leuchtturm, Nadelwald, Fluss und einer Seeschlange im Meer.
map/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit console pixel art: the crescent island of Lornholm as a top-down overworld with harbour town and three boats, windmill, lighthouse, pine forest, river and a sea serpent offshore.

motif_missing: winding road does not link the windmill: it runs below the hilltop windmill without a branch to it (town and lighthouse are linked)
problems: Convincing top-down aerial look with white sans-serif leader-line labels, white compass rose and scale bar; colours lean slightly saturated, and the low-sun long shadows are weak
Windmill and lighthouse are drawn slightly obliquely; the lighthouse lean is plausible near the frame edge
Scale implausible (houses roughly 70 m wide against the 1 km bar), inherent to the motif
Format correct (1254x1254 square); no visible drone, logos, signatures or real landmarks
map/aerial-drone-photography-1.note_de: Die Straße führt an der Windmühle vorbei, ohne sie zu erreichen.
map/aerial-drone-photography-1.note_en: The road passes below the windmill without reaching it.
map/aerial-drone-photography-1.alt_de: Drohnenfoto senkrecht von oben: die sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Felsküste, Kiefernwald, Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Leuchtturm, Hafenort mit Mole und drei Booten, im türkisen Meer ein Wal.
map/aerial-drone-photography-1.alt_en: Straight-down drone photograph: the crescent island of Lornholm with rocky shores, pine forest, hilltop windmill, lighthouse, harbour town with breakwater and three boats, and a whale in turquoise water.

problems: Pixel grid is coarser than specified (about 125 pixels on the short side instead of about 256), with slight soft edges from upscaling
Reads more like a generic pixel-art icon sheet than a 16-bit console menu screen: no framed windows or square icon cells
Glossy specular highlights on the heart, bell and lenses lean slightly toward a modern hi-bit look
House carries extra detail (bushes, chimney, brick texture) compared with the simpler icons; the map pin is slightly narrower than the rest
icons/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: 16-Bit-Pixelgrafik mit groben Quadratpixeln auf dunkelblauem Grund: neun Icons im 3×3-Raster – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Kartenpin, Zahnrad und Herz, mit dunklen Umrissen.
icons/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit pixel art with coarse square pixels on dark blue: nine icons in a 3×3 grid – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, map pin, gear and heart, with dark outlines.

problems: Lettering is a modern sans-serif typeface rather than brush-painted capitals
Boat stacks float without ruled register ground lines; light tonal modelling on the skin
No key: each boat with four figures stands for 6, but the counts of 2 / 5 / 4 / 1 boats are exactly proportional
Small pale plinth under the lower June boat
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Putz, bunte Blockbordüre: Unter „LORNHOLM 2026“ zeigen gestapelte Ruderboote 12, 30, 24 und 6 für Juni bis September, darunter blaues Zickzackwasser.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on cracked plaster, block border: under 'LORNHOLM 2026', stacked rowing boats show 12, 30, 24 and 6 for June to September over blue zigzag water.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the figure counts are 6 / 15 / 12 / 4 for 12 / 30 / 24 / 6. June, July and August use one figure for 2, but September shows 4 figures where 3 would match, so July is only 3.75 times September instead of 5. The crowd heights (289 / 624 / 464 / 159 px) also give July 3.9 times September and August 1.6 times June.
problems: Five extra passengers boarding on the gangway right beside the June column can be mistaken for part of the June count
Figures stand on each other's heads as human towers
Some fine hatching in the sky and water, closer to linocut than coarse plank woodcut
chart/woodcut-3.note_de: September zeigt vier Figuren statt drei und wirkt neben dem Juli deshalb zu groß. Die September-Gruppe zeigt vier statt drei Figuren und wirkt dadurch rund ein Drittel größer, als der Wert 6 im Vergleich zu den anderen Monaten verlangt.
chart/woodcut-3.note_en: September shows four figures instead of three, so it looks too large next to July. The September group shows four figures instead of three, so it looks about a third larger than the value 6 warrants next to the other months.
chart/woodcut-3.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf warmweißem Papier: Unter einem Spruchband mit „LORNHOLM 2026“ stehen aufgetürmte Fahrgäste für 12, 30, 24 und 6 am Steg, links Fähre, rechts Insel.
chart/woodcut-3.alt_en: Black woodcut on warm paper: below a 'LORNHOLM 2026' scroll banner, stacked crowds of passengers stand for 12, 30, 24 and 6 on a pier, ferry left, island right.
text_errors: Proportion: the other months use 1 figure = 2 (JUN 6 figures, JUL 15 in 5 rows of 3, AUG 12 in 4 rows of 3), so SEP should have 3 figures; found 4 (about +33%). Group height is about 160 px against about 615 px for JUL (0.26 instead of 0.20). JUN is about 282 px high, roughly +15%, on the tolerance limit.

problems: Lettering is a crisp digital serif rather than hand-inked or stencil capitals
The ferry, island and mirrored water read like a blue-toned photograph with perspective, not like a photogram
The measured bars (164 / 438 / 336 / 92 px) are within about 7 percent of the correct proportions
chart/cyanotype-2.alt_de: Cyanotypie in Preußischblau mit ausgefransten Pinselrändern: Unter „LORNHOLM 2026“ stehen weiße Balken für 12, 30, 24 und 6 auf einem Steg, links Fähre und Blätter, rechts Leuchtturm.
chart/cyanotype-2.alt_en: Prussian-blue cyanotype with ragged brushed edges: under 'LORNHOLM 2026', white bars for 12, 30, 24 and 6 stand on a pier, ferry and leaves left, lighthouse right.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the crowd columns measure about 256 / 605 / 445 / 149 px, so July is only 4.1 times September (should be 5) and August 1.74 times June (should be 2). September is about 25 percent too tall.
problems: The figures and the ferry are fairly detailed, which gives a generic AI-watercolour look instead of loose wet-in-wet washes
The painting runs off the left edge instead of fading into bare paper
Extra boarding passengers next to the June column add clutter
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-3.note_de: Die Säulen sind nicht proportional: September ist zu hoch, August nur rund 1,75-mal so hoch wie Juni statt doppelt.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-3.note_en: The columns are out of proportion: September is too tall, and August is only about 1.75 times June instead of twice.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-3.alt_de: Nass-in-Nass-Aquarell mit verlaufenden Rändern: Säulen aus Fahrgästen für 12, 30, 24 und 6 stehen auf einem Kai, links eine Fähre, rechts eine grüne Insel, darüber „LORNHOLM 2026“ in Sepia.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-3.alt_en: Wet-in-wet watercolour with bleeding edges: columns of passengers for 12, 30, 24 and 6 stand on a quay, ferry left, green island right, 'LORNHOLM 2026' in sepia above.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the ferry rows are 4 / 11 / 8 / 2 for 12 / 30 / 24 / 6. June, August and September use one row for 3, but July has 11 rows instead of 10, so it reads as 33 and is 5.5 times September instead of 5.
problems: The pixel grid is irregular and slightly soft, with mixed block sizes in the town and mountains, and coarser than the roughly 256-pixel spec
Pairs of ferries fused side by side look more like apartment blocks than stacked boats
chart/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Der Juli-Stapel hat eine Fährenreihe zu viel und steht damit für 33 statt 30.
chart/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: July's ferry stack has one row too many, so it reads as 33 instead of 30.
chart/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: 16-Bit-Pixelgrafik im Stil eines Konsolenspiels: Türme aus gestapelten Fähren für 12, 30, 24 und 6 stehen auf einer Mole, Monatsnamen in dunkelblauen Fenstern, dahinter Meer und Inselstädtchen.
chart/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: 16-bit console-game pixel art: towers of stacked ferries for 12, 30, 24 and 6 stand on a pier, month names in dark blue windows, sea and island town behind.

problems: The bars have extruded side faces, which gives a slight 3D look
The layout is fairly symmetric with narrow margins and no hand-drawn arrows, so it reads less like a zine spread
The measured bars (212 / 528 / 397 / 108 px) are within about 5 percent of the correct proportions
chart/risograph-2.note_de: Ein diagonaler Abrieb im ersten O lässt den Titel auf normale Größe wie „LØRNHOLM“ wirken; Zahlen und Balken stimmen.
chart/risograph-2.note_en: A diagonal ink-wear streak through the first O makes the title read like 'LØRNHOLM' at normal size; the numbers and bars are correct.
chart/risograph-2.alt_de: Risodruck in Pink, Blau und Gelb, körnig und versetzt: Pinke Balken für 12, 30, 24 und 6 vor blauem Meer, links Fähre, rechts Leuchtturminsel unter gelber Sonne.
chart/risograph-2.alt_en: Risograph print in pink, blue and yellow, grainy and misregistered: pink bars for 12, 30, 24 and 6 against blue sea, ferry left, lighthouse island under a yellow sun.
text_errors: expected 'LORNHOLM 2026' to read cleanly; found the first 'O' with a diagonal white ink-wear streak over its right stroke. At full resolution the glyph is an O with a clean counter, but at normal and half viewing size the title reads as 'LØRNHOLM 2026'

motif_missing: stove has three to four gas burners instead of two
problems: Reads as a generic contemporary 'old-master' digital painting rather than a 17th-century Dutch panel: warm brown varnish tone, which the style block says to avoid, instead of cool daylight on a pale wall
Dense clutter on every surface; little bare wall, unlike the quiet ordered space of the style
No visible craquelure or glazed layering; even, grungy painterly texture across the whole surface
Positives: de Hooch-like doorway into further lit rooms, window light from the left, Delftware
Modern gas range with a lit blue flame (radio and jigsaw are required by the motif)

Otherwise complete: 3 herb pots plus a spoon jar on the sill, window above a stone sink, two mismatched chairs, jigsaw, teapot, one cup, shelves with plates, pasta, lentils and radio, calendar, coat beside the second door, newspaper on a chair, bread on the counter, tea towel on the oven handle, nobody present
Format 1536x1024 landscape is correct; no logo or signature
interior/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.note_de: Der Herd hat mehr als zwei Flammen, und der warme Braunton wirkt eher wie eine generische Altmeister-Imitation.
interior/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.note_en: The stove has more than two burners, and the warm brown tone reads more like a generic old-master imitation.
interior/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.alt_de: Ölgemälde nach holländischer Genremalerei in warmen Brauntönen: Küche mit Kräutertöpfen am Fenster über dem Steinbecken, Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Holztisch, dahinter offene Tür zu weiteren Räumen.
interior/dutch-golden-age-painting-1.alt_en: Oil painting in warm browns after Dutch genre scenes: kitchen with herb pots above a stone sink, jigsaw, teapot and cup on the table, an open door beyond.

motif_missing: stove is a four-burner range, not a two-burner stove
problems: Not convincingly clay animation: realistic wood grain on the table and chairs, real glass jars, photoreal basil, rosemary and ivy, jute rug and wicker dish rack
Window view is a soft-focus, photo-like backdrop (background blur or bokeh, which the style block says to avoid) instead of a painted flat backdrop
Warm, golden interior light instead of neutral white studio lamps
No plasticine traits such as fingerprints, tool scores, marbled unmixed colours or chunky simplified forms; only the teapot, cup, sink and stove look slightly lumpy, like clay
No visible set edges; reads as a photographed dollhouse or miniature set

Otherwise motif complete: 3 herb pots plus a spoon jar, window above the sink, mismatched blue and brown chairs, jigsaw, teapot, one cup, plates, pasta and lentil jars, radio, calendar, coat beside the door, newspaper on a chair, bread bag, tea towel on the oven handle, nobody present
Format 1536x1024 landscape is correct; no logo
interior/clay-animation-2.note_de: Kaum Knetoptik: Holzmaserung, Glas, Pflanzen und der unscharfe Fensterblick wirken fotorealistisch wie ein Miniaturset.
interior/clay-animation-2.note_en: Hardly any clay look: wood grain, glass, plants and the blurred window view look photoreal, like a miniature set.
interior/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Miniatur-Küchenset mit leichter Knetoptik in warmem Licht: Kräutertöpfe am Fenster über dem Spülbecken, Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Tisch, Kessel auf dem Herd, Mantel neben der Tür.
interior/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Miniature kitchen set, faintly clay-like, in warm light: herb pots above the sink, jigsaw, teapot and cup on the table, kettle on the stove, coat by the door.

motif_missing: stove is a four-burner range, not a two-burner stove
the two chairs are the same design and differ only in their seat cushions, so they are barely mismatched
problems: Reads as modern cozy indie pixel art, not an early-1990s 16-bit console screen: a frontal perspective room illustration instead of a side or top-down tile view
Warm sunbeam light patches and a glow on the floor drift toward painterly or hi-bit lighting
Large palette with soft-looking edges in places; the grid is mostly consistent
Checkerboard dithering in the window sky matches the style
Added fridge, range hood, umbrella stand and second rug (acceptable clutter)

Otherwise complete: 3 herb pots plus a spoon jar on the sill, window above the sink, jigsaw, teapot, one cup, plates, two jars, radio, calendar, coat on a hook beside the door, newspaper on a chair, bread bag, tea towel on the oven handle, nobody present
Format 1536x1024 landscape is correct; no logo
interior/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Der Herd hat vier statt zwei Flammen, und die Szene wirkt eher wie moderne Indie-Pixelkunst als ein 16-Bit-Spielbildschirm.
interior/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: The stove has four burners instead of two, and the scene looks more like modern indie pixel art than a 16-bit game screen.
interior/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Pixelgrafik im Stil eines Konsolenspiels mit gerastertem Himmel: Küche mit Kräutertöpfen am Fenster über der Spüle, Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Tisch, Sonnenflecken auf dem Dielenboden.
interior/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Console-style pixel art with a dithered sky: a kitchen with herb pots above the sink, jigsaw, teapot and cup on the table, sunlight patches on the plank floor.

problems: Reads as a downsampled painting rather than hand-placed 16-bit sprite work: soft blotchy shading with many intermediate tones (fruit, leaves, section flesh) instead of a limited flat palette with 3-5-step ramps
Pixel cells are about 8 px, so roughly 128 pixels on the short side, coarser than the ~256 the style asks for; the grid is consistent and there is no mixing of pixel sizes
Intermediate edge tones on the seed, petal and fruit outlines amount to pseudo anti-aliasing

Laid out as a natural-history plate on a plain cream ground, with no game-screen framing (no menu or encyclopedia window, no tiles); the plain ground is what the motif asks for, but the console-game context is missing

Motif complete: four leaves (top-left curled, left one with an insect bite), one five-petalled blossom, one closed bud, one slightly lumpy quince, a lengthwise half showing core and six seeds, a single seed and a detached petal, all on an empty ground
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, signature or watermark
botanical/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein verpixeltes Gemälde als wie echte 16-Bit-Spielgrafik: zu viele weiche Farbabstufungen statt einer knappen Palette.
botanical/16-bit-pixel-art-1.note_en: Looks more like a pixelated painting than true 16-bit game graphics, with too many soft colour gradations instead of a tight palette.
botanical/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_de: Grobe Pixelgrafik mit dunklen Konturen auf Cremegrund: Quittenzweig mit vier Blättern, rosa Blüte, Knospe und gelber Frucht, darunter eine halbierte Quitte mit Kernen, ein Samen und ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/16-bit-pixel-art-1.alt_en: Coarse pixel art with dark outlines on cream: quince branch with four leaves, pink blossom, bud and yellow fruit; below, a halved quince with seeds, one seed and a petal.

motif_missing: young man is behind/on top of the boat rather than crouching beside the woman
problems: modern illustration with a uniform stone/stipple texture laid over it (filter-like), not soft blown or swabbed ochre
receding sea band with horizon, waves and a perspective jetty, explicitly to be avoided
boat drawn in three-quarter perspective with planks and ribs, not a flat side-view outline
faces, knitted cap and clothing folds modelled in detail instead of crude contour silhouettes
figures and objects arranged as a coherent scene with depth rather than separate figures on rock bulges
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.note_de: Wirkt wie eine moderne Illustration mit Steintextur: Meereshorizont und perspektivisches Boot statt flacher Höhlenwand-Figuren.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.note_en: Looks like a modern illustration with a stone texture applied: a sea horizon and a perspective boat instead of flat cave-wall figures.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.alt_de: Ocker und Kohle auf rissigem Kalkstein: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie fest; dahinter Meer, Steg, Möwen.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.alt_en: Ochre and charcoal on rough rock: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank; a young man in a knitted cap nails it. Sea, jetty, gulls behind.

problems: jetty recedes diagonally in perspective, against the no-perspective rule
boat hull shown with some volume and curvature rather than a strict flat side view
young man's crouch is a naturalistic three-quarter pose
no ruled ground lines or registers
woman painted red-brown instead of the conventional pale ochre for women
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_de: Steg und Boot sind perspektivisch gezeichnet, was der flachen ägyptischen Bildordnung widerspricht.
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_en: The jetty and boat are drawn in perspective, breaking the flat Egyptian picture order.
