people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: Eine grauhaarige Frau im Leinenkleid kniet am Boot, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt eine Planke; dahinter Zickzackwasser, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster: a grey-haired woman kneels at the boat, a young man in a knitted cap nails a plank; zigzag sea, jetty, two gulls.

motif_missing: woman presses the hull with only one visible hand; no distinct new plank
problems: figures have drawn interior folds, hair highlights and facial modelling instead of opaque black card
boat, toolbox and pebbles rendered in brown wood tones with plank lines rather than black cut-outs
boat and toolbox in perspective, not strict profile
background opens into a receding coastal vista with horizon, village and church tower
figures not on a single frieze ground strip; pebble beach recedes
people/silhouette-animation-3.note_de: Figuren und Requisiten haben gezeichnete Falten und Holztöne statt reinem Schwarz, und der Hintergrund öffnet sich zu einer tiefen Küstenansicht.
people/silhouette-animation-3.note_en: Figures and props show drawn folds and wood tones instead of solid black card, and the background opens into a deep coastal view.
people/silhouette-animation-3.alt_de: Scherenschnitt-Filmbild in Schwarz vor blaugrünen Papierebenen: Eine ältere Frau und ein junger Mann mit Pudelmütze reparieren ein umgedrehtes Boot, dahinter Meer, Steg mit zwei Möwen, Küstendorf.
people/silhouette-animation-3.alt_en: Silhouette film frame, black cut-outs against blue-green paper layers: an older woman and a young man in a bobble hat repair an upturned boat; behind, sea, jetty, two gulls, village.

problems: photorealistic modern look on a real location, not a sound-stage set
real sky with clouds and a deep vista with headland and house, explicitly to be avoided
directional sunlight and HDR micro-detail in skin, wool and wood
muted naturalistic grade with no jewel-tone accent or dense dye-transfer colour
no painted backdrop or carpentered flats
people/three-strip-technicolor-3.note_de: Wirkt wie ein modernes Foto an einer echten Küste statt wie eine Technicolor-Studioszene der 1940er mit gemaltem Hintergrund.
people/three-strip-technicolor-3.note_en: Looks like a modern photograph on a real coast, not a 1940s Technicolor sound-stage scene with a painted backdrop.
people/three-strip-technicolor-3.alt_de: Fotorealistisches Filmbild an felsiger Küste: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine neue Planke auf ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie fest; Steg mit Möwen.
people/three-strip-technicolor-3.alt_en: Photorealistic film still on a rocky coast: a grey-haired woman presses a new plank onto an upturned boat, a young man in a beanie nails it; jetty with gulls.

problems: adult drawing skill: correct proportions, convincing kneeling and crouching poses with foreshortened legs
boat drawn in perspective with curved ribs; jetty recedes in perspective
figures overlap the boat and each other, against the no-overlap rule
gulls drawn with adult detail (feet, wingtips)
densely textured pebble field instead of bare paper with a few circles; reads as crayon texture over a clean illustration
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-3.note_de: Zu gekonnt für ein sechsjähriges Kind: richtige Proportionen, Überschneidungen und ein perspektivisches Boot.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-3.note_en: Too skilled for a six-year-old: correct proportions, overlaps and a boat in perspective.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-3.alt_de: Wachsmalkreide auf weißem Papier mit Sonne in der Ecke: Eine grauhaarige Frau drückt eine Planke ans umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann mit blauer Mütze hämmert; dahinter Meer, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/child-s-crayon-drawing-3.alt_en: Wax crayon on paper with a corner sun: a grey-haired woman presses a plank to the upturned boat, a young man in a blue cap hammers; sea, jetty, two gulls.

motif_missing: woman presses the new plank with only one hand; her other hand rests on the old hull, and her kneeling pose is hidden
problems: reads as a contemporary retro/risograph illustration rather than a 1950s print
sea horizon, receding jetty and foreshortened boat give depth, against the flat-stage rule
faces and hands drawn near-realistically with wrinkles and knuckles instead of oval heads and mitten hands
artificial worn/grainy print texture, explicitly to be avoided
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.note_de: Eher moderne Retro-Illustration mit Druckstruktur: Perspektive, Horizont und fast realistische Gesichter und Hände statt flacher 50er-Jahre-Formen.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.note_en: Reads as a modern retro illustration with print texture: perspective, a horizon and near-realistic faces and hands instead of flat 1950s shapes.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.alt_de: Retro-Illustration in Senf, Petrol, Tomatenrot und Oliv auf Creme: Ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt eine Planke, eine grauhaarige Frau presst die Hände aufs umgedrehte Boot; Steg, Möwen.
people/mid-century-modern-commercial-art.alt_en: Retro illustration in mustard, teal, tomato red and olive on cream: a young man in a cap nails a plank, a grey-haired woman presses on the upturned boat; jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: short grey hair: hair is longer and windswept
kneeling not visible: the woman leans over the hull, lower body hidden
problems: Too clean for push-processed Tri-X: grain is fine, shadows hold full detail, rich midtones, HDR-like clarity in wood and pebbles
Little blocked shadow or harsh contrast; reads as modern digital monochrome
Format 1536x1024 landscape correct; no anatomy errors, logos or landmarks found
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_de: Für gepushten Film zu sauber: feines Korn, durchgezeichnete Schatten und viele Mitteltöne.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_en: Too clean for push-processed film: fine grain, detailed shadows and plenty of midtones.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_de: Körniges Schwarzweißfoto im Reportagestil: Eine alte Frau drückt eine neue Planke an ein umgedrehtes Holzboot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze nagelt sie fest; dahinter Brandung, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.alt_en: Grainy black-and-white reportage photo: an old woman presses a plank onto an upturned wooden boat, a young man in a beanie nails it; surf, jetty, two gulls behind.

motif_missing: two gulls: shown as long-legged wading birds
woman presses the plank with only one visible hand, not both
short grey hair: drawn as a bun
problems: Figures fill over a third of the picture height instead of under a fifth; oval heads, not circle-plus-two-triangle Warli bodies
Man's cap is a detailed striped beanie with pompom; woman's hair bun has strand detail
Boat, toolbox and nail tin drawn in perspective with modelling and overlap; pebbles as stippled tone
Man's head floats detached from the body; legs crossed in an odd X
Reads as a Warli-inspired modern illustration, not a Warli wall painting
people/warli-painting-3.note_de: Die Figuren sind für Warli zu groß und detailliert, Boot und Kiste perspektivisch gezeichnet, und statt Möwen stehen Watvögel da.
people/warli-painting-3.note_en: Figures are too large and detailed for Warli, boat and toolbox are drawn in perspective, and wading birds replace the gulls.
people/warli-painting-3.alt_de: Weiße Strichmalerei auf rotbraunem Lehmgrund im Warli-Stil: Eine Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot, ein Mann mit Mütze hämmert; Wellenlinien mit Fischen, Steg, zwei Watvögel, Kiesel als Tupfen.
people/warli-painting-3.alt_en: White paste-style painting on red-brown ground: a woman kneels at an upturned boat, a capped man hammers; wavy water with fish, a jetty, two wading birds.

problems: Sea, boat wood grain, rope and toolbox look like real materials, not matte clay
Deep naturalistic landscape with hills, cliffs and houses instead of a shallow tabletop stage with painted backdrop
Polished modern CG-clay / naturalistic-miniature look rather than 1970s-90s European TV clay animation
Figures and motif complete; hands fine; format correct; no logos
people/clay-animation-2.note_de: Wirkt wie eine polierte moderne Miniatur: Meer, Holz und Seil sehen echt aus, dazu eine tiefe Landschaft statt Knetkulisse.
people/clay-animation-2.note_en: Looks like a polished modern miniature: sea, wood and rope look real, with a deep landscape instead of an all-clay set.

Faces and limbs are tonally modelled; figures have natural proportions, not giant stiff cut-outs with oversized hands and wide eyes
Seam with nail holes, hard outlines and comma waves are correct

people/thermal-imaging-2.alt_en: Thermal image in violet, orange and yellow with crosshair and colour scale: a woman presses her hands on an upturned boat, a capped man hammers a nail; jetty, two gulls.

problems: Minor: horizon nearly level and little downward view; colour bleed weaker than described
Bottom noise band leans slightly toward multicoloured digital glitch
Motif complete; hands fine; format correct; no logos or date stamp

people/vhs-camcorder-footage-3.alt_en: Washed-out camcorder still with tape noise at the bottom: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat pressing a plank, a young man hammers; jetty with two gulls behind.

problems: Not 1990s clip art: a continuous edge-to-edge scene with horizon, sea, island and perspective instead of separate stock clips on plain white with grey shadow ellipses
Comic-book detail the style block explicitly excludes: wood grain, individually shaded pebbles, wrinkle hatching, soft shading on the hull. It reads as a modern editorial cartoon
Figures are naturalistic, not stiff side-view figures with big round heads and dot eyes; hands have five fingers, not four
Spatial glitch: the woman's green-trousered knee and boot sit on top of the hull planks, as if she were kneeling on or inside the upturned boat
The young man's jacket does not look clearly oversized (minor)
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no logo, watermark or signature found
people/1990s-clip-art-3.note_de: Statt einzelner Clipart-Motive auf Weiß zeigt das Bild eine durchgehende, detailreiche Comic-Szene mit Horizont.
people/1990s-clip-art-3.note_en: Instead of separate clip-art pieces on white, this is a continuous, detailed comic-style scene with a horizon.
people/1990s-clip-art-3.alt_de: Comicartige Zeichnung mit dicken Konturen und flachen Farben: Ein junger Mann mit roter Mütze nagelt eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Holzboot, eine grauhaarige Frau drückt sie an; Steg, Meer, Möwen.
people/1990s-clip-art-3.alt_en: Comic-style drawing with thick outlines, flat colours: a young man in a red beanie nails a plank to an upturned boat while a grey-haired woman holds it; jetty, sea, gulls.

problems: Camera is not vertical. This is a steep oblique, high-angle shot: the sides of the jetty piles, the flank of the boat and the people's backs and profiles are visible, which the style block rules out
People are far too large for the style: the man is about 18% of the frame width, the woman about 17%, against a limit of one tenth
The young man's age (~20) cannot be read: his face is hidden under the cap and he looks rather older and stockier than lanky
The jetty's end is cut off at the top edge (minor)

Otherwise all elements are present: kneeling grey-haired woman pressing the new plank with both hands, sleeves pushed up; man with a knitted cap hammering a nail; open toolbox, rope coil, tin of nails, sea, jetty, two gulls (standing on the beach)
Low sun with long hard shadows and natural colour match the style; format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no drone, logo or watermark visible
people/aerial-drone-photography-2.note_de: Die Aufnahme ist schräg von oben fotografiert statt senkrecht von oben, die Menschen wirken dadurch zu groß.
people/aerial-drone-photography-2.note_en: The shot is taken at a steep oblique angle rather than straight down, so the people appear too large.
people/aerial-drone-photography-2.alt_de: Drohnenfoto schräg von oben bei tiefer Sonne: Eine grauhaarige Frau und ein Mann mit Strickmütze reparieren ein umgedrehtes, verwittertes Ruderboot am Kiesstrand; daneben Werkzeugkiste, Seil, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/aerial-drone-photography-2.alt_en: Drone photo from a steep angle in low sun: a grey-haired woman and a man in a knitted cap repair an upturned rowing boat on pebbles; toolbox, rope, jetty, gulls.

slightly crooked nose not discernible (straight profile nose)

Close-up hero framing; the figure does not stand on a register ground line
Surface (flaking whitewash, Egyptian blue, red-brown outlines), dotted hills, palm row and zigzag water panels are convincing
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, signature, hieroglyphs or deities

portrait/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_en: Face and beard are painted naturalistically rather than in the Egyptian scheme, and the scar on the left eyebrow is barely visible.
portrait/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem, abblätterndem Putz: Ein bärtiger Mann mit blauer Mütze und Jacke hält einen angeschlagenen Emaillebecher, hinter ihm Zickzack-Wasser, eine Fähre, Palmen und gepunktete Hügel.
portrait/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster: a bearded man in a blue cap and jacket holds a chipped enamel mug; behind him zigzag water, a ferry, palms and dotted hills.

motif_missing: scar sits on his right eyebrow (viewer's left), not the left
problems: Paint surface drifts toward detailed hyperrealist texture (pores, individual hairs, crusty jacket, HDR-like hands) instead of enamel-smooth glazes with hard drawn contours
Figure is not stiff or mannequin-like; head and hands not enlarged
Fitting elements: flat bare wall with hard cast shadow, cold side light, slate/rust/grey-green palette, raw pink nose, figure cut by the frame
Hands plausible, no extra fingers; format correct; no logo or signature
portrait/new-objectivity-2.note_de: Die Oberfläche wirkt eher wie fotorealistische Feinmalerei als wie die glatte Malweise der Neuen Sachlichkeit; die Narbe sitzt an der rechten Augenbraue.
portrait/new-objectivity-2.note_en: The surface reads more like photoreal fine painting than smooth New Objectivity, and the scar is on the right eyebrow.
portrait/new-objectivity-2.alt_de: Gemälde der Neuen Sachlichkeit in kaltem Seitenlicht: Ein älterer Mann mit Strickmütze und Stoppelbart umfasst einen abgeplatzten Emaillebecher, ein Finger trägt ein Pflaster; dahinter kahle Wand, rostiger Stahlträger, Tau.
portrait/new-objectivity-2.alt_en: New Objectivity painting in cold side light: an older man in a knitted cap clasps a chipped enamel mug with a plastered finger, before a bare wall and rusty girder.

motif_missing: eyes look straight into the camera, not just past the viewer
plaster is on the index finger, not a thumb (thumb clearly visible over the rim)
scar on his right eyebrow rather than the left
problems: Face has crisp HDR-like local contrast and a full midtone range; shadows are detailed rather than blocked, highlights barely blown
Background (bulb, ferry cabin) is softly out of focus instead of deep focus
Grain present but moderate, not coarse push-processed grit
Posed eye-contact portrait rather than a mid-action reportage moment; horizon nearly level
Hands anatomically fine (five digits on the left hand); format correct; no logo or watermark
portrait/push-processed-black-and-white-.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein nachgeschärftes digitales Schwarzweißporträt als wie gepushter Tri-X, und der Mann blickt direkt in die Kamera.
portrait/push-processed-black-and-white-.note_en: It looks more like a sharpened digital black-and-white portrait than push-processed Tri-X, and the man looks straight into the camera.
portrait/push-processed-black-and-white-.alt_de: Körniges Schwarzweißfoto an Deck einer Fähre: Ein wettergegerbter Mann mit Strickmütze und grauem Bart hält einen angeschlagenen Emaillebecher, Pflaster am Finger; dahinter nasses Deck, Wasser, eine nackte Glühbirne.
portrait/push-processed-black-and-white-.alt_en: Grainy black-and-white photo on a ferry deck: a weathered, grey-bearded man in a knitted cap holds a chipped enamel mug; behind him a wet deck, water and a bare bulb.

problems: Water looks naturalistic with real wave texture and soft focus instead of flat pressed clay

Face and hands are lifelike and finely detailed (glossy realistic eyes, fingernails, skin creases) instead of ball head, bead eyes and mitten hands
Rope on the bollard looks like real rope

Format correct; no logo; no famous clay character
portrait/clay-animation-3.note_de: Wasser, Fähre und Gesicht wirken eher wie eine naturalistische Miniatur mit Unschärfe als wie eine flache Knetkulisse fürs Kinderfernsehen.
portrait/clay-animation-3.note_en: Water, ferry and face look like a naturalistic miniature with soft focus rather than a flat children's-TV clay set.

portrait/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay animation: a clay man with knitted cap, grey beard and jug ears holds a chipped enamel mug, plaster on one finger; behind, bollards, ferry, water, painted hills, clay clouds.

plaster is on the index finger, not a thumb
slightly crooked nose not discernible

Skin is gritty and hyper-detailed rather than poreless and waxy; grade is mostly orange with little teal
Hands anatomically fine; format correct; no logo or watermark
portrait/modern-ai-default-look-1.note_de: Die Narbe ist eine frische rote Schnittwunde an der rechten Augenbraue, und das Pflaster sitzt am Zeigefinger statt am Daumen.

portrait/modern-ai-default-look-1.alt_en: Typical AI look in golden backlight: a weathered man in a knitted cap with a grey beard holds a chipped enamel mug before a blurred harbour sunset with bokeh lights.

problems: Millstone drawn as a foreshortened cylinder with elliptical top, grey stone texture and modelling, against the flat side-view rule
Bowl (step 5) has an elliptical rim and mottled shading; table (step 4) shows its top plane in perspective
Oven shown with interior depth and flames; loaf is modelled with highlights and shading
Modern block arrows between items and a Latin serif typeface not in ruled boxes; lettering reads as a modern poster, not one-colour brush capitals
Figures are convincing (profile heads, red-brown men, kilts, ground lines, flaking plaster), but objects drift toward the default illustrative look
Bake: peel shaft and blade look slightly doubled/disjointed (minor)
Correct 1024x1536 portrait; no logos, signatures or watermarks; hands and limbs anatomically acceptable

infographic/ancient-egyptian-wall-painti.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on flaking plaster: in six stacked registers, red-brown men in profile sow, harvest, mill, knead and bake bread; dough rises in a bowl under a cloth.

Subtle gradients and shading on hands, millstone and loaf, against the no-shading rule; millstone shown as a foreshortened 3D wheel
Title in mixed case rather than bold condensed capitals
Layout is a two-column zigzag with dotted arrows, close to but not quite a winding road
Odd stray green shape behind the flour sack in step 3 (minor)
Kneading hands acceptable; no extra or fused fingers
Correct 1024x1536 portrait; no logos, signatures or watermarks
