infographic/flat-vector-corporate-infogr.note_en: The cloth hangs behind the dough instead of covering it.
infographic/flat-vector-corporate-infogr.alt_de: Flache Vektor-Infografik in Petrol, Koralle und Senfgelb: Sechs runde Bildplaketten im Zickzack, verbunden durch gepunktete Pfeile, zeigen Säen, Ernten, Mahlen, Kneten, Gehenlassen und Backen unter einem Bannertitel.
infographic/flat-vector-corporate-infogr.alt_en: Flat vector infographic in teal, coral and mustard: six circular badges in a zigzag, linked by dotted arrows, show sowing, harvesting, milling, kneading, rising and baking beneath a ribbon title.

problems: Composition breaks the style block's 'no vanishing point, no single focus': the river recedes in Western-style central perspective toward a vanishing point, and the bridge and village form one central focal area. Near, middle and far grounds are not stacked up the picture.

The whole surface has the same dense illustrative detail. The houses have regular windows and doors drawn in crisp, even lines, not fine wobbly literati lines. It reads like a modern AI illustration in Chinese style, not a Yuan to early Qing painting.
Small cast shadow under the bench and some modelling on the tree trunk, although the style block asks for no light source or cast shadow.
Terrace fields are tinted fairly green, beyond the faint ochre and indigo palette.

Motif complete: raised view of the valley, a winding river, a single-arch stone bridge with one tiny figure, 5 houses plus a small chapel with a cross finial (not a real building), terraces on the left, dense forest on the right, a large old tree leaning toward the river with a wooden bench, a jagged far ridge and 7 birds. Format is 1536x1024 landscape as requested. No seals, inscriptions, pseudo-characters, signature or logo found in any corner.
landscape/shan-shui-literati-ink-paintin.note_de: Der Fluss zieht in westlicher Zentralperspektive in die Tiefe, und der Detailreichtum wirkt eher wie eine moderne Illustration als wie Literatenmalerei.
landscape/shan-shui-literati-ink-paintin.note_en: The river recedes in Western central perspective, and the dense detail reads more like a modern illustration than literati painting.
landscape/shan-shui-literati-ink-paintin.alt_de: Chinesische Tuschmalerei auf vergilbtem Papier: Vorn ein alter Baum mit Holzbank, am Fluss eine Bogenbrücke mit kleiner Figur, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassenfelder, Wald, Vogelschwarm und nebelverhangene Gipfel.
landscape/shan-shui-literati-ink-paintin.alt_en: Chinese ink painting on yellowed paper: old tree and wooden bench in front, arched stone bridge with tiny figure, village with chapel, terraced fields, forest, birds, misty peaks.

problems: The views do not match: the antenna leans left in the perspective and top views but right in the front elevation
Handle height is inconsistent: a tall arch in the perspective view, a short stub in the side view
Hatching fades into soft grey tones, closer to engraved illustration than even ruling-pen lines; shading also has some grey smudging
No 'Fig.' labels, which is correct because text is forbidden; thin ruled border present; no logos or signatures
product/patent-drawing-1.note_de: Die Ansichten passen nicht ganz zusammen: In der Vorderansicht neigt sich die Antenne zur anderen Seite, und der Griff ist unterschiedlich hoch.
product/patent-drawing-1.note_en: The views do not quite match: the antenna leans the other way in the front view and the handle height varies.
product/patent-drawing-1.alt_de: Patentzeichnung in schwarzer Tusche auf Weiß: dasselbe Kofferradio in vier Ansichten – schräg von vorn, frontal, von oben und von der Seite –, schattiert mit feinen Parallellinien.
product/patent-drawing-1.alt_en: Black ink patent drawing on white: the same portable radio in four views (three-quarter, front, top and side), modelled with fine parallel lines inside a thin border.

problems: Density logic is off: metal parts (antenna, speaker magnet, screws) are no brighter than the plastic casing, so it reads like a clear-acrylic product render rather than a radiograph
Interior lacks plausible construction such as batteries, a circuit board or a transformer; the speaker basket looks like clear plastic
The tuning mechanism has an odd tone-arm-like pointer
Film border, grain and scratches are present; no lead markers, which is correct; flat front projection; square format as requested
product/x-ray-radiograph-1.note_de: Wirkt eher wie durchsichtiges Plastik als wie ein Röntgenbild: Metallteile wie Antenne und Magnet leuchten nicht heller.
product/x-ray-radiograph-1.note_en: Looks more like clear plastic than a radiograph: metal parts such as the antenna and magnet are no brighter than the casing.
product/x-ray-radiograph-1.alt_de: Röntgenbild auf schwarzem Film: Das Kofferradio wirkt durchscheinend, innen sind Lautsprecherkorb, Abstimmmechanik, Skalenfenster und zwei Knöpfe zu sehen, darüber Tragegriff und schräge Teleskopantenne.
product/x-ray-radiograph-1.alt_en: X-ray on black film: the portable radio appears translucent, revealing speaker basket, tuning mechanism, scale window and two knobs, with carry handle and angled telescopic antenna above.

problems: The side-mounted clockwork key named in the style block is missing
The knobs are sculpted, knurled chrome-like metal and the screws are real modelled screws, where the style needs printed detail, not modelled
Proportions are realistic rather than chunky toy simplification, so it drifts toward a real vintage painted radio
Lithographed panels, outlines, chips, rust specks and the plain grey card are convincing; no logos
product/lithographed-tin-toy-1.note_de: Ohne Aufziehschlüssel und mit plastisch modellierten Metallknöpfen wirkt es eher wie ein echtes altes Radio als wie Blechspielzeug.
product/lithographed-tin-toy-1.note_en: With no wind-up key and sculpted metal knobs it reads more like a real vintage radio than a tin toy.
product/lithographed-tin-toy-1.alt_de: Blechspielzeug-Radio auf grauem Karton: rote Dose mit gelb-blau bedruckter Front, Lautsprechergitter, großem Senderknopf, Skala und zwei Knöpfen, abgeplatzter Lack, Rostflecken, Bügelgriff, schräge Antenne.
product/lithographed-tin-toy-1.alt_en: Tin toy radio on grey card: a red tin box with a yellow and blue printed front, speaker grille, large dial, scale and two knobs, chipped paint, rust, handle and angled antenna.

problems: The radio is a coherent 3D body in normal perspective with a dark cast shadow at the base, which the style forbids (no vanishing point, no cast shadow)
The subject is centred and whole instead of rebuilt from a few large, flat, offset planes seen from front and above at once
The collage textures (newsprint, faux bois, wallpaper, stippling) are applied over the form like a filter
Palette and materials fit the period; no legible headlines or text
product/synthetic-cubism-1.note_de: Das Radio ist als plastischer Körper mitten im Bild in Perspektive gemalt statt in flache, verschobene Flächen zerlegt.
product/synthetic-cubism-1.note_en: The radio is painted as a solid, centred object in perspective rather than broken into flat, shifted planes.
product/synthetic-cubism-1.alt_de: Kubistische Collage in Braun, Ocker, Grün und Blau: ein Kofferradio aus Zeitungspapier, Holzmaserung und Tapetenmustern, mit Lautsprecherpunkten, Senderknopf, Skala und schräger Antenne vor zerschnittenen Papierflächen.
product/synthetic-cubism-1.alt_en: Cubist collage in brown, ochre, green and blue: a portable radio pieced from newsprint, faux wood grain and wallpaper, with speaker dots, dial, scale and angled antenna against cut-paper planes.

problems: The radio is rendered as a fairly photoreal 3D object with chrome knobs, sitting on a shelf in the painted niche, not painted flat on the panel; a minor drift only
Small three-quarter tilt that breaks strict frontal symmetry slightly; no script, flags or religious elements
product/south-asian-truck-art-1.alt_de: Pakistanische Lastwagenmalerei: Ein mit Rosen und Ranken bemaltes Kofferradio steht unter einem Bogen vor tiefblauem Grund, umrahmt von Pfauen, Spiegelrauten und hängenden Ketten mit Blattanhängern.
product/south-asian-truck-art-1.alt_en: Pakistani truck art: a portable radio painted with roses and vines sits beneath an arch on deep blue, framed by peacocks, mirror diamonds and dangling chains with leaf pendants.

problems: The handle is mounted asymmetrically (left leg lands on the top surface, right leg pivots on the side face), a minor construction oddity
The radio fills much of the frame and is only slightly off-centre
product/memphis-design-1.alt_de: Memphis-Zeichnung mit schwarzen Konturen: lachsrosa Radio mit Punkt-, Kringel- und Gittermuster auf gelb-rot geteiltem Grund, mintgrüner Griff, bunte Knöpfe, harter schwarzer Schatten, ringsum schwebende Formen.
product/memphis-design-1.alt_en: Memphis-style drawing with black outlines: a salmon radio clad in dot, squiggle and grid patterns on a yellow-red split ground, mint handle, bright knobs, hard black shadow and floating shapes.

problems: Rendering is far too polished for 1980s-90s ray tracing: perfect anti-aliasing, no jagged edges, no banded gradients, horizon fades into smooth haze instead of aliasing moire
Anisotropic brushed-steel front panel and photographic clear-coated wood veneer read as modern product CGI, not primitive procedural textures
Cast shadow to the right has a soft, graded edge and the body shows soft contact darkening, not a single point light's razor-sharp shadow
Subject fills the frame and sits nearly centred from a fairly low three-quarter view, rather than small and off-centre in a raised wide-angle view
Style cues present: infinite grey checkerboard plane, high straight horizon, empty blue gradient sky, chrome knobs mirroring the checkerboard, glossy floor reflection

Motif complete: boxy rounded body, perforated grille on left half, one large dial above tick-mark-only window, two small knobs, top carry handle, angled partly extended telescopic antenna; square 1254x1254 matches 1024x1024; no logos or marks
product/early-raytraced-cgi-1.note_de: Zu glatt für frühes Raytracing: Gebürstetes Metall, fotoechtes Holzfurnier und weiche Schatten wirken wie ein modernes Produktrendering.
product/early-raytraced-cgi-1.note_en: Too polished for early ray tracing: brushed metal, photo-real wood veneer and soft shadows read like a modern product render.
product/early-raytraced-cgi-1.alt_de: Raytracing-Grafik im Stil der 1980er: Ein Kofferradio mit Holzgehäuse, Tragegriff, Lochgitter, Chromknöpfen und schräger Teleskopantenne steht auf spiegelndem Schachbrettboden unter blauem Verlaufshimmel.
product/early-raytraced-cgi-1.alt_en: Ray-traced 1980s-style CGI: a wood-cased portable radio with perforated grille, chrome knobs, carry handle and angled telescopic antenna stands on a glossy checkerboard floor under a blue gradient sky.

problems: Seascape inside the arch is larger and more spatial (horizon, water reflections, layered sunset sky) than the small flat vignette the style asks for
Overall more Mucha-pastiche than period lithograph: little visible misregistration or crayon grain
poster/art-nouveau-poster-1.note_de: Alle drei Zeilen stimmen, doch unten links am Rand steht eine blasse, unleserliche Schein-Signatur.
poster/art-nouveau-poster-1.note_en: All three lines are correct, but a faint, illegible pseudo-signature has crept into the bottom-left margin.
poster/art-nouveau-poster-1.alt_de: Jugendstil-Farblithografie in Salbeigrün, Ocker und Rosé: Eine Frau mit wallendem roten Haar bläst Trompete vor großer Sonnenscheibe, dahinter eine Leuchtturminsel im Meer, ringsum Blumenornamente.
poster/art-nouveau-poster-1.alt_en: Art Nouveau colour lithograph in sage, ochre and rose: a woman with flowing red hair plays trumpet before a large sun disc, a lighthouse island behind, floral border around.
text_errors: extra: faint, illegible handwritten pseudo-signature (scribble like 'Tiwy') in the bottom-left paper margin below the frame, approx. x 30-60, y 1523-1532, very low contrast

problems: Composition is one integrated poster picture with sea and horizon, not a flash sheet of separate designs packed on bare paper as the style block requires
Trumpeter figure is rather illustrative and detailed (leaning neo-traditional) rather than a closed flash silhouette
Linework, dotted shading, forked ribbon banners, flowers and tack holes are convincing
poster/american-traditional-tattoo-flash.note_de: Statt eines Flash-Bogens mit Einzelmotiven zeigt es ein zusammenhängendes Bild mit Meereshorizont.
poster/american-traditional-tattoo-flash.note_en: Instead of a flash sheet of separate designs it shows one continuous picture with a sea horizon.
poster/american-traditional-tattoo-flash.alt_de: Tattoo-Flash-Stil mit dicken schwarzen Konturen und gepunkteten Schatten: Ein Trompeter mit Strohhut vor gelber Sonne, daneben eine Leuchtturminsel in Wellen, Schriftbänder und rote Blüten.
poster/american-traditional-tattoo-flash.alt_en: Tattoo flash style with thick black outlines and dotted shading: a trumpeter in a straw boater before a yellow sun, a lighthouse island in waves, ribbon banners and red flowers.

problems: Sun is only implied by the large red disc behind the trumpeter (acceptable abstraction)
Island photograph has no visible cut edge along the top; trees and sky blend softly into the card ground, slightly seamless
poster/photomontage-1.alt_de: Fotomontage aus grob gerasterten Schwarz-Weiß-Fotos auf vergilbtem Karton: Ein Trompeter vor roter Scheibe, schräge rote Balken und aufgeklebte Schriftstreifen, unten rechts eine Insel mit Leuchtturm.
poster/photomontage-1.alt_en: Photomontage of coarse halftone black-and-white photos on yellowed card: a trumpeter before a red disc, steep red bars and pasted type strips, a lighthouse island lower right.

problems: Seascape, sky and moon look painted/digitally coloured (saturated teal sky, glowing moon gradient) rather than a collotype photo with translucent flat tints
No medallion of the lead figure overlapping the oval
Figure in waist-up medium shot against open scenery, not a medium-long shot on a built studio set
Reads closer to a vintage travel poster than a lobby card
poster/hand-tinted-lobby-card-1.note_de: Die Meerszene wirkt eher gemalt als wie ein handkoloriertes Foto, und das Medaillon fehlt.
poster/hand-tinted-lobby-card-1.note_en: The seascape looks painted rather than like a hand-tinted photo, and the medallion is missing.
poster/hand-tinted-lobby-card-1.alt_de: Handkoloriertes Foto im Oval auf cremefarbenem Karton: Ein Trompeter mit Hut spielt am Ufer unter gelbem Mond, dahinter eine Leuchtturminsel, darunter rote Antiqua und Schreibschrift.
poster/hand-tinted-lobby-card-1.alt_en: Hand-tinted photo in an oval on cream card: a trumpeter in a hat plays on the shore under a yellow moon, a lighthouse island behind, red roman and script lettering below.

problems: Orange smoke-like wisps around the figure and the smooth rim glow on the silhouette lean toward digital glow effects
Island, rocks and water are lit fairly evenly rather than only in streaky torch patches
poster/light-painting-1.note_de: In der Unterzeile steht „FiLM“ mit kleinem i samt Punkt statt „FILM“.
poster/light-painting-1.note_en: The subline reads 'FiLM' with a lowercase dotted i instead of 'FILM'.
poster/light-painting-1.alt_de: Lichtmalerei bei Nacht: In die Luft geschriebene, leuchtende Schrift, ein Trompeter als Silhouette mit orangem Lichtumriss am Ufer, daneben Mond und eine angeleuchtete Leuchtturminsel.
poster/light-painting-1.alt_en: Light-painting night photo: glowing lettering written in the air, a trumpeter silhouetted with an orange light outline on the shore, a moon and a torch-lit lighthouse island.
text_errors: expected 'JAZZ & FILM', found 'JAZZ & FiLM' (the I is written as a lowercase i with a separate dot)

motif_missing: date '18–20 JUL 2027' is absent from the poster
problems: Required date line missing entirely; bottom area shows only sea
Scenic island-and-sea view with large sun disc is more travel-poster than an asymmetric grid of hard rectangles
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-1.note_de: Das Datum fehlt. Die Datumszeile „18–20 JUL 2027“ fehlt auf diesem Plakat vollständig.
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-1.note_en: The date is missing. The date line '18–20 JUL 2027' is missing from this poster entirely.
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-1.alt_de: Im Stil eines Jazzplattencovers in Blau, Orange und Schwarz: riesige Versalien oben, ein körniges Foto eines Trompeters am linken Rand angeschnitten, orange Sonnenscheibe über einer Leuchtturminsel.
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-1.alt_en: Jazz record sleeve style in blue, orange and black: huge condensed capitals on top, a grainy trumpeter photo cropped at the left edge, an orange sun over a lighthouse island.
text_errors: expected '18–20 JUL 2027', found nothing (the date line is missing from the poster)

problems: The red circle has a red reflection on the water below it, so it reads as a sunset disc over a sea horizon, which the style block explicitly lists as something to avoid
Detailed continuous-tone photo montage (trumpeter, rocky island, sea) feels like a contemporary retro poster rather than a 1950s-60s Swiss print with hard-cropped photos and large empty fields
Grid is only loosely implied; flush-left heavy grotesque headline at near full width is on-style
Hands and trumpet are plausible; no logo, signature or real landmark; portrait 1024x1536 correct
poster/swiss-international-typographic-s.note_de: Durch die Spiegelung im Meer wird die rote Scheibe zum Klischee-Sonnenuntergang, den der Stil eigentlich meidet.
poster/swiss-international-typographic-s.note_en: Mirrored in the sea, the red disc turns into the sunset cliché this style avoids.
poster/swiss-international-typographic-s.alt_de: Schweizer Plakat im Internationalen Stil: riesige schwarze Groteskschrift oben, darunter das Schwarzweißfoto eines Trompeters vor roter Kreisscheibe, rechts eine Felseninsel mit Leuchtturm im Meer.
poster/swiss-international-typographic-s.alt_en: Swiss-style poster: huge black grotesque headline across the top, below it a black-and-white photo of a trumpeter against a red circle, and a rocky lighthouse island at sea.

problems: The island sits in water with a horizon line and reflections, a small scene with depth the style block says to avoid (minor)
Date line looks evenly lettered, almost typeset, rather than loosely brush-painted (minor)
Strong visual metaphor: the trumpeter's black body merges into the island cliff; gouache dry-brush, grey-green ground, ochre moon, red accent all on-style
Single stylised hand on the valves is acceptable; no logo or signature; portrait correct
poster/polish-poster-school-1.alt_de: Gouache-Plakat im Stil der Polnischen Schule: Die schwarze Silhouette eines Trompeters geht in eine Felseninsel mit Leuchtturm über, darüber ein gelber Mond auf graugrünem Grund, pinselgemalte Schrift.
poster/polish-poster-school-1.alt_en: Gouache poster in the Polish School manner: the black silhouette of a trumpeter merges into a rocky island with lighthouse, a yellow moon above, brush-painted lettering on grey-green.

problems: Central vignette is a conventional sun-disc-over-horizon scene with a lighthouse island and a reflection on the water, which the style block explicitly lists as something to avoid
The vignette has spatial depth and extra tones (teal, light blue, textured shading) beyond two to four flat inks, plus a grunge texture
Composition is not symmetrical: figure on the left, scene on the right
Front hand on the valves has slightly mangled, claw-like fingers (minor)
Lettering itself is strong: swollen Wes-Wilson-style letters, orange on blue, Art Nouveau swirls, ornamental border, plainer date at the bottom
poster/psychedelic-concert-poster-1.note_de: In der Bildmitte steht eine gewöhnliche Sonnenuntergangsszene über dem Horizont statt eines Emblems, das mit der Schrift verschmilzt.
poster/psychedelic-concert-poster-1.note_en: The centre is an ordinary sunset-over-the-horizon scene rather than an emblem merged with the lettering.
poster/psychedelic-concert-poster-1.alt_de: Psychedelisches Konzertplakat in Orange auf Blau: aufgeblähte Jugendstil-Lettern rahmen einen Trompeter, dessen Gewand in Wirbel übergeht, daneben eine Leuchtturminsel vor großer Sonne.
poster/psychedelic-concert-poster-1.alt_en: Psychedelic concert poster in orange on blue: swollen Art Nouveau letters frame a trumpeter whose robe dissolves into swirls, beside a lighthouse island against a large sun.

problems: Default composition: a silhouetted trumpeter beside a sun disc setting behind a lighthouse island, with its reflection on the water. The style block explicitly says to avoid a sun disc over the horizon
No single graphic idea typical of Cuban film posters (ICAIC): no pop-art repetition, no concentric vibrating stripes, no figure-ground reversal
Speckled distressed texture leans toward digital grunge; reads as a generic modern screen-printed gig poster
On-style elements: three flat inks (orange, black, hot pink), stencil edges, slight misregistration, hand-drawn headline
Hand and trumpet acceptable as silhouette; no logo or signature; portrait correct
poster/cuban-silkscreen-film-poster-2.note_de: Statt einer grafischen Idee mit Wiederholung oder Ringen zeigt das Plakat die übliche Silhouette vor einem Sonnenuntergang über dem Meer.
poster/cuban-silkscreen-film-poster-2.note_en: Instead of one graphic idea with repetition or rings, it shows the stock silhouette against a sunset over the sea.
poster/cuban-silkscreen-film-poster-2.alt_de: Siebdruckplakat in Orange, Schwarz und Pink: schwarze Silhouette eines Trompeters, rechts eine Leuchtturminsel vor pinker Sonne, die sich im Wasser spiegelt, Farben leicht versetzt gedruckt.
poster/cuban-silkscreen-film-poster-2.alt_en: Screen-print poster in orange, black and pink: a black silhouette of a trumpeter, a lighthouse island against a pink sun reflected in the water, slightly misregistered inks.

problems: Centred title block and fairly central hero figure, though the style block says to avoid centred hero framing (minor)
Hyperreal, HDR-like rendering is slightly more modern AI-photo than 2005-2012 stock montage (minor)
Film-strip ribbons stand in for aurora ribbons; the diagonal waterline, bubbles, splashes, lens flare, glowing white humanist sans and glossy capsules are all on-style
Hands plausible; no brand marks; pale moon disc plus sun flare; portrait correct
poster/frutiger-aero-2.alt_de: Glänzendes Frutiger-Aero-Plakat in Himmelblau und Aqua: Trompeter mit Strohhut über schräger Wasserlinie, Leuchtturminsel, blasser Mond, Seifenblasen, Filmstreifen-Bänder, Lichtreflex und Schrift in Glaskapseln.
poster/frutiger-aero-2.alt_en: Glossy Frutiger Aero poster in sky blue and aqua: a trumpeter in a straw hat above a tilted waterline, lighthouse island, pale moon, bubbles, film-strip ribbons, lens flare, glass-capsule lettering.

problems: Composition contradicts the style block: a staged 3D scene with a wall/floor horizon line, cast shadows and spatial depth instead of one flat, cropped metaphor shape on a plain painted ground
Figures are naturalistically modelled period-illustration people, not the flat, witty, stylised forms of the Polish poster school; reads more as a generic mid-century gouache editorial painting
Palette (ochre, grey-green, off-white, red accent) and dry-brush gouache surface do match; the added muted-blue floral decor on the cup is outside the described palette (minor)

All motif elements present: cracked giant cup, ladder figure stitching with oversized needle and red thread, figure on rim lowering a bucket on a rope, woman at base shouldering a glue tube, shards; upper left largely empty for a headline
No anatomy errors, signature, logo or watermark found; format 1536x1024 landscape is correct
editorial/polish-poster-school-1.note_de: Statt einer flachen Plakatmetapher zeigt das Bild eine räumliche Szene mit Horizont und naturalistisch gemalten Figuren.
editorial/polish-poster-school-1.note_en: Instead of a flat poster metaphor, the image shows a staged scene with a horizon and naturalistically painted figures.
editorial/polish-poster-school-1.alt_de: Gouache in Ocker und Graugrün: Ein Mann auf der Leiter vernäht mit rotem Faden eine riesige gesprungene Porzellantasse, einer senkt vom Rand einen Eimer, eine Frau schultert eine Klebetube.
editorial/polish-poster-school-1.alt_en: Gouache in ochre and grey-green: a man on a ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup with red thread, another lowers a bucket, a woman shoulders a glue tube.

problems: Slight drift toward seamless compositing: figures, ladder, cup and shards cast consistent soft shadows on the ochre paper ground, so light and perspective are more unified than the style block asks for (minor)

Otherwise convincing: coarse halftone B/W figures, halftone porcelain with torn white fibres at the cracks, torn paper shapes in coral, cobalt and ochre cropped by the frame, sparse crayon marks, much bare off-white paper
Rope from the rim figure shows a second loose strand next to the main rope (negligible)

All motif elements present: man on ladder stitching a crack with needle and red thread, woman on the rim lowering a bucket into the cup, woman at the base with a long glue tube on her shoulder, shards around the base; upper third empty
No anatomy errors, logo, signature or watermark; format 1536x1024 landscape is correct
editorial/mixed-media-editorial-collage-.alt_de: Collage aus Rasterfotos und gerissenem Papier in Koralle, Kobalt und Ocker: Drei Schwarzweißfiguren flicken eine riesige geblümte Porzellantasse mit Nadel und rotem Faden, Eimer und Klebetube.
editorial/mixed-media-editorial-collage-.alt_en: Collage of halftone photos and torn paper in coral, cobalt and ochre: three black-and-white figures mend a giant floral porcelain teacup with needle and red thread, bucket and glue tube.

motif_missing: The lane rises toward the upper right instead of sloping down to the right, so the woman pushing the bicycle seems to head downhill rather than up the slope
problems: Style drift: the amber tint, grain, scratches and iris corners look laid over a detailed sepia illustration, not a photographed painted stage set
Windows stay upright and rectangular rather than rhomboid; buildings lean only moderately
Figures (the woman at the window, the woman with the bicycle) are rendered realistically, not pale, dark-eyed or frozen in angular poses
The corner building fills the centre-left fairly conventionally rather than as a shallow, flat stage
The ground has fine, realistic cobblestone detail rather than broad painted canvas brushwork
The pretzel sign is a slightly odd ring with an X, but it reads as a pretzel and has no lettering
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, signature, watermark or real landmark; no anatomy errors found in the hands, the dog or the bicycle
street/german-expressionist-film-2.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine getönte, detailreiche Illustration als ein Filmbild; Fenster und Figuren bleiben fast realistisch.
street/german-expressionist-film-2.note_en: Reads more like a tinted, detailed illustration than a film frame; windows and figures stay almost realistic.
street/german-expressionist-film-2.alt_de: Bernsteingetöntes Stummfilmbild mit gemalten Zackenschatten: schiefes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei und Brezelschild, Hund an der Bank, Teppich im Fenster, Wäscheleine; eine Frau schiebt ihr Rad mit Brotkorb.
street/german-expressionist-film-2.alt_en: Amber-tinted silent-film frame with painted jagged shadows: leaning corner bakery with pretzel sign, dog by a bench, rug in a window, washing line; a woman pushes her bread-laden bicycle.

motif_missing: Hand action wrong: the hand dips a bread piece into the soup instead of tearing a piece off a bread slice
problems: Wrong central action: the bread is dunked into the soup, which disturbs the soup surface, instead of being torn off a slice

Style only partly convincing: the 1970s props are there (ochre wall, stoneware jug, candle, orange-brown runner, chair) and the image has a warm cast, but the rendering is clean, crisp digital colour with no aged offset-print quality, brownish shadows or dull greens
Lighting is soft and directional rather than flat frontal flash with short hard shadows and hot glints
Modern artisan scored sourdough boule and rustic styling feel contemporary, not period
Format correct (square 1254x1254); no logos, watermark or anatomy errors; drip on rim, knife-marked butter, spoon, crumbs, napkin, basil and vine tomatoes all present
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-2.note_de: Die Hand tunkt das Brot in die Suppe, statt ein Stück von einer Scheibe abzureißen.
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-2.note_en: The hand dips bread into the soup instead of tearing a piece off a slice.
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-2.alt_de: Kochbuchfoto im Stil der 1970er, warm und orangestichig: Eine Hand tunkt Brot in Tomatensuppe, daneben angeschnittener Laib, Butter, Basilikum, Rispentomaten, Steinzeugkrug und Kerze vor ockerfarbener Wand.
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-2.alt_en: 1970s cookbook photo, warm orange cast: a hand dips bread into tomato soup beside a sliced loaf, butter, basil, vine tomatoes, stoneware jug and candle against an ochre wall.

problems: The underlying photo is a neatly arranged, magazine-style overhead food shot; the style asks for a casual one-handed snapshot with nothing arranged

Filter effects are only partly there: square format, rough black border, vignette and warm highlights are present, but blacks are not milky or lifted, and there is little JPEG blocking, colour noise or over-sharpening halo. Detail stays fairly clean

All motif elements are present: loaf with one third sliced, bread knife, crumbs, soup with cream swirl and spoon, drip on rim, knife-marked butter, basil, vine tomatoes, linen napkin, and a hand from the upper right pulling at a bread piece
Format correct (square); no anatomy errors, logos or watermark
food/early-instagram-filter-2.note_de: Der Filter liegt über einer sauber arrangierten Food-Fotografie statt über einem schnellen Handy-Schnappschuss.
food/early-instagram-filter-2.note_en: The filter sits on a neatly styled food photo rather than a quick phone snapshot.
food/early-instagram-filter-2.alt_de: Handyfoto mit Retrofilter, Vignette und schwarzem Rand: Von oben eine Schale Tomatensuppe mit Sahne, angeschnittenes Brot mit Messer, Butter, Rispentomaten, Basilikum; eine Hand zupft ein Stück Brot ab.
food/early-instagram-filter-2.alt_en: Retro-filtered phone snapshot with vignette and rough black border: from above, tomato soup with cream, a sliced loaf and knife, butter, vine tomatoes, basil; a hand tears off bread.

problems: Too much fine detail for sumi-e: heron feathers drawn stroke by stroke with dark contour edges, closer to Western ink-and-watercolour illustration than to few broad boneless strokes
Far bank is a detailed tree line with reflections and a clear water horizon, which the style block forbids (no horizon, distance as a single pale wash)
Smooth grey tonal gradations in water and mist; less bare paper than the style calls for
Heron sits near the centre rather than strongly off-centre

Motif complete: heron in side view, neck forward and down, fish in beak, droplets, both legs, ripple rings, reeds and lily pads at left, dragonfly on reed tip, far bank; anatomy OK (two legs, normal knees); correct 1536x1024 landscape; no seal, signature or watermark
animal/sumi-e-ink-wash-2.note_de: Für Sumi-e zu detailreich: fein gezeichnetes Gefieder und ein klarer Uferhorizont statt weniger Pinselzüge und leerem Papier.
animal/sumi-e-ink-wash-2.note_en: Too detailed for sumi-e: finely drawn feathers and a sharp tree-lined horizon instead of a few strokes and bare paper.
animal/sumi-e-ink-wash-2.alt_de: Tuschemalerei in Grautönen auf cremefarbenem Papier: Ein Graureiher steht im flachen Wasser und packt einen Fisch, Tropfen fallen, links Schilf mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter, hinten ein nebliges Ufer.
animal/sumi-e-ink-wash-2.alt_en: Grey ink wash on cream paper: a heron in shallow water snaps up a fish amid drops; reeds with a dragonfly and lily pads at left, misty far bank behind.

problems: No measuring-grid backdrop in any frame; a natural pond and tree line stand in for it, which removes the style's most recognisable feature

Reads as sepia-filtered digital photos (explicitly on the avoid list): smooth, slightly illustrative heron, residual colour tints (yellow beak, olive reeds, greenish lily pads) instead of brownish-black collotype
Frames are uniformly exposed; no hard sun or crisp cast shadows; margins are thin rather than wide; no extra rows with front, rear or oblique views
Strict grid of 18 equal frames (3x6) with side view and constant scale is correct and carries the motion-study idea

Motif complete across the sequence: strike with splash and rings, fish in beak with falling droplets, both legs (partly mixed with reeds), reeds and floating leaves at left, dragonfly on reed tip, far bank; no clear anatomy error found; correct 1536x1024 landscape; no logo or watermark
animal/motion-study-sequence-2.note_de: Wirkt wie getönte Digitalfotos statt wie eine Lichtdruck-Tafel; das Messraster im Hintergrund fehlt.
animal/motion-study-sequence-2.note_en: Looks like tinted digital photos rather than a collotype plate; the measuring-grid backdrop is missing.
animal/motion-study-sequence-2.alt_de: Bewegungsstudie aus 18 bräunlich getönten Fotofeldern in drei Reihen: Ein Graureiher senkt im Teich den Hals, stößt ins Wasser und hebt einen zappelnden Fisch heraus; links Schilf mit Libelle.
animal/motion-study-sequence-2.alt_en: Motion-study plate, 18 brownish photo frames in three rows: a heron lowers its neck, strikes the water and lifts out a wriggling fish; reeds with a dragonfly at left.

problems: Bottom black strip with moon-phase icon is missing entirely (required where text is forbidden)
Too clean for a cheap CMOS trail camera: only mild noise, no JPEG blocking, no motion smear on the wriggling fish or droplets
Heron is neatly framed in full side view near the centre, level horizon; reads as a composed wildlife shot rather than an accidental, tilted, edge-cropped capture
Far bank vegetation still clearly visible instead of falling to black beyond a few metres
Glowing eye-shine on a heron in side view (style reserves it for mammals facing the lamp) - minor
Strengths: monochrome IR grey, blown-out blurred grass blades glaring in the left foreground, low viewpoint

Motif complete: heron with neck forward and down, fish in beak, droplets, both legs in ripple rings, reeds and lily pads at left, dragonfly on reed tip, far bank; anatomy OK; correct 1536x1024 landscape; no logo or watermark
animal/trail-camera-capture-2.note_de: Für eine Wildkamera zu sauber und zu ordentlich gerahmt; der untere Streifen mit Mondphasen-Symbol fehlt.
animal/trail-camera-capture-2.note_en: Too clean and neatly framed for a trail camera, and the bottom strip with the moon-phase icon is missing.
animal/trail-camera-capture-2.alt_de: Graues Infrarot-Nachtbild einer Wildkamera: Ein Graureiher mit leuchtendem Auge hält im dunklen Wasser einen Fisch im Schnabel, Tropfen und Wasserringe, links grell angeblitztes Schilf mit Libelle.
animal/trail-camera-capture-2.alt_en: Grey infrared night shot from a trail camera: a heron with glowing eye holds a fish in dark water amid drops and ripples; flash-bleached reeds with a dragonfly at left.

motif_missing: glance back over the shoulder toward the viewer (head and eyes face the door)
problems: Badger looks toward the door, not back at the viewer

Composition reads as a vintage postcard or children's-book scene (door, wall, raised step, pavement slabs, shrub) rather than a lotería emblem: one figure on a flat background with at most a wall edge
Fine fur hatching and detailed shading look more like 1930s storybook engraving than a coarse lotería key drawing; slight off-register only
Format correct (portrait 1024x1536); white margin and black frame line present, bottom correctly left bare; no logos or marks
character/loteria-card-2.note_de: Der Dachs blickt nicht zum Betrachter zurück, und Tür, Stufe und Busch machen die Karte szenischer als ein Lotería-Emblem.
character/loteria-card-2.note_en: The badger does not glance back at the viewer, and the door, step and shrub make the card more of a scene than a lotería emblem.
character/loteria-card-2.alt_de: Lotería-Karte in kräftigen Druckfarben mit schwarzer Schraffur auf vergilbtem Karton: Ein Dachs mit blauer Mütze, rotem Schal und Ledertasche klopft an eine rote Tür, ein Paket im Arm.
character/loteria-card-2.alt_en: Lotería card, bright printed inks and black hatching on yellowed card: a badger in blue cap, red scarf and leather satchel knocks on a red door, holding a parcel.

motif_missing: glance back over the shoulder toward the viewer (pie-cut eyes look at the door)
problems: Badger looks at the door, not back toward the viewer
Figure has hatched fur on tail and legs and grey knit/quilt textures on scarf and vest instead of flat opaque black-and-white cel fills
Background is a detailed, almost photographic grey village (thatched cottage, half-timbering, ivy) rather than a sparse inked setting
Thick furry arms, not smooth jointless rubber-hose limbs; sepia tint instead of neutral black and white
Period cues present: pie-cut eyes, big round shoes, mitten paws, sweat drops, grain, scratches, vignetting, oval shadow; format correct, no marks
character/rubber-hose-cartoon-2.note_de: Der Dachs blickt nicht zum Betrachter zurück; Fellstruktur und detailreicher Dorfhintergrund passen nicht zum flachen Zeichentrick um 1930.
character/rubber-hose-cartoon-2.note_en: The badger does not glance back at the viewer, and the fur textures and detailed village background stray from flat 1930 cel animation.
character/rubber-hose-cartoon-2.alt_de: Schwarzweißes Zeichentrickbild um 1930 mit Filmkorn und Kratzern: Ein Dachs mit großen runden Schuhen, Strickschal und Posttasche klopft schwitzend an eine Holztür, dahinter ein Dorf.
character/rubber-hose-cartoon-2.alt_en: Black-and-white 1930s cartoon frame with film grain and scratches: a badger with pie-cut eyes, big round shoes, scarf and satchel knocks on a wooden door, sweat drops flying, village behind.

motif_missing: glance back over the shoulder toward the viewer (head turned to the door)
problems: Badger faces the door; no clear backward glance toward the viewer
Space is deep and perspectival (receding lane, village, stepped doorstep) instead of flat, tilted and frieze-like; figure is near the centre
Cosy autumn village mood and uniform digital grain read as contemporary retro illustration rather than a 1960s Eastern Bloc offset page; no visible plate misregistration
Fitting cues: earthy ochre/olive/slate palette with vermilion scarf, dry-brush and stamp textures, cheek spots, scarf and fur as ornamental stroke rows
Format correct; no logos or marks
character/eastern-european-picture-book-.note_de: Der Dachs blickt nicht zum Betrachter zurück, und der tiefe, gemütliche Dorfraum wirkt eher wie modernes Retro als wie ein flacher Bilderbuchfries der 1960er.
character/eastern-european-picture-book-.note_en: The badger does not glance back at the viewer, and the deep, cosy village scene reads as modern retro rather than a flat 1960s picture-book frieze.
character/eastern-european-picture-book-.alt_de: Gouache mit Schwamm- und Trockenpinselstruktur in Ocker, Oliv und Schiefergrau: Ein Dachs mit roten Wangenpunkten, Mütze, rotem Schal und Ledertasche klopft an eine blaugraue Tür, dahinter ein Herbstdorf.
character/eastern-european-picture-book-.alt_en: Gouache with sponge and dry-brush texture in ochre, olive and slate grey: a badger with red cheek spots, cap, scarf and satchel knocks on a blue-grey door, autumn village behind.

problems: Costume inconsistency: the parcel-holding arm wears a cream knitted sleeve while the knocking arm is bare fur
Head still faces the door; the backward glance is carried only by the eyes turning sideways

Style faithfully shows the generic AI look: glossy big-eyed character, subsurface fur, golden key and rim light, warm/teal palette, creamy bokeh village; background church spire is generic, not a real landmark
Format correct (portrait); no logos or marks
character/generic-3d-animated-feature-1.note_de: Nur ein Arm trägt einen Strickärmel, der andere ist nacktes Fell.
character/generic-3d-animated-feature-1.note_en: Only one arm has a knitted sleeve; the other is bare fur.
character/generic-3d-animated-feature-1.alt_de: Glänzender 3D-Animationslook im goldenen Abendlicht: Ein Dachs mit großen Kulleraugen, Mütze, Strickschal und Ledertasche klopft an eine Holztür, ein Paket im Arm, dahinter ein verschwommenes Dorf.
character/generic-3d-animated-feature-1.alt_en: Glossy 3D animated-film look in golden evening light: a big-eyed badger in cap, knitted scarf and leather satchel knocks on a wooden door, parcel in arm, a blurred village behind.

problems: Compass rose is a plain Western nautical star, out of period for the style but required by the motif
Labels look like a typeset serif font, not brushed letters
Little visible wear of the gold at the panel folds; no tiny figures
map/momoyama-gold-cloud-screen-2.alt_de: Vierteiliger Goldgrund-Stellschirm im Momoyama-Stil: Die sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Hafenstadt, drei Booten, Windmühle, Leuchtturm, Fluss und Wald liegt in azurblauem Meer zwischen flachen Goldwolken, daneben ein Seedrache.
map/momoyama-gold-cloud-screen-2.alt_en: Four-panel Momoyama gold-leaf screen: crescent island Lornholm with harbour town, three boats, windmill, lighthouse, river and forest in azurite-blue sea between flat gold clouds; a sea dragon swims nearby.

problems: Land fully washed in green and yellow, although the style block calls for no wash, only thin coastal colour bands
Forest and cliffs painted as dense, painterly 3D-shaded illustration instead of small burin-cut tree and molehill symbols, which drifts toward the generic fantasy-map look
Tan paper with heavy foxing and a four-way fold reads as artificially aged parchment (the style block lists this under avoid) rather than laid paper with a single centre fold
Compass rose has 16 points instead of 32; cartouche is baroque scrollwork, not strapwork
map/antique-engraved-map-1.note_de: Die Karte driftet zum Fantasy-Look: Das Land ist flächig koloriert und malerisch statt gestochen, das Papier wirkt künstlich gealtert. Alle Beschriftungen sind korrekt, aber in der Gradskala am Rand stehen winzige erfundene Pseudo-Ziffern.
map/antique-engraved-map-1.note_en: It drifts toward a fantasy-map look: the land is fully washed and painterly rather than engraved, on artificially aged paper. All labels are spelled correctly, but the degree scale around the border is filled with tiny invented pseudo-numerals.
map/antique-engraved-map-1.alt_de: Handkolorierte Kupferstichkarte auf vergilbtem Papier: Die sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Hafenstadt, drei Segelschiffen, Windmühlenhügel, Leuchtturm und Wald; im Meer ein Seeungeheuer, dazu Zierkartusche, Lilien-Windrose und Maßstab mit Zirkel.
map/antique-engraved-map-1.alt_en: Hand-coloured copperplate map on aged paper: crescent island Lornholm with harbour town, three ships, windmill hill, lighthouse and forest; sea monster, scrolled cartouche, fleur-de-lis compass and scale with dividers.
text_errors: expected only the allowed labels, found invented pseudo-numerals at every division of the degree-scale border

extra: Tiny illegible pseudo-numerals/glyph pairs (about 4-6 px high) at each division of the ruled degree-scale border on all four sides, e.g. '3|0', '5|6', '2|0'-like marks along the bottom and top, stacked unreadable glyphs along the left and right edges, and a garbled 'G.' / 'm' cluster in the bottom-right corner box

problems: The house vignette is a small scene with shrubs, steps, a path and a ground line, while the pin, gear, calendar and envelope are simple glyphs, so the level of detail is uneven across the set (the motif asks for the same detail and construction logic).
Vignette fields have a pinkish tint from the dense ruling rather than reading as white paper (minor).

Otherwise convincing: single carmine ink, burin hatching and stipple, horizontal-ruled vignettes, ornamental frames with corner rosettes, a 3x3 sheetlet split by perforation rows with torn teeth on the outer edge. No text, postmarks, country names or emblems. Square 1254x1254 matches 1024x1024.
icons/engraved-postage-stamp-2.note_de: Das Haus ist mit Büschen und Weg als kleine Landschaft gezeichnet und damit detaillierter als die übrigen, schlichteren Icons.
icons/engraved-postage-stamp-2.note_en: The house is drawn as a little scene with bushes and a path, more detailed than the plainer other icons.
icons/engraved-postage-stamp-2.alt_de: Stichtiefdruck in Karminrot: Neun gezähnte Briefmarken mit Ornamentrahmen und Eckrosetten zeigen Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Kartennadel, Zahnrad und Herz in feiner Schraffur.
icons/engraved-postage-stamp-2.alt_en: Carmine line-engraved stamp sheetlet: nine perforated stamps with ornate frames and corner rosettes show house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, map pin, gear and heart in fine hatching.

problems: Drifts toward a generic flat tile icon set (Metro style): the signs are not consistently built from bars of one width, circles and quarter circles. The teardrop map pin has free curved sides, the envelope is cut with thin lines of another width, and the camera and house are solid blocks.
The colour fields are not identical squares (about 374x365 px, middle column about 361 px wide), so the single square construction grid is not held exactly.

Palette (light blue, mid blue, green, orange, grey, white), flat ink without outlines and the gap-split bell are on style. All nine icons are present in the right order. No logos. Square format is correct.
icons/ulm-systematic-design-2.note_de: Die Zeichen wirken wie ein gängiges flaches Kachel-Icon-Set; Kartennadel und Brief folgen nicht dem strengen Raster aus gleich breiten Balken und Kreisen.
icons/ulm-systematic-design-2.note_en: The signs read like a common flat tile icon set; the map pin and envelope ignore the strict grid of equal bars and circles.
icons/ulm-systematic-design-2.alt_de: Flache Piktogramme im Ulmer Stil: Neun weiße Zeichen auf blauen, grünen, orangen und grauen Quadratfeldern – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Kartennadel, Zahnrad, Herz.
icons/ulm-systematic-design-2.alt_en: Flat Ulm-style pictograms: nine white signs on blue, green, orange and grey square fields – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, map pin, gear, heart.

problems: Minor: the paper, map and leather surfaces share a slightly uniform crinkled AI texture.
The calendar page is blank with no date grid, but it is still clearly a tear-off calendar page.

The camera suggests a retro rangefinder but has no brand mark or text. The airmail envelope has no lettering. The map shows no real place. Tiles on grey linen share shape, bevel and downward shadow. Square format is correct.
icons/skeuomorphic-interface-art-2.alt_de: Skeuomorphe App-Kacheln auf grauem Leinen: Haus auf Holz, Luftpostbrief, Lupe auf Filz, Messingglocke auf genähtem Leder, Abreißkalender, Metallkamera, Kartennadel auf Stadtplan, Stahlzahnrad, rotes Herz.
icons/skeuomorphic-interface-art-2.alt_en: Skeuomorphic tiles on grey linen: house on wood, airmail envelope, magnifier on felt, brass bell on stitched leather, tear-off calendar, metal camera, pin on map, steel gear, red heart.

problems: Minor: the magnifier lens is slightly translucent and several objects repeat red (roof, calendar header, pin, heart), so not every object has its own hue. Otherwise this is the typical inflated glossy candy-plastic render on a pastel gradient with soft shadows. All nine icons are present in order. No logos. Square format is correct.
icons/glossy-3d-icon-1.alt_de: Glänzende 3D-Icons aus aufgeblasen wirkendem Kunststoff in Bonbonfarben auf Pastellverlauf: Haus, gelber Brief, blaue Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, lila Kamera, rote Kartennadel, grünes Zahnrad, Herz.
icons/glossy-3d-icon-1.alt_en: Glossy 3D icons in inflated candy-coloured plastic on a pastel gradient: house, yellow envelope, blue magnifier, bell, calendar, purple camera, red map pin, green gear, heart.

motif_missing: Month labels 'AUG' and 'SEP' are only half visible: their lower parts are covered by white smudges
SEP bar is about 8% too short (128 px vs. ~139 px expected from JUL = 30); JUL/SEP ratio is about 5.4 instead of 5
problems: Obvious erasure artifacts: white smears across the bottom label band cut off AUG and SEP and wipe out the lower right part of the double-rule frame, both outer and inner lines
Frame is incomplete at the bottom right, and the label strip's border is missing there
Bar proportions measured from the baseline (y≈896): JUN 275, JUL 696, AUG 555, SEP 128. JUN and AUG are within 1%, SEP is about 8% short
Grid is coarse with unevenly spaced columns rather than a fine hairline grid; month labels are upright roman capitals, not italic
Wash texture is fairly even and stays inside the outlines (no overrun), which leans slightly digital
Format is correct (1536x1024 landscape); no logo, signature or watermark
chart/19th-century-statistical-plate-2.note_de: Die Monatsnamen AUG und SEP sind von weißen Schlieren halb verdeckt, und unten rechts fehlt ein Stück des Rahmens. Die Monatsnamen AUG und SEP sind von hellen Schmierstellen halb abgeschnitten und kaum lesbar; Zahlen und Balkenhöhen stimmen.
chart/19th-century-statistical-plate-2.note_en: White smudges half-cover the month labels AUG and SEP and erase part of the frame at the bottom right. The month labels AUG and SEP are cut off halfway by pale smears and are barely readable; the numbers and bar heights are correct.
chart/19th-century-statistical-plate-2.alt_de: Handkolorierte Statistiktafel auf vergilbtem Papier mit Stockflecken: vier aquarellierte Säulen in Ocker, Rosa, Taubenblau und Salbeigrün mit 12, 30, 24 und 6 unter dem Titel LORNHOLM 2026, im Doppelrahmen.
chart/19th-century-statistical-plate-2.alt_en: Hand-coloured statistical plate on foxed cream paper: four watercolour bars in ochre, rose, slate blue and sage labelled 12, 30, 24, 6 under the title LORNHOLM 2026, inside a double-rule frame.
text_errors: expected 'AUG', found only the top half of the letters (reads like 'AUC'); the lower half is erased by a pale grey smear
expected 'SEP', found only the top half of the letters; the lower half is covered by a pinkish-white smear
expected 'JUN' and 'JUL', found the J's ball terminal detached as a separate dot left of the stem (reads '.JUN', '.JUL'); minor

motif_missing: two-burner stove: shown as a full-width cooker with a four-burner grate and six control knobs
problems: Stove has the wrong burner count (four-burner range, six knobs) instead of the two-burner stove the motif specifies, which matters because this motif tests object counts
Duplicated object: two complete bridge mixer taps side by side over a single Belfast sink

Style drift toward the cosy AI default: warm golden glow, styled flowers and a bowl of apples, and a foreground table vignette that acts as a hero subject. The style asks for no single subject, objects left as found, and no soft golden light
Room reads as fairly spacious (two doors, a hallway area with a runner) rather than small
Tiny illegible wordmark on the radio grille; it is not identifiable as a brand, but noted

HDR traits are well handled: pasted cartoon-blue sky with halos on the window frame, all lamps on beside daylight, oversaturation, crunchy microcontrast on wood, a cool cast at the glazed door, a strip of lit ceiling, a wide diagonal corner view. Format is correct (1536x1024 landscape), no people, no watermark
interior/real-estate-hdr-2.note_de: Der Herd hat vier statt zwei Kochstellen, und über der Spüle sitzen zwei Wasserhähne.
interior/real-estate-hdr-2.note_en: The stove has four burners instead of two, and there are two taps over the sink.
interior/real-estate-hdr-2.alt_de: Maklerfoto in überdrehtem HDR: Landhausküche mit Kräutern am Fenster, halbfertigem Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Holztisch, Zeitung auf grünem Stuhl, draußen knallblauer Himmel.
interior/real-estate-hdr-2.alt_en: Real-estate photo in overcooked HDR: cottage kitchen with herbs on the sill, half-done jigsaw, teapot and cup on the wooden table, newspaper on a green chair, cartoon-blue sky outside.

motif_missing: Leaf count wrong: about five leaves instead of four (three large leaves, plus a small extra leaf under the blossom and another partly hidden behind the fruit stalk)
problems: The branch carries more leaves than the four the motif specifies
The intact fruit's surface has a wormy, digital-looking texture instead of clear engraved hatching or stipple; the washes on the fruit and leaves are rather dense and opaque
There is no sunken plate mark, which the style block asks for

Otherwise correct: five-petalled blossom, closed bud, curled leaf, leaf with an insect-bite notch, lumpy fruit, lengthwise section with core and seeds, single seed and detached petal on empty cream paper; diagonal branch; no lettering, signature or watermark; upright 1024x1536 as requested
botanical/hand-colored-engraved-plate-2.note_de: Der Zweig trägt mehr als die vorgegebenen vier Blätter.
botanical/hand-colored-engraved-plate-2.note_en: The branch carries more than the specified four leaves.
botanical/hand-colored-engraved-plate-2.alt_de: Handkolorierter Kupferstich, feine Schraffur unter Aquarelllasur: Quittenzweig mit rosa Blüte, Knospe, angefressenem Blatt und gelber Frucht; darunter halbierte Quitte mit Kernen, ein Samen, ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/hand-colored-engraved-plate-2.alt_en: Hand-coloured engraving, fine hatching under watercolour washes: a quince branch with pink blossom, bud, bitten leaf and yellow fruit; below, a halved quince with seeds, one seed, one petal.

problems: The intact quince looks like a translucent 3D surface render with relief shading; its core cavity and seeds are not superimposed, although the style block asks for inside and outside to show together
The seeds in the section and the single seed have glossy, highlight-like 3D shading rather than flat density values
The border is a thin grey frame with rounded corners, not a clear surround of pale unexposed film

Leaves and blossom read convincingly as a radiograph: translucent veins, bright stamens and fine grain. All motif elements are present: four leaves (one curled, one with insect holes), a five-petalled blossom, a bud, a lumpy fruit, the section with core and seeds, one seed and one petal. There are no markers, logos or signature, and the format is upright 1024x1536 as requested
botanical/x-ray-radiograph-1.note_de: Die ganze Quitte wirkt wie eine Oberflächenansicht, Kerngehäuse und Samen scheinen nicht durch.
botanical/x-ray-radiograph-1.note_en: The whole quince looks like a surface view; its core and seeds do not show through as they would in a real X-ray.
botanical/x-ray-radiograph-1.alt_de: Röntgenaufnahme, hell auf schwarzem Film, Blattadern durchscheinend: Quittenzweig mit Blüte, Knospe, durchlöchertem Blatt und Frucht, darunter eine halbierte Quitte mit Kernen, ein Samen und ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/x-ray-radiograph-1.alt_en: Radiograph, pale on black film with translucent leaf veins: a quince branch with blossom, bud, insect-holed leaf and fruit; below, a halved quince with seeds, one seed, one petal.

problems: Lantern cues are there (black paper mask, round openings, taped corners, white thumb spot, white serif lettering), but the window contents are crisp, detailed, nearly full-colour photos (golden wheat, blue sky, orange fire glow) instead of a soft grey scale with two or three flat overrunning tints
Dramatic firelight in the oven window, which the style block lists under avoid
Windows sit in a 2x3 grid, not along one ring; arrows only link 1-2, 3-4 and 5-6, so the order between rows depends on the numbers alone (still unambiguous)
Labels are mixed-case serif, not capitals
Drifts toward a generic AI vintage-photo collage
Format is correct (portrait 1024x1536); hands look fine; no logos or maker's names
infographic/magic-lantern-slide-2.note_de: Die Fotos sind zu scharf und fast vollfarbig statt grau mit wenigen flachen Tönungen.
infographic/magic-lantern-slide-2.note_en: The photos are too crisp and almost full-colour instead of grey with a few flat tints.
infographic/magic-lantern-slide-2.alt_de: Handkolorierte Laterna-magica-Platte: schwarze Maske mit sechs runden Fenstern, darin Fotos vom Säen, von Ähren mit Sichel, Mühlstein mit Mehlsack, Kneten, Teigschüssel unter Tuch und Brot im Ofen.
infographic/magic-lantern-slide-2.alt_en: Hand-tinted magic lantern slide: black mask with six round windows showing photos of sowing, wheat and sickle, a millstone filling a flour sack, kneading, a covered dough bowl and a loaf baking.

problems: Convincing side-section housing with stacked chambers, chutes, a belt and pipes, circled numerals, a banner, a soil strip, halftone on yellowed paper

Scale breaks: the step-4 kneader is shown as large close-up arms, with the head hidden by the ceiling above, so figures are not all one size and close-up hands appear (both against the style block, but the motif requires the hands)
Slight three-quarter perspective on the millstone, bowl and oven
Labels are mixed-case on tabs without leader lines, not capitals
Step 1 shows a whole farmer scattering seed from a bag rather than just a hand (acceptable)
Format is correct; no logos or signature found
infographic/retro-popular-science-cutawa.alt_de: Populärwissenschaftlicher Schnitt wie aus alten Magazinen: ein Haus mit sechs Kammern, verbunden durch Rutschen und Rohre, zeigt Säen, Ernten, Mahlen, Kneten, Gehenlassen und Backen über einer Erdschicht.
infographic/retro-popular-science-cutawa.alt_en: Retro magazine cutaway: a building in section with six chambers linked by chutes and pipes, showing sowing, sickle harvest, milling, kneading, rising dough and baking above a soil strip.

problems: The film-print look is present: pink-magenta cast, grain, dust and faint scratches, a dark title card, circled numerals, a dashed arrow path zigzagging downward
The pictures are modelled and shaded with gradients, and the millstone, bowl and oven are in three-quarter perspective, instead of flat dark-outlined poster-colour shapes in side or top view
Furrowed soil is drawn as a perspective field, not a ridged brown strip
Labels are mixed-case, not capitals
Reads as a generic modern illustrated infographic with a film filter on top
Hands are anatomically fine; format is correct; no logos
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.note_de: Die Bildelemente sind schattiert und perspektivisch statt flach gemalt wie auf einer Lehrfilm-Tafel.
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.note_en: The pictures are shaded and drawn in perspective rather than in flat poster colours as on a classroom-film card.
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.alt_de: Rosastichiges Lehrfilm-Standbild einer gemalten Schautafel: Hand streut Saat, Ähren mit Sichel, Mühlstein mit Mehlsack, knetende Hände, Teig unter Tuch und Brot im Ofen, verbunden durch gestrichelte Pfeile.
infographic/mid-century-educational-film.alt_en: Pink-tinged 1950s classroom-film frame of a painted chart: a hand sowing seed, wheat and sickle, millstone and flour sack, kneading hands, covered dough and a loaf in an oven, linked by dashed arrows.

problems: Strong Warli cues: white on red-brown ground, faceless triangle-body figures, forked trees, birds, a wavy river band with fish, a dotted winding path with numbered scenes
The lettering is an even, font-like mixed-case hand, not rough stick-painted capitals (the style block says to avoid typefaces)
The millstone is a hatched cylinder in three-quarter view and the step-5 bowl is in perspective, against the style block's no-depth and no-stippled-tone rules
Strokes are fairly clean and regular, with little wavering
Steps 1, 4 and 6 show whole figures rather than isolated hands, which is acceptable in this style
Format is correct; no logos
infographic/warli-painting-2.note_de: Die Schrift wirkt wie gesetzt, und Mühlstein und Schüssel sind räumlich schraffiert.
infographic/warli-painting-2.note_en: The lettering looks like a typeface, and the millstone and bowl are hatched in perspective.
infographic/warli-painting-2.alt_de: Warli-Malerei in Weiß auf rotbraunem Lehm: Dreiecksfiguren säen, mähen mit der Sichel, drehen den Mühlstein, kneten und schieben Brot in den Ofen, verbunden durch einen gepunkteten Pfad über Fischwasser.
infographic/warli-painting-2.alt_en: Warli painting in white on red-brown mud: triangle figures sow, cut wheat, turn a millstone, knead and slide bread into an oven, linked by a dotted winding path above a river with fish.

problems: The loaf in the oven is rendered like real bread (glossy, crackled crust) with an orange glow, against the style's no-real-food and no-golden-light rules
The dough and its flour dusting also look close to real food
The clay is smooth and clean, close to CG clay: few fingerprints or tool scores, and soft lighting without small hard shadows
The hands have detailed fingers, not mitten hands (anatomy itself is fine)
Uses a clay-relief board with symbol tiles, clay-snake title letters and a painted-flat backdrop with clay trees and houses, all as the style block describes
Arrows only link steps within a row; the order still follows from the numbers
Format is correct; no logos or famous characters
infographic/clay-animation-3.note_de: Das Brot im Ofen sieht aus wie echtes Brot, nicht wie Knete.
infographic/clay-animation-3.note_en: The loaf in the oven looks like real bread, not modelling clay.
infographic/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Knetrelief auf einer Tafel: Titel aus Knetwürsten, sechs Kacheln mit säender Knethand, Ähren und Sichel, Mühlstein mit Mehlsack, knetenden Händen, Teigschüssel unter Tuch und Brot im Ofen.
infographic/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay relief board: title in rolled clay letters, six tiles showing a clay hand sowing, wheat and sickle, millstone with flour sack, kneading hands, covered dough bowl and a loaf in an oven.

problems: Composition is a Western perspective landscape: deep receding river, horizon, sky with mountains, smaller-with-distance - the style block forbids landscape depth and demands stacked registers on plain whitewash
Buildings (chapel, houses) shown in three-quarter view with visible side walls, explicitly to be avoided
No ruled ground lines or registers; reads as Minoan/Pompeian fresco or modern tile mural rather than Theban tomb painting
Correct surface cues only: Egyptian blue/ochre on cracked plaster, red-brown outlines, zigzag water, papyrus, profile figure on bridge, flying ducks
All motif elements present (bridge with one figure, ~4-5 houses plus chapel, terraces left, trees right, leaning tree with bench, mountains, birds); no logos or signatures
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Statt flacher Register zeigt das Bild eine Perspektivlandschaft mit Tiefe, Himmel und Schrägansichten – eher Fresko als ägyptische Grabmalerei.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Instead of flat registers it shows a perspective landscape with depth, sky and three-quarter buildings, more fresco than Egyptian tomb painting.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Wandmalerei in Blau und Ocker auf rissigem Putz: Ein Fluss mit Wellenlinien windet sich zu blauen Bergen, ein Mann quert die Brücke, vorn Baum und Bank, rechts ein Dorf.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Wall painting in blue and ochre on cracked plaster: a wavy-lined river winds toward blue mountains; a man crosses the bridge, with tree, bench and village beside.

problems: Looks like a desaturated, finely detailed digital painting, not a hand-tinted glass positive
No black paper mask with round or arched opening, no tape, no white thumb spot - only a dark rounded-corner frame like a 35mm/old print border
Colour is continuous and modelled rather than two or three flat see-through tints overrunning zones
Crisp distant detail in mountains and village, explicitly to be avoided; dust/scratches barely present
Village has about 7 houses plus chapel (slightly more than five or six) - minor
All central motif elements present: winding river, single-arch bridge with one figure, terraces left, forest right, leaning tree with bench, jagged ridge, birds
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-2.note_de: Wirkt wie ein entsättigtes, fein detailliertes Gemälde; runde Maskenöffnung, flache Lasurtöne und weiches Glasbild fehlen.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-2.note_en: Looks like a desaturated, finely detailed painting; the round mask opening, flat see-through tints and soft glass image are missing.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-2.alt_de: Blass getönte Landschaft mit dunklem, abgerundetem Rand: Ein Fluss zieht unter einer Steinbrücke hindurch zu schroffen Bergen, links Baum und Bank über Terrassen, rechts Dorf mit Kirchturm.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-2.alt_en: Faintly tinted landscape in a dark round-cornered frame: a river runs under a stone bridge toward jagged peaks, tree and bench above terraces, a village with church opposite.

problems: Drifts toward a contemporary retro travel-poster illustration: many receding hill layers with atmospheric haze, which the style block forbids
Reflections in the water and busy clumped foliage on tree and slopes, both listed under 'avoid'
Scenic view rather than a geometric construction with one enormous form before an empty gradient field
Good cues: airbrush spray grain, ochre/blue/vermilion/black palette, faceted mountains, cone trees, white cube houses
All motif elements present: bridge with one small figure, ~4-5 houses plus chapel, terraces left, conifer forest right, large tree with bench, peaks, birds
landscape/art-deco-poster-2.note_de: Eher modernes Retro-Reiseplakat: gestaffelte Dunstschichten, Spiegelungen im Wasser und kleinteiliges Laub statt strenger geometrischer Konstruktion.
landscape/art-deco-poster-2.note_en: Leans toward a modern retro travel poster: hazy receding layers, water reflections and busy foliage instead of strict geometric construction.
landscape/art-deco-poster-2.alt_de: Art-déco-Plakat mit Spritzkorn in Ocker, Blau und Zinnober: Ein mächtiger Baum mit Bank rahmt das Flusstal mit Bogenbrücke, weißem Dorf mit Kirchturm und gezackten Bergen.
landscape/art-deco-poster-2.alt_en: Art Deco poster with airbrush grain in ochre, blue and vermilion: a huge tree and bench frame a river valley with arched bridge, white steepled village and jagged peaks.

problems: Reads as clean digital monochrome with an added grain layer: shadows remain fully detailed, smooth midtones, near-HDR clarity in rocks and foliage
No tilted handheld horizon, no motion blur or camera shake; calm, composed scenic framing with a dramatic cloudy sky
Village has roughly 7-8 houses plus chapel, plus extra houses on the left slope - more than the five or six requested (minor)
All central motif elements present: winding river, single-arch bridge with one figure, terraces left, forest right, leaning old tree with bench, jagged peaks, birds

Looks like the generic AI landscape default rather than 1970s American New Color large-format work
No figure on the bridge (allowed, 'at most one'); all other motif elements present: bridge, ~5 houses plus chapel, terraces left, forest right, leaning tree with bench, birds, ridge

Bridge arch drawn as a smooth curve with masonry lines and the winding riverbanks are curvy - the style block asks for angled polylines and no curves

Houses drawn with hidden lines removed instead of see-through wireframes with back edges
Good cues: thin glowing pale-green strokes on black, bloom, cone trees, box houses with prism roofs, chevron birds, dashed water, stick figure on bridge
All motif elements present: river, bridge with one figure, 5 houses plus chapel, terraces left, forest right, leaning tree with bench, jagged ridge, birds
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-2.note_de: Eher nachgezeichnete Szene als einzelne Modelle: geschwungener Brückenbogen, Flussufer und dichtes Baumnetz sprengen die schlichte Vektorgrafik.
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-2.note_en: Reads as a traced scene rather than separate models: the curved arch, winding banks and dense tree mesh exceed simple vector graphics.
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-2.alt_de: Leuchtend grüne Vektorlinien auf Schwarz: Ein Baum aus Polygonnetz über einer Bank, gewundener Fluss mit Bogenbrücke und Strichmännchen, Kegelbäume, Kastenhäuser mit Kirchturm, gezackte Bergkette.
landscape/vector-display-wireframe-2.alt_en: Glowing green vector lines on black: a polygon-mesh tree over a bench, a winding river with arched bridge and stick figure, cone trees, box houses with steeple, jagged ridge.

motif_missing: Village has only four houses (plus chapel) instead of five or six
problems: Strong drift toward the generic AI 'CG clay diorama' look: smooth, glossy, evenly rendered surfaces, no fingerprints, lint or tool marks beyond stamped grass texture
Deep naturalistic vista with atmospheric haze on the distant ranges, instead of a shallow tabletop stage with a nearby painted backdrop; no set edges visible
Water is rendered semi-naturalistically with foam and whitecaps rather than flat clay with pressed ripples

landscape/clay-animation-3.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine glatte Computer-Knetminiatur mit tiefer, dunstiger Fernsicht als wie eine flache Trickfilmkulisse; zudem hat das Dorf nur vier Häuser.
landscape/clay-animation-3.note_en: Looks more like a polished computer-rendered clay miniature with a deep, hazy vista than a shallow stop-motion set, and the village has only four houses.
landscape/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Landschaft aus Knetmasse: Unter einem alten Baum mit Kugelkrone steht eine Bank; ein Fluss fließt unter einer Steinbrücke hindurch an Dorf und Kapelle vorbei, dahinter Terrassenfelder, Wald und Berggipfel.
landscape/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay diorama: a bench sits under an old tree with ball-shaped foliage; a river flows beneath a stone bridge past a village and chapel, with terraced fields, forest and peaks beyond.

problems: Knob rims hatched like cylinders and a narrow side strip on the left edge of the body hint at slight depth; the style asks for strictly flat side views

product/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf rissigem, abblätterndem Kalkputz: ein blaues Kofferradio in flacher Seitenansicht mit rotbraunen Umrisslinien, ockerfarbenem Lautsprechergitter, Senderscheibe, zwei Knöpfen und grüner Antenne auf einer Standlinie.
product/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on flaking plaster: a blue portable radio in flat side view, red-brown outlines, ochre grille, tuning dial, two knobs, green antenna, standing on a ground line.

problems: Reads as a modern AI product render placed in front of a painted backdrop rather than a 1940s Technicolor frame
Backdrop, flowers and urn are thrown out of focus (depth-of-field blur), contrary to 'everything sharp'
Glossy marble tabletop with a mirror reflection of the radio; style explicitly avoids glossy reflections and asks for shiny surfaces dulled
Brushed-metal knobs with radial machining and fine micro-detail (HDR product-shot look)
Close three-quarter hero product framing instead of a static eye-level medium-long shot of a shallow sound-stage set; warm directional light rather than flat frontal arc light
Red flowers add a second ruby accent next to the ruby radio
Motif itself complete: grille left half, dial above tick-only window, two knobs, top handle, angled partly extended antenna; square format correct; no logos
product/three-strip-technicolor-2.note_de: Wirkt wie ein modernes Produktfoto vor gemalter Kulisse: unscharfer Hintergrund, spiegelnder Marmor, gebürstetes Metall.
product/three-strip-technicolor-2.note_en: Looks like a modern product shot in front of a painted backdrop: blurred background, glossy marble, brushed metal.
product/three-strip-technicolor-2.alt_de: Kinobild im Technicolor-Stil: ein rubinrotes Kofferradio mit cremefarbener Front und Messingknöpfen auf glänzendem Marmor, dahinter eine gemalte Meereskulisse mit Felsen, Zypresse und roten Blumen in einer Steinurne.
product/three-strip-technicolor-2.alt_en: Technicolor-style still: ruby-red portable radio with cream front and brass knobs on glossy marble, before a painted sea backdrop with cliffs, cypress and red flowers in an urn.

problems: Grain is present but fine to moderate, not the coarse gritty push-processed Tri-X grain; radio surfaces stay finely detailed
Rich midtones on the radio front and detailed shadows instead of hard contrast with blocked shadows
Shallow depth of field: window, chair and foreground cloth/table edge are blurred, contrary to 'deep focus' and 'avoid creamy bokeh'
Composition partly fits (off-centre subject, low tilted handheld angle, cloth cut by frame edge, blown-out window), but it reads as a moody still life rather than reportage
Tiny printed symbols above the two knobs (not text, acceptable)
Motif complete: grille left half, large dial above tick-only window, two knobs, handle on top, angled partly extended antenna; radio whole; square format correct; no logos
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.note_de: Zu sauber für gepushten Tri-X: feines Korn, viele Mitteltöne und unscharfer Hintergrund statt durchgehender Schärfe.
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.note_en: Too clean for push-processed Tri-X: fine grain, rich midtones and a blurred background instead of deep focus.
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.alt_de: Körniges Schwarzweißfoto aus Untersicht: ein abgenutztes Kofferradio mit Lochgitter, großem Drehknopf, Skala und zwei Knöpfen auf einem Tisch mit abblätternder Farbe, dahinter ein überstrahltes Fenster und ein Stuhl.
product/push-processed-black-and-white-f.alt_en: Grainy black-and-white photo from a low angle: a worn portable radio with perforated grille, large dial, scale window and two knobs on a peeling table, a blown-out window behind.

problems: Telescopic antenna rendered as real shiny metal, not clay (style requires everything matte modelling clay)
Background landscape recedes in depth and is softly blurred (depth of field); style asks for a shallow tabletop stage with painted flats and no blur
Warm sunlit light with long soft shadow instead of white studio lamps with small hard shadows
Clay surfaces smooth and CG-like with few fingerprints or tool marks; no set edges visible
Antenna grows out of the handle's pivot block rather than the body (odd but readable)
Motif complete: grille left half, dial with pointer above tick-only window, two knobs, carry handle on top, angled partly extended antenna; radio whole; square format correct; no logos
product/clay-animation-3.note_de: Die Antenne ist aus echtem Metall statt Knete, und die Landschaft dahinter verschwimmt in Tiefenunschärfe.
product/clay-animation-3.note_en: The antenna is real metal rather than clay, and the landscape behind fades into depth-of-field blur.
product/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Knetanimation: ein beige-blaues Kofferradio aus Knete mit eingedrückten Gitterlöchern, Drehscheibe, Skala und zwei Knöpfen auf rotbraunem Knetboden, dahinter grüne Hügel, Kugelbäume, ein Häuschen und Wolken.

problems: Torso drawn in three-quarter/profile rather than with the frontal shoulders of the Egyptian convention (minor)
Island with lighthouse, keeper's house and rounded trees reads as a modern flat illustration rather than Egyptian landscape signs (no dotted-hump hill, no rows of identical trees)
Single scene rather than stacked registers; acceptable for a poster
poster/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: Ein rotbrauner Mann mit weißem Schurz bläst im Profil Trompete neben einer gelben Sonne, dahinter eine Leuchtturminsel über Zickzackwasser, Schrift in Linienbändern.
poster/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on flaking plaster: a red-brown man in profile blows a trumpet beside a yellow sun, a lighthouse island above zigzag water, lettering in ruled bands.

problems: Faint light reflection streak on the water, which the style block says to avoid (minor)
Blocky hand merges with the valve pistons, readable only as stylisation (minor)

problems: Grain is a uniform worm-like noise texture laid over everything, filter-like rather than push-processed film grain
Warm sepia tint instead of neutral black-and-white
Moonlit seascape with level horizon, glittering moon path and silhouetted posed trumpeter feels like staged cinematic key art, not caught mid-action reportage
Lettering sits directly on the dark sky, not in a white band as the style block describes
poster/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_de: Das Korn wirkt wie ein digitaler Filter, die Mondszene eher inszeniert als reportagehaft.
poster/push-processed-black-and-white-fi.note_en: The grain looks like a digital filter and the moonlit scene feels staged rather than like reportage.

problems: Golden sunset light with a glittering sun path on the water, explicitly to be avoided
