food/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay-animation set: a clay hand tears bread before a clay backdrop of trees and cottage, while the loaf, tomato soup, butter and cherry tomatoes look photographic.

problems: Reads as a recoloured sharp photograph: fine wood grain, crisp crumb texture and bread crust far beyond a 320x240 sensor

Heat logic follows light and surface rather than temperature: cold butter is the brightest (hottest) patch, cherry tomatoes and basil glow as warm as the soup, and warm reflections appear on the tabletop
Crosshair and colour scale at right are present; ironbow palette correct; no corner readouts (none required)

All motif elements present: sliced loaf, serrated bread knife, crumbs, bowl with cream swirl, spoon and drip, butter with knife groove, basil, vine tomatoes, napkin, hand from upper right tearing bread; square format correct; no logos
food/thermal-imaging-2.note_de: Wirkt wie ein umgefärbtes Foto: Die kalte Butter leuchtet am hellsten, Maserung und Krume sind zu scharf.
food/thermal-imaging-2.note_en: Looks like a recoloured photo: the cold butter glows hottest, and wood grain and crumb are too sharp.
food/thermal-imaging-2.alt_de: Wärmebild in Violett, Orange und Gelbweiß mit Fadenkreuz und Farbskala: Eine warme Hand reißt ein Stück Brot ab, daneben Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale, Butter, Kirschtomaten, Basilikum und Serviette.
food/thermal-imaging-2.alt_en: Thermal image in violet, orange and yellow-white with crosshair and colour scale: a warm hand tears off bread beside tomato soup with cream swirl, butter, cherry tomatoes, basil and napkin.

problems: Composition contradicts the style block: a full riverbank landscape with a far-bank band acting as a horizon, a continuous water plane and ripples/lily pads drawn as foreshortened ellipses. Cave art has no scenery, horizon or perspective, and distant things should be separate figures elsewhere on the wall

Rendering is too naturalistic for Paleolithic art: hatched charcoal feather brushwork, a detailed eye and crest, leafy reeds with seed heads, and veined lily pads instead of single strokes and one flat contour. It reads as a fresco or tomb painting on stone
A fine woven, crosshatched texture covers the whole image like a filter, which the style block explicitly forbids
No cave-wall vocabulary: no overlapping older figures, hand stencils, dot rows or use of rock bulges, and the rock appears only as a frame at the top and bottom edges
Minor: the fish lies lengthwise along the beak and looks partly skewered rather than gripped
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.note_de: Statt Höhlenmalerei zeigt das Bild eine durchkomponierte Uferlandschaft mit Horizont, eher Fresko als Felsbild.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.note_en: Instead of cave art it shows a fully composed riverbank landscape with a horizon, closer to a fresco than a rock painting.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.alt_de: Ocker und Kohle auf rissigem Kalkstein: Ein Graureiher packt im gekräuselten Wasser einen Fisch, links Schilf mit Libelle und Schwimmblätter, dahinter ein Uferstreifen.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-3.alt_en: Ochre and charcoal on cracked limestone: a grey heron snaps up a fish in rippling water; reeds with a dragonfly and floating leaves at left, a far bank behind.

problems: Minor non-Egyptian details: ripple rings drawn as foreshortened ellipses, dark leg reflections under the water surface, and slight grey shading on the neck
Floating lotus leaves spread into the middle of the water instead of only framing the left side (minor)
animal/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: Ein Graureiher im Profil fängt im blauen Wasserband mit Wellenlinien einen Fisch, links Papyrus mit Libelle und Lotosblätter, oben Pflanzen und Bäume.
animal/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on flaking plaster: a grey heron in profile catches a fish in a blue wavy-lined water band; papyrus, dragonfly and lotus leaves at left, trees above.

problems: The water is glossy, transparent and reflective, with mirrored legs and lily pads, like real water or resin. The style requires flat matte clay with pressed ripples
Droplets are clear glass-like beads, not clay beads
Deep receding landscape with sky, clouds, layered hills and slightly soft background trees. There is no shallow tabletop stage, no set edges and no flat painted backdrop

The heron is a finely sculpted naturalistic miniature with layered feather plates, closer to polished CG clay than the kneaded lumps of 1970s-90s children's TV; fingerprints and tool marks are barely visible
animal/clay-animation-3.note_de: Das Wasser glänzt und spiegelt wie echtes Wasser, die Szene wirkt eher wie eine glatte Miniatur als ein Knetfilm-Set.
animal/clay-animation-3.note_en: The water is glossy and reflective like real water, and the scene looks more like a polished miniature than a clay-animation set.
animal/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Szene aus Knete: Ein modellierter Graureiher fängt im glänzend blauen Wasser einen Fisch, Tropfen als Kügelchen, links Rohrkolben mit Libelle und Seerosenblätter, hinten Bäume aus Knetkugeln.
animal/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay-animation scene: a sculpted grey heron catches a fish in glossy blue water, droplets as beads, cattails with a dragonfly and lily pads at left, clay-ball trees behind.

motif_missing: does not glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer: head faces the door in profile
slightly out-of-breath expression not shown (calm smile)
problems: Badger is a modern storybook figure: fur done in hatched strokes, cartoon eye in profile, rather than flat schematic fills with a frontal eye
Parcel drawn as a foreshortened 3D box (top and side visible), against the flat-side-view rule
Recessed door jamb and two-tier step suggest depth
The background (trees in registers, zigzag water panel, flat building front, flaking whitewash) is convincing; only the figure looks generic
Format correct (portrait 1024x1536); no logos, hieroglyphs, deities or gold; hands and legs fine
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Der Dachs schaut zur Tür statt über die Schulter zum Betrachter und ist eher bilderbuchhaft als ägyptisch-schematisch gemalt.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: The badger looks at the door rather than back at the viewer, and is painted more like a storybook animal than a schematic Egyptian figure.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei in Ocker, Blau und Grün auf fleckigem Putz: Ein Dachs mit Schirmmütze, Schal, Taschenweste und Paket klopft an eine Holztür, dahinter Baumreihen und Zickzackwasser.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster in ochre, blue and green: a badger courier with cap, scarf, satchel and parcel knocks on a wooden door, beside rows of trees.

motif_missing: not standing on the doorstep: feet are on the dirt path beside the step
problems: Drifts toward the generic polished CG-clay look: a deep village with hills, trees, houses and a fence, warm golden light, and a naturalistic miniature feel instead of a shallow tabletop stage with a painted backdrop
Door, stone step and wall look like real wood and stone, not matte clay; no set edges, fingerprints or lint visible
The figure itself reads as clay (scored fur, bead eyes, knitted-clay scarf)
Head turned toward the viewer with an open-mouthed cheerful expression; cap, quilted pocket vest, scarf, satchel with letters, string-tied parcel and short bushy tail all present
Format correct (portrait 1024x1536); paws and two legs fine; no logos or famous characters
character/clay-animation-2.note_de: Glatte CG-Knetoptik mit tiefem Dorfhintergrund statt flacher Trickfilmbühne; außerdem steht der Dachs neben der Türschwelle, nicht darauf.
character/clay-animation-2.note_en: Polished CG-clay look with a deep village backdrop instead of a flat tabletop set; the badger also stands beside the doorstep rather than on it.
character/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetanimation: Ein Dachs aus Knete mit blauer Schirmmütze, rotem Strickschal, grüner Steppweste und Umhängetasche voller Briefe klopft an eine Holztür, unterm Arm ein Paket, dahinter ein Dorf mit Hügeln.
character/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay animation: a clay badger in blue cap, red knitted scarf and green vest knocks on a wooden door, parcel in paw, satchel of letters; village and hills behind.

motif_missing: the road passes the foot of Eskel hill but never reaches the windmill
problems: Reads as a generic illustrated fantasy map with a cracked-plaster overlay: a European eight-point compass rose (portolan style) and a typeset Roman serif face, with lowercase place names outside any boxes, where the style calls for one-colour brush capitals in ruled boxes
The town is a Mediterranean whitewashed cluster with a domed tower, and its house blocks are drawn in slight three-quarter view; the spiny sea monster comes from a European bestiary, not Egyptian art
What does fit the style: flat fills, red-brown outlines, flaking whitewash, blue water panels with zigzag lines, dotted hump hills and rows of identical palms and cypresses
A stray grey line (a path or stream) in the north runs from nowhere into the road

Crescent island, lighthouse on the north tip, harbour with pier and three boats, river into the bay, south forest, sea creature, compass N and 1 km scale bar are all present; square format matches 1024x1024; no logos or landmarks
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_de: Windrose, Serifenschrift und das Mittelmeerstädtchen wirken eher nach Fantasykarte als nach ägyptischer Grabmalerei.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_en: The compass rose, serif lettering and Mediterranean town look more like a fantasy map than Egyptian tomb painting.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Wandmalerei in flachen Farben auf abblätterndem Putz: sichelförmige Insel mit Palmenwald, Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Leuchtturm im Norden, Hafenstadt mit Steg und drei Booten, dazu ein Seeungeheuer.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Wall painting in flat colours on flaking plaster: a crescent island with palm forest, hilltop windmill, northern lighthouse, harbour town with pier and three boats, plus a sea monster.

motif_missing: no single road links town, windmill and lighthouse: there are two separate roads, windmill to south coast and lighthouse to town
problems: Polished, evenly lit modern AI clay-diorama look: very little fingerprint, tool-score or lint texture and none of the matte grit of 1970s-90s children's TV clay; the camera looks down at a tilted overhead angle
The road network is broken: one road runs from the windmill down to the south coast and a separate one from the lighthouse to the town, so the windmill is not connected to the other two
The island is a broad hook shape and only loosely a crescent; the windmill hill sits on the northern arm rather than in the centre
What does fit the style: clay relief on a board, flat clay water with pressed-snake waves and bead drops, clay-ball trees on sticks, clay-block houses and clay-snake title letters

Harbour with stone pier and three boats (sailboat, small motorboat, rowboat), river into the harbour bay, south forest, whale (body partly submerged, tail behind), compass N and 1 km scale bar are all present; square format is correct; no logos
map/clay-animation-2.note_de: Keine Straße verbindet die Windmühle mit Stadt und Leuchtturm, und die Knete wirkt glatt wie am Computer gerendert.
map/clay-animation-2.note_en: No road links the windmill to the town and lighthouse, and the clay looks smooth, almost computer-rendered.
map/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetrelief auf blauem Brett: Insel aus Knete mit Kugelbäumen, Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Leuchtturm, Hafenstädtchen mit Steinmole und drei Booten, daneben ein lächelnder Wal und Wellen aus Knetwürsten.
map/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay relief on a blue board: a plasticine island with ball-shaped trees, hilltop windmill, lighthouse, small harbour town with stone pier and three boats, a smiling whale and clay-snake waves.

motif_missing: no road leads to the windmill; the only road runs from the lighthouse to the town
problems: The lighthouse (red and white tower side visible) and the windmill (side-view body and sails) are seen at an angle, which breaks the strictly vertical, tops-only view
Saturated, glossy turquoise look of a typical AI aerial-island image; it reads as a high-altitude render rather than a stitched drone orthomosaic, with no seams
The island is a C or horseshoe with a round outer coast, so only loosely a crescent; the river is a short creek starting behind the town rather than clearly running from the hill
What does fit the style: no horizon, small white sans-serif labels on leader lines, spaced-capital title in a corner, white north arrow and scale bar

Harbour village with piers and three boats in the inner bay, lighthouse on the north tip, south forest, whale offshore and surf lines are present; square format is correct; no drone, logo or real landmark
map/aerial-drone-photography-2.note_de: Leuchtturm und Windmühle sind schräg von der Seite zu sehen, und keine Straße führt zur Windmühle.
map/aerial-drone-photography-2.note_en: The lighthouse and windmill are seen at an angle from the side, and no road leads to the windmill.
map/aerial-drone-photography-2.alt_de: Senkrechte Luftaufnahme: felsige, C-förmige Insel im tiefblauen Meer, Wald im Süden, Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Leuchtturm, Hafenort mit Molen und drei Booten, draußen ein Wal, weiße Beschriftung.
map/aerial-drone-photography-2.alt_en: Top-down drone photo: a rocky C-shaped island in deep blue sea, forest in the south, hilltop windmill, lighthouse, harbour village with piers and three boats, a whale offshore, white labels.

problems: All nine icons are present in the correct 3x3 order and square format; no logos, watermarks or hieroglyphs
Medium is convincing: Egyptian blue, ochre, green and red-brown outlines on flaking whitewash, ruled boxes, ground line under the house
The icon shapes themselves are standard modern flat UI icons with a plaster/palette texture applied; outlines are near ruler-exact and uniform rather than freehand, so it reads as a filter
House has a pitched gable roof instead of a flat Egyptian building front
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_de: Die Symbole wirken wie moderne Vektor-Icons mit Putzstruktur: zu exakte Linien und ein Giebelhaus statt flacher Hausfront.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.note_en: The symbols read as modern vector icons with a plaster texture: lines too exact, and a gabled house instead of a flat building front.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Kalkputz: Neun flache Symbole in rotbraun umrandeten Feldern – Haus, Brief, Lupe, Glocke, Kalender, Kamera, Ortsmarke, Zahnrad, Herz – in Ägyptischblau, Ocker und Grün.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-2.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking whitewash: nine flat icons in red-brown ruled boxes – house, envelope, magnifier, bell, calendar, camera, map pin, gear, heart – in Egyptian blue, ochre and green.

problems: All nine icons are present in the correct 3x3 order and square format; no logos or watermarks

Material reads as matte modelling clay with some dents and cracks, but surfaces are very smooth and even, with few fingerprints and no lint or tool scores; it leans toward the generic AI plasticine-icon look
Lighting is soft and diffuse with blurry shadows, not small hard studio-lamp shadows; no visible set edges, so it does not read as a 1970s-90s TV animation frame
Detail level is uneven: the house has a door, knob, window and chimney while the calendar page is blank and the heart and pin are plain
icons/clay-animation-2.note_de: Zu glatt und weich ausgeleuchtet: wirkt eher wie generische KI-Knete als wie ein Trickfilm-Standbild, und nur das Haus hat Details.
icons/clay-animation-2.note_en: Too smooth and softly lit, closer to generic AI clay than a stop-motion frame, and only the house has extra detail.
icons/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetrelief auf blauer Knetplatte: Neun plastische Symbole in drei Reihen – Haus mit Schornstein, Brief, Lupe, gelbe Glocke, Kalenderblatt, schwarze Kamera, rote Ortsmarke, graues Zahnrad, rotes Herz.
icons/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay relief on a blue modelling-clay board: nine chunky icons – house with chimney, envelope, magnifier, yellow bell, calendar page, black camera, red map pin, grey gear, red heart.

The upper boat-and-landscape frieze is decorative and not data, though it does not hide the data

Style is strong: stacked registers, zigzag water band, profile figures with frontal eyes, red-brown men and ochre women, flaking whitewash; the hills add slight depth and the lettering is modern sans-serif rather than brush capitals in boxes
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.note_de: Die Figurenzahl passt nicht zu den Werten: 8 statt 12 im Juni, 36 statt 30 im Juli, 5 statt 6 im September. Die Beschriftung stimmt, aber die gemalten Figurenreihen passen nicht zu den Zahlen: Juni zeigt 8 statt 12, Juli 36 statt 30 und September 5 statt 6 Figuren.

The lettering is correct, but the painted rows of figures don't match the numbers: June shows 8 instead of 12, July 36 instead of 30 and September 5 instead of 6 figures.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: Oben ein Segelboot mit Passagieren auf Zickzack-Wasser vor Palmen und Häusern, darunter vier Register mit Reihen sitzender Profilfiguren für Juni bis September.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster: a sailing boat with passengers on zigzag water before palms and houses; below, four registers of seated profile figures for June to September.

problems: Bar heights measured 260/621/487/131 px (per unit 21.7/20.7/20.3/21.8): within about 4% of correct, acceptable
Fills are crayon/coloured-pencil scribble with darker rims, not flat brush-streaked watercolour with ink outlines
Four wide primary-colour columns spread evenly across the board read as a generic school bar chart rather than one large Du Bois figure amid bare board
Labels and numbers are bold, font-like sans capitals instead of small thin hand capitals
Palette (crimson, golden yellow, royal blue, deep green), chipped cream board, heavy hand-drawn title and the absence of axes and grid are on style
chart/du-bois-data-portraits-1.note_de: Die Tafel wirkt eher wie ein gewöhnliches Buntstift-Balkendiagramm als wie ein Du-Bois-Blatt.
chart/du-bois-data-portraits-1.note_en: The board looks more like an ordinary crayon bar chart than a Du Bois plate.
chart/du-bois-data-portraits-1.alt_de: Handgezeichnete Tafel auf fleckigem, bestoßenem Karton: vier Säulen in Karminrot, Goldgelb, Königsblau und Dunkelgrün mit den Werten 12, 30, 24 und 6, darüber der Titel in schwarzen Blockbuchstaben.
chart/du-bois-data-portraits-1.alt_en: Hand-drawn chart on stained, chipped board: four columns in crimson, golden yellow, royal blue and deep green showing 12, 30, 24 and 6, titled in heavy black capitals.

problems: Background (ferry, island village, rocks, sea) is rendered with photographic depth-of-field blur, which the style explicitly forbids; it should be a flat painted backdrop
Clay surfaces are very smooth and polished with almost no fingerprints or tool marks, drifting toward CG clay
Bar heights measured 171/464/358/86 px (per unit 14.3/15.5/14.9/14.3): July about 8% too tall relative to June and September, minor
Added sailor and girl figures plus harbour scenery are decorative extras; the data stays readable
Hands (mitten-like, thumb and fingers) show no anatomy errors; no logos or famous characters seen
chart/clay-animation-2.note_de: Die Kulisse dahinter ist fotografisch unscharf, statt flach gemalt zu sein, und die Knete wirkt zu glatt.
chart/clay-animation-2.note_en: The backdrop is photographically blurred instead of flatly painted, and the clay looks too smooth.
chart/clay-animation-2.alt_de: Knetanimations-Szene: Ein Seemann im Strickpullover zeigt einem Mädchen mit Rucksack eine Knettafel mit vier bunten Säulen (12, 30, 24, 6), dahinter Fähre, Meer und Inseldorf.
chart/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Clay-animation scene: a sailor in a cable-knit jumper shows a girl with a backpack a clay board with four coloured columns (12, 30, 24, 6); ferry, sea and island village behind.

problems: Style drift: both chairs and the tabletop are drawn in three-quarter perspective (seat and table plane foreshortened) instead of flat side views
The room is one modern frontal kitchen view, not stacked registers on ground lines; only the window view uses registers (trees, zigzag water)
The window shows a blue sky and a town skyline, which the style block forbids (no sky or depth)
The craquelure and flaking read as an overlay on a flat folk-art illustration, so the look is partly filter-like
Correct: Egyptian blue, green and ochre palette, red-brown outlines, whitewash ground, rows of identical trees, zigzag water panel, no hieroglyphs or deities

interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_de: Stühle und Tischplatte sind schräg in die Tiefe gezeichnet, nicht flach im Profil wie in ägyptischer Wandmalerei.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_en: The chairs and tabletop are drawn in receding perspective instead of the flat side views of Egyptian wall painting.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei in Ocker, Grün und Blau auf rissigem Putz: flache Küche mit Kräutern am Fenster, Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf dem Tisch, Wasserkessel auf dem Herd.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_en: Egyptian-style wall painting in ochre, green and blue on cracked plaster: a flat kitchen with herbs on the sill, jigsaw, teapot and cup on the table, kettle on the stove.

motif_missing: two-burner stove: the stove has three burners (two on the left, one on the right) and four knobs
problems: Wrong object count: the stove has three burners instead of two

Correct: matte kneaded surfaces with dents on the table, cushion and chairs, clay puzzle pieces, painted backdrop behind the window

interior/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay animation with fingerprints: kitchen with herb pots on the sill, jigsaw, blue teapot and cup on the table, two odd chairs, a coat beside a blue door.

problems: Style drifts toward a Western natural-history plate painted on plaster: no ruled ground lines or registers, overlapping naturalistic branch arrangement
Slight modelling/shading on the whole fruit and a foreshortened curl on the right leaf, against the flat, side-view rule
No Egyptian blue in the palette; the flaking whitewash and red-brown outlines carry most of the style

botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine botanische Tafel auf Putz als wie ägyptische Grabmalerei: keine Register, Frucht und Blatt leicht plastisch.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Reads more like a botanical plate on plaster than Egyptian tomb painting: no registers, slight modelling on fruit and leaf.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Kalkputz mit rotbraunen Umrissen: Quittenzweig mit vier Blättern, weißer Blüte, Knospe und gelber Frucht, darunter die halbierte Quitte, ein Blütenblatt und ein Kern.

problems: Naturalistic polymer-clay miniature, which the style block explicitly avoids, instead of chunky 1970s-90s TV clay animation (kneaded lumps, scored lines)
Colours are blended and airbrushed (gradient greens on leaves, pink blush on petal and bud) instead of unmixed clay colours
No tabletop stage, clay ground, painted backdrop or visible set edges; plain seamless beige studio backdrop like a product shot

botanical/clay-animation-2.note_en: A naturalistic clay miniature rather than chunky TV clay animation: no stage set, blended colours.

botanical/clay-animation-2.alt_en: Finely modelled in clay against a beige backdrop: a quince branch with white blossom, pink bud, bitten leaf and yellow fruit; below, the halved quince, a seed and a petal.

problems: Composition contradicts the style block: continuous scene with horizon, sea band, receding pebble beach and depth instead of isolated figures on bare wall
Figures are detailed modelled illustrations in three-quarter view, not single-contour side-view silhouettes
Uniform overlay texture across the image reads like a modern mural or filter on rock, not Paleolithic pigment
No hand stencils, dot rows or overlapping older figures
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-4.note_de: Wirkt wie ein modernes Wandbild auf Felsstruktur: Horizont, Meer und räumliche Tiefe statt flacher Höhlensilhouetten.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-4.note_en: Reads as a modern mural on rock texture: horizon, sea and depth instead of flat cave-wall silhouettes.

Natural sunlight look rather than flat frontal arc lighting

people/three-strip-technicolor-4.note_en: No Technicolor look: a photorealistic image with real sky, wide coastline and fine detail instead of a studio set.

people/three-strip-technicolor-4.alt_en: Photorealistic image in muted colours: a grey-haired woman presses a plank onto an upturned hull while a young man in a knitted cap hammers a nail; sea, jetty, gulls behind.

motif_missing: older woman's age not legible (hair in a bun rather than short grey, no aged posture)
woman presses the plank with only one visible hand
problems: Only the palette is Warli: figures are large (about 40% of picture height) instead of under a fifth
Hair, apron bow, sleeve cuffs and knitted-cap detail, which the style forbids
Boat and jetty drawn in perspective/foreshortening with overlap; man not built from two triangles
Leafy naturalistic tree instead of forked-trunk sign; reads as a modern folk-inspired linocut illustration
people/warli-painting-4.note_de: Nur Warli-Farben: große Figuren mit Haar- und Kleiderdetails, Boot und Steg in Perspektive statt flacher Dreiecksfiguren.
people/warli-painting-4.note_en: Only the Warli colours: large figures with hair and clothing detail, boat and jetty in perspective instead of flat triangle figures.
people/warli-painting-4.alt_de: Weiße Linien auf rotbraunem Lehmgrund: Eine kniende Frau drückt eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, ein hockender Mann mit Mütze hämmert; dazu Werkzeugkiste, Seil, Nageldose, Wellen mit Fischen, Steg, Möwen.
people/warli-painting-4.alt_en: White lines on red-brown mud: a kneeling woman presses a plank onto an upturned boat, a crouching man in a cap hammers; toolbox, rope, nail tin, fish-filled waves, jetty, gulls.

problems: Exactly the 'recoloured sharp photo' the style block forbids: sharp facial features and wrinkles, individual hair strands, wood grain, rope fibres, pebble shapes
Heat logic wrong: wooden hull and metal nail tin glow as hot as skin, hair brightest; metal shows light reflections
No crosshair, no coarse sensor resolution; only the colour scale at right is thermal-camera-like
people/thermal-imaging-3.note_de: Wirkt wie ein umgefärbtes scharfes Foto: Gesichtszüge, Holzmaserung und Seilfasern sind fein sichtbar, Holz und Blech leuchten unlogisch heiß.
people/thermal-imaging-3.note_en: Looks like a recoloured sharp photo: fine facial features, wood grain and rope fibres, with wood and tin glowing implausibly hot.
people/thermal-imaging-3.alt_de: Wärmebild in Violett, Orange und Gelb mit Farbskala rechts: Eine alte Frau drückt eine Planke an den Bootsrumpf, ein junger Mann mit Mütze schlägt einen Nagel ein; Steg mit Möwen.
people/thermal-imaging-3.alt_en: Thermal image in violet, orange and yellow: an old woman presses a plank onto the hull, a young man in a cap hammers a nail; jetty and gulls behind.

motif_missing: woman not shown kneeling (she bends over the boat, apparently standing)
problems: Edge-to-edge detailed comic scene with horizon, perspective and hundreds of shaded pebbles, explicitly to be avoided
No separate clips on white, no grey shadow ellipses, no stiff side-view figures with big round heads and dot eyes
Modelled faces, wood grain and chipped paint give comic-book detail rather than few closed vector shapes
Extra houses and island on the far shore
people/1990s-clip-art-4.note_de: Kein Clipart-Stil der 90er: ein randloses, detailreiches Comicbild statt einzelner Clips auf Weiß.
people/1990s-clip-art-4.note_en: Not 1990s clip art: a detailed edge-to-edge comic scene instead of separate clips on white.
people/1990s-clip-art-4.alt_de: Bunte Comiczeichnung mit dicken Konturen: Eine grauhaarige Frau in Schürze drückt eine Planke auf einen Bootsrumpf, ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze hämmert einen Nagel; Kiesstrand, Steg, Möwen.
people/1990s-clip-art-4.alt_en: Comic drawing with thick outlines: a grey-haired woman presses a plank onto a hull, a young man in a knitted cap hammers a nail; pebble beach, jetty, gulls.

problems: Filter-pixelated skilled cartoon rather than a crude mouse drawing: competent anatomy, three-quarter views, expressive faces
Detailed ground of hundreds of shaded pebbles that shrink with distance; horizon with island gives depth
Shading and texture on boat planks, jacket and stones; no paint-bucket fills leaking, no tool-shape figures, no spray-can speckle
people/ms-paint-style-3.note_de: Zu geübt für MS Paint: verpixelte Comiczeichnung mit Schattierung, Tiefe und Hunderten Kieseln statt krakeliger Mauszeichnung.
people/ms-paint-style-3.note_en: Too skilled for MS Paint: a pixelated cartoon with shading, depth and hundreds of pebbles instead of a crude mouse drawing.
people/ms-paint-style-3.alt_de: Verpixelte Zeichnung mit gezackten Linien: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot und drückt eine Planke an, ein junger Mann mit Mütze hämmert; knallblaues Meer, Steg, Möwen.
people/ms-paint-style-3.alt_en: Pixelated drawing with jagged lines: a grey-haired woman kneels at the upturned boat pressing a plank, a young man in a cap hammers; bright blue sea, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: The woman presses the plank with only one hand; her other hand grips the top of the hull
The woman stoops or stands at the hull rather than clearly kneeling
problems: Style drifts toward modern high-clarity dramatic monochrome photography: crisp HDR-like texture on the wood and pebbles, clean digital tonality, little nitrate grain or halation
Faces are lit from front-left, which does not match the backlighting moon. The key light is not motivated from inside the scene, and both faces stay well lit instead of half lost in black
Camera is at eye level with no low angle or tilt. The figures sit close together left of centre, without a figure near the lens and another small in depth
Stock moon behind dramatic clouds; background jetty and gulls are slightly soft instead of deep focus
A thin vertical line runs from the hammer head down to the nail, a small artefact
Correct 1536x1024 landscape format. No logo, signature, watermark or real landmark
people/film-noir-2.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein modernes, dramatisches Schwarzweißfoto als wie ein Filmbild der 1940er, und die Frau hält die Planke nur mit einer Hand.
people/film-noir-2.note_en: Looks more like a modern dramatic black-and-white photo than a 1940s film frame, and the woman holds the plank with only one hand.
people/film-noir-2.alt_de: Nächtliches Schwarzweißbild mit hartem Licht und tiefen Schatten: Eine alte Frau und ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nageln eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, dahinter Mond, Steg und zwei Möwen.
people/film-noir-2.alt_en: Night-time black-and-white still, hard light, deep shadows: an old woman and a young man in a knitted cap nail a plank to an upturned boat; moon, jetty, gulls behind.

problems: Trumpet valve section is a garbled tangle of tubing loops with no readable valves; the bell is oversized relative to the head
Both gripping hands are murky dark blobs with uncountable, poorly defined fingers (partly masked by the grainy print)

Style drift: large orange sun disc with the trumpet bell breaking out of the photo rectangle over it, and a cut-out lighthouse island collage. This reads more like a modern retro jazz poster than a flat 1956-67 sleeve built on a strict grid of hard rectangles; the photo is not radically cropped to a fragment
Format OK (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, watermark, signature or real landmark found; the trumpeter is generic and I could not identify him as a real person
All motif elements present: a small rocky island with a lighthouse, a single trumpeter and the sun as an orange disc; headline, subline and date form a clear hierarchy
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-2.note_de: Die Hände und der Ventilblock der Trompete sind verschwommen und ergeben kein stimmiges Instrument.
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-2.note_en: The hands and the trumpet's valve section are a murky tangle that does not form a plausible instrument.
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-2.alt_de: Plakat im Stil eines Sechziger-Jazzcovers in Schwarz, Orange und Blau: körniges Schwarzweißfoto eines Trompeters am linken Rand, orange Sonnenscheibe, Felseninsel mit Leuchtturm über blauem Meer, oben riesige schmale Versalien.
poster/modern-jazz-record-sleeve-2.alt_en: Poster as a 1960s jazz LP sleeve in black, orange and blue: grainy photo of a trumpeter far left, orange sun, lighthouse island over blue sea, huge condensed capitals.

motif_missing: Hand is not tearing a piece off a bread slice: it holds an already torn chunk and dips it over the soup bowl
problems: Style drift toward the modern AI food-photo look: clean digital colour, vivid fresh-green basil and glossy tomatoes, with no aged four-colour offset cast, no brownish shadows and no dull greens
Lighting is soft and directional (warm side light, gentle shading), not the flat frontal single-flash look with short hard shadows

Dark worn wood table and the overall warm, moody rustic mood conflict with the 'avoid moody rustic styling' instruction; the soup bowl works as a semi-centred hero dish instead of stiffly spaced dishes
Period props are correct (orange wall, floral drape, brown stoneware carafe, candle), but the patterned orange-brown runner is missing; the striped napkin stands in for it

Format correct (square 1254x1254 for 1024x1024); hand anatomy is clean; no logos, brands or watermarks; crumbs, cream swirl, rim drip, knife mark in butter, vine tomatoes, basil and folded linen napkin are all present
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-3.note_de: Die Hand reißt kein Brot ab, sondern hält ein Stück über die Suppe, und Licht und Farben wirken moderner als ein Druck aus den 70ern.
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-3.note_en: The hand holds bread over the soup instead of tearing it, and the light and colour look more modern than a 1970s print.
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-3.alt_de: Warmes Kochbuchfoto im 70er-Stil mit Steingutkaraffe, Kerze und geblümtem Stoff: angeschnittenes Brot auf Holzbrett, Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale, Butter, Rispentomaten, Basilikum; eine Hand hält Brot über die Suppe.
food/1970s-cookbook-photography-3.alt_en: 1970s-style cookbook photo with stoneware carafe, candle and floral drape: sliced loaf on a board, tomato soup with cream swirl, butter, vine tomatoes, basil; a hand holds bread over soup.

motif_missing: winding road does not reach the windmill (road links lighthouse and town only; western branch passes below the hill)
problems: Style drift toward the generic fantasy-map look: land fully washed green and cliffs pink, where the style calls for no wash and only thin coastal colour bands
Sea coloured blue along all coasts, though the style wants the sea uncoloured
Strong oblique bird's-eye view with raised, shaded 3D cliffs along the whole coast, which the style explicitly avoids
Compass rose has 16 points, not 32
Title set in a clean modern-looking serif rather than engraved capitals; cartouche is baroque acanthus scrollwork rather than strapwork
Foxing reads somewhat like stained parchment; centre fold only faintly visible
Format correct (1254x1254 square for 1024x1024); no logos, signatures, watermarks or real landmarks
map/antique-engraved-map-2.note_de: Land und Meer sind flächig koloriert und die Küsten plastisch erhöht, was eher an eine moderne Fantasy-Karte erinnert als an einen Atlasstich. Außerdem führt keine Straße zur Mühle. Alle Beschriftungen sind korrekt, doch im Gradrahmen stehen winzige, unlesbare Pseudo-Ziffern statt echter Gradzahlen.
map/antique-engraved-map-2.note_en: Fully painted land and sea with raised 3D cliffs look more like a modern fantasy map than a hand-coloured atlas plate, and no road leads to the windmill. All labels are correct, but the degree border holds tiny illegible pseudo-numerals instead of real degree figures.
map/antique-engraved-map-2.alt_de: Handkolorierte Kupferstichkarte auf stockfleckigem Papier: die sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Leuchtturm im Norden, Windmühlenhügel, Wald im Süden, Hafenstadt mit drei Booten, Kompassrose und Seeungeheuer.
map/antique-engraved-map-2.alt_en: Hand-coloured engraved map on foxed paper: crescent island Lornholm with northern lighthouse, windmill hill, southern forest, harbour town with three boats, compass rose and sea monster.
text_errors: All six required strings are present and exact: 'LORNHOLM' (roman caps in cartouche), 'Varn', 'Eskel', 'Moa' (italic), 'N' above fleur-de-lis, '1 km' (with space) under scale bar

Degree-scale border on all four sides carries tiny illegible glyph-like clusters (approx. 8-12 px) at regular intervals where degree numerals would sit; they form no readable letters or numbers, so treated as pseudo-glyph ornament rather than words (strict reading of the pseudo-text rule could escalate to fail)
extra: Illegible pseudo-numeral squiggles in the degree-scale border (top, bottom, left, right), e.g. clusters resembling '卄'/'非'-like marks; not legible as any characters

motif_missing: strict proportionality: the September crowd is too large next to July
problems: Crowd columns are only roughly proportional. Heights measured at about 213/582/405/138 px for JUN/JUL/AUG/SEP give JUL/SEP 4.2 (should be 5.0) and AUG/SEP 2.9 (should be 4.0), so September is overstated by about 20%.
The figures do not count consistently as pictograms: 7 figures for 12, 3 for 6, about 12 for 24 and about 17 for 30, and no unit is given.

The scene is busy, with a ferry, gangway passengers, an island and dense horizontal hatching in the sky and water. That is more parallel hatching and fine detail than the style block allows. The figures are small rather than large and outlined, and the page has no broadsheet vignette layout. The month labels look like a clean digital slab serif.
A generic castle ruin sits on the island. It is not identifiable as a real landmark.
Format is correct (1536x1024 landscape). No anatomy errors, logos or signatures.
chart/woodcut-4.note_de: Die Menschengruppen sind nur ungefähr proportional; der September wirkt neben dem Juli zu groß. Alle Texte stimmen, doch die Passagiergruppen sind nur grob proportional: Der Juli-Stapel ist gegenüber dem August zu hoch, die September-Gruppe gegenüber dem Juni zu groß.
chart/woodcut-4.note_en: The crowds are only roughly proportional; September looks too large next to July. All text is correct, but the passenger groups are only roughly proportional: July's stack is too tall next to August's, and September's group is too big next to June's.
chart/woodcut-4.alt_de: Holzschnitt in Schwarz auf gelblichem Papier: Unter dem Spruchband „LORNHOLM 2026“ stehen Menschentrauben für 12, 30, 24 und 6 Fahrgäste am Steg, links eine Fähre, hinten eine Insel mit Burgruine.
chart/woodcut-4.alt_en: Black woodcut on off-white paper: under a 'LORNHOLM 2026' banner, crowds for 12, 30, 24 and 6 passengers stand on a pier; ferry left, island with castle ruin behind.
text_errors: proportion: expected SEP group height 1/5 of JUL, found ~1/4.25 (JUL ~586 px, SEP ~138 px; SEP ~17-24% too tall)
proportion: expected JUN group 2x SEP, found ~1.54x (JUN ~213 px vs SEP ~138 px)
proportion: expected JUL:AUG 1.25, found ~1.47 by height (586 vs 400 px); figure counts JUN 7, JUL ~18, AUG 12, SEP 3 also do not follow 12:30:24:6

problems: Proportions are exact. Bar heights of 264/661/531/131 px above a baseline at y=891 work out to about 22 px per passenger for every month.
Minor style deviation: the washes are very even and stay inside the outlines with no overrun. The mottled texture repeats uniformly, like a digital fill, rather than reading as hand-laid watercolour.
The grid is coarse and slightly irregular rather than a fine hairline grid. Month labels are roman capitals, not italic. Both points are acceptable.
Format is correct (1536x1024 landscape). No legend box, axis numbers, imprint, logo or ornament.
chart/19th-century-statistical-plate-3.alt_de: Handkolorierte Statistiktafel wie aus dem 19. Jahrhundert: Unter dem Titel „LORNHOLM 2026“ zeigen lavierte Balken in Ocker, Rosa, Blau und Grün 12, 30, 24 und 6 Fahrgäste, gerahmt von Doppellinien.
chart/19th-century-statistical-plate-3.alt_en: Hand-coloured 19th-century-style statistical plate: under the title 'LORNHOLM 2026', ochre, rose, blue and green washed bars show 12, 30, 24 and 6 passengers on cream paper within a double-ruled frame.

motif_missing: strict proportionality: the September group is too large next to July
problems: Traveller groups are only roughly proportional. Heights measured at about 245/635/490/155 px give JUL/SEP 4.1 (should be 5.0) and AUG/SEP 3.2 (should be 4.0), so September is overstated.
The figures do not count consistently: about 5 people for 12, 3 for 6, about 15 for 24 and about 22 for 30.
A small white bird- or Y-shaped emblem sits on the ferry's blue funnel. It is logo-like but too vague to identify as a real brand. Flagged for decision.

The look drifts toward a generic AI watercolour. The ferry, backpacks and suitcases are rendered in clean, fairly fine detail rather than a few broad wet-in-wet strokes. Wet blooms appear mainly in the sky, and there are no sketchbook arrows or scattered notes.
A background queue of tiny figures boarding the ferry adds people that could be mistaken for data.
Format is correct (1536x1024 landscape). Sepia brush lettering and the vignette edges are present. No visible anatomy errors.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-4.note_de: Die Gruppe im September wirkt zu groß, und die Figuren sind für lockeres Nass-in-Nass zu detailliert. Alle Texte stimmen, doch die Menschengruppen sind nur grob proportional: Die September-Gruppe wirkt neben der Juni-Gruppe zu groß, und im Juli stehen fast doppelt so viele Figuren wie im August.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-4.note_en: September's group looks too large, and the figures are too detailed for loose wet-in-wet. All text is correct, but the crowds are only roughly proportional: September's group looks too big next to June's, and July holds almost twice as many figures as August.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-4.alt_de: Aquarell mit verlaufenden Himmelsflächen auf weißem Papier: Reisende mit Koffern stehen in vier Gruppen für 12, 30, 24 und 6 am Kai, links eine Fähre, rechts ein Inseldorf mit Burgruine.
chart/watercolor-wet-in-wet-4.alt_en: Watercolour with soft, bleeding sky washes: travellers with suitcases form groups for 12, 30, 24 and 6 on a quay; ferry left, island village with castle ruin right.
text_errors: proportion: expected SEP group height 1/5 of JUL, found ~1/4.0 (JUL ~638 px, SEP ~158 px; SEP ~24% too tall)
proportion: expected JUN group 2x SEP, found ~1.55x (245 vs 158 px)
proportion: figure counts JUN 5, JUL ~18, AUG 10, SEP 3 do not follow 12:30:24:6 (JUL:AUG ~1.8 instead of 1.25)

problems: Core Egyptian grammar absent: deep western perspective with a river receding to a horizon, rolling hills and a mountain skyline instead of stacked registers on ruled ground lines
Village houses with terracotta roofs drawn in three-quarter view with visible side walls, plus Tuscan cypresses: reads as a Mediterranean/Minoan-type fresco, not Theban tomb painting
Egyptian traits limited to surface: flaking plaster, ochre/blue palette, zigzag water lines, papyrus clumps, flying ducks, small red-brown kilted figure
All motif elements present (bridge with one figure, about six houses plus a bell-gable chapel, terraces left, forest right, leaning tree with bench, birds, ridge); no logos or landmarks
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Statt flacher Register zeigt das Bild eine perspektivische Mittelmeerlandschaft, nur die Oberfläche wirkt ägyptisch.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Instead of flat registers it shows a deep Mediterranean landscape; only the surface looks Egyptian.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptisch anmutende Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz, aber mit perspektivischer Tiefe: blau gewellter Fluss, Steinbrücke mit Wanderer, weißes Dorf, Terrassenfelder, Baum mit Bank, fliegende Enten, Bergkette.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian-tinged painting on flaking plaster, yet in deep perspective: wavy blue river, stone bridge with a walker, white village, terraced fields, tree with bench, flying ducks, mountain ridge.

problems: Image inside the mask is a finely detailed, muted full-colour painterly/photographic view rather than a soft grey-sepia plate with two or three flat overrunning tints
Crisp distant snowy peaks and fine foliage detail, which the style explicitly avoids
Mask opening is a near-full-frame rounded rectangle rather than a round or arched window; taped corners, scratches and small white spots are present

All motif elements present: river, single-arch stone bridge with one tiny figure, about five houses and a chapel tower, terraces left, forest right, tree with bench, five birds, jagged ridge; no logos or maker's names
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-3.note_de: Zu detailreich und durchgehend fein koloriert, mit scharfen Fernbergen statt weniger flacher Tönungen auf grauem Grund.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-3.note_en: Too detailed and finely coloured throughout, with crisp distant peaks instead of a few flat tints on grey.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-3.alt_de: Laternbild mit schwarzer Maske und abgeklebten Ecken, gedämpft getönt: Flusstal mit Steinbogenbrücke, Dorf mit Kirchturm, Terrassen links, Wald rechts, vorn Baum mit Bank, dahinter Schneegipfel und Vögel.
landscape/magic-lantern-slide-3.alt_en: Lantern slide, black mask, taped corners, muted tints: river valley, stone arch bridge, village with church tower, terraces left, forest right, tree and bench in front, snowy peaks, birds.

problems: Exactly the picture-postcard view the style forbids: large framing tree and foliage, scenic river leading line, grand jagged mountains
Glossy HDR-like clarity, lifted shadows, saturated greens and blue sky; no hard midday flat light, no dense dye-transfer palette
No square-on, level, banal roadside composition; nothing of 1970s American New Color (poles, wires, kerbs, worn buildings) — reads as a generic AI travel photo

All motif elements present: river, single-arch stone bridge with one tiny figure, village of about five houses and a chapel, terraces left, forest right, tree with bench, five birds, ridge; no logos or recognisable landmark
landscape/new-color-photography-3.note_de: Eine szenische Postkartenansicht mit Rahmenbaum und HDR-Schärfe statt nüchterner Farbfotografie der 1970er.
landscape/new-color-photography-3.note_en: A scenic postcard view with framing tree and HDR clarity instead of plain 1970s colour photography.
landscape/new-color-photography-3.alt_de: Glatte, sonnige Postkarten-Landschaftsfotografie: Ein knorriger Baum mit Bank rahmt den Blick auf Fluss, Steinbrücke, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassen links, Wald rechts und schroffe Berge unter blauem Himmel.
landscape/new-color-photography-3.alt_en: Glossy sunny postcard photo: a gnarled tree with bench frames river, stone bridge, village with chapel, terraces left, forest right and jagged mountains under blue sky.

problems: Style drift toward the default AI product shot: the radio body is high-gloss lacquer with specular reflections, although the style block asks for dulled shiny surfaces and no glossy reflections
Marble ledge shows fine HDR-like veining micro-detail (explicitly to be avoided)
Camera is a slightly elevated three-quarter product view, not the static eye-level medium-long sound-stage shot; lighting is directional with cast ivy shadows, not flat frontal arc light
Positives: painted backdrop (lake, villas, cypresses as soft brushwork), ruby jewel accent against creams and greys, prop urn and ivy all fit the style

Motif complete: left-half grille, one large tuning dial above a tick-mark-only window, two small knobs, top carry handle (fixed-looking rather than clearly fold-down), partly extended angled telescopic antenna; radio alone and whole
Format correct (1254x1254 square for 1024x1024); no logo, brand mark, signature or watermark; backdrop is a generic Italian lakeside, not an identifiable landmark
product/three-strip-technicolor-3.note_de: Lackglanz und fein gezeichneter Marmor wirken eher wie ein modernes Produktfoto als wie ein Technicolor-Filmbild.
product/three-strip-technicolor-3.note_en: Glossy lacquer and finely detailed marble read more like a modern product shot than a Technicolor film frame.
product/three-strip-technicolor-3.alt_de: Technicolor-Filmstill: Ein rubinrotes Kofferradio mit Messinggitter, großem Drehknopf, Skalenfenster und Teleskopantenne steht auf einer Marmorbrüstung, dahinter eine gemalte Kulisse mit See, Villen und Zypressen.
product/three-strip-technicolor-3.alt_en: Technicolor film still: a ruby-red portable radio with brass grille, tuning dial and telescopic antenna on a marble ledge, before a painted backdrop of lake, villas and cypresses.

problems: Not a cutaway at all: the cup is shown whole in three-quarter perspective, with no side section, solid cut-edge band, internal chambers, pipes, chutes or belts
Explicitly forbidden elements present: horizon line, receding landscape with cypress trees, bushes and a farmhouse, perspective ground plane, modelled shading and soft cast shadows

Reads as a generic vintage storybook/editorial illustration with an aged-paper texture; coarse four-colour halftone is not visible, and the palette is cobalt blue on cream instead of dulled red/ochre/teal
Figures are modelled, turned three-quarter illustration figures, not tiny flat profile workers all of one size

Motif itself is complete: three workers (ladder with oversized needle and thread, rim sitter lowering a bucket on a rope into the cup, woman carrying a glue tube), several shards at the base, open upper third; no anatomy errors, logos or landmarks found
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.note_de: Kein Schnittbild: Die Tasse steht ganz und perspektivisch in einer Landschaft mit Horizont, ohne Querschnitt, Kammern oder Rohre.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.note_en: Not a cutaway: the cup stands whole and in perspective in a landscape with a horizon, with no section, chambers or pipes.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.alt_de: Vergilbte Retro-Illustration statt Schnittbild: Drei kleine Arbeiter flicken eine riesige, gesprungene Porzellantasse mit blauen Blumen – Nadel und Faden, Eimer am Seil, Klebstofftube. Scherben liegen herum, dahinter Landschaft.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.alt_en: Yellowed retro illustration rather than a cutaway: three tiny workers mend a giant cracked blue-flowered teacup with needle and thread, a bucket on a rope and a glue tube; shards and countryside around.

motif_missing: The woman walks to the right, down the lane that slopes down to the right, instead of pushing the bicycle up the slope (minor)
problems: Composition contradicts the style block: the cobbled street recedes in full perspective, with open sky, cypresses layered in depth and a bell tower drawn smaller in the distance. There are no ruled registers, and distance is not shown as height.
Buildings, awning and bench are drawn as three-quarter or perspective views, not flat side views. Overall it reads as a Mediterranean naive or folk mural, not a Theban tomb painting.
The Egyptian cues are limited to the profile heads with kohl eyes, linen dresses, red-brown outlines and the flaking plaster texture, which comes across as a filter on a generic storybook street.
No skin-colour convention: both women are red-brown like the man, where the style block asks for pale ochre women.
Bodies are mostly in profile or three-quarter view; the frontal-shoulder convention is only partly followed.
Format is correct (portrait, 1024x1536). No logo, signature or real landmark; the bell tower with a cross is generic.
No anatomy errors found; the hands on the rug, handlebar and bread look fine.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.note_de: Nur Figuren und Putz wirken ägyptisch, denn Fluchtperspektive, Himmel und Tiefenstaffelung passen nicht zur Wandmalerei.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.note_en: Only the figures and plaster look Egyptian; the receding street, sky and depth contradict the style.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_de: Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz, Figuren im ägyptischen Profil: Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Brezelschild und Hund an der Bank, oben Frau mit Teppich, Wäscheleine, rechts Frau mit Fahrrad.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_en: Wall painting on flaking plaster, Egyptian-profile figures: corner bakery with pretzel sign, dog by the bench, woman shaking a rug above, laundry line, woman pushing a bicycle.

motif_missing: The woman pushes the bicycle away from the viewer into the lane, which visibly descends toward the lake, so she is going down the slope rather than up (minor)
problems: Drifts toward the picture-postcard view the style block forbids: a quaint Italian lake village with geraniums, a rustic bakery, a lake and mountains, and a scenic campanile.
The main subject, the red corner building, is large and dominant in the frame, not small and off centre among poles, wires and kerbs.
The sky is a saturated deep blue, not pale cyan. The image has crisp digital clarity, slightly lifted shadows and no film grain, so it lacks the dense dye-transfer look of the 1970s.
Real New Color cues are present: a wide foreground of patched asphalt with a manhole cover, hard midday light with short shadows, a level camera with mostly straight verticals, and everything sharp.
The bench stands in front of the shop window, a little away from the door (minor).
Format is correct (portrait, 1024x1536). No logo, watermark or identifiable landmark; the tower and lakeside are generic.
No anatomy errors found: the woman holds the rug with both hands, the cyclist is seen from behind and the dog is intact.
street/new-color-photography-3.note_de: Die Szene wirkt eher wie eine Urlaubspostkarte als wie nüchterne Alltagsfotografie der 70er-Jahre.
street/new-color-photography-3.note_en: The scene looks more like a holiday postcard than plain 1970s everyday photography.
street/new-color-photography-3.alt_de: Farbfoto in Mittagssonne: rotes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Markise und Brezelschild, Hund an der Bank, oben schüttelt eine Frau einen Teppich aus, Wäscheleine, rechts Frau mit Fahrrad, vorn rissiger Asphalt.
street/new-color-photography-3.alt_en: Colour photo in midday sun: red corner bakery with pretzel sign, dog by the bench, woman shaking a rug upstairs, laundry line, woman with bicycle, patched asphalt foreground.

motif_missing: hand does not tear a piece off a bread slice; it only holds an already torn piece above the soup bowl
problems: Only the backdrop (cottage, clay-ball trees, hills, stone wall), soup bowl, hand, tomatoes and basil read as clay; the bread loaf, slices and crumbs have photographic crumb and crust texture
Butter looks like real butter, napkin like real woven linen with frayed threads, table and cutting board like real wood grain, which the style block forbids ('no real wood, food')
Overall reads as a photoreal food still life in front of a clay diorama backdrop: naturalistic miniature, warm light, considerable depth instead of a shallow tabletop stage
Hand is a lifelike clay hand with detailed nails and skin lines, not a mitten hand
Hand action is wrong: it holds a torn piece over the soup instead of tearing it off a slice
Format is correct (square 1254x1254 for 1024x1024); no logo, signature, watermark or real landmark
food/clay-animation-3.note_de: Brot, Butter, Serviette und Tisch wirken fotorealistisch statt geknetet, und die Hand reißt kein Brot ab, sondern hält nur ein Stück.
food/clay-animation-3.note_en: Bread, butter, napkin and table look photoreal rather than clay, and the hand only holds a piece instead of tearing it off.
food/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Kulisse aus Knete mit Landhaus und Hügeln, davor fast fotorealistisch: angeschnittener Brotlaib mit Messer, Tomatensuppe in blauer Schale, Butter, Kirschtomaten, Basilikum, Serviette; eine Knethand hält ein Stück Brot.
food/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay backdrop with cottage and hills; in front, near-photoreal sliced loaf and knife, tomato soup in a blue bowl, butter, cherry tomatoes, basil, napkin; a clay hand holds torn bread.

problems: Composed as a naturalistic landscape: far-bank vegetation band with a horizon line, a horizontal water plane and reeds framing the scene. The style block forbids scenery, ground line, horizon and receding landscape.
The heron is built from feathery, brushy strokes with tonal modelling (charcoal back, rust neck with dark stripes) instead of one confident contour filled flat or blown.
A uniform, repeating micro-texture lies over the whole rock surface, visible in full-resolution crops. It reads as an applied filter, not as real flaked pigment on calcite.
None of the cave conventions appear: no hand stencils, dot rows, overlapping older figures or use of rock bulges.
Minor: the rust-coloured striped neck reads more like a purple heron than a grey heron, though the ochre/charcoal palette partly explains this.

Motif elements are complete: side view, crest, neck stretched down, fish in the closing beak, droplets, two legs breaking into ripple rings, reeds and floating leaves at left, a dragonfly on a reed tip, the far bank. Format is 1536x1024 landscape as requested. No logo, signature or anatomy error found.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-4.note_de: Das Bild ist als Landschaft mit Uferstreifen und Wasserfläche komponiert, die Höhlenmalerei nicht kennt, und die Felsstruktur wirkt wie ein Filter.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-4.note_en: The image is composed as a landscape with a far bank and water surface, which Paleolithic art never shows, and the rock texture looks like a filter.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-4.alt_de: Höhlenmalerei in Ocker und Holzkohle auf rissigem Kalkstein: Ein Reiher mit dunklem Rücken packt im Flachwasser einen Fisch, umgeben von Wasserringen, links Schilf mit Libelle und Schwimmblättern.
animal/paleolithic-cave-painting-4.alt_en: Cave painting in ochre and charcoal on cracked limestone: a dark-backed heron snatches a fish in shallow water amid ripple rings, with reeds, a dragonfly and floating leaves at left.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities: the counted figures are JUN 8 (2x4), JUL 24 (4x6), AUG 18 (3x6), SEP 5, so they match neither 12/30/24/6 nor any single unit (JUL is 3x JUN instead of 2.5x, AUG is 2.25x JUN instead of 2x)
problems: The pictogram counts (8, 24, 18, 5) contradict the printed values 12, 30, 24, 6. There is no consistent unit, so the encoding is not honest or proportional, which is the core of what this motif tests.
Decorative ferry scene with 9 seated passengers fills the upper third. It is extra ornament and could be read as an extra quantity.
Island drifts from the style: overlapping rolling hills give slight depth, Mediterranean cypresses instead of rows of identical trees, and blocky houses with a hint of volume.
Lettering is plain red-brown capitals but not in ruled boxes (minor).

Otherwise convincing: flaking whitewashed plaster, zigzag blue water panel, stacked registers on ruled ground lines, profile figures, red-brown men and pale ochre women. No hieroglyphs or deities, no logo, correct 1536x1024 landscape format, no visible anatomy errors.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.note_de: Die gezählten Figuren (8, 24, 18, 5) passen nicht zu den Zahlen 12, 30, 24 und 6 und sind nicht proportional. Alle Beschriftungen stimmen, aber die Zahl der Figuren (8, 24, 18, 5) passt zu keinem festen Wert pro Figur, und der Juni wirkt im Vergleich zum Juli zu klein.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.note_en: The counted figures (8, 24, 18, 5) do not match the numbers 12, 30, 24 and 6 and are not proportional. All labels are correct, but the figure counts (8, 24, 18, 5) match no fixed value per figure, and June looks too small next to July.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: Unter dem Titel ein Fährboot auf Zickzackwellen vor einer Insel, darunter gestapelte Reihen schreitender Männer und Frauen für Juni bis September mit Zahlen.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on flaking plaster: a ferry on zigzag waves nears an island; below, stacked rows of striding men and women count June to September, with numbers.
text_errors: expected figure counts proportional to 12:30:24:6, found 8:24:18:5 walking figures (JUN 2x4, JUL 4x6, AUG 3x6, SEP 5); no consistent value per figure (1.5 / 1.25 / 1.33 / 1.2 passengers each)
expected JUL:JUN ratio 2.5, found 3.0 (JUN about 17% too small relative to JUL); AUG -6% and SEP +4% are within tolerance

motif_missing: fourth leaf (branch carries only three leaves: one bitten, one curled, one plain)
problems: Only three leaves on the branch instead of four; the small green parts behind the blossom are sepals, not leaves
Style drifts toward a polished, naturalistic clay miniature or CG clay: very fine realistic surface detail, soft diffuse light with soft shadows instead of small hard studio-lamp shadows
No shallow tabletop stage: no set edges, no painted backdrop, branch and fruit float freely in the air, so it does not read as a 1970s-90s children's-TV animation frame
Clay material itself is convincing (matte, scored textures, unmixed colours)
Other motif elements present and correct: five-petalled blossom, closed bud, lumpy ripe fruit, curled leaf, bitten leaf, lengthwise half with core and seeds, single seed, detached petal, empty ground
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, signature or watermark
botanical/clay-animation-3.note_de: Am Zweig sitzen nur drei statt vier Blätter, und die feine Knetplastik wirkt eher wie ein Miniaturmodell als wie ein Trickfilmbild.
botanical/clay-animation-3.note_en: The branch has only three leaves instead of four, and the finely sculpted clay looks more like a miniature model than an animation frame.
botanical/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Matte Knete vor Blau: Quittenzweig mit zartrosa Blüte, Knospe, drei Blättern (eines angefressen) und gelber Frucht; darunter eine halbierte Quitte, ein Kern und ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Matte modelling clay on blue: a quince branch with pale pink blossom, bud, three leaves (one bitten) and yellow fruit; below, a halved quince, a seed and a petal.

motif_missing: woman presses the hull with only one visible hand, not both
problems: Continuous scene with a sea band as horizon, a boat in perspective and a 3D toolbox, all of which the style block excludes
Figures modelled with clothing folds and detailed faces instead of crude single-contour side-view silhouettes
Blue-grey pigment for the sea, outside the ochre/charcoal palette
Fine woven, canvas-like texture laid over the rock surface
Correct elements: ochre and charcoal on cracked limestone, dotted ground, wavy-line water, ladder-like jetty, silhouetted gulls
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-5.note_de: Wirkt eher wie eine moderne Illustration auf Fels: Meereshorizont, perspektivisches Boot und blaue Farbe passen nicht zur Höhlenmalerei.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-5.note_en: Reads more like a modern illustration on rock: the sea horizon, perspective boat and blue pigment don't belong in cave painting.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-5.alt_de: Ocker und Kohle auf rissigem Kalkstein: Eine grauhaarige Frau kniet am umgedrehten Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze hämmert einen Nagel ein; Kiste, Seil, Nageldose, Wellenlinien, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/paleolithic-cave-painting-5.alt_en: Ochre and charcoal on cracked limestone: a grey-haired woman kneels at an upturned boat, a young man in a cap hammers a nail; toolbox, rope, nail tin, sea, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: woman's grey hair is mid-length and pinned up, not short
problems: Reads as a modern photoreal/HDR image: pore-level skin, wood-grain and pebble micro-detail instead of smooth, dense dye-transfer colour
Real-looking sea with reflections and a deep vista to a headland with a lighthouse instead of a shallow sound-stage set; only the sky looks like a painted backdrop
Muted palette without a clear jewel accent or opaque blacks; close two-shot rather than a static eye-level medium-long frieze
Hands, objects, gulls and jetty are otherwise correct; no logos or text
people/three-strip-technicolor-5.note_de: Wirkt wie ein modernes, detailscharfes Foto mit echtem Meer und weiter Fernsicht, nicht wie ein farbsatter Studiofilm der 1940er.
people/three-strip-technicolor-5.note_en: Looks like a modern, hyper-detailed photo with a real sea and deep vista, not a saturated 1940s studio film frame.
people/three-strip-technicolor-5.alt_de: Filmstill-Optik mit gemaltem Wolkenhimmel: Ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt eine helle Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, eine grauhaarige Frau drückt sie an; Kiesstrand, Werkzeugkiste, Seil, Steg mit zwei Möwen.
people/three-strip-technicolor-5.alt_en: Film-still look with painted sky: a young man in a knitted cap nails a pale plank to an upturned boat while a grey-haired woman holds it; toolbox, rope, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: woman reaches one open hand toward the plank instead of pressing it into place with both hands
woman wears a hair bun rather than short hair
problems: Boat and toolbox drawn in perspective; figures overlap the boat, against the flat no-overlap Warli rule
Figures about 40% of picture height, far above the Warli fifth; the man's body is a coat shape rather than two joined triangles
Gulls drawn as naturalistic silhouettes instead of triangle-bodied birds
Correct elements: white paste on red-brown ground, faceless circle heads, wavy water band with fish, dotted pebble ground
people/warli-painting-5.note_de: Boot und Werkzeugkiste sind perspektivisch gezeichnet, und die Frau drückt die Planke nicht mit beiden Händen an.
people/warli-painting-5.note_en: The boat and toolbox are drawn in perspective, and the woman does not press the plank with both hands.
people/warli-painting-5.alt_de: Weiße Reispaste auf rotbraunem Lehm: Eine kniende Frau mit Dutt und ein hockender Mann mit Mütze und Hammer, gesichtslose Dreiecksfiguren, reparieren ein umgedrehtes Boot; Wellen mit Fischen, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/warli-painting-5.alt_en: White rice paste on red-brown mud: faceless triangle figures, a kneeling woman and a crouching man with cap and hammer, mend an upturned boat; waves with fish, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: no distinct new plank; the woman presses the existing top strake
problems: A recoloured sharp photograph, which the style block explicitly excludes: crisp facial features, individual hair strands, knit, fabric, wood-grain and pebble texture instead of a coarse 320x240 heat map with soft face masks

Heat logic is wrong: the steel hammer head and nail tin glow orange-yellow though metal should read darkest; the woman's hair is the brightest area; the room-temperature boat and rope are as warm as skin
No coarse pixels or sensor stripes; crosshair and colour scale are the only thermal-camera cues
people/thermal-imaging-4.note_de: Ein umgefärbtes, gestochen scharfes Foto statt Wärmebild: Hammer und Nageldose glühen, obwohl Metall am kältesten erscheinen müsste.
people/thermal-imaging-4.note_en: A recoloured sharp photo rather than a heat map: the hammer and nail tin glow although metal should read coldest.
people/thermal-imaging-4.alt_de: Wärmebild in Violett, Orange und Gelb mit Fadenkreuz und Farbskala: Eine Frau drückt eine Planke auf das umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann mit Mütze schlägt den Nagel ein; Möwen, Steg.
people/thermal-imaging-4.alt_en: Thermal image in violet, orange and yellow with crosshair: a woman presses a plank onto an upturned boat as a young man in a cap hammers; gulls, jetty.

problems: Edge-to-edge continuous scene with a horizon, background island, house and pine trees instead of separate clips on white with grey shadow ellipses
Figures are modern comic style with detailed faces, wrinkles and clothing shading, not stiff side-view figures with big round heads and dot eyes
Detailed, multicoloured pebble beach instead of a small flat ground patch
Correct elements: thick uniform black outlines, flat fills in red, royal blue, green and tan, white sky
people/1990s-clip-art-5.note_de: Eher moderner Comic als Clipart der 90er: eine durchgehende Szene mit Horizont statt einzelner Clips auf Weiß.
people/1990s-clip-art-5.note_en: Closer to a modern comic than 1990s clip art: one continuous scene with a horizon instead of separate clips on white.
people/1990s-clip-art-5.alt_de: Clipart-Zeichnung mit dicken schwarzen Konturen und Flachfarben: Eine grauhaarige Frau in grüner Schürze drückt eine Planke ans umgedrehte Boot, ein junger Mann mit blauer Mütze hämmert; Kiesstrand, Steg, zwei Möwen.
people/1990s-clip-art-5.alt_en: Clip-art drawing, thick black outlines, flat colours: a grey-haired woman in a green apron presses a plank to an upturned boat while a young man hammers; pebbles, jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: the older woman reads as an old man (wild spiky grey hair, no female cues)
woman presses the plank with only one visible hand
problems: A skilled illustration with a pixel filter, which the style block excludes, rather than a crude mouse drawing: competent anatomy, three-quarter views, foreshortened boat
Detailed pebble beach, perspective jetty and background island with houses instead of a straight ground line and sign-like setting
No shaky stair-stepped pencil lines, bucket-fill leaks or spray-can speckle; outlines are neat dashed contours
people/ms-paint-style-4.note_de: Eine gekonnte, nur verpixelte Illustration statt einer krakeligen Paint-Mauszeichnung; die ältere Frau wirkt zudem wie ein alter Mann.
people/ms-paint-style-4.note_en: A skilled illustration with a pixel filter rather than a crude Paint mouse drawing; the older woman also reads as an old man.
people/ms-paint-style-4.alt_de: Pixelige Zeichnung in kräftigen Grundfarben: Ein junger Mann mit grüner Mütze schlägt einen Nagel ins umgedrehte Boot, eine ältere Person mit wirrem Grauhaar drückt die Planke an; Kiesstrand, Steg, Möwen.
people/ms-paint-style-4.alt_en: Pixelated drawing in primary colours: a young man in a green cap nails a plank onto an upturned boat, held by an older figure with wild grey hair; jetty, gulls.

motif_missing: village has only three or four houses beside the chapel instead of five or six
problems: Surface and palette match the style (Egyptian blue, greens, ochres, red-brown outlines, flaking whitewash, zigzag water panels, profile kilted figure, geese), but the spatial system is a Western perspective landscape: horizon, open sky, river receding to a vanishing point, trees and hills shrinking with distance, blue mountain range as a backdrop. The style block explicitly forbids horizon, sky and landscape depth and asks for stacked registers on ruled ground lines; only the terraced fields hint at registers.
Reads as an Egyptian palette/texture applied to a default AI landscape composition (filter-like).
Cypresses and a chapel with cross are motif-driven, acceptable.
No anatomy errors; figure on bridge is a clean profile walker. No logo, signature, watermark or real landmark. Format 1536x1024 landscape correct.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Horizont, Himmel und Tiefenstaffelung widersprechen dem flachen ägyptischen Registerstil, und das Dorf hat zu wenige Häuser.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Horizon, sky and receding depth break the flat Egyptian register style, and the village has too few houses.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Kalkputz in Blau und Ocker: Ein Fluss mit Zickzackwellen windet sich durchs Tal, ein Mann im Schurz quert die Bogenbrücke, vorn Baum und Bank.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian-style wall painting in blue and ochre on flaking plaster: a zigzag-patterned river winds through the valley, a kilted man crosses the arched bridge, an old tree shades a bench.

problems: Not New Color Photography: this is the picture-postcard view the style block forbids, with a tree framing the left edge and top, the river as a scenic leading line, a picturesque village and lush dense green slopes.

Modern HDR-like clarity and saturation; no dense dye-transfer palette, no deadpan square-on stacked bands, no unremarkable roadside fact (poles, wires, kerbs, asphalt). The main subject is not small and off-centre among clutter; it is staged as a hero vista.
Only the hard sunny light and clear sky match the brief; overall it reads as a generic AI travel photo.

Motif complete: raised viewpoint, winding river, single-arch stone bridge with one tiny figure, about six houses plus a chapel with bell tower, terraced left slope, forested right slope, old tree with bench, jagged ridge, five birds. No anatomy issues, logo, signature or watermark; village and bridge not identifiable as a real landmark. Format 1536x1024 landscape correct.
landscape/new-color-photography-4.note_de: Glänzende Postkartenansicht mit rahmendem Baum und HDR-Schärfe statt nüchterner Farbfotografie der 1970er.
landscape/new-color-photography-4.note_en: A glossy picture-postcard view with a framing tree and HDR sharpness instead of a plain, deadpan 1970s colour photograph.
landscape/new-color-photography-4.alt_de: Scharfes Postkarten-Farbfoto im Sonnenlicht: Unter einem alten Baum eine Holzbank, unten ein Fluss mit Steinbogenbrücke, daneben ein Dorf mit Kapelle, dahinter bewaldete Hänge und schroffe Berge.
landscape/new-color-photography-4.alt_en: Crisp, postcard-like color photo in bright sun: a wooden bench under an old tree overlooks a river, a stone arch bridge and a village with a chapel below jagged mountains.

motif_missing: glue tube is carried under the arm against the body, not on her shoulder
problems: Not a cutaway at all: the cup is shown whole in three-quarter perspective with an elliptical rim, no strict side section, no solid cut-edge band, no inner chambers, pipes, chutes or belts
Horizon line, scrubby landscape ground and visible cast shadows, all explicitly excluded by the style block
No coarse four-colour halftone; rendering is modelled vintage-lithograph/storybook painting with volumetric shading, not flat opaque gouache
Figures are modelled 3D people of varying size, not tiny flat profile workers of one size
Palette leans to cream and cobalt-blue porcelain rather than dulled red, ochre, teal, cream
Reads as a generic 'vintage illustration' default rather than a popular-science cutaway
Minor motif drift: glue tube held under the arm rather than on the shoulder
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.note_de: Kein Schnittbild: Die Tasse steht perspektivisch in einer Landschaft mit Horizont, statt im flachen Seitenschnitt gezeigt zu werden.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.note_en: Not a cutaway: the cup is drawn in perspective in a landscape with a horizon instead of in flat side section.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.alt_de: Vintage-Illustration in Creme und Kobaltblau: Drei kleine Arbeiter flicken eine riesige, gesprungene Porzellantasse – einer näht auf der Leiter, einer lässt einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau trägt eine Klebetube.
editorial/retro-popular-science-cutaway-.alt_en: Vintage-style illustration in cream and cobalt: three tiny workers mend a giant cracked porcelain cup; one stitches from a ladder, one lowers a bucket from the rim, a woman carries a glue tube.

motif_missing: The woman pushes the bicycle toward the lower right, i.e. down the lane, not up the slope
problems: The composition uses linear perspective: a receding cobbled lane, buildings and trees that shrink with distance, and a small bell tower in the background. No stacked registers or ruled ground lines; reads as a European storybook street with an Egyptian surface texture.
Cypresses and houses overlap in depth instead of appearing as rows of signs.
The house number '12' is a black serif typeface, not a one-colour brush numeral in a ruled box.
The Egyptian cues are mostly the flaking whitewash, the palette and the two profile figures (red-brown man, pale ochre woman, frontal eye).
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.note_de: Die Gasse ist perspektivisch gemalt statt in flachen Registern, und die Frau schiebt das Rad bergab statt bergauf.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.note_en: The lane is painted in perspective rather than flat registers, and the woman pushes her bicycle downhill instead of uphill.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf abblätterndem Putz: Bäckerei mit Markise und Brezelschild, Hund vor der Bank, am Fenster wird ein Teppich ausgeschüttelt, eine Frau schiebt ihr Rad die Pflastergasse entlang.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.alt_en: Egyptian-style painting on flaking plaster: bakery with awning and pretzel sign, dog by the bench, rug shaken from a window, a woman in profile pushing her bicycle over cobbles.

motif_missing: The hand holds an already torn piece above the soup instead of tearing it off a bread slice (minor)
problems: Medium break: the round loaf, its slices and the crumbs are photorealistic real bread (real crumb structure and crust), although the style block explicitly forbids real food and requires all matte modelling clay
The folded napkin is a photographic woven textile, not clay
Butter is glossy and naturalistic, soup surface with pepper flecks looks real; knife blade and spoon read as real metal

Result is a photo composite with clay props (hand, bowl, basil, tomatoes, painted backdrop) rather than an all-clay tabletop frame; slightly elevated camera and soft receding background instead of a flat stage at figure height
All motif objects present; drip on bowl rim, crumbs, knife mark in butter visible; square 1024x1024 format correct; no logos or landmarks; hand anatomy fine
food/clay-animation-4.note_de: Brot und Serviette sehen fotografisch echt aus statt nach Knete – der Stil bricht genau beim Hauptmotiv.
food/clay-animation-4.note_en: The bread and napkin look photographically real rather than clay, so the style breaks at the very centre of the motif.
food/clay-animation-4.alt_de: Knetszene vor Lehmhaus, Kugelbäumen und Hügeln: Eine Knethand hält Brot über eine Tonschale Tomatensuppe, daneben Butter, Basilikum und Kirschtomaten; Laib und Serviette wirken fotografisch echt.
food/clay-animation-4.alt_en: Clay scene before a clay house, ball trees and hills: a clay hand holds bread over a bowl of tomato soup beside butter, basil and cherry tomatoes; loaf and napkin look photographic.

motif_missing: Counted passenger figures do not match the labels: JUN shows 10 figures (label 12), JUL 29 (label 30), AUG 23 (label 24), SEP 5 (label 6)
