problems: The image reads as the generic AI or stock travel-postcard look (saturated, HDR-like, golden), not a 1970s New Color view-camera print. It lacks the dense, sober print quality, fine grain and flat matter-of-fact framing.
The nearest tree is cropped at the top and left edges and used as a framing device. The style block requires that even the nearest tree stand whole with sky around it.
Style-defining elements are missing: no utility wires crossing the sky, no poles, fences or parked car near the subject, and no plain gravel, asphalt or verge strip across the bottom.
The distant mountains are large, sharp and dramatic and dominate the centre. The style asks for small, pale distant mountains.
The composition is a picturesque, centred valley vista seen from a slope. It is not the level, eye-height, standing-well-back ordinary-place view of the style.
Minor: some houses sit on the left slope away from the cluster next to the bridge, so the village is spread out rather than one cluster of five or six houses.

product/three-strip-technicolor-9.alt_de: Technicolor-Studioszene: braunes Kofferradio mit cremefarbener Front und Messingknöpfen auf gesprenkeltem Stein, links rote Geranien in einer Steinurne, dahinter eine gemalte Kulisse mit Meer und Felsküste.
product/three-strip-technicolor-9.alt_en: Technicolor studio scene: a brown portable radio with cream front and brass knobs on speckled stone, red geraniums in a stone urn, and a painted backdrop of sea and cliffs.

motif_missing: bread knife has a plain, unserrated blade
problems: The style block asks for a flat low-relief slab of clay seen square to the camera, with farther things higher up. The image is instead a deep three-quarter tabletop scene with a chair and wall behind it.
The loaf, slices, crumbs, butter and wood grain are rendered almost photographically, with realistic crumb holes, flour dusting and creamy butter, so they do not read as pressed clay.
Only the hand, the knitted sleeve, the chair, the bowls and the tomatoes read as modelling clay. The result is a mixed clay/photo look, close to the generic AI 'claymation' style.
The hand has realistic proportions and is no mitten hand.
Format is correct (1254x1254 square). No logo or watermark.
food/clay-animation-8.note_de: Statt flachem Knetrelief eine räumliche Tischszene, Brot und Butter wirken fotografisch.
food/clay-animation-8.note_en: Instead of a flat clay relief it shows a deep tabletop scene, and the bread and butter look photographic.
food/clay-animation-8.alt_de: Knetszene in Schrägansicht auf Holztisch: Eine Hand aus Terrakotta-Knete reißt ein Stück von einer Brotscheibe, daneben blaue Schale mit Tomatensuppe, Butter, Rispentomaten und Leinentuch; das Brot wirkt fotografisch.
food/clay-animation-8.alt_en: Angled clay scene on a wooden table: a terracotta-clay hand tears bread beside a blue bowl of tomato soup, butter, vine tomatoes and a linen napkin; the loaf looks photographic.

problems: The style block's material mapping is ignored. The bread should be one brown lump with flat cream cut faces, but it is photoreal, with an open crumb, flour-dusted crust and realistic crumbs.
The linen napkin shows a real woven fabric texture with loose threads instead of a rolled-thin clay sheet with pinched folds.
The soup and the wooden table look photographic rather than like smoothed clay sheets or combed brown clay.
Only the hand, the sleeve, the chair, the tomatoes and the basil read as clay. The result is a hybrid with a photo look rather than a clay-animation frame.
The hand holds the torn piece in mid-air; the tearing off a slice is only implied. Hand anatomy is fine.
Format is correct (1254x1254 square). No logo or watermark.
food/clay-animation-9.note_de: Brot, Suppe und Leinentuch wirken fotografisch statt aus Knete geformt.
food/clay-animation-9.note_en: The bread, soup and linen napkin look photographic rather than modelled in clay.
food/clay-animation-9.alt_de: Knetszene vor gemalter blauer Wand: Eine Tonhand im Strickärmel hält ein abgerissenes Brotstück über Laib und Scheiben, daneben Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale, Butter, Rispentomaten, Basilikum und ein fotografisch wirkendes Leinentuch.
food/clay-animation-9.alt_en: Clay scene before a painted blue wall: a clay hand holds torn bread above the loaf, beside tomato soup with a cream swirl, butter and vine tomatoes; bread looks photographic.

motif_missing: the knife on the board is pointed with a plain edge, not a serrated bread knife
the hand dips a bread piece over the soup instead of tearing it off a slice
problems: The clay look is the strongest of the three. The painted card backdrop shows a window landscape and plants, and the blue bowl, butter dish, tomatoes, napkin and chunky hand read as clay.
The loaf and slices are still nearly photoreal, with an open crumb, flour dusting and graded browns. This breaks the rule that every part is one unmixed shop colour, edge to edge.
The table wood has realistic grain and tonal variation rather than even clay colour.
The landscape in the window is generic, not a real landmark. Hand anatomy is fine.
Format is correct (1254x1254 square). No logo or watermark.
food/clay-animation-10.note_de: Das Brot wirkt fotografisch statt geknetet, und das Messer ist kein Brotmesser.
food/clay-animation-10.note_en: The bread looks photographic rather than modelled, and the knife is not a bread knife.
food/clay-animation-10.alt_de: Knetszene vor blauer Pappkulisse mit gemaltem Fenster: Eine Tonhand hält ein Brotstück über eine blaue Schale Tomatensuppe mit Sahnespirale, daneben Laib, Butter in Knetschälchen, Rispentomaten, Basilikum und gestreiftes Tuch.
food/clay-animation-10.alt_en: Clay scene before blue painted card: a clay hand holds bread over a blue bowl of tomato soup with cream swirl, beside the loaf, butter, vine tomatoes and striped cloth.

motif_missing: River ends in a pool behind the town houses instead of visibly flowing into the bay
problems: Style drift: an oblique 3D tabletop diorama with free-standing miniature trees and finely sculpted, near-photoreal rocks, where the style block asks for a flat clay slab in low relief, shot square to the camera; this is the generic AI clay-map look
Clay surface is convincing (matte, fingerprints, clay-snake letters on cream plaques, clay waves), so the medium still reads as clay
No anatomy issues, logos, landmarks or watermarks; format 1:1 as requested (1254x1254)
map/clay-animation-6.note_de: Eher räumliches Knetdiorama als flaches Relief, und der Fluss endet hinter der Stadt statt in der Bucht.
map/clay-animation-6.note_en: More a 3D clay diorama than a flat relief, and the river ends behind the town instead of reaching the bay.
map/clay-animation-6.alt_de: Knetanimation: Lornholm als Knetrelief auf blauem Knetmeer, mit Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Fluss, Leuchtturm im Norden, Hafenstadt mit drei Booten, Wald im Süden, Wal und Beschriftung aus Knetwürsten.
map/clay-animation-6.alt_en: Clay animation: Lornholm as a modelling-clay relief in a blue clay sea, with hilltop windmill, river, northern lighthouse, harbour town with three boats, southern forest, a whale and clay-snake lettering.

motif_missing: River does not reach the bay: it runs south from the hill under a bridge and ends in the meadow at the forest edge
problems: Geographic logic error: the river dead-ends inland, far from the western harbour bay
Island reads more as a broad landmass with a western bay than as a clear crescent
Style: generic oblique clay diorama with warm yellowish light and soft painterly finish, not a straight-on relief under white studio lamps; clay-snake lettering and matte clay texture are present
No anatomy issues, logos, landmarks or watermarks; format 1:1 as requested
map/clay-animation-7.note_de: Der Fluss endet mitten im Land, statt in die Bucht zu münden.
map/clay-animation-7.note_en: The river ends inland instead of flowing into the bay.
map/clay-animation-7.alt_de: Knetanimation in warmem Licht: Insel Lornholm als Knetdiorama, Hafenstadt Varn mit Holzstegen und drei Booten in der Westbucht, Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Leuchtturm im Norden, Wald im Süden, Wal.
map/clay-animation-7.alt_en: Clay animation in warm light: Lornholm as a clay diorama, harbour town Varn with wooden piers and three boats in the western bay, hilltop windmill, northern lighthouse, southern forest, whale.

motif_missing: Town Varn sits on a separate islet surrounded by water, not on the crescent island itself
The winding road links only windmill and lighthouse; it does not reach the town
problems: Geographic logic error: the harbour town is cut off from the main island, so the town-windmill-lighthouse road link is broken
Style is the closest of the three to the brief: bright unmixed shop colours, chunky rounded forms, clay-snake letters, but still an oblique 3D diorama rather than a straight-on relief
No anatomy issues, logos, landmarks or watermarks; format 1:1 as requested
map/clay-animation-8.note_de: Die Stadt liegt auf einer eigenen kleinen Insel, die Straße erreicht sie nicht.
map/clay-animation-8.note_en: The town sits on its own islet, and the road does not reach it.
map/clay-animation-8.alt_de: Knetanimation in ungemischten Knetfarben: Lornholm mit Windmühle auf dem Hügel, Feldern, Fluss, Leuchtturm im Norden, Wald im Süden; Varn liegt mit drei Booten auf einer kleinen Nebeninsel, dazu ein Wal.
map/clay-animation-8.alt_en: Clay animation in plain, unmixed clay colours: Lornholm with hilltop windmill, fields, river, northern lighthouse and southern forest; Varn and three boats sit on a separate islet; a whale.

problems: Measured bar heights (baseline y=788): JUN 224, JUL 535, AUG 433, SEP 112 px. Best fit is 18.0 px/unit, so JUN and SEP are about 4% tall and JUL about 1% short (JUL:SEP 4.78, JUL:JUN 2.39, AUG:JUN 1.93). That is within tolerance.
The island on the right is a soft landscape vignette with Italian-looking cypresses, not an Egyptian convention. This is minor style drift.
The frayed, aged edges look like a digital 'old fresco' frame.
The ferry carries an anachronistic canopy and blue box structure. This is decoration only, not part of the motif.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-9.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf Putz mit rotem Hilfsraster: vier flache Farbbalken zeigen 12, 30, 24 und 6 Fahrgäste; links steigt eine Familie im Profil einen Steg hinauf, rechts wartet ein Fährmann.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-9.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on gridded plaster: four flat colour bars show 12, 30, 24 and 6 passengers; a family in profile climbs a gangplank, a ferryman waits in his boat.

motif_missing: July band holds 31 passenger figures instead of 30
August band holds 23 passenger figures instead of 24
problems: The chart uses one seated figure per passenger: JUN has exactly 12 and SEP exactly 6. A count of hair blobs, checked by eye in zoomed crops, gives JUL 31 and AUG 23, so the pictogram counts contradict the labels 30 and 24.
Two pictograms in the July row are malformed: at x≈590 a figure with messy hair, turned and blurred, and at x≈1105 a smaller, misshapen figure.
Measured band lengths (shared left edge x=180): JUN 476, JUL 1235, AUG 974, SEP 265 px. SEP is about 8% too long against the fit, and JUL:SEP is 4.66 instead of 5.
The ferry is a modern motor launch with a glazed wheelhouse and a white-and-black hull, which breaks the 1400 BC look.
The flat-roofed houses on the right island read as modern Mediterranean buildings.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-10.note_de: Die Figurenreihen passen nicht zu den Zahlen: Im Juli sitzen 31, im August nur 23 Fahrgäste. Die Figuren lassen sich einzeln zählen, aber der Juli zeigt 31 statt 30 und der August 23 statt 24, obwohl die Zahlen daneben stimmen.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-10.note_en: The figure rows do not match the numbers: July shows 31 passengers, August only 23. Each figure stands for one passenger, but July shows 31 instead of 30 and August 23 instead of 24, even though the numbers beside them are right.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-10.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei in Registern: oben steigen Reisende über einen Steg in eine Fähre, darunter vier blaue Bänder aus sitzenden Figuren für Juni bis September mit 12, 30, 24 und 6.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-10.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting in registers: travellers walk up a gangplank onto a ferry; below, four blue bands of seated figures for June to September, labelled 12, 30, 24, 6.
text_errors: expected 30 seated figures in the JUL row, found 31
expected 24 seated figures in the AUG row, found 23

motif_missing: September bar too short: July is 5.5 times September instead of 5 times
problems: Measured bar heights (ground line y=813): JUN 227, JUL 548, AUG 439, SEP 99.5 px. Best fit is 18.25 px/unit, so SEP should be about 110 px and is about 10% short. JUN:SEP is 2.28 instead of 2.
The style block asks for ruled lines behind the bars. None are visible.
The quay at the left is naturalistic grey stone masonry rather than a flat Egyptian sign.
Otherwise the image is faithful: single-colour bars of equal width on one ground line, numerals above, zigzag water strip, rows of rounded tree crowns and flat house fronts.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-11.note_de: Der September-Balken ist rund zehn Prozent zu kurz.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-11.note_en: The September bar is about ten percent too short.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-11.alt_de: Thebanische Grabmalerei auf Kalkputz: vier gleich breite blaue Balken auf einer Grundlinie mit 12, 30, 24 und 6, links steigen Reisende ins Boot, rechts ein Inseldorf mit Palmen.
chart/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-11.alt_en: Theban tomb painting on whitewash: four equal-width blue bars on one ground line read 12, 30, 24 and 6; left, travellers board a boat; right, a palm-lined island village.

problems: Composition is a Western perspective landscape: the river recedes into the distance, the blue mountains fade with aerial perspective, and the hills are modelled. There are no registers on ruled ground lines and no water panel seen from above.
Overall look is a Mediterranean or Tuscan illustrated landscape with a speckled fresco or mosaic texture (cypresses, terracotta-roofed village), not a Theban tomb painting.
Egyptian cues are only surface additions: zigzag water lines, a faint grid, an ochre dado strip at the bottom, and a tiny red-brown figure in a kilt.

All motif elements are present: river, single-arch bridge with one figure, five or six houses plus a chapel, terraces on the left, forest on the right, a leaning old tree with a bench, birds and a jagged ridge. Format is correct (1536x1024). No logo, signature or real landmark.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Wirkt wie eine mediterrane Landschaftsillustration mit Tiefenperspektive, nicht wie ägyptische Wandmalerei mit Standlinien.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Reads as a Mediterranean perspective landscape illustration, not an Egyptian wall painting built on ground lines.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Wandmalerei auf hellem Putz mit Rasterlinien: Fluss mit Zickzackwellen, Steinbogenbrücke mit kleiner Figur, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassenhang, Wald, alter Baum mit Bank, Gänse vor blauen Bergen.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Wall painting on gridded pale plaster: zigzag-rippled river, arched stone bridge with a small figure, village with chapel, terraced slope, forest, old tree with bench, geese, blue mountains.

problems: Many details fit the style: flat colour with red-brown outlines, bare whitewash sky, rows of rounded tree crowns, pink ground strips with red dots and ruled edges, papyrus clumps, and a red-brown man in a white kilt on the bridge.

The composition still uses deep Western perspective: the river winds toward a vanishing distance, the plain is dotted with shrinking trees, and the mountains form layered ranges. There are no registers on ground lines.
The bench is drawn in three-quarter view and the whitewashed village looks Greek or Mediterranean. Both pull the image toward a generic illustrated landscape.

All motif elements are present: river, single-arch bridge with one figure, about five houses and a chapel, terraced left slope, forested right slope, a leaning old tree with a bench, birds and a jagged ridge. Format is correct (1536x1024). No logo, signature or real landmark.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Tiefenperspektive statt flacher Register auf Standlinien – ägyptisch wirken vor allem die Details.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: Uses deep Western perspective instead of flat registers on ground lines; mainly the details look Egyptian.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Flächige Malerei im ägyptischen Stil mit rotbraunen Umrissen: Fluss mit Zickzackwellen und Papyrus, Brücke mit Mann im Schurz, weiße Häuser mit Kapelle, Terrassen, rot getupfter Boden, alter Baum mit Bank.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Flat Egyptian-style painting with red-brown outlines: zigzag-rippled river with papyrus, bridge with a man in a kilt, white houses and chapel, terraces, red-dotted ground, old tree with bench.

problems: Drift toward the default illustrated look: the scene has modern pictorial depth (horizon line with a distant headland, sea receding into the distance) instead of a flat frieze on a cord-ruled ground line
Jetty drawn in perspective with mirrored reflections in the water, which is foreign to Theban tomb painting
Both gulls are rendered naturalistically with modelled shading, not as flat outlined side views
Boat hull shown with perspective curvature and weathered wood-grain texture rather than a flat side elevation

Torsos in three-quarter view rather than the frontal-shoulder convention; Egyptian conventions (profile head, frontal eye, red-brown man, pale-yellow woman, zigzag water, dotted ground) are applied to an otherwise modern composition
Minor: the woman's near hand has simplified, partly merged fingers (small, not prominent)
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-8.note_de: Steg mit Spiegelungen, Horizont und naturalistische Möwen brechen die flache ägyptische Bildordnung.
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-8.note_en: The jetty with reflections, the horizon and the naturalistic gulls break the flat Egyptian picture order.
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-8.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei, Figuren im Profil mit Frontalauge: Eine grauhaarige Frau und ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nageln eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot am Kiesstrand, dahinter Zickzackwellen, Steg und Möwen.
people/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-8.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting with profile figures: a grey-haired woman and a young man in a knitted cap nail a plank to an upturned boat; behind, zigzag sea, jetty and gulls.

problems: Composition is a continuous Western perspective landscape with atmospheric recession and overlapping, not friezes on cord-ruled ground lines with flat side elevations
Village reads Tuscan/Provençal: white houses with pitched terracotta roofs, church with bell tower, many cypresses
Old tree trunk modelled with shading rather than flat colour fields
Egyptian cues are only surface-level: zigzag blue water, one profile figure on the bridge, plaster texture, flying ducks, bottom brick band
Would read as a Mediterranean folk mural or Minoan-style fresco without the caption
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Perspektivische Mittelmeerlandschaft mit toskanisch wirkendem Dorf statt ägyptischer Friese auf Standlinien; nur Zickzackwasser und eine Figur erinnern an Grabmalerei.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: A perspective Mediterranean landscape with a Tuscan-looking village instead of Egyptian friezes on ground lines; only the zigzag water and one figure recall tomb painting.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptisch anmutende Wandmalerei auf hellem Putz in Blau, Ocker und Grün: Fluss mit Zickzackwellen, Steinbrücke mit Profilfigur, weißes Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassen, Baum mit Bank, Enten über blauen Bergen.
landscape/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Mural on pale plaster in blue, ochre and green: zigzag-waved river, stone bridge with profile figure, white village with chapel, terraces, tree with bench, ducks over blue mountains.

problems: Generic AI travel-postcard look: warm golden colour grade, glowing haze, picturesque framing
Foreground tree is cut off by the top and left edges and used as a framing device; the style asks for the nearest tree whole with sky above it, camera well back and square-on
No deadpan view-camera quality or dense dye-transfer colour; reads as a modern digital stock photo
Motif elements all present (single-arch bridge with one figure, village with chapel, terraces, forest, bench under leaning tree, birds, jagged ridge)
landscape/new-color-photography-8.note_de: Warmer Postkarten-Look mit angeschnittenem Rahmenbaum statt nüchterner, weit zurückgesetzter Großformat-Ansicht.
landscape/new-color-photography-8.note_en: A warm postcard look with a cropped framing tree instead of a sober, distant large-format view.
landscape/new-color-photography-8.alt_de: Farbfoto bei warmer Sonne: Unter einem angeschnittenen alten Baum steht eine Holzbank über dem Fluss, dahinter Steinbogenbrücke, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassenhang, bewaldeter Hang und zackige Berge.
landscape/new-color-photography-8.alt_en: Colour photograph in warm sun: wooden bench under a cropped old tree above the river; beyond, stone arch bridge, village with chapel, terraced and wooded slopes, jagged mountains.

motif_missing: at most one tiny figure on the bridge: two tiny figures stand on it (one at the left end, one at the apex)
problems: Two tiny figures on the bridge instead of at most one
Tree reaches almost to the top edge, against the style's rule that nothing rises above two thirds of the frame
Three-band layout, deep focus, high sun and pale hazy ridges are close to the style, but the overall feel drifts toward a picturesque travel photo with a slightly smooth digital finish
landscape/new-color-photography-9.note_de: Auf der Brücke stehen zwei winzige Figuren statt höchstens einer, und das Bild kippt leicht ins Reisefoto.
landscape/new-color-photography-9.note_en: Two tiny figures stand on the bridge instead of at most one, and the picture drifts slightly toward a travel photo.
landscape/new-color-photography-9.alt_de: Farbfoto im Mittagslicht unter blassblauem Himmel: Vorn trockenes Gras und ein schräger Baum mit Bank, in der Mitte Fluss, Steinbrücke, Dorf mit Kapelle, Terrassen, Wald, dahinter dunstige Felsgipfel.
landscape/new-color-photography-9.alt_en: Colour photograph, noon light, pale blue sky: dry grass and a leaning tree with bench in front; river, stone bridge, village with chapel, terraces, forest; hazy peaks beyond.

problems: Foreground tree is cropped by the top and left edges and frames the view like a travel photo; the style asks for the nearest tree whole with white sky above it
Overcast white-grey sky, deep focus and saturated local colour match the style block, but the crisp, slightly HDR finish drifts toward the default stock-photo look
Lower trunk leans away from the river before the upper trunk bends toward it (minor)
landscape/new-color-photography-10.note_de: Der Baum ist oben angeschnitten und rahmt das Bild wie ein Reisefoto, statt ganz und frei vor dem weißen Himmel zu stehen.
landscape/new-color-photography-10.note_en: The tree is cropped at the top and frames the view like a travel photo instead of standing whole against the white sky.
landscape/new-color-photography-10.alt_de: Farbfoto bei hellem, bedecktem Himmel: ein knorriger, oben angeschnittener Baum mit Bank am Hang, Fluss mit Steinbogenbrücke, Steinhäuser mit roten Dächern und Kapelle, Terrassen, bewaldete Hänge, helle Felsgipfel.
landscape/new-color-photography-10.alt_en: Colour photograph, white-grey overcast sky: gnarled tree cropped at the top, with bench; river, stone arch bridge, red-roofed stone houses and chapel, terraces, wooded slopes, pale peaks.

motif_missing: The cobbled lane shows no clear downward slope to the right; the woman walks away into a level lane rather than up a slope
The pretzel sign is a crude ring with a cross rather than a clear pretzel shape
problems: The style block demands plain American vernacular (clapboard, cinder block, tin roofs), but the image shows a picturesque Italian/Mediterranean stone village with terracotta roofs, cypresses and geraniums, which is the model's stock postcard look

Light is warm and glowing with lifted, soft shadows and a slight warm-filter haze instead of hard noon sun with short dark shadows; it reads as a contemporary digital travel photo, not 8x10 dye transfer
Positives: level, square-on view from across the street with asphalt along the bottom; deep focus
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logos or real landmarks; '12' present beside the door; no anatomy errors found (dog, rug woman, cyclist checked at full resolution)
street/new-color-photography-7.note_de: Statt eines schlichten amerikanischen Orts zeigt das Bild ein sonniges italienisches Postkartendorf im typischen KI-Look.
street/new-color-photography-7.note_en: Instead of a plain American place, it shows a sunny Italian postcard village in the typical AI look.
street/new-color-photography-7.alt_de: Farbfoto in warmem Sonnenlicht von gegenüber: helles Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Brezelschild und Hund an der Bank; oben schüttelt eine Frau einen Teppich aus, rechts Wäscheleine, Frau mit Fahrrad, Glockenturm.
street/new-color-photography-7.alt_en: Sunlit colour photograph from across the street: pale corner bakery, pretzel sign, dog by the bench; upstairs a woman shakes a rug; laundry line, woman pushing a bicycle, bell tower.

problems: Instead of an 'unremarkable place' it shows a picturesque Tuscan hill-town panorama (terracotta roofs, cypresses, vineyard valley), which is the generic AI postcard look

Composition breaks the block: the block asks for three bands with nothing rising above two thirds of the frame, but the corner building fills almost the full height, and the plain ground is only the bottom quarter
High sun, short shadows, deep focus and hazy distant ridges do match the block, but the surface is smooth and digital, with no dye-transfer density

Every motif element is present: bakery, awning, pretzel sign, bench with dog, rug, flower boxes, clothesline to the next house, lane sloping down to the right, woman pushing a bicycle with bread uphill, generic bell tower, '12' beside the door
Format correct (portrait); no logos or real landmarks; no anatomy errors found
street/new-color-photography-8.note_de: Ein malerisches toskanisches Postkartenmotiv statt eines unscheinbaren Orts; das Haus füllt die ganze Bildhöhe.
street/new-color-photography-8.note_en: A picturesque Tuscan postcard view rather than an unremarkable place; the house fills the full height of the frame.
street/new-color-photography-8.alt_de: Farbfoto in hoher Mittagssonne: rotes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, Brezelschild und Hund an der Bank; rechts schiebt eine Frau ihr Fahrrad die Gasse hinauf, unten Dächer und Glockenturm im Dunst.
street/new-color-photography-8.alt_en: Colour photograph in high midday sun: red corner bakery, pretzel sign, dog by the bench; a woman pushes her bicycle up the lane, hazy rooftops and bell tower below.

motif_missing: The pretzel sign hangs on the neighbouring white building to the left, not on the bakery's own building
problems: The block's light is followed well: bright high overcast, white-grey sky, matte surfaces, saturated local colour (red paint, dark green shutters, grey stone), pale far ridges, a strip of plain ground, small people going about their business
It still drifts toward the generic picturesque Italian lake-village travel photo (geraniums everywhere, lake, cypresses), and the surface is smooth digital rather than dense dye transfer
The clothesline starts at the top-floor window box and runs diagonally across the front of the facade before crossing to the next house (slightly odd but readable)
Extra element: an old man sits on the bench (allowed); the dog sits beside the bench
Format correct (portrait); '12' beside the door; no logos or real landmarks; no anatomy errors found
street/new-color-photography-9.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein Reisefoto aus einem italienischen Seedorf; das Brezelschild hängt am Nachbarhaus.
street/new-color-photography-9.note_en: Reads more like a travel photo of an Italian lake village; the pretzel sign hangs on the neighbouring house.
street/new-color-photography-9.alt_de: Farbfoto unter weißem Wolkenhimmel: rotes Eckhaus mit Bäckerei, alter Mann auf der Bank, daneben ein Beagle; oben Frau mit Teppich, rechts schiebt eine Frau ihr Fahrrad bergauf, dahinter ein See.
street/new-color-photography-9.alt_en: Colour photograph under white overcast sky: red corner bakery, old man on the bench beside a beagle, rug shaken from a window, woman pushing a bicycle uphill, lake beyond.

problems: The central idea of the style is there: a factory inside the cup with teal girders, red boilers, storeys, stairs, conveyors, chutes and small workers in overalls, all in muted red, ochre, teal and cream.
The style block asks for a phantom view in which the wall is a faint see-through skin. Here the porcelain wall is torn open with jagged holes and broken edges.

There is no coarse four-colour halftone. Up close the surface is a soft watercolour or digital-paint texture, not flat gouache in print, so it drifts toward the generic AI 'vintage illustration' look.
There is no soil slab cut straight in front: the dirt field runs back to the horizon and off the bottom edge.
The extra factory workers inside the cup come from the style, so they are acceptable, but they add figures beyond the motif's three.
The glue carrier wears a red polka-dot bandana, a Rosie-the-Riveter cliché. This is not a likeness, just a stock trope.

All motif elements are present: the ladder figure stitches with needle and thread, the rim sitter lowers a bucket on a rope, the woman carries the glue tube at her shoulder, shards lie around, and the upper left is empty. Format is 1536x1024 landscape, correct. No anatomy errors, logos or signature found.

problems: There is no cutaway at all: no tall sawn rectangular opening, no thick red band on the cut edge, and no factory interior with floors, stairs, boilers, pipes or tiny workers. The defining feature of the style is missing.
The result reads as a generic vintage storybook or magazine painting on yellowed paper, not a popular-science cutaway.
There is no coarse halftone, only a fine canvas-like texture.
There is no soil slab cut straight in front; the ground runs off the frame.
The glue carrier wears a red polka-dot bandana, a Rosie-the-Riveter cliché. This is a trope, not a likeness.

All motif elements are present: the ladder figure stitches the crack with needle and thread, the rim sitter lowers a bucket on a rope into the cup, the woman carries the glue tube on her shoulder, shards lie around, and the upper left is empty. problems: Information architecture ignores the style block: not one building with a storey per step joined by chutes, but six separate picture panels in a zigzag of red arrows (motif tests exactly this).
Only step 3 (Mill) is a real cutaway (walls removed, storeys, stairs, belt drive, two workers in overalls); the other five panels are generic vintage close-up illustrations.
No phantom-view see-through skin, no soil slab cut straight in front; rendering reads more like pen-and-wash engraving than flat gouache with coarse halftone.
Labels are mixed-case, not hand-lettered capitals; numbers are circled on white tabs as specified.
Format 1024x1536 portrait correct; all six steps, '500 g' sack and '230 °C' oven present; hands anatomically fine; no logo, brand or watermark.

problems: Style not recognisable as a popular-science cutaway: a plain 3x2 grid of vintage picture panels instead of one building with its front sawn away, a storey per step, chutes between storeys.

No soil slab in front, no blank paper above; halftone texture and dulled red/ochre/cream palette are present, so it reads as a generic retro poster filter.
Information architecture unchanged from the default panel infographic (the motif's test).

problems: No cutaway at all: no wedge cut away from a building, no red cut faces, no storeys, stairs, boilers or belts, no small workers in overalls.

problems: Reads as a contemporary saturated/HDR digital photograph of a real beach, not a 1940s indoor sound stage: real sea with breaking surf instead of flat painted bands, photographic rock headland, depth-of-field blur on the jetty
No canvas backdrop meeting the floor in a straight line; only the sky shows a faint painted texture
No ruby-red costume piece or prop, which the style requires
Wood is realistically weathered planking, not painted plywood; pebbles are oversaturated multicoloured stones rather than even-sized studio dressing
Camera is close to the figures, which fill the frame, instead of several metres back framing a shallow set
Palette is vivid blue and tan, not muted dye creams, greys and browns

Motif otherwise complete: woman kneels pressing the plank with both hands, sleeves rolled up; young man in knitted cap hammers a nail; toolbox, rope coil, tin of nails, jetty end, two gulls; neither looks at the camera; hands anatomically fine; 1536x1024 landscape correct; no logos or watermarks

The wall-painting system itself is convincing: red squared grid, whitewash, red-brown outlines, red-brown male skin, blue water with black zigzags, ochre ground strip with red dots, flaking plaster

Crooked nose not discernible

problems: Drifts toward modern illustration: the millstone, flour sack, bowl and especially the scored loaf are modelled with 3D shading and highlights instead of flat colour areas inside outlines
Lettering is a modern typeset-looking serif in red-brown, not brush-painted letters in ruled boxes
Torsos are drawn in naturalistic three-quarter view with muscle shading rather than the strict frontal-shoulder convention
A rotary quern with a handle is anachronistic for c. 1400 BC Egypt (a saddle quern would fit); the motif still reads as a millstone
Step 5: the cloth is being lifted, so the dough is only partly under it
Arrows only within rows (1>2, 3>4, 5>6); the register numbering keeps the order unambiguous
Style elements that do work: red squared grid, ruled ground lines in three registers, ochre ground strip with red dots, blue water band with black zigzags, red-brown men and pale yellow women
Format portrait 1024x1536 as requested; no logos, signatures, deities or hieroglyphs; anatomy acceptable
infographic/ancient-egyptian-wall-painti.note_de: Mühlstein, Sack und Brot sind räumlich schattiert, und die Schrift wirkt gesetzt statt mit dem Pinsel gemalt.

infographic/ancient-egyptian-wall-painti.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf rotem Raster: Rotbraune Männer und hellgelbe Frauen säen, ernten, mahlen, kneten, lassen Teig gehen und backen Brot, in drei Registern über blauem Zickzackwasser.

problems: The loaf in step 6 is rendered with photorealistic crust browning, and the oven has a glowing orange firelight gradient. Both break the rule of unmixed shop-colour clay under white studio lamps

Hands are fairly naturalistic, with separate detailed fingers rather than chunky mitten hands; finger count looks correct
No arrow between step 3 and step 4; numbered grid keeps the order clear
Otherwise convincing: clay-snake lettering on cream plaques, numbered clay discs, snake arrows, wheat sheaf of clay rolls, fingerprinted surfaces, clay landscape strip at top, wooden table front edge

editorial/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf Putz mit rotem Raster: Ein Mann auf der Leiter vernäht eine riesige gesprungene Teetasse, einer sitzt mit Eimer auf dem Rand, eine Frau schultert eine Klebetube.
editorial/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on gridded plaster: a man on a ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup, another sits on the rim with a bucket, a woman shoulders a glue tube.

problems: Backdrop is a sculpted, naturalistic landscape (hills, lake, trees) with atmospheric haze and depth-of-field blur, not flat painted card close behind; violates 'everything sharp'
Mottled, multi-tone ground and graded greens go beyond the dozen unmixed shop colours; overall polish drifts toward the generic modern AI claymation look
Hands have separate fingers rather than mitten hands
All motif elements present: ladder stitcher with needle and thread, rim sitter lowering bucket into the cup, woman with glue tube on shoulder, several cracks, shards at base; open sky in upper third
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); no logos, known characters or signatures; no anatomy errors
editorial/clay-animation-3.note_de: Der Hintergrund ist eine unscharfe, naturalistische Landschaft statt flacher, bemalter Pappe.
editorial/clay-animation-3.note_en: The backdrop is a blurred, naturalistic landscape instead of flat painted card.
editorial/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Knetanimation: Eine Knetfigur auf der Leiter vernäht eine riesige gesprungene Teetasse, eine zweite lässt vom Rand einen Eimer hinab, eine Frau trägt eine Klebetube, ringsum Scherben.
editorial/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Plasticine animation frame: one figure on a ladder stitches a giant cracked teacup, one on the rim lowers a bucket inside, a woman carries a glue tube; shards lie around.

motif_missing: Woman pushes the bicycle down the slope (walking right, front foot lower) instead of up it
Person at the upper window hangs/holds the rug on the clothesline rather than shaking it out
Bicycle's rear wheel is missing (chainring visible, no rear rim below or beside the skirt)
problems: Bicycle drawn without a rear wheel: only the chainring and front wheel show, no rear rim appears below the skirt hem
Movement direction reversed: lane descends to the right and the woman walks right/downhill

Style drift: side lane, receding buildings and cobbles are in modern linear perspective with shutters and a cypress backdrop, so the scene reads as a modern Mediterranean illustration in Egyptian dress rather than ruled registers on ground lines
House number '12' is plain black serif numerals, not brush letters in a ruled box

Strong Egyptian cues are present: red squared grid, whitewash plaster, red-brown outlines, profile heads with frontal eye, red-brown men and pale women, ochre ground strip with red dots, blue water band with black zigzags
Format 1024x1536 portrait correct; no logo, real landmark, signature or watermark; bell tower is generic
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-5.note_de: Die Frau schiebt ihr Rad bergab statt bergauf, und dem Fahrrad fehlt das Hinterrad.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-5.note_en: The woman pushes her bicycle downhill instead of uphill, and the bicycle has no rear wheel.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-5.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf Kalkputz mit rotem Raster: Bäckerei-Eckhaus mit Brezelschild, Hund an der Bank, oben Frau mit Teppich an der Wäscheleine, rechts Frau im Profil mit Fahrrad und Brotkorb.
street/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-5.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on gridded whitewash: bakery corner house with pretzel sign, dog by the bench, woman hanging a rug from a window, profile woman pushing a bicycle with bread.

problems: Style drift toward the generic polished AI clay-diorama look: warm golden light with a glowing shop lamp instead of flat white studio light
Far more than a dozen unmixed shop colours: walls, cobbles and stones have many tonal shades and realistic stone texture
Background is a deep sculpted hill town with atmospheric depth instead of flat painted card close behind; no front edge of the set showing
Figures lean toward a Aardman-like look with sculpted faces and detailed hands rather than ball heads, bead eyes and mitten hands (not a specific known character)

All motif elements present: three-storey corner bakery, awning, unlettered pretzel sign, bench with dog, flower boxes, man shaking a rug from an open window, clothesline to the next building, cobbled lane, woman pushing bicycle with bread basket uphill, generic bell tower, '12' beside the door
Format 1024x1536 portrait correct; no anatomy errors found on hands; no logo, landmark, signature or watermark
street/clay-animation-3.note_de: Wirkt eher wie ein detailreiches Miniaturdiorama in warmem Licht als wie Knetanimation aus wenigen ungemischten Knetfarben.
street/clay-animation-3.note_en: Looks more like a detailed miniature diorama in warm light than clay animation in a few unmixed clay colours.
street/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Knetanimation: gelbes Eckhaus mit rot-weißer Markise, Bäcker im Schaufenster, Hund an der Holzbank, oben schüttelt ein Mann einen Teppich aus, rechts schiebt eine alte Frau ihr Rad bergauf.
street/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay animation set: yellow corner bakery with striped awning, baker in the window, dog by the bench, a man shaking a rug upstairs, an old woman pushing her bicycle uphill.

motif_missing: Hand does not tear a piece off a bread slice; it only holds an already torn chunk over the soup
problems: Style drifts to modern illustration: table drawn in oblique perspective with visible top, bowl as a perspective ellipse, bread with naturalistic volume shading and texture, instead of flat Egyptian profile views stacked on ground lines
Egyptian cues are mostly in the setting (red squared grid, cracked whitewash, ochre ground strip with red dots, black ground line), so it reads partly as a filter or backdrop
Knife beside the board is a plain smooth-edged chef's knife, not clearly a serrated bread knife (minor)
Knife mark in the butter reads more as a broken-off corner (minor)
Format correct (1254x1254 square for 1024x1024); hand anatomy fine; no logo, signature, landmark or watermark; extra basil garnish on the soup is harmless
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.note_de: Tisch, Brot und Schüssel sind in moderner Perspektive schattiert statt flach im ägyptischen Profil gemalt.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.note_en: Table, bread and bowl are drawn in modern shaded perspective instead of flat Egyptian profile views.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf rissigem Kalkputz mit rotem Raster: Auf einem Holztisch Brotlaib mit Scheiben, Messer, Tomatensuppe, Butter, Basilikum, Kirschtomaten, Serviette; eine rotbraune Hand hält Brot über die Suppe.
food/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-4.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on cracked whitewash with grid: wooden table with sliced loaf, knife, tomato soup, butter, basil, vine tomatoes, napkin; a red-brown hand holds bread over the soup.

problems: Heron plumage and yellow iris are rendered more naturalistically than typical tomb painting (minor)
White ripple rings and faint underwater leg reflections are non-Egyptian devices, though the motif requires them
animal/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_de: Altägyptische Wandmalerei auf Kalkputz mit rotem Raster: Ein Graureiher im Profil packt im blauen Zickzackwasser einen Fisch, links Papyrus, Seerosenblätter und Libelle, dahinter Palmen.
animal/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_en: Ancient Egyptian wall painting on gridded whitewash: a grey heron in profile seizes a fish from blue zigzag water, papyrus, lily pads and a dragonfly at left, palms behind.

problems: Glossy, photoreal water with gradients and leg reflections, against the style block's 'avoid gloss' and unmixed flat clay colours
Shallow depth of field: blurred foreground blades and soft background, where the style asks for everything sharp
Background is sculpted clay trees in many mixed greens, not flat painted card close behind
Overall reads as a modern AI 'claymation' look rather than a 1970s-90s TV clay frame
animal/clay-animation-4.note_de: Glänzendes Wasser und unscharfer Hintergrund wirken eher wie moderner KI-Knetlook als wie ein Knetfilm der 1970er.
animal/clay-animation-4.note_en: Glossy water and a blurred background drift toward a modern AI clay look rather than 1970s clay animation.
animal/clay-animation-4.alt_de: Knetanimation: Ein Graureiher aus Knete hält im glänzend blauen Fluss einen zappelnden Fisch im Schnabel, Tropfen spritzen, links Rohrkolben, Seerosen und Libelle, dahinter Knetbäume.
animal/clay-animation-4.alt_en: Clay animation: a modelling-clay grey heron holds a wriggling fish in its beak above glossy blue water, droplets flying, cattails, lily pads and a dragonfly at left, clay trees behind.

motif_missing: The badger does not glance back over its shoulder toward the viewer; its head is in strict profile facing the door
It stands on the ground line at the foot of the steps rather than on the doorstep itself
problems: Egyptian props are correct (red squared grid, red-brown outlines, ochre ground strip with red dots, blue water with black zigzags, papyrus), but the badger is drawn like a modern storybook illustration, with stippled fur, a diamond-quilted vest and a naturalistic satchel
The door frame and steps are drawn in oblique perspective with receding depth, which Egyptian flat ruled painting does not use
The village and palm vignette reads as a pictorial landscape inset, not as successive registers
No gold, deities, hieroglyphs, logos or signatures. Anatomy is fine: knocking paw and parcel paw are clean
Format is correct: 1024x1536 portrait
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Der Dachs blickt im Profil zur Tür, statt über die Schulter zum Betrachter zu schauen.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: The badger looks at the door in profile instead of glancing back at the viewer.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei mit rotem Raster auf Kalkputz: Ein Dachs im Profil mit blauer Mütze, Steppweste, Schal und Umhängetasche klopft an eine Holztür, in der Pfote ein Paket; dahinter Nil und Palmen.
character/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting over a red grid: profile badger in blue cap, quilted vest, scarf and satchel knocks on a wooden door, parcel in paw; zigzag water and palms behind.

problems: It drifts toward the generic modern 'AI claymation' look rather than 1970s-90s TV clay: the background has strong depth-of-field blur, which breaks 'everything sharp'

Instead of painted card close behind, there is a detailed, near-photographic English stone-cottage set with naturalistic multi-tone stonework, so colours are not limited to a dozen unmixed shop colours
The scarf is rendered as real knitted yarn and the tail tip as wool fibres, not as modelling clay
Glance at the viewer is only partial: the head is turned three-quarters toward the camera, but the eyes look sideways toward the door
Motif is otherwise complete: peaked cap, pocketed vest, long scarf, satchel of letters, string-tied parcel, knocking paw, doorstep, short bushy tail, full body
No logo, known character, signature or watermark. Mitten paws are clean. Format is correct: 1024x1536 portrait
character/clay-animation-3.note_de: Wirkt wie moderne Knet-Optik mit Wollschal, unscharfer Steinhauskulisse und naturalistischen Farben statt schlichter Knete vor gemalter Pappe.
character/clay-animation-3.note_en: Reads as a modern clay render with a woollen scarf, blurred stone-cottage set and naturalistic colours rather than plain clay before painted card.
character/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Knetanimation: Ein Dachs aus Knete mit blauer Schirmmütze, blauer Weste, rotem Strickschal und Umhängetasche voller Briefe klopft an eine Holztür, ein verschnürtes Paket in der Pfote; dahinter Steinhäuser.
character/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay animation: a plasticine badger in blue peaked cap and vest, red knitted scarf and letter-filled satchel knocks on a wooden door, string-tied parcel in its paw; stone cottages behind.

motif_missing: The winding road does not link the windmill: it runs past the Eskel hill without branching up to it, so it only connects the lighthouse and the town
problems: The Egyptian look is mostly surface treatment (red squared grid, whitewashed plaster, blue water with black zigzags, red-brown outlines). Under it is a generic illustrated fantasy map

The hill is modelled with shading and oblique relief, the houses are drawn in perspective with red tiled roofs, and there are many shaded trees and palms. This breaks the flat, top-view plan and the flat colour the style block asks for
The land is not a plain ochre ground with sparse red dots. It is a busy green and ochre landscape texture
The lettering is a generic serif map typeface. Only the title sits in a ruled box; Varn, Eskel and Moa are not boxed
The windmill hill sits in the north-west part of the island's body, not clearly in the centre (minor)
Format is correct (1254x1254, square, as requested). No logo, signature, watermark, real landmark, deity, gold or hieroglyphs
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.note_de: Unter Raster und Zickzack-Wellen steckt eine gewöhnliche, schattierte Fantasy-Karte statt flacher ägyptischer Malerei, und die Straße führt nicht zur Windmühle.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.note_en: Beneath the grid and zigzag waves sits an ordinary shaded fantasy map rather than flat Egyptian painting, and the road does not reach the windmill.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_de: Ägyptische Wandmalerei auf Putz mit rotem Raster: sichelförmige Insel Lornholm mit Hafenstadt, drei Booten, Leuchtturm, Windmühle auf Hügel, Wald, Fluss, Zickzack-Wellen, Fisch, Kompassrose und Maßstab.
map/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_en: Egyptian wall painting on gridded plaster: crescent island Lornholm with harbour town, three boats, lighthouse, hilltop windmill, forest, river, zigzag waves, a fish, compass rose and scale bar.

problems: Outlines are very even and vector-crisp rather than brush-painted; the speckled plaster texture is uniform across the whole image, slightly overlay-like
Icon shapes are standard modern flat-icon silhouettes (unavoidable for the motif)
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_de: Ägyptische Grabmalerei auf weißem Putz mit rotem Raster: neun Icons von Haus bis Herz in Blau, Ocker, Grün und Rotbraun, jede Reihe auf einem gepunkteten Ockerstreifen.
icons/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-3.alt_en: Egyptian tomb painting on whitewashed plaster over a red grid: nine icons from house to heart in blue, ochre, green and red-brown, each row on a dotted ochre ground strip.

problems: Forms are rather neat and symmetric, less lopsided than the style asks; reads slightly like a modern plasticine stock icon set
Background is a blue clay slab shot top-down instead of painted card behind a visible front edge (acceptable for an icon grid)
icons/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Neun Icons aus Knete auf blauer Knetplatte: Haus mit rotem Dach, cremefarbener Brief, Lupe, gelbe Glocke, Kalender, schwarze Kamera, roter Pin, graues Zahnrad, rotes Herz, mit Spachtelspuren.
icons/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Nine smeared, chunky modelling-clay icons on a blue clay board: house with red roof, cream envelope, magnifier, yellow bell, calendar, black camera, red pin, grey gear, red heart.

motif_missing: Proportional quantities only approximate: SEP bar about 17% too tall, so JUL:SEP is about 4.3:1 instead of 5:1, and AUG:JUN is about 1.8:1 instead of 2:1
problems: Proportions were measured at full resolution on the shared shelf baseline (y about 795). The bar heights are JUN 190 px, JUL 447 px, AUG 345 px and SEP 104 px. A best fit of about 14.85 px per unit predicts 178, 446, 356 and 89 px. SEP is about 17% too tall, JUN about 7% too tall and AUG about 3% short. The ratios are JUL:SEP 4.3 (should be 5), JUL:JUN 2.35 (should be 2.5) and AUG:JUN 1.82 (should be 2). The order and rough magnitudes are right.
The quay paving in the foreground is photoreal grey stone, not clay or painted card.
The backdrop is mildly soft. The ferry, sea and island are slightly out of focus, but the style block asks for everything sharp. The backdrop is modelled scenery, not flat painted card close behind.
Faces are smooth and fingerprint-free, with a mixed peach skin tone and blended cheek blush instead of one unmixed shop colour. This is a slight drift toward the polished generic AI claymation look.
The board is centred in hero framing, and no front edge of the set is visible.

Two figures were added (a sailor pointing and a girl with clasped hands), plus ferry and lighthouse scenery. They are decorative and do not overwhelm the data. The lighthouse and ferry are generic, with no real landmark or logo.

The chart itself fits the style well. It is a clay relief on a framed board, shot straight on. The bars show fingerprints and smears, and the title and labels are flat-pressed clay snake letters. Each number sits above its bar, and there are no axis titles or gridline numbers. The format is landscape 1536x1024, as requested. No anatomy errors were found.
chart/clay-animation-3.note_de: Die Balken sind nur ungefähr proportional: September ist zu hoch, Juli nur gut viermal statt fünfmal so hoch. Der September-Balken ist etwas zu hoch: Der Juli wirkt nur gut viermal so groß statt fünfmal.
chart/clay-animation-3.note_en: The bars are only roughly proportional: September is too tall, so July is just over four times its height instead of five. The September bar is slightly too tall: July looks only about 4.3 times as large instead of five times.
chart/clay-animation-3.alt_de: Knetanimation: Auf einer Tafel aus cremefarbener Knete stehen unter „LORNHOLM 2026“ vier Knetbalken mit 12, 30, 24 und 6; ein Seemann zeigt darauf, ein Mädchen staunt, dahinter Fähre und Leuchtturminsel.
chart/clay-animation-3.alt_en: Clay animation: under 'LORNHOLM 2026' on a cream clay board, four fingerprinted clay bars show 12, 30, 24, 6; a sailor points, a girl marvels, ferry and lighthouse behind.
text_errors: Proportion: expected SEP bar = 1/5 of JUL bar, found JUL 447 px vs SEP 104 px (ratio 4.3:1 instead of 5:1); at the best-fit scale (14.86 px/unit) SEP should be ~89 px, so it is ~17% too tall. Other bars are within tolerance: JUN 189 px (+6%), AUG 346 px (-3%).

motif_missing: Open shelves hold stacked bowls, not stacked plates
problems: The Egyptian elements are there: whitewash with a red squared grid, flat blue, green and ochre fields, red-brown outlines, an ochre ground strip with red dot triplets and a blue zigzag water band at the bottom.

The drawing itself is a modern flat illustration rather than tomb painting. Chairs, table and sink are in three-quarter perspective with a foreshortened tabletop, where Egyptian convention would use composite profile or top views. The window opens onto a sky and a Mediterranean village with a cypress. The result reads as an Egyptian palette and texture over a contemporary picture-book kitchen.

Everything else in the motif is present and countable: window above the sink, 3 herb pots and a jar of wooden spoons on the sill, 2 mismatched chairs (blue and red), a half-finished jigsaw, teapot and one cup, a kettle on a two-burner stove, pasta and lentil jars, a radio, a wall calendar, a coat on a hook next to a second door, a newspaper on a chair, a bread bag on the counter and a tea towel on the oven handle. Nobody is present.
Correct landscape format (1536x1024). No logos, landmarks, signatures, gold, deities or hieroglyphs.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_de: Tisch, Stühle und Spüle sind in moderner Perspektive gezeichnet statt ägyptisch flach, und auf den Regalen stehen Schüsseln statt Teller.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.note_en: Table, chairs and sink are drawn in modern perspective rather than flat Egyptian views, and the shelves hold bowls instead of plates.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_de: Ägyptisch anmutende Wandmalerei auf gekalktem Putz mit rotem Raster: leere Küche mit Kräutertöpfen am Fenster, Puzzle und Teekanne auf dem Tisch, Wasserkessel auf dem Herd, darunter blaues Zickzackwasser.
interior/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting-.alt_en: Egyptian-style wall painting on gridded whitewash: an empty kitchen with herb pots on the sill, jigsaw and teapot on the table, kettle on the stove, blue zigzag water below.

motif_missing: The stove has three to four gas burners instead of two
problems: Clay texture with fingerprints and smears shows on the walls, table, chairs, stove, coat and calendar, so the set reads as clay animation.

Many materials are not modelled in clay. The glass jars are transparent, photoreal glass with reflections. The tap is shiny chrome and the bread bag is clear plastic. The window view is painted soft-focus. This breaks 'every part is clay' and 'avoid gloss'.

Warm, cosy tungsten lighting and many mixed, muted tones (sage green, several terracotta shades on the floor) push the image toward the generic AI cosy-diorama look. The style asks for a dozen plain shop colours under white studio lamps, 1970s-90s TV style.

The motif is otherwise complete: window above the sink, 3 herb pots and a spoon jar on the sill, 2 mismatched chairs (brown and blue), a half-done jigsaw, teapot and one cup, a blue kettle on the stove, stacked plates, pasta and lentil jars, a radio, a calendar, a coat on a hook next to a blue door, a newspaper on a chair, a bread bag on the counter and a tea towel on the oven handle. Nobody is present. The fridge, boots, rug and dish rack are extra clutter, which is acceptable.
Correct landscape format (1536x1024). No logos, known characters, landmarks or signatures.
interior/clay-animation-4.note_de: Gläser, Chromhahn und Brotbeutel wirken echt statt aus Knete geformt, und der Herd hat mehr als zwei Kochstellen.
interior/clay-animation-4.note_en: Glass jars, chrome tap and bread bag look real rather than modelled in clay, and the stove has more than two burners.
interior/clay-animation-4.alt_de: Kulisse aus Knete: leere Küche mit halb gelegtem Puzzle, Teekanne und Tasse auf einem knubbeligen Tisch, Kräutertöpfen am Fenster, blauem Kessel auf dem Herd und Jacke an der Tür.
interior/clay-animation-4.alt_en: Clay-animation set of an empty kitchen: a half-done jigsaw, teapot and cup on a lumpy table, herb pots on the sill, blue kettle on the stove, coat by the door.

motif_missing: only three leaves instead of four (bitten, curled and one plain leaf present; fourth leaf missing)
problems: Only three leaves on the branch; motif asks for four (one curled, one bitten).

Style drift: rendering is a shaded naturalistic botanical watercolour (vein hatching, mottled fruit modelling, pink blush on petals) rather than flat Egyptian colour fields; the red grid and the dotted ochre ground strip carry the Egyptian look almost alone.
Elements float above the ground strip instead of standing on ruled ground lines; reads like a natural-history plate on gridded plaster.
A leafless side twig runs into the left flank of the fruit, looking like a second stalk.
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, signature or watermark; five petals, bud, ripe lumpy fruit, lengthwise half with core and seeds, single seed and detached petal all present.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_de: Am Zweig fehlt ein Blatt, und die schattierte Malweise wirkt eher wie ein Botanikaquarell als wie flache ägyptische Wandmalerei.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.note_en: One leaf is missing from the branch, and the shaded painting reads more like a botanical watercolour than flat Egyptian wall painting.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_de: Wandmalerei auf geweißtem Putz mit rotem Raster und ockerfarbenem Bodenstreifen: Quittenzweig mit Blüte, Knospe, angefressenem und eingerolltem Blatt und gelber Frucht, darunter Längsschnitt, Kern und Blütenblatt.
botanical/ancient-egyptian-wall-painting.alt_en: Wall painting on whitewashed plaster with red grid and ochre ground strip: quince branch with blossom, bud, bitten and curled leaf and yellow fruit; below, a halved fruit, seed and petal.

problems: Style drift: petals carry soft pink blush gradients and the fruit an orange blush, against the brief of unmixed shop colours even from edge to edge.
Modelling is finely detailed and naturalistic (veined leaves, knobbly bark, realistic seeds), closer to a polished clay relief or sugarcraft than chunky, lopsided 1970s-90s children's TV claymation.
No front edge or painted card set visible; plain blue backdrop only.
Motif complete: four leaves (one curled, one bitten), five-petalled blossom, closed bud, lumpy ripe quince, lengthwise half with core and seeds, single seed, detached petal on empty ground.
Format correct (1024x1536 portrait); no logo, signature or watermark.
botanical/clay-animation-4.note_de: Die zart verlaufenden Rosatöne und die feine, naturgetreue Modellierung entfernen sich vom groben, einfarbigen Knetfiguren-Look.
botanical/clay-animation-4.note_en: Soft pink blushes and fine, lifelike modelling drift away from the chunky, single-colour plasticine look.
botanical/clay-animation-4.alt_de: Knetrelief vor blauem Karton mit Fingerspuren: Quittenzweig mit rosa-weißer Blüte, Knospe, vier Blättern und gelber Frucht, darunter halbierte Quitte mit Kernen, ein Kern und ein Blütenblatt.
botanical/clay-animation-4.alt_en: Modelling-clay relief on blue card with fingerprint texture: quince branch with pink-white blossom, bud, four leaves and yellow fruit; below, a halved quince with seeds, a seed and a petal.

motif_missing: Woman presses the new plank with only one hand; the other rests on the old hull further up (minor)
problems: Style not achieved: reads as a gritty, hyper-detailed photorealistic/HDR digital image of a real seashore, i.e. the generic AI 'cinematic' look, not a 1940s Technicolor sound stage
Sea rendered as realistic breaking waves, not flat painted bands; no canvas backdrop meeting a studio floor in a straight line
Heavy grime, weathering and dirt on costumes, jetty, boat and toolbox, against the style's fresh costumes, clean set dressing and painted plywood
Pebbles and wood carry dense photographic micro-texture instead of satin-finished props
Saturated blue sea and sky dominate rather than the muted cream/grey/brown dye palette; only the sky clouds and the ruby-red vest hint at the style
Woman's kneeling pose is hidden behind the hull (not wrong, just not visible)
Format correct (1536x1024 landscape); hands and fingers clean; no logos, signatures or real landmarks seen
people/three-strip-technicolor-13.note_de: Wirkt wie ein körniges, fotorealistisches Digitalbild an echter Küste statt wie eine gemalte Technicolor-Studiokulisse.
people/three-strip-technicolor-13.note_en: Looks like a gritty photorealistic digital image of a real coast rather than a painted Technicolor studio set.
people/three-strip-technicolor-13.alt_de: Fotorealistisch und detailreich, mit gemaltem Himmel: Ein junger Mann mit Strickmütze nagelt eine Planke an ein umgedrehtes Boot, eine alte Frau in roter Weste drückt sie an; Steg, Möwen.
people/three-strip-technicolor-13.alt_en: Gritty photorealism, painted sky: a young man in a knitted cap nails a plank to an upturned boat; an older woman in a red vest holds it. Jetty, gulls behind.
